column2: 他们幻象中出现了一个遥远的西北王国；他们说我们应该去那里一趟。

column1: They dreamed Issaries took them to a hall full of marvelous treasures, and said that if we acquired more treasures in the next two years, he would reward us richly in years to come.
column2: 他们梦见伊萨瑞斯带他们进入一个满是奇妙珍宝的大厅，并说如果在接下来两年内我们获得更多珍宝，他会在未来年份丰厚地奖赏我们。

column1: Several of them walked beside our ancestors in Sacred Time and learned that the ancestors needed sacrifices so that they would be able to keep our clan magic strong.
column2: 有几位在神圣时间与我们的祖先同行，得知祖先需要献祭，才能保持我们的氏族魔法强大。

column1: The god-talkers rode on a wild raid with Orlanth during Sacred Time. They learned that if we sent no more than a dozen warriors, our first cattle raid this year would be extraordinarily successful.
column2: 神言者在神圣时间与奥兰斯一同进行了一场狂野的劫掠。他们学到了如果今年我们派出的战士不超过十二人，第一次劫牛行动将会异常成功。

column1: They said that Issaries and Orlanth would judge us by our ability to increase our herds: if we could seize or buy more cattle, they would bless us. If we lost cattle, we might be cursed.
column2: 他们说伊萨瑞斯和奥兰斯将根据我们增加畜群的能力来评判我们：如果我们能夺取或购买更多牛只，他们会祝福我们。如果我们失去牛只，可能会被诅咒。

column1: They saw a great map painted by Lhankor Mhy, and warned that another clan would gain luck meant for us if we did not explore distant parts of Dragon Pass this year.
column2: 他们看见兰克·莫绘制的一幅大地图，并警告说如果我们今年不探索龙隘的遥远地区，另一个氏族将获得本该属于我们的运气。

column1: They heard Ernalda crying beneath the earth, and said that our crops might suffer terribly if we did not learn one of her blessings before the year was through.
column2: 他们听到厄娜尔达在地底哭泣，说如果我们年内学不到她的一个祝福，作物将遭受严重损失。

column1: They had terrible visions of Maran Gor, and said that we might suffer an earthquake if we did not learn one of her blessings this year.
column2: 他们见到玛兰·戈尔的可怕幻象，说如果我们今年学不到她的一个祝福，可能会遭受地震。

column1: They said that Odayla would lure all the game away if we did not learn one of his blessings this year.
column2: 他们说如果我们今年学不到欧达亚的一个祝福，他会诱走所有猎物。

column1: They looked deeply into Uralda's brown eyes, and felt that we should learn one of her blessings this year or else our herd magic might suffer.
column2: 他们深深望入乌拉尔达的棕色眼睛，觉得我们应该今年学到一个她的祝福，否则我们的畜牧魔法可能会受损。

column1: They heard the bellowing of a bull, and said that the future of our clan's war magic depended on learning one of Urox's blessings this year.
column2: 他们听到一头公牛的低吼，说我们氏族战争魔法的未来取决于今年能否学到乌洛克斯的一个祝福。

column1: They walked beside the Lightbringers as those great gods strode to the edge of the world. When the god-talkers returned, they said we needed to attempt a heroquest this year.
column2: 他们与光明使者同行，当那些伟大的众神大步走向世界边缘之时。神言者回来后说，我们今年需要尝试一次英雄任务。

column1: They saw a sword hovering above our tula; Humakt wanted us to raid before we were attacked ourselves.
column2: 他们看到一柄剑悬在我们领地上空；呼玛克特要我们在受到攻击之前先出击劫掠。

column1: The god-talkers heard Orlanth laughing and dancing in the hills. They said that we would enjoy good luck if we raided, and that those enemies would be scared or confused and unable to raid us back.
column2: 神言者听到奥兰斯在小山中欢笑舞蹈。他们说，如果我们劫掠，会交好运，而那些敌人会害怕或困惑，无法回击我们。

column1: They saw Vinga finding her spear, and said we needed to sacrifice to her before we went exploring.
column2: 他们看到文加寻回她的长矛，并说我们需要在出发探索之前向她献祭。

column1: They said the spirits of our ancestors were peevish because we were stuck in our ways and not learning anything new.
column2: 他们说祖先之灵感到恼怒，因为我们固守旧习，不学任何新东西。

column1: They heard whispers in a strange language, but could not make out the meaning.
column2: 他们听到一种奇怪语言的低语，但无法理解其含义。

column1: They heard metal ringing in the distance, but could not tell if it was bells or swords.
column2: 他们听到远处金属鸣响，但分不清是钟声还是剑刃声。

column1: They said any children born this year would have great destinies.
column2: 他们说今年出生的孩子都将拥有伟大命运。

column1: Some god-talkers identified good signs, others thought things would go poorly. Nobody could agree.
column2: 一些神言者看出吉兆，另一些则认为事情会不顺。无人能达成一致。

column1: They identified no other omens, and this troubled them.
column2: 他们没有发现其他征兆，这令他们不安。

column1: They said the gods had blessed the clan with more magic this year.
column2: 他们说今年众神赐予氏族更多魔法。

column1: They said the clan's magic was not as strong as usual this year.
column2: 他们说今年氏族的魔法不如往常强大。

column1: They said we couldn't perform crop rituals this year.
column2: 他们说今年我们无法举行作物仪式。

column1: They said we couldn't conduct diplomacy rituals this year.
column2: 他们说今年我们无法举行外交仪式。

column1: They said we couldn't carry out health rituals this year.
column2: 他们说今年我们无法举行健康仪式。

column1: They said we couldn't perform rituals for our herds this year.
column2: 他们说今年我们无法为牲畜举行仪式。

column1: They said we couldn't improve our chance of heroquesting this year.
column2: 他们说今年我们无法提高英雄任务的成功机率。

column1: They said we couldn't perform trade rituals this year.
column2: 他们说今年我们无法举行贸易仪式。

column1: They said we couldn't perform combat rituals this year.
column2: 他们说今年我们无法举行战斗仪式。

column1: During the Gods War, Chalana Arroy conducted many great healings. This quest can heal the sick or wounded, mend a rift in the clan or tribe, make peace with a neighbor, make the quester wiser, or mend our wounds faster in the future.
column2: 在神战期间，查拉娜·阿罗伊施行了许多伟大的治疗。这个任务可以治愈病患或伤者，弥合氏族或部落中的裂痕，与邻邦讲和，使探索者更睿智，或让我们未来的伤口愈合更快。

column1: When Orlanth left on the Lightbringers Quest, Elmal guarded his stead, driving off many enemies. This quest can strengthen our defenses, gain fine horses, strengthen our leaders or the quester, ward against Chaos, or reconcile the weaponthanes.
column2: 当奥兰斯出发踏上光明使者追寻时，埃尔马守护他的庄园，驱退了许多敌人。这个任务可以加强我们的防御，获得良马，强化我们的领袖或探索者，抵御混沌，或调停武器领主。

column1: During the Darkness, Ernalda rescued the bountiful deities who feed our people. This quest can bring back a treasure from the Underworld, increase crop yield, make peace with the elves, make our cows healthy, reconcile the farmers, or strengthen the quester.
column2: 在大黑暗期间，厄娜尔达拯救了养育我们人民的丰饶众神。这个任务可以从冥界带回一件宝物，提高作物产量，与精灵讲和，使我们的牛只健康，调停农夫，或强化探索者。

column1: When Humakt gained the power of Death, Orlanth tried to get it from him. They finally made peace, and Humakt gained a new status. This quest can gain a treasure, bestow Humakt's blessing in battle, defend against undead, reconcile the weaponthanes, or strengthen the quester.
column2: 当呼玛克特获得死亡之力时，奥兰斯试图从他那里夺取。最终他们讲和，呼玛克特获得了新的地位。这个任务可以获得一件宝物，在战斗中赐予呼玛克特的祝福，防御亡灵，调停武器领主，或强化探索者。

column1: During the Darkness, Issaries restored travel, trade, and talking by bringing peace to two warring tribes. This quest can end a feud, improve relations with others, enhance our trade, learn about Dragon Pass, learn new myths, or strengthen the quester.
column2: 在大黑暗期间，伊萨里斯通过让两个交战的部落和解，恢复了旅行、贸易和交谈。这个任务可以结束世仇，改善与他人的关系，提升我们的贸易，了解龙之隘口，学习新神话，或强化探索者。

column1: Lhankor Mhy made a voyage to regain the lost truth. This quest can learn new myths, make our leaders or the quester wiser, fight darkness, defend against Chaos, or learn more about the land of Dragon Pass.
column2: 兰科尔·米伊进行了一次航行以重获失落的真理。这个任务可以学习新神话，使我们的领袖或探索者更睿智，对抗黑暗，防御混沌，或更多了解龙之隘口这片土地。

column1: With Ernalda's aid, Orlanth made the first tribe by gathering his kin and allies. This quest can improve our tribe's mood, reconcile our tribe with another clan, regain the king's favor, gain tribal regalia, ward off rebellion, make our clan king-makers, improve our political reputation, or make the quester a strong leader.
column2: 在厄娜尔达的帮助下，奥兰斯召集他的亲族和盟友，建立了第一个部落。这个任务可以改善我们部落的情绪，调和我们的部落与另一个氏族，重获国王的恩宠，获得部落徽记，抵御叛乱，使我们氏族成为王位拥立者，提升我们的政治声誉，或使探索者成为一位强有力的领袖。

column1: To end a drought caused by a kinsman, Orlanth slew a dragon and rescued Heler, the Rain God. This quest can bring rain, gain a treasure, strengthen our clan or the quester, make dragonewts fear us, or shield us from kinstrife.
column2: 为了结束由一名亲族引起的旱灾，奥兰斯杀死了一条龙并救出了雨神海勒尔。这个任务可以带来雨水，获得一件宝物，强化我们的氏族或探索者，使龙人畏惧我们，或保护我们免受亲族相残。

column1: Uralda found a way to shelter her children with two-legged people. This quest can make our cows more valuable or healthier; gain a herd of cows or a magical cow; increase the cow knowledge of our people or the quester; protect our cows from bad fortune; or gain dominion over bulls and bull-headed people.
column2: 乌拉尔达找到了用两足人类庇护她子孙的办法。这个任务可以让我们的牛只更有价值或更健康；获得一群牛或一头魔法牛；增加我们人民或探索者的养牛知识；保护我们的牛只免受厄运；或获得对公牛和牛头人的统治权。

column1: With Ernalda's aid, Orlanth made the first tribe by gathering his kin and allies. This quest can gain Orlanth's blessing for tribe-making, improve our reputation or political abilities, or make the quester a strong leader.
column2: 在厄娜尔达的帮助下，奥兰斯召集他的亲族和盟友，建立了第一个部落。这个任务可以获得奥兰斯对建部之事的祝福，提升我们的声誉或政治能力，或使探索者成为一位强有力的领袖。

column1: Sea Season
column2: 海之季

column1: Fire Season
column2: 火季

column1: Earth Season
column2: 地季

column1: Dark Season
column2: 暗之季

column1: Storm Season
column2: 风暴季

column1: We revere our ancestors, all the way back to those who so bravely survived the Great Darkness.
column2: 我们崇敬我们的祖先，一直追溯到那些勇敢地熬过大黑暗的先辈们。

column1: Troll god of trade. The Only Old One was his son.
column2: 巨魔的贸易之神。唯一古老者是祂的儿子。

column1: Barntar the Plowman is the peaceful farmer god, backbone of the clan. He is the son of Ernalda and Orlanth. His wife is Mahome, Goddess of the Hearth.
column2: 犁者巴恩塔是和平的农夫之神，氏族的支柱。他是厄娜尔达和奥兰斯之子。他的妻子是马霍梅，炉火女神。

column1: Goddess of Health and Healing, and one of the Seven Lightbringers.
column2: 健康与治愈女神，七位光明使者之一。

column1: God of the Sun. He was rescued by Orlanth, and married into the Storm Tribe. Elmal guarded the homestead when the Lightbringers departed.
column2: 太阳之神。他曾被奥兰斯救下，并嫁入风暴部落。当光明使者离开时，埃尔玛守护了家园。

column1: Earth Queen, and our main goddess. As Orlanth's wife and mother of Barntar and Voria, she's also the Family Goddess, with a pantheon of household spirits.
column2: 大地女王，我们的主神。作为奥兰斯的妻子、巴恩塔和沃里亚的母亲，她也是家庭女神，拥有众多家宅神灵。

column1: The Trickster God. Fool, Outlaw, and Scapegoat, but also one of the Seven Lightbringers, and a friend to Orlanth. He brings trouble to those around him.
column2: 恶作剧之神。愚者、法外之徒与替罪羊，但也是七位光明使者之一，奥兰斯的朋友。他给身边人带来麻烦。

column1: God of War and Death, and of all Endings. He is the patron of the severest of warriors, each of whom has a list of stringent vows to uphold.
column2: 战争与死亡之神，一切终结之神。他是最严苛战士的庇护者，每个战士都有一系列严苛的誓言要遵守。

column1: The Talking God is the God of Trade and Travel, and also of Communication and Conciliation. He's one of the Seven Lightbringers.
column2: 谈判之神是贸易与旅行之神，也是沟通与调解之神。他是七位光明使者之一。

column1: The mother of Orlanth and Yinkin, she is the huge mountain sometimes called Wintertop.
column2: 奥兰斯与银金之母，她是那座巨山，有时被称为冬顶山。

column1: The Knowing God, and God of Lawspeaking. He is one of the Seven Lightbringers. He's the patron of jurors and scholars.
column2: 全知之神，律法宣讲之神。他是七位光明使者之一。他是陪审员和学者的庇护者。

column1: Mistress of Disease, Pestilence, and Plague. She is one of the Unholy Trio.
column2: 疾病、瘟疫与灾祸之主。她是邪恶三神之一。

column1: Earth Shaker and Mother of Dinosaurs. She is Ernalda's grim sister.
column2: 撼地者与恐龙之母。她是厄纳尔达冷酷的姐妹。

column1: God of Hunting. He is a friend of the Lady of the Wild, and of Orlanth's brother Yinkin, the alynx god.
column2: 狩猎之神。他是荒野女士的朋友，也是奥兰斯之弟银金——山猫神的朋友。

column1: King of the Gods, and our principal deity. He led the Seven Lightbringers to renew the world. He made the first clans and the first justice.
column2: 众神之王，我们的主神。他带领七位光明使者重塑世界。他创造了最初的氏族与最初的正义。

column1: Spirit of the local hills.
column2: 本地山丘之灵。

column1: The Cow Mother, one of Ernalda's daughters, makes our herds prosper.
column2: 母牛女神，厄纳尔达之女，使我们的牧群兴旺。

column1: The Storm Bull is unruly and lawless, but his powers are indispensable in the fight against Chaos, which he hates more than anything.
column2: 风暴公牛桀骜不驯、无法无天，但他的力量在对抗混沌时不可或缺——他恨混沌胜过一切。

column1: Adventuress. She is the patron of women born with the heart of a warrior.
column2: 女冒险家。她是生来具有战士之心的女性的庇护者。

column1: Air spirits related to Orlanth and to his mother, Kero Fin.
column2: 与奥兰斯及其母亲克罗·芬相关的空气精灵。

column1: I am not able to serve on the ring just now. Ask me again later.
column2: 我现在不能担任长老会职务。晚点再来问我。

column1: Don't bother me now, I'm too unwell to think about anything.
column2: 现在别烦我，我身体太不舒服，什么也不想考虑。

column1: We need a ring-leader first thing.
column2: 我们首先需要一位环首领。

column1: A clan without a chief is like a duck without web-feet.
column2: 没有酋长的氏族就像没有蹼足的鸭子。

column1: We need a chief. Now.
column2: 我们需要一位酋长。立刻。

column1: A female chief would see that the women's concerns are taken care of.
column2: 一位女性酋长会确保妇女的关切得到处理。

column1: A male chief would see that the men's concerns are taken care of.
column2: 一位男性酋长会确保男子们的关切得到处理。

column1: We need a chief who keeps the fighters busy raiding for cattle.
column2: 我们需要一位让战士们忙于劫掠牛群的酋长。

column1: We need a chief who will build up our herds and our trade goods.
column2: 我们需要一位能壮大我们牧群和贸易货物的酋长。

column1: We need a chief who will build up our herds and our trade goods. I could do the work.
column2: 我需要一位能壮大我们牧群和贸易货物的酋长。我能胜任这工作。

column1: We need a chief to make sure the clash of our warriors' armor doesn't drown out everyone else.
column2: 我们需要一位酋长，确保我们战士盔甲的撞击声不会淹没其他人的声音。

column1: We need a chief to determine who to build temples to and how many to build.
column2: 我们需要一位酋长来决定为谁建造神殿以及建造多少。

column1: I could make sure we use our shrines and sacrifices to better our clan magic.
column2: 我能确保我们用圣祠和献祭来增强氏族魔法。

column1: Shrines, magics, and sacrifices will do us little good without a leader to direct how they're used.
column2: 没有领导者指导如何使用圣祠、魔法和献祭，它们对我们就没什么用处。

column1: Our custom requires a ring-leader, one who will enshrine learning and lore for the good of the clan.
column2: 我们的习俗需要一位环首领，一位为了氏族利益而尊崇学识与传承的人。

column1: Our custom requires a ring-leader, one who will lead us to grow in our own wisdom.
column2: 我们的习俗需要一位环首领，一位引领我们增长自身智慧的人。

column1: Our custom requires a ring-leader, one who can see into the true heart of matters.
column2: 我们的习俗需要一位环首领，一位能看透事物本质的人。

column1: Our custom requires a chief, a knowledgeable ring-leader. Like me, for instance.
column2: 我们的习俗需要一位酋长，一位博学的环首领。比如像我这样的。

column1: Our law and our ways require a clan chief!
column2: 我们的法律和传统需要一位氏族酋长！

column1: The clan needs a chief. I am quite qualified to do the job if you will agree to it.
column2: 氏族需要一位酋长。如果你同意，我完全有资格担任此职。

column1: The clan needs a chief, someone strong enough to lead the warriors and wise enough to listen to the rest.
column2: 氏族需要一位酋长，一位足够强壮领导战士、又足够智慧倾听他人的人。

column1: A chief could see to it that the gods are honored properly with profits from our trade deals.
column2: 酋长可以确保用贸易收益恰当地敬奉诸神。

column1: We need a ring-leader to see that the clan saves its wealth.
column2: 我们需要一位环首领来确保氏族保存财富。

column1: A leader must know the proper value of trade goods and of our treasures.
column2: 一位领袖必须知晓贸易货物和我们宝物的恰当价值。

column1: Without a leader to throw proper feasts and give gifts, what use wealth?
column2: 没有领袖来举办恰当的宴席和赠送礼物，财富有何用？

column1: We need a chief to keep an eye on the clan's riches. I could do a good job at this.
column2: 我们需要一位酋长来照看氏族的财富。我能做好这事。

column1: Without a chief to manage our wealth what use are clever deals?
column2: 没有酋长管理我们的财富，精明的交易有何用？

column1: I'll be napping near the grain bins. Wake me up for the new chief's feast. If you pick me, wake me up in time for the ceremony.
column2: 我将在粮仓附近打盹。新酋长的宴席时叫醒我。如果你选我，及时叫醒我参加仪式。

column1: I'll be napping near the grain bins. Wake me up for the new chief's feast.
column2: 我将在粮仓附近打盹。新酋长的宴席时叫醒我。

column1: The weaponthanes need a chief to rally behind and to send us on glorious missions.
column2: 武器领主们需要一位酋长来凝聚追随，并派遣我们执行光荣使命。

column1: The weaponthanes need a chief to rally behind. I could inspire our warriors to greater glory.
column2: 武器领主们需要一位酋长来凝聚追随。我能激励我们的战士获得更大荣耀。

column1: The weaponthanes need a chief to rally behind and to keep our war-whoops from being lost in the clatter of plows.
column2: 武器领主们需要一位酋长来凝聚追随，并让我们的战吼不被犁铧的叮当声淹没。

column1: Everything I ever try I succeed at. I am elated at this chance to be part of the ring.
column2: 我尝试的一切都会成功。能有机会成为长老会一员，我欣喜若狂。

column1: Someone else could serve the clan just as well. There are other things I want to do.
column2: 别人也能同样为氏族效劳。我还有别的事想做。

column1: So far, I'm content to repay this clan for raising me by using my skills here.
column2: 迄今为止，用我的技能在这里回报这个氏族的养育，我很满足。

column1: Everything I ever try I succeed at. I would relish a chance to be part of the ring!
column2: 我做过的每件事都成功了。我很乐意有机会加入议会！

column1: I would be happy to serve on the ring for a short while.
column2: 我很乐意在议会短期任职。

column1: Now I'm where I can do the most good for myself.
column2: 现在我处在最能利己的位置。

column1: Now I'm where I can do the most good for the clan. Oh, yes.
column2: 现在我处在最能利氏族的位子。哦，是的。

column1: If I weren't of some use, I wouldn't be sitting here. I'd be drinking.
column2: 如果我没点用处，就不会坐在这里了。我会在喝酒。

column1: For whose amusement am I here? Surely mine own, if not someone else's!
column2: 我在这里是为了取悦谁？当然是为了我自己，若不是为了别人的话！

column1: Don't take me off the RING! I don't want to GO! I really really LIKE it here!
column2: 别把我从长老会赶走！我不想走！我真的真的喜欢这里！

column1: Let the whole clan ring go exploring - far away! And we'll see what happens while we're gone.
column2: 让整个氏族议会去远行探索吧！我们倒要看看离开后会发生什么。

column1: At last the clan recognizes my superior wit and wisdom.
column2: 终于，氏族认可了我超群的才智与智慧。

column1: Maybe I'll just quit the ring anyway, whether you like it or not!
column2: 也许我干脆退出议会，不管你愿不愿意！

column1: Me? I'd love a chance to show those grey-beards a thing or two!
column2: 我？我很乐意有机会给那些老家伙露两手！

column1: I know! Don't just put me on the ring - make me chief! Yes, that's the answer!
column2: 我知道了！别只让我进议会——让我当首领吧！对，这就是答案！

column1: A trickster on the ring brings many headaches, but some unexpected boons.
column2: 议会里有个狡诈之人会带来许多头疼事，但也有一些意想不到的恩惠。

column1: The right mix of ring leaders will help us in our heroquests.
column2: 议会领袖的正确组合将有助于我们的英雄任务。

column1: Oh, not the RING! I don't want to do THAT! ANYTHING but a seat on the RING!
column2: 哦，别去长老会！我不想干那个！除了长老会的席位，什么都行！

column1: Not only is it a good idea for me to sit on the ring, I could be chief! Then I could keep myself in line!
column2: 我进议会不仅是个好主意，我还能当首领！那样我就能管好自己了！

column1: If I sat on the ring, the clan could benefit from my years of wisdom. And experience. And insight. Did I already say wisdom?
column2: 如果我进了议会，氏族就能受益于我多年的智慧。还有经验。还有洞察力。我是不是已经说过智慧了？

column1: Oh, maybe I'll just sit in on the ring sessions anyway, whether you like it or not!
column2: 哦，也许我干脆旁听议会会议，不管你愿不愿意！

column1: We would profit most by favoring allies and trade ties. I oppose pointless fighting and bloodshed.
column2: 我们通过支持盟友和贸易关系获益最大。我反对无谓的战斗和流血。

column1: All our battles, what have they won us? I'd rather have allies and trade ties than always be fighting other clans.
column2: 我们所有的战斗，给我们赢得了什么？我宁愿拥有盟友和贸易关系，而不是总跟其他氏族打仗。

column1: What good are weaponthanes without raiding? I know we can win fat prizes and much glory in battle!
column2: 没有劫掠，武器领主有何用？我知道我们能在战斗中赢得丰厚的战利品和许多荣耀！

column1: Marriage bonds, trade agreements, alliances - pfah! The best way to get rich is still by fighting!
column2: 联姻、贸易协定、联盟——呸！致富的最好方法还是靠战斗！

column1: The honor-seat brings the sitter name and renown. The word-arranger brings the honor-seat talent and tongue.
column2: 荣誉席给就座者带来名声和声望。辞令者给荣誉席带来才华和口才。

column1: The young fox is wily and learns new tricks quickly.
column2: “年轻的狐狸狡猾，学新把戏很快。”

column1: The mature fox knows many tricks and wiles to teach its young.
column2: “成熟的狐狸知道许多把戏和诡计，可以教给幼崽。”

column1: The oldest fox is the smartest, having outwitted many snares and hunters.
column2: “最老的狐狸最聪明，曾智胜许多陷阱和猎人。”

column1: The finest oxen in the field must plow the soonest.
column2: “田里最好的牛必须最先犁地。”

column1: All oxen are called to plow the field sooner or later.
column2: “所有的牛迟早都会被叫去犁地。”

column1: Even the oldest ox is harnessed when planting time is near.
column2: “即使是老牛，在种植时节临近时也要套上轭。”

column1: I'm honored to be here.
column2: 我深感荣幸能在此。

column1: I'm honored to serve.
column2: 我深感荣幸能为氏族服务。

column1: I'm honored.
column2: 我深感荣幸。

column1: Me on the ring? I'd be honored.
column2: 我进议会？我会很荣幸。

column1: Serve the clan? Yes.
column2: 为氏族服务？是的。

column1: Yes, me.
column2: 是的，我。

column1: The ring should include someone who knows the most about crafts. That would be me.
column2: 议会应该包括一个最懂工艺的人。那就是我。

column1: The ring needs the person who knows the most herding. That person is me.
column2: 议会需要最懂畜牧的人。那个人就是我。

column1: The ring needs the person who knows the most about crops. That person is me.
column2: 议会需要最懂庄稼的人。那个人就是我。

column1: The ring needs somebody who knows the most about healing. That would be me.
column2: 议会需要一个最懂治疗的人。那就是我。

column1: The best hunter belongs on the ring. The best hunter is me.
column2: 最好的猎手应该在议会。最好的猎手就是我。

column1: The clan needs the best magician to sit on the ring. That would be me.
column2: 氏族需要最好的法师进入议会。那就是我。

column1: The ring is incomplete without the one who knows the most about the law and customs of our people. That's me.
column2: 没有最懂我们族人法律与习俗的人，议会就不完整。那就是我。

column1: The ring needs the person with the best ability to make the critical decisions. That person is me.
column2: 议会需要最有能力做出关键决策的人。那个人就是我。

column1: The clan is likely to be swindled unless I, who have the most devious trading tricks, am on the ring.
column2: 除非我这拥有最诡诈贸易手段的人进入议会，否则氏族很可能被坑骗。

column1: The best warrior belongs on the ring. I am the shrewdest fighter this clan has.
column2: 最好的战士应该在议会。我是这个氏族最精明的斗士。

column1: I don't regret my time on the ring, indeed, it's been an honor. But I could return to the crafts I once knew so well.
column2: 我不后悔在议会的时光，确实，那是荣誉。但我可以回到我曾经非常熟悉的工艺上去。

column1: This is my best work to date.
column2: 这是我迄今为止最好的作品。

column1: I believe my advice is for the good of the clan. At least I try to make it so - "Poor clay never became a fine pot."
column2: 我相信我的建议是为了氏族好。至少我努力如此——“劣质的泥土从未变成好罐子。”

column1: A wide range of trade goods and a wide range of trade will make our clan famous and rich.
column2: 广泛的贸易货物和广泛的贸易将使我们的氏族有名且富有。

column1: I hope I can craft the clan together as easily I created goods.
column2: 我希望我能像制作货物一样轻易地将氏族凝聚起来。

column1: I made reams of trade goods, and knit together many solutions for the clan. Now I could rest.
column2: 我制作了大量贸易货物，并为氏族编织了许多解决方案。现在我可以休息了。

column1: The ring should have at least one crafter to make sure that we produce a good amount and right mix of goods.
column2: 议会至少应有一名工匠，以确保我们生产足够数量和正确组合的货物。

column1: I've learned many things in applying my craft that I could put to good use with a seat on the ring.
column2: 在运用我的手艺时，我学到了许多东西，可以在议会的席位上加以善用。

column1: I'm happy where I am, but if the ring needs a crafter I'd be willing to serve.
column2: 我对自己目前的位置很满意，但如果议会需要一名工匠，我愿意服务。

column1: We should make a wide range of trade goods, and garner a wide range of trade, to become well-known and strong.
column2: 我们应该生产广泛的贸易货物，并获取广泛的贸易，从而变得知名而强大。

column1: I'm just beginning to learn all about my trade! I'd hate to be interrupted for such a stodgy job.
column2: 我才刚开始学习我的行当！我不想被这种沉闷的差事打断。

column1: The ring might well use someone with my experience in making things.
column2: 长老会正需要我这样有经验的人来管事。

column1: This old ox has plowed the clans' fields in more ways than one. And now the bones hurt, and I'm ready for a rest.
column2: 这头老牛犁过的氏族田地，可不只一个样。如今骨头疼了，我也该歇歇了。

column1: This old ox has milked the clans' cows in more ways than one. And now the bones hurt, and I'm ready for a rest.
column2: 这头老母牛挤过的氏族奶牛，也不只一种法子。如今骨头疼了，我也该歇歇了。

column1: I am glad to serve the clan by handling herding concerns.
column2: 我很乐意通过打理牧事来为氏族效力。

column1: I am content in my spot here, but I could plow again if need be.
column2: 我在这里待得挺自在，但若有需要，我还能再拿起犁。

column1: I am content in my spot here, but I could milk again if need be.
column2: 我在这里待得挺自在，但若有需要，我还能再挤奶。

column1: I'd measure our clan's strength by fertile, large herds and lush, fruitful fields.
column2: 我会用旺盛的畜群和丰饶的田地来衡量氏族的实力。

column1: I'm honored to be here, but, I must confess, I worry about my fledgling herds and little plot.
column2: 能来这里是我的荣幸，但说实话，我总惦记着我那些刚起步的牲口和那点地。

column1: I am content to give the clan the benefit of my experience in matters of cows and crops.
column2: 我乐意将自己在牛只和庄稼方面的经验献给氏族。

column1: The ring should have at least one farmer to make sure that crop and herding matters are properly heard.
column2: 长老会至少该有一位农夫，好让种地和放牧的事能被认真听取。

column1: I know my farming skills can be put to good use on the ring.
column2: 我知道我的农活本事能在长老会上派上用场。

column1: Plowing the fields, or sitting on the ring, I do my work as best I can.
column2: 耕田也好，坐长老会也罢，我都尽力做好分内事。

column1: Milking the cows, or sitting on the ring, I do my work as best I can.
column2: 挤奶也好，坐长老会也罢，我都尽力做好分内事。

column1: If I sat on the ring, would I forget my farming skills?
column2: 要是进了长老会，我那些农活本领会不会荒废了？

column1: I plowed land and herded cattle, enough to last me the rest of my life. A seat on the ring would be a nice rest.
column2: 我犁过的地、放过的牛，够我下半辈子用了。能在长老会得个席位，正好歇歇。

column1: I birthed calfs and made cheese, enough to last me the rest of my life. A seat on the ring would be a nice rest.
column2: 我接生的牛犊、做过的奶酪，够我下半辈子用了。能在长老会得个席位，正好歇歇。

column1: It's been an honor to sit on this ring. I could always go back to just tending the sick and wounded, if that's best.
column2: 能坐在这长老会上是莫大的荣幸。要是觉得这样最好，我随时可以回去照料病患和伤员。

column1: This seat lets me influence the clan so that we avoid unnecessary bloodshed.
column2: 这个席位让我能影响氏族，避免无谓的流血。

column1: As long as I am more useful here than in tending the sick and wounded, I'm content to stay.
column2: 只要在这里比照料病患更有用，我就乐意留任。

column1: If only we Orlanthi could all get along like a large, happy family.
column2: 要是我们奥兰提人真能像一大家子那样和睦相处就好了。

column1: When I hear the cries of the ill and injured, it's hard to focus on matters here.
column2: 听到伤病者的哀嚎时，很难专心处理这里的事。

column1: I'm here to reduce the number of bandages the clan goes through in a season.
column2: 我来这儿就是为了减少氏族一季里要用的绷带数量。

column1: A good ring has a good balance - hard decisions must be tempered by a kind soul.
column2: 一个出色的长老会讲究平衡——铁腕决断需有仁慈之心来调和。

column1: I know I could be very useful on the clan ring.
column2: 我知道我能在氏族议会上大有作为。

column1: Honor and justice cry for blood. Without tender healing, honor and justice are hard and dry things.
column2: 荣誉与正义呼唤流血。若没有温和的疗愈，荣誉与正义只会变得冷酷干涩。

column1: I fear I would lose my healing wisdom if I were to sit on the ring.
column2: 我担心要是进了长老会，会失去疗伤的智慧。

column1: After repairing so much damage as I have seen, it would be a relief to stop some of it before it starts.
column2: 见过那么多创伤之后，能在它们发生前阻止一些，也算是种解脱。

column1: The ring has made good use of my talents. Now I'd like to bask quietly, in the sun, for a while.
column2: 长老会充分发挥了我的才干。现在我想安安静静地晒晒太阳，歇上一阵。

column1: The ring needs my keen hunting sense to keep them alert.
column2: 长老会需要我敏锐的狩猎直觉，好让他们保持警觉。

column1: This is interesting work. Unless the clan needs me back in the woods, I'm content to stay.
column2: 这活儿挺有意思。除非氏族要我回林子里去，不然我乐意留在这儿。

column1: The ring should keep all eyes and ears wide open for news of our friends and our foes.
column2: 长老会应当眼观六路耳听八方，打探朋友和敌人的消息。

column1: It's hard to adjust to staying closer to home, and not hunting as far afield as I used to.
column2: 很难适应总待在离家近的地方，不像以前那样能走远路打猎了。

column1: I brought home a forest of game, a skyful of fowl, and rivers of fishes. Now I get to advise and rest. I like it.
column2: 我带回过满林的猎物、满天的飞禽，还有满河的鱼。如今我既能出主意又能歇着。我喜欢这样。

column1: A hunter on the ring is like a warrior on the ring, only sneakier.
column2: 长老会里的猎人，就像长老会里的战士——只是更鬼祟些。

column1: Surely the ring could use my tracking skills, keen eyes, and sensitive ears.
column2: 长老会肯定能用到我的追踪本事、锐利的眼睛和灵敏的耳朵。

column1: I enjoy the hunt. I'd probably enjoy tracking things down on the clan ring, too.
column2: 我喜欢狩猎。我可能也会喜欢在长老会上追查各种事。

column1: I'm happiest when out chasing game, not cooped up inside.
column2: 在外面追捕猎物时最开心，不愿被关在里面。

column1: I brought home many herds of game, and flocks of birds, in my day. The ring might gain from what I learned on my adventures.
column2: 我年轻时曾带回成群的猎物和成片的飞鸟。我从冒险中学到的东西，长老会或许用得上。

column1: All the spells in the world cannot keep us from dying. I could use a little rest before I go.
column2: 世上所有法术也免不了一死。我想在走之前稍微歇歇。

column1: This is the perfect spot for me.
column2: 这位置对我再合适不过了。

column1: I can practice magic whether I sit here or not. Whatever's best for all.
column2: 无论坐不坐在这里，我都能施展法术。怎么对大家最好就怎么办。

column1: It would take powerful spells indeed to get the ring to agree, let alone an entire clan, or group of clans!
column2: 得用多么强大的法术才能让长老会同意啊，更别说整个氏族，甚至好几个氏族了！

column1: I'm enjoying learning the mysteries of the clan ring!
column2: 我正在享受学习氏族议会奥秘的乐趣！

column1: I do not use magic to influence the ring. My long experience gives me all the tricks I need.
column2: 我不用法术来影响长老会。我多年的经验自有一套本事。

column1: Without a magician on the ring, how can we hope that the gods will receive our sacrifices?
column2: 长老会要是没有法师，又如何指望诸神接受我们的献祭？

column1: I'd love a chance to hone my magic skills in service to the clan.
column2: 我很想有机会磨练法术，为氏族效力。

column1: I can practice magic on the ring or off of it. Whatever's best.
column2: 无论在长老会上还是不在，我都能施展法术。怎么最好就怎么办。

column1: Hmmm...maybe a small spell could land me a spot on the ring. But I wouldn't stoop to that.
column2: 嗯……也许一个小法术就能让我在长老会上谋个席位。但我不会堕落到那步田地。

column1: The ring needs people with wisdom, not just people with know-how.
column2: 长老会需要的是有智慧的人，而不只是有手艺的人。

column1: I've given the ring the best of my opinions for a long time. Now I'd like a chance to sit quietly and study.
column2: 长期以来，我一直向长老会进献最好的见解。如今我想安安静静地坐着研习。

column1: Now that I have the chance to serve on the ring, my destiny is shining brightly.
column2: 既然我有了为长老会效力的机会，我的命运正在闪闪发光。

column1: I teach, and as I teach, I learn. This is the perfect place for me, providing the clan agrees.
column2: 我教，我亦学。只要氏族同意，这里就是我最好的位置。

column1: Old stories and customs tell us how to behave now. Sometimes they tell how what to do in the future.
column2: 古老的故事和习俗告诉我们如今该如何行事。有时它们会指明未来的道路。

column1: I'm learning something new almost every day! What a great honor!
column2: 我几乎每天都能学到新东西！莫大的荣幸！

column1: Living as long as I have, I have an ocean of learning to draw on for the clan.
column2: 活了这么久，我积累的学识如汪洋大海，可供氏族取用。

column1: A ring without someone conversant with our law is like a bull without a nose-ring!
column2: 长老会中没有熟谙律法之人，就像公牛没有鼻环！

column1: As a member of the clan ring my opinions would have great influence.
column2: 作为氏族议会的成员，我的意见会有很大的影响力。

column1: Of course I'd like a chance to sit on the ring. When the time is right, I will be ready.
column2: 我当然想有机会进入长老会。时机成熟时，我自会做好准备。

column1: I'd love to interpret laws and customs for the clan! I know most of what I need to know to do that.
column2: 我很乐意为氏族诠释法律与习俗！所需的知识我大多已经掌握。

column1: Yes, I could tell these youngsters a tale or two! Stories that would help guide the clan in proper ways.
column2: 是啊，我可以给这些年轻人讲上一两个故事！那些能指引氏族走上正途的故事。

column1: I may have sat on the ring for a long time, but I still have plenty to say about clan matters.
column2: 我可能在长老会坐了很久，但关于氏族事务，我仍有说不完的话。

column1: I am very useful here, and I like giving people the benefit of my opinion.
column2: 我在此处大有裨益，也乐于让人们听取我的见解。

column1: I do think this is the best job for me.
column2: 我真心觉得这是最适合我的职位。

column1: I could lead this clan. I could lead more than just this clan.
column2: 我能领导这个氏族。我所能领导的还不止这个氏族。

column1: Of course I belong on the ring - why look at how much I've learned already!
column2: 我当然属于长老会——看看我已经学到了多少东西！

column1: Of course I belong here - I have lived such a long life, with so much experience to give back to the clan.
column2: 我当然属于这里——我活了这么久，有如此丰富的经验可以回馈氏族。

column1: Why are the fine families of our clan not represented on the ring? We must not shirk our duty!
column2: 为什么我们氏族的名门望族在长老会上没有代表？我们不能逃避责任！

column1: Of course I want to serve on the ring. What better way is there to learn how to rule?
column2: 我当然想为长老会效力。还有什么更好的方式来学习如何统治呢？

column1: Of course I want to serve on the ring, when the right time comes.
column2: 我当然想为长老会效力，当时机成熟时。

column1: I have a feeling I could be useful to the clan even though I am young.
column2: 我觉得即便年轻，我也能为氏族派上用场。

column1: Many times have I seen the right way to thread the needles of a situation.
column2: 我见过许多次如何正确穿针引线化解困局。

column1: I gladly spent many years serving on the ring, but now I'd be happy with a booth at our market.
column2: 我欣然在长老会效力多年，但现在我更乐意在我们集市里有个摊位。

column1: It's about time they let me keep a watchful eye on our trades.
column2: 是时候让他们允许我密切关注我们的贸易了。

column1: Everything's a trade of some kind. Just make sure to get the long end of the stick.
column2: 万事万物都是某种交易。只要确保自己占上风就好。

column1: A peaceful land, with lots of trade routes - that's my idea of a great land!

column2: 突袭是对其他氏族的全面攻击。

column2: 武器领主是专职战士。他们需要一匹马，两倍于农夫的食物，以及价值1头牛的年度礼物。\n\n新武器领主需要价值3头牛的装备。

column2: 从有前途的自由民中选拔

column2: 从氏族外部招募

column1: There once was a time when gods and people walked the earth together. Your clan traces its ancestry back to those times.\n\nYour clan history begins when you joined the forces of the storm god Orlanth. Back then, Orlanth was simply one of many upstart, rebellious gods bent upon conquest of the world. Orlanth’s unique contributions at that time were personal honor, and a close kinship to the other deities who seemed to be on the winning side.
column2: 曾有一个时代，神祇与凡人一同行走在大地上。您的氏族将其血统追溯至那些岁月。\n\n您的氏族历史始于您加入风暴神奥兰斯的阵营之时。彼时，奥兰斯只是众多野心勃勃、叛逆不羁、意图征服世界的神祇之一。奥兰斯在那时独有的贡献是个人的荣誉，以及与那些似乎站在胜利一方其他神祇的密切亲缘。

column1: After many tribulations, adventures, and discoveries Orlanth proved himself worthy of marrying Ernalda, the Earth Mother. The two formed the Marriage Ring, and created a great harmony in the world through this sacred bond. Your clan took part in the wedding ceremony. Most clans either whooped with Orlanth, or learned a secret from Ernalda. A few clans stood with Elmal, God of Horses and the Sun, as an honor guard.\n\nHow did you prepare for the great marriage?
column2: 历经无数磨难、冒险与发现之后，奥兰斯证明了自己配得上迎娶大地母亲厄娜尔达。两者共同缔结了婚姻之环，并通过这一神圣纽带在世界中建立了伟大的和谐。您的氏族参加了这场婚礼。大多数氏族要么为奥兰斯欢呼，要么从厄娜尔达那里得知了一个秘密。少数氏族则站在骏马与太阳之神埃尔玛一边，作为荣誉卫队。\n\n您是如何为这场伟大婚礼做准备的？

column1: Your men and women donned gleaming armor and stood guard with Elmal, to protect the celebrants from Orlanth’s\nmany enemies.
column2: 你的男男女女穿上闪亮铠甲，与埃尔玛一同守卫，保护庆典者免受奥兰斯\n众多敌人的侵害。

column1: Your men whooped with Orlanth, and drank the Eight Known Drinks, so that your heads would hurt during the ceremony.
column2: 你的男人们与奥兰斯一同欢呼，畅饮八种已知饮品，好让仪式上你们的头痛欲裂。

column1: Your women withdrew with Ernalda, and learned a List of Names, which they promised not to repeat to the men.
column2: 你的女人们与埃尔纳达一同退避，习得一册名录，并承诺绝不向男人们泄露。

column1: Orlanth’s struggle to remake the world was just beginning, and many other gods joined him in it. Orlanth fought Yelm the Bright Emperor, and undertook many wars of conquest. Other, more peaceful deeds were just as important. Your earliest Famous Event was:
column2: 奥兰斯重塑世界的斗争才刚刚开始，众多神祇也加入了他的行列。奥兰斯与光明皇帝耶尔姆交战，发动了多场征服战争。其他更温和的功绩同样重要。你们最早的名事迹是：

column1: The Healing of Orlanth, when the merciful goddess Chalana Arroy joined Orlanth’s tribe.
column2: 奥兰斯之愈，慈悲女神查拉纳·阿罗伊正是在此时加入奥兰斯部落。

column1: The Hundred-Day Hunt, when Orlanth and his son Odayla tracked the Sky Bear.
column2: 百日狩猎，奥兰斯与其子奥达拉追踪天熊之时。

column1: Jested’s Settlement, where Orlanth and Issaries the Talking God outwitted foreign deities in a difficult negotiation.
column2: 杰斯泰德之约，奥兰斯与谈判之神伊萨里斯在一次艰难谈判中用智谋胜过异邦神祇。

column1: The Procession of the Animals, where Uralda\nthe Cow Mother led the sacred herds into\nOrlanth’s stead.
column2: 动物行列，母牛女神乌拉尔达\n带领神圣兽群进入\n奥兰斯的农庄。

column1: When Barntar, son of Orlanth and Ernalda, learned of harnessing oxen to plow.
column2: 当巴恩塔——奥兰斯与埃尔纳达之子——学会用牛拉犁之时。

column1: When Lhankor Mhy, the Knowing God, learned how to use the marking bone, which could mark signs of power upon anything.
column2: 当全知之神兰科·米学会使用标记骨，能在任何物件上刻下力量符号之时。

column1: When Pella, the pottery goddess, made the first pot to store grain in.
column2: 当陶器女神佩拉制成第一只贮存谷物的陶罐之时。

column1: When Roitina, lady of dance, first did the Clan-making Dance.
column2: 当舞蹈女神罗伊蒂娜首次跳起部落创立之舞之时。

column1: Orlanth succeeded in remaking the world. Thus began the golden era called the Storm Age. Orlanth’s son Vingkot was a famous warlord during this time. Most people in the area were his followers. He introduced new principles, such as the rule of hospitality, which said that after you invited people into your steads, you could not attack or harm them. Thus was much treachery banished from Orlanthi society. Many who would not have survived agreed to his new ways in order to gain his protection. He was a great organizer, and helped the many scattered people form into new clans and tribes. Your clan was one of those aided by King Vingkot. After you proved yourselves robust and capable of survival, Vingkot placed a remnant people under your protection. They were the Nalda Bin, or “Stick Farmers.” You had a choice whether to make them into thralls (slaves) or adopt them as members of your clan.\n\nHow did you add these strangers?
column2: 奥兰斯成功重塑了世界。由此开启了名为风暴时代的黄金纪元。奥兰斯之子文戈特是这一时期著名的军阀。地区内大多数人都是他的追随者。他引入了新的准则，例如好客之规：一旦你邀请他人进入你的农庄，便不得攻击或伤害他们。如此，奥兰斯社会中的大量背信弃义行为被杜绝。许多本无法存活的人为了获得他的庇护而接受了这些新规矩。他是一位伟大的组织者，帮助许多分散的族群组建成新的氏族和部落。你们的氏族正是文戈特王所扶持的氏族之一。在你们证明了自己强健且具备生存能力之后，文戈特将一个残余族群置于你们的保护之下。他们就是纳尔达·宾人，或称“棍棒农夫”。你们可以选择将他们变为奴隶，或者接纳他们为氏族成员。\n\n你们是如何安置这些外人的？

column1: As thralls.
column2: 作为奴隶。

column1: As adopted family.
column2: 作为收养的家人。

column1: The foes of the Vingkotlings were many, and your people fought hard against them. Which one of them in particular did you fight?
column2: 文戈特子民的敌人众多，你们的人民与他们英勇作战。你们与之交战的主要是哪一支敌人？

column1: Boztakang the Troll Lord.
column2: 食人魔领主博兹塔康。

column1: Ukkar Gra, King of the Basmoli Beastmen.
column2: 巴什莫利兽人之王乌卡尔·格拉。

column1: Chinkis Mor, the Elf Warlord.
column2: 精灵军阀金基斯·莫尔。

column1: Tada the Green, champion of the flat land\ncalled Prax.
column2: 绿色塔达，平原\n普拉克斯的冠军。

column1: Ves Venna, Warlord of the Ice Tribe.
column2: 维斯·文娜，冰族军阀。

column1: The Storm Age ended in disaster, when the gods and creatures of Chaos came, and destroyed nearly everything. Orlanth and his allies fought hard, but Chaos almost always won. Many gods died, and new ones rose to prominence. Many people died, too. Catastrophes shook the world: the Sun Fall, the Rain of Blood, and the terrible Laughing Tsunami. The Darkness got so bad that even Orlanth and his companions had to abandon humans to their own destiny. Only a few deities, either small ones or weak ones, remained. The world stagnated and died. Your clan was diminished to a ragged handful of hardy survivors.
column2: 风暴时代终结于一场灾难——混沌的诸神与生灵降临，几乎摧毁了一切。奥兰斯及其盟友奋力作战，但混沌几乎总是获胜。众多神祇陨落，新的神祇崛起。无数凡人也随之丧命。灾祸震撼世界：太阳坠落、血雨、以及可怕的狂笑海啸。黑暗愈发严重，连奥兰斯与他的同伴也不得不将人类抛弃，任其自生自灭。仅剩少数弱小神祇留守。世界停滞、死亡。你们的氏族萎缩成一簇衣衫褴褛的顽强幸存者。

column1: Heort the King was the leader who emerged amid the turmoil of the Darkness. The efforts of Heort and his companions helped set the world in order again. He created the laws that we follow to this day. One of the great distinctions which Heort discerned among his clans was that some of them tended towards either peace or war, while others maintained a balance between these two principles.\n\nWhich kind was your clan?
column2: 国王赫奥尔特是在黑暗时代动荡中涌现的领袖。赫奥尔特及其同伴的努力帮助世界重新走向秩序。他制定了我们至今遵循的法律。赫奥尔特在其氏族中辨识出的一个重大区别是：有些氏族倾向于和平或战争，而另一些则在这两种原则之间保持平衡。\n\n你们的氏族属于哪一类？

column1: War.
column2: 战争。

column1: Balanced.
column2: 平衡。

column1: Peace.
column2: 和平。

column1: Finally, the sun rose again. While the rest of society worked to protect themselves, find food, or otherwise just survive, the First Priests worked to re-establish links with the ancient deities. With a new harmony between people and deities, the world was slowly improved. Once the awakening process had begun, it got easier and went quicker as the gods woke each other, too.\n\nWho was the first deity which your clan help to awaken?
column2: 终于，太阳再次升起。当社会其余成员努力自卫、觅食或仅仅为求生存时，初代祭司们致力于重建与古老神祇的联系。随着人与神之间达成新的和谐，世界逐渐好转。一旦复苏过程开始，随着诸神彼此唤醒，事情变得更容易、更迅速。\n\n你们的氏族首先帮助唤醒的是哪一位神祇？

column1: None. Our ancestors are good enough.
column2: 没有。我们的祖先已经足够好。

column1: ~None. We retained worship of our living deity:
column2: ~没有。我们保留了对现存神祇的崇拜：

column1: Elmal, the Loyal Thane.
column2: 埃尔玛，忠诚侍从。

column1: Urox, the Storm Bull.
column2: 乌洛克斯，风暴公牛。

column1: Odayla the Hunter.
column2: 奥达拉，猎人。

column1: Things have been different since the Dawn, thirteen hundred years ago. Orlanth and the other gods retreated from the world, leaving it to mortals. You can still contact them through ritual and sacrifice, or enter their realm by re-enacting stories about their deeds, which contain great magic. But they no longer walk beside you. When you settled in a new place, you marked this great change in the world by naming your land not after a god, but after a mortal like yourselves. You called it Heortland, in honor of the king who taught you how to survive during the Darkness.
column2: 自一千三百年前的黎明时代起，一切就不同了。奥兰斯与其他众神退离了世间，将天地留给了凡人。你依然能通过仪式与献祭联系他们，或通过重演蕴含强大魔法的诸神事迹，进入他们的领域。但他们不再行走在你身旁。当你定居于新地时，你以一位与你一样的凡人之名来命名这片土地，以此纪念世界的巨变。你称它为赫奥特兰，以纪念那位教会你在黑暗时代幸存之道的国王。

column1: About six hundred years ago, a dragon approached you, in either its own form or that of a human with a dragon’s soul inside it. The dragons had always been hostile, or at the very best utterly uncaring. Orlanth was always the dragon-slayer. You had to choose whether to believe it and cooperate and learn to do what dragons know, or whether to maintain neutrality.\n\nWhat was your attitude towards the dragons?
column2: 大约六百年前，一条龙以龙形或人形（其体内有龙魂）接近了你。龙族向来怀有敌意，或至少全然漠不关心。奥兰斯一直是屠龙者。你必须选择是否相信它、与之合作并学习龙所知之事，还是保持中立。\n\n你对龙族的态度如何？

column1: Hostile. We would never believe a dragon.
column2: 敌对。我们绝不会相信一条龙。

column1: Neutral. We didn’t go along.
column2: 中立。我们未与其同行。

column1: Positive. We joined into their dragon knowledge.
column2: 友善。我们融入了他们的龙之知识。

column1: Most of the people who said “Yes” to the dragons moved to Dragon Pass, a land to the north of your home. You stayed in Heortland, and it is a good thing, too, for a little over two hundred years ago, the dragons rose up and ate everyone who lived in Dragon Pass. They ate the Orlanthi along with all of the other foolish human dragonfriends. For a long time, no humans went to Dragon Pass; they were sure that the dragons would eat them, too.
column2: 大多数对龙说“是”的人迁往龙隘——你们家园北部的一片土地。你们留在了赫奥特兰，这也是件好事，因为大约两百多年前，龙群崛起并吃掉了龙隘的所有居民。它们吃掉了奥兰斯人，以及其他所有愚蠢的人类龙友。很长一段时间里，没有人类敢去龙隘；他们确信龙也会吃掉他们。

column1: Recent events made you think twice about the abandoned land of Dragon Pass. A generation ago, a usurper who called himself the Pharaoh came to Heortland and started a civil war. Your clan broke into disputes, sometimes violent, about whether to support the Pharaoh. In the end, your group of dissidents decided it would be better to risk the dangers of Dragon Pass than to stay and kill your own kin, the greatest sin an Orlanthi can commit. Those unable to live under the Pharaoh would move northward to Dragon Pass. People of similar beliefs from other clans had already made the same decision, and settled there. So you made a new clan, just as your ancestors had done in the days of King Heort.
column2: 近期的事件让你对那片被遗弃的龙隘之地重新思量。一代人之前，一个自称法老的篡位者来到赫奥特兰，挑起了一场内战。你的氏族内部爆发争执，有时甚至诉诸暴力，争论是否支持法老。最终，你们这群异见者认定，与其留下杀害自己的亲族——奥兰斯人所能犯下的最大罪行——不如冒险前往龙隘。那些无法在法老治下生活的人将北迁至龙隘。其他氏族中抱有相似信念的人早已做出同样的决定，并在那里定居。于是你们组建了一个新氏族，正如你们的祖先在赫奥特王时代所做的那样。

column1: Your new clan made the dangerous trek to Dragon Pass and selected a place to live. Like the other Orlanthi refugees from Heortland, you settled in Quiviniland, a mountainous area in the southeast of Dragon Pass. You would call these lands your home, or tula. Tradition required you to make a formal land-claim.\n\nHow much land did you claim?
column2: 你的新氏族历经艰险来到龙隘，选定了一处居所。与其他来自赫奥特兰的奥兰斯难民一样，你们定居在奎维尼兰——龙隘东南部的一片山区。你们将称这片土地为家园，或称图拉领地。传统要求你正式提出土地主张。\n\n你要求多少土地？

column1: As much as we needed, no more.
column2: 按需索取，不多不少。

column1: More than we needed, to grow into.
column2: 略多于所需，以备发展。

column1: Lots more than we would probably need.
column2: 远超所需，留有余地。

column1: Huge tracts, far more than needed.
column2: 大片领地，绰绰有余。

获胜的重要条件。
通常最好是
让他人欠我们恩惠，但我们会向某人索要牛。

滑动顶部的控制条
直到“欠下的恩惠”处于
中央位置。

column1: Click “Gorind” in the clan list.
column2: 在部族列表中点击“戈林德”。

column1: (Click the info balloon if you\nwant to hide it.) Click the\n“Emissary” button to send an emissary.
column2: （如果你\n想隐藏它，点击信息气泡。）点击\n“使者”按钮派遣一位使者。

column1: The dialog chose Kulbrast as our best diplomat. Press the small picture of his face.
column2: 对话选择了库尔布拉斯特作为我们最优秀的外交官。点击他的小头像。

column1:
Sure enough, he has an
excellent Bargaining skill,
as well as good Leadership;
leave him chosen. Click “Ask for Cattle” (as a Goal).
column2:
果然，他拥有
卓越的议价技能，
以及不错的领导力；
就选他吧。点击“索要牛只”（作为目标）。

column1: The Gorind clan will be more likely to respond favorably if we give them a few gifts. Adjust the Goods slider to bring 10 cows worth of goods…
column2: 如果我们送上几件礼物，戈林德氏族就更可能给出有利回应。调整货物滑块，带来价值10头牛的货物……

column1: …and click the ‘+’ a few times to bring 8 footmen to help guard our gifts.
column2: ……然后点击几次“+”，带来8名步兵协助保护我们的礼物。

column1: Click “Send” to send out\nthe mission.
column2: 点击“派遣”派出\n任务。

column1: While the mission is on its way, events require your attention. The ring will advise you — when you click someone, their recommended actions highlight in blue. Click the Advisor button.
column2: 在任务出发期间，各种事件需要你关注。长老会会为你提供建议——当你点击某人时，他们推荐的操作会高亮显示为蓝色。点击顾问按钮。

column1: Kulbrast can’t give advice (click his picture to see why). To see the full illustration, click it (click again to show the text).\n\nPick any response — there’s seldom a wrong choice.
column2: 库尔布拉斯特无法提供建议（点击他的图片查看原因）。要查看完整插图，点击它（再次点击显示文本）。\n\n选择任意回复——通常没有错误选项。

column1:
Kulbrast arrives at the Gorind
clan. (Note that only Kulbrast
can give advice.) Choose a
customary response of
20 cows. You’ll see that
you’ve gained cattle.
column2:
库尔布拉斯特到达戈林德
氏族。（注意只有库尔布拉斯特
能够提供建议。）选择一个
符合习俗的回复，支付
20头牛。你会看到
你获得了牛只。

column1: Clans get their most powerful\nmagic by worshipping Glorantha’s many gods.\nClick the Menu button at the bottom right, then “Magic.”
column2: 氏族通过崇拜格洛兰萨的众多神明获得最强大的\n魔法。\n点击右下角的菜单按钮，然后选择“魔法”。

column1: In the list of deities, choose Humakt, the god of war.
column2: 在神祇列表中，选择战争之神胡马克特。

column1: The right side shows magical benefits which a temple to Humakt can provide.\n\nClick “Build.”
column2: 右侧显示供奉胡马克特的神庙能够提供的魔法增益。\n\n点击“建造”。

column1: When you build, the Battle Luck blessing will be chosen automatically, though you can change it.\n\nClick “Build” to build a shrine to Humakt.
column2: 建造时，战斗运气祝福会被自动选择，不过你可以更改。\n\n点击“建造”建造一座胡马克特的神龛。

column1: Another crisis! Choices here impact dealings with two other clans, and the mood of your own. Ignore your advisors and insist that Korol marry her.
column2: 又一场危机！这里的抉择会影响与其他两个氏族的往来，以及你自己氏族的情绪。无视你的顾问们，坚持让科罗尔娶她。

column1:
The matter is not yet
resolved…

Before raiding Korol’s clan,
the Herani, find out more
about them by clicking the Info button at the bottom right.
column2:
此事尚未
解决……

在袭击科罗尔的氏族
赫拉尼之前，通过点击右下角的信息按钮了解他们更多
信息。

column1: Find Heran in the list\nand click it.
column2: 在列表中找到赫拉尼\n并点击它。

column1: At least you’re not allied with the Herani! Click the Info button again to return to the event.
column2: 至少你没有与赫拉尼结盟！再次点击信息按钮返回事件。

column1: Choose to launch\na retaliatory raid.
column2: 选择发动\n一次报复性袭击。

column1:
Now decide who goes on
the raid: footmen (mostly
farmers, who are quite
capable of fighting),
weaponthanes (full-time warriors), and woman
auxiliaries who heal and
encourage. Then scroll down
and click “Proceed.”
column2:
现在决定谁去参加
这次袭击：步兵（大多是
农夫，他们相当
能战斗），
武器领主（全职战士），以及女性
辅助者，她们负责治疗和
鼓舞士气。然后向下滚动
并点击“继续”。

column1: The two forces are about\nto close. Improve your odds\nby clicking the ‘+’ to allocate one point of magic.
column2: 两股力量即将\n交锋。点击“＋”分配一点魔力来\n提高胜算。

column1: By not making sacrifices before battle, you can charge the enemy before they’re ready. Scroll down and click “Proceed” to begin the fight.
column2: 不在战前献祭，你便可在敌人准备就绪前发起冲锋。向下滚动并点击“继续”开始战斗。

column1: Click the ‘×’ at the end of the battle results to see how the clan takes the news.
column2: 点击战斗结果末尾的“×”查看氏族对这个消息的反应。

column1: Done.
column2: 完成。

column1:
You won’t hear from the
Herani right away, but chances
are they aren’t very happy
about the raid, even if they
defeated you.

Click “Done” since there are no
more choices.
column2:
你不会马上收到
赫拉尼的消息，但他们很可能
对这次袭击
不太高兴，即使他们
击败了你。

因为没有更多
选择，点击“完成”。

column1:
Even if no weaponthanes
were killed or injured, it can’t
hurt to strengthen your
fighting forces. Click the Menu
button, then switch to the War screen to
hire more warriors.
column2:
即便没有
武器领主战死或受伤，增强你的
战斗力也
无妨。点击菜单
按钮，然后切换到战争界面
招募更多战士。

column1: Click the “Weaponthanes” button to recruit more fighters.
column2: 点击“武器领主”按钮招募更多战士。

column1: Choose the maximum number of weaponthanes by using the slider or clicking the ‘+,’ then click “Recruit.” You may not always be able to hire as\nmany as you want.
column2: 使用滑块或点击“＋”选择最大的武器领主数量，然后点击“招募”。你未必总能招募到\n想要的那么多。

column1: Click the Menu button, then switch to the Lore screen, which provides information about the world of Glorantha.
column2: 点击菜单按钮，然后切换到知识界面，那里提供关于格洛兰萨世界的信息。

column1:
You don’t need to know all
this right now, but to win
the game, be familiar with
the myths. Sacrifice to the
appropriate deity to learn
their details. These will help
when you reenact the myth
as a heroquest (a heroquest duplicates the feats of the gods to gain magical benefits). Click “The Sword Story.”
column2:
你无需现在就了解所有
内容，但要赢
得游戏，就要熟悉
这些神话。向合适的
神明献祭以了解
其详情。这些将在你作为英雄探险重现神话时

提供帮助（英雄探险复制诸神的伟业从而获得魔法好处）。点击“剑的故事”。

column1: As usual, click the picture to hide the text, or show it again.\n\nA brief overview is shown. Click the “⊝” button to show the detailed version. Click the “×” to return to the Lore screen.
column2: 照常点击图片可隐藏或再次显示文本。\n\n显示简要概览。点击“⊝”按钮显示详细版本。点击“×”返回知识界面。

column1:
Most of Dragon Pass is still
unknown, since your clan
just arrived. You have a basic
idea of the geography from
when people lived here before.
Click the Menu button, then
switch to the Map screen
to see what you know about
your new home.
column2:
龙隘的大部分区域仍是
未知，因为你的氏族
刚刚抵达。根据以前人们生活在此的
记忆，你对地理有一个基本
了解。
点击菜单按钮，然后
切换到地图界面
查看你对
新家园的了解。

column1:
You can scroll or zoom the
map the usual ways. Click
“Explore” to outfit an
exploration party and learn
more about Dragon Pass.
column2:
你可以用通常的方式滚动或缩放
地图。点击
“探索”装备一支
探险队，了解更多
关于龙隘的信息。

column1:
The exploration cross is set to
the north of your clan. Leave
it there, or click where you wish to explore. Then click the
“Send” button.
column2:
探索标记默认指向
氏族的北方。保留
在那里，或点击你想探索的地方。然后点击
“派遣”按钮。

column1:
The clan is under attack! Use
a point of magic, and sacrifice
a cow to Humakt for his favor. Click “Proceed” to get the
fight underway.
column2:
氏族正遭受攻击！消耗
点魔力，并向胡玛克特献祭
头牛以换取他的恩惠。点击“继续”开始
战斗。

column1:
Sometimes a battle has a
pivotal moment, when a
leader has the chance to act
heroically. This is one of those
times. Make a decision, then
proceed to the main battle.
column2:
有时，一场战役会有一个
关键时刻，此时一名
领袖有机会
英勇行事。这就是这样的
时刻。做出决定，然后
继续主线战役。

column1:
Chances are you have some
wounded fighters to tend to.
One quick way to heal people
is to call on the healing
goddess, Chalana Arroy, so click
the Menu button and switch
to the Magic screen.
column2:
你可能有一些
伤兵需要照料。
快速治愈伤员
的方法是呼唤治愈
女神查拉娜·阿罗伊，因此点击
菜单按钮并切换
到魔法界面。

column1: Pick “Chalana Arroy” in the Deity list…
column2: 在神灵列表中选择“查拉娜·阿罗伊”……

column1:
Click the “Healing” button
to select that blessing. If you
have no wounded, just click
“×” to leave the dialog.
Otherwise, choose at least
15 goods for entreating
the goddess, then click
“Sacrifice.”
column2:
点击“治愈”按钮
选择该祝福。如果你
没有伤员，只需点击
“×”关闭对话框。
否则，选择至少
15份谢礼以祈求
女神，然后点击
“献祭”。

column1:
Sometimes, you’ll just want time to pass by. Click the
Menu button to see that it’s
now Earth season, when the
clan takes in the harvest. You
wouldn’t want to call up the
farmers for a raid. Instead,
click the “season wheel” to
advance to the next season.
column2:
有时，你只想让时间流逝。点击
菜单按钮，可以看到当前是
地季，此时
氏族正进行收获。你
不会想在此时召集
农夫去突袭。而应
点击“季节轮盘”以
推进到下一个季节。

column1:
An earlier decision has a
delayed effect. See what
your advisors have to say.
Sometimes matters brought
before the clan ring are not
truly issues for the ring to
settle, so choose “Leave this
matter to her kinfolk.”
column2:
早先的决定有
滞后效果。看看
你的顾问们有何见解。
有时提交到
氏族议会面前的事情并非真正需要议会

解决，因此选择“将此事
交由她的族人处理”。

column1:
Your expedition has returned
with another opportunity.
Decide how to handle it (your
clan ring can advise you). The
newly explored territory will
be shown the next time you
look at the map.
column2:
你的远征队已经返回
带着另一个机遇。
决定如何处理它（你的
氏族议会可以给你建议）。
新探索的领土将
在下一次你
查看地图时显示。

column1:
It’s Dark season, and Minara
reports the final tally of the
harvest. (It’s worth paying
attention to the agricultural
calendar, even if this tutorial
didn’t.) Click the “×.”
column2:
现在是黑暗季，米娜拉
报告了
收成的最终统计。（值得关注农业
历法
，即使这个教程没有
这样做。）点击“×.”

column1: The game keeps track of what’s been going on. Click the Menu button, then switch to the Saga screen, which shows your clan’s history.
column2: 游戏会记录所发生的事情。点击菜单按钮，然后切换到史卷界面，那里展示你氏族的历史。

column1:
Later, you may decide to
restore a game using the
button at the end of each
complete year.

Click the Menu button, then
click the season wheel so more time can pass.
column2:
稍后，你可能会决定
使用每一
完整年结束时的
按钮恢复游戏。

点击菜单按钮，然后
点击季节轮盘以让更多时间流逝

column1:
Although members of the clan
ring are in a sense your
playing pieces, they do have
minds of their own. There are
sound mythic reasons
to have a Trickster on the
ring, but sometimes practical
reasons not to. Remove
Bastakos from the ring.
column2:
虽然氏族长老会
成员在某种意义上是你
的棋子，但他们确实有自己的
想法。让一个恶作剧者加入长老会
有
可靠的传说理由
，但有时也有实际的
理由不这样做。将
巴斯塔科斯从长老会移除。

column1:
The ring now has only six
members, so click the Menu
button and then go to
the Clan screen.
column2:
长老会现在只有六
位成员，因此请点击菜单
按钮，然后前往
部落界面。

column1: Click “Reorganize” to pick a new clan ring.
column2: 点击“重组”来挑选新的氏族议会。

column1:
You can sort the clan leaders
in several ways. Click a leader
for their opinion. Note that
Bastakos can’t return to the
ring for a while. Find Brenna
(she has high Bargaining), then
click the box to choose her.
Click “Reorganize” to appoint
the ring.
column2:
你可以通过多种方式对氏族领袖进行排序
。点击某位领袖
了解其意见。注意
巴斯塔科斯暂时无法回到
长老会。找到布伦娜
（她拥有很高的议价技能），然后
勾选她的框来选中她。
点击“重组”来任命
长老会。

column1:
Although the ring reorganization ceremonies take
a while, there are no new
events to deal with, so click
the Menu button and then
the season wheel.
column2:
虽然长老会重组仪式需要花费
一些时间，但没有新的
事件需要处理，所以点击
菜单按钮，然后点击
季节轮盘。

column1:
A problem has arisen within
the clan. Choose the first
option to try to smooth
things over.
column2:
氏族内部出现了一个问题
。选择第一个
选项，尝试缓和
局势。

column1: That didn’t work — even the most silver-tongued chief can’t always win over the people. Try something else.
column2: 那样行不通——即使是最能言善辩的首领也无法总是赢得人心。试试别的办法。

column1:
You have played one full year
now! That’s it for the tutorial.
Learn more from each screen’s
“More Info” (available from the
Menu button), or the manual
(on the Lore screen).

Click “Proceed.”
column2:
你已经游玩了整整一年
！教程至此结束。
从每个界面的
“更多信息”（可从
菜单按钮找到）或手册
（在知识界面）中了解更多。

点击“继续”。

column1:
Keep playing (with the
consequences of the previous
decisions), or start a new game
from the Controls screen.
Have fun!
column2:
继续游玩（承担此前
决策的
后果），或从控制界面
开始新游戏。
祝你好运！

column1: …then click “Sacrifice” to choose the sacrifice.
column2: ……然后点击“献祭”选择祭品。

column1: If you haven’t already rated the game in the App Store, please consider it. Thanks!
column2: 如果你尚未在 App Store 中评价此游戏，请考虑一下。多谢！

column1: Click “Info” to learn how to play this unique storytelling game.
column2: 点击“信息”了解如何游玩这款独特的叙事游戏。

column1: (To shrink this tutorial box, click it. Click it again to grow.)\n\nYou’re in charge of a clan which just emigrated to Dragon Pass. We begin with choosing your clan’s backstory. Once you’ve read the text, click “Continue.”
column2: （要缩小此教程框，单击它。再次单击可展开。）\n\n你负责一个刚刚迁徙至龙之隘口的氏族。我们从选择氏族的背景故事开始。读完文本后，点击“继续”。

column1: There are no right or wrong answers; choices mold the mythological profile of your clan. For now, click the “whoop with Orlanth” choice. (You can review all your choices before starting in Dragon Pass.)
column2: 答案无对错；选择塑造你氏族的神话形象。现在，先点击“与奥兰斯一起欢呼”选项。（你可以在龙之隘口开始前回顾所有选择。）

column1: Each early event starts your clan with knowledge of a different divine blessing. Again, there’s no best answer.
column2: 每个早期事件都会让氏族了解一种不同的神圣恩赐。同样，没有最佳答案。

column1: If you decide that your ancestors took the Nalda Bin as thralls, they see nothing wrong with the practice. Otherwise, they dislike the institution of slavery.
column2: 如果你决定祖先将纳尔达·宾当作奴隶，他们认为这种做法毫无问题。否则，他们厌恶奴隶制度。

column1: Your ancestors expect you to retain enmity to their ancient enemies, who are still around to bedevil you.
column2: 你的祖先期望你对他们的宿敌保持敌意，这些宿敌仍在四处作祟。

column1: War clans can devote more clan magic towards war, and more of the farmers can muster to fight. Peace clans can devote more clan magic towards crop and herds. Balanced clans are in the middle.
column2: 战争氏族可以将更多氏族魔法投入战争，更多农夫也能集结作战。和平氏族可以将更多氏族魔法投入作物与畜群。平衡氏族则处于中间。

column1: You’ll begin with a shrine to the deity you first awakened or continued to worship. As always, different choices change the game slightly but none is “best.”
column2: 你将从一个供奉你最初唤醒或继续崇拜的神祇的神龛开始。一如既往，不同选择会略微改变游戏，但无一是“最佳”。

column1: Whatever your ancestors chose,\nyou’ll want to treat dragons and their kin the same way.
column2: 无论你的祖先作何选择，\n你应同样对待龙及其亲族。

column1: Larger borders are harder to guard — enemies will find it easier to elude\nyour patrols.
column2: 更大的边界更难防守——敌人更容易避开\n你的巡逻队。

column1: Stick with Normal difficulty and a Short length for your first game.\n\n“Restart” lets you start over and make new choices. Click “Play” to begin the story in Dragon Pass.
column2: 首次游戏请坚持普通难度和短时长。\n\n“重新开始”可让你重新开始并做出新选择。点击“开始”在龙之隘口开启故事。

column1:
Sacred Time is two weeks of magical ceremonies which precede each new year. Here, you allocate the clan’s magic resources for the coming year. Members of your clan council, or ring, offer advice.

Click another advisor for their advice, or the text to hide it.

Click the boxes to allocate a point of clan magic to Crops, Herds, and War, then click “Proceed.” (This leaves a reserve in case you need it later.)
column2:
神圣时间是每个新年前举行的两周魔法仪式。在此，你分配氏族来年的魔法资源。氏族长老会成员会提供建议。

点击其他顾问听取其建议，点击文本可隐藏。

点击选框将一点氏族魔法分配给作物、畜群和战争，然后点击“继续”。（这样会留出储备以备不时之需。）

column1: Click another advisor for their advice, or the text to hide it.\n\nClick the boxes to allocate a point of clan magic to Crops, Herds, and War, then click “Proceed.” (This leaves a reserve in case you need it later.)
column2: 点击其他顾问听取其建议，点击文本可隐藏。\n\n点击选框将一点氏族魔法分配给作物、畜群和战争，然后点击“继续”。（这样会留出储备以备不时之需。）

column1: Let’s check on the neighbors. In the menu at the left, click “Relations.”
column2: 来看看邻居们。在左侧菜单中，点击“关系”。

column1: Relations with the other clans of Dragon Pass are important for winning. It’s generally better to be owed favors, but we’ll ask someone for cattle.\n\nSlide the control at the top until “Favors Due” is in the center.
column2: 与龙之隘口其他氏族的关系对获胜很重要。通常来说，让别人欠我们恩惠更有利，但我们要向某人索要牛只。\n\n滑动顶部的控件，直到“应得恩惠”居中。

column1: (Click the info balloon if you want to hide it.) Click the “Emissary” button to send an emissary.
column2: （如果希望隐藏信息气泡，点击它。）点击“使者”按钮派遣一名使者。

column1: Sure enough, he has an excellent Bargaining skill, as well as good Leadership; leave him chosen. Click “Ask for Cattle” (as a Goal).
column2: 确实如此，他拥有卓越的议价技能和良好的领导力；保持他被选中。点击“索要牛只”（作为目标）。

column1: Click “Send” to send out the mission.
column2: 点击“发送”以派出任务。

column1:
While the mission is on its way, events require your attention. The ring will advise you — when you click someone, their recommended actions highlight in blue.
Kulbrast can’t give advice (click his picture to see why).

Pick any response — there’s seldom a wrong choice.
column2:
任务进行期间，有事件需要你关注。长老会会给出建议——当你点击某人时，他们推荐的操作会以蓝色高亮。
库尔布拉斯特无法提供建议（点击他的头像查看原因）。

选择任意回应——很少有错误选择。

column1: Kulbrast arrives at the Gorind clan. (Note that only Kulbrast can give advice.) Choose a customary response of 20 cows. You’ll see that you’ve gained cattle.
column2: 库尔布拉斯特抵达戈林德氏族。（注意：只有库尔布拉斯特能提供建议。）选择20头牛的习俗回应。你会看到自己获得了牛只。

column1: Clans get their most powerful magic by worshipping Glorantha’s many gods. Click “Magic” in the menu.
column2: 氏族通过崇拜格洛兰萨的众多神祇获得最强大的魔法。点击菜单中的“魔法”。

column1: The matter is not yet resolved…\n\nBefore raiding Korol’s clan, the Herani, find out more about them by clicking them in the clan list at right.
column2: 此事尚未解决……\n\n在袭击科罗尔的氏族——赫拉尼之前，通过点击右侧氏族列表中的它们来了解更多。

column1: The matter is not yet resolved…\n\nBefore raiding Korol’s clan, the Herani, find out more about them by clicking them in the clan list below.
column2: 此事尚未解决……\n\n在袭击科罗尔的氏族——赫拉尼之前，通过点击下方氏族列表中的它们来了解更多。

column1: At least you’re not allied with the Herani! Choose to launch a retaliatory raid.
column2: 至少你没有与赫拉尼结盟！选择发动报复性袭击。

column1: Choose to launch a retaliatory raid.
column2: 选择发动报复性袭击。

column1: Now decide who goes on the raid: footmen (mostly farmers, who are quite capable of fighting), weaponthanes (full-time warriors), and woman auxiliaries who heal and encourage. Then click “Proceed.”
column2: 现在决定谁参与袭击：步兵（大多是农夫，相当擅长战斗）、武器领主（全职战士）以及负责治疗和鼓舞的女性辅助者。然后点击“继续”。

column1: The two forces are about to close. Improve your odds by clicking the ‘+’ to allocate one point of magic.
column2: 两股力量即将交锋。点击“+”分配一点魔法来提升胜算。

column1: By not making sacrifices before battle, you can charge the enemy before they’re ready. Click “Proceed” to begin the fight.
column2: 战前不进行献祭，就能在敌人准备就绪前发起冲锋。点击“前进”开始战斗。

column1:
You won’t hear from the Herani right away, but chances are they aren’t
very happy about the raid,
even if they defeated you.

Click “Done” since there are no more choices.
column2:
你不会立刻收到赫拉尼的消息，但很可能他们
对这次袭击不太高兴，
即使你击败了他们。

没有更多选择，点击“完成”。

column1: Even if no weaponthanes were killed or injured, it can’t hurt to strengthen your fighting forces. Switch to the War screen to hire more warriors.
column2: 即使没有武器领主阵亡或受伤，增强战斗力量也总没坏处。切换到战争界面雇佣更多战士。

column1:
Choose the maximum number of
weaponthanes by using the slider or
clicking the ‘+,’ then click “Recruit.”
You may not always be able to hire
as many as you want.
column2:
使用滑块或
点击“+”选择最大数量的
武器领主，然后点击“招募”。
你并非总能雇到
你想要的数量。

column1: Switch to the Lore screen, which provides information about the world of Glorantha.
column2: 切换到知识界面，那里提供关于格洛兰萨世界的信息。

column1: You don’t need to know all this right now, but to win the game, be familiar with the myths. Sacrifice to the appropriate deity to learn their details. These will help when you reenact the myth as a heroquest (a heroquest duplicates the feats of the gods to gain magical benefits).\n\nClick “The Sword Story.”
column2: 你不需要现在全部了解，但要赢得游戏，就得熟悉神话。向适当的神祇献祭以了解详情。当你以英雄任务（英雄任务重现神的功绩以获取魔法增益）重演神话时，这些知识会有帮助。\n\n点击“剑的故事”。

column1: A brief overview is shown. Click the “.” button to show the detailed version. Click the “×” to return to the Lore screen.
column2: 显示简要概览。点击“.”按钮显示详细版本。点击“×”返回知识界面。

column1: Most of Dragon Pass is still unknown,\nsince your clan just arrived. You have a basic idea of the geography from when people lived here before. Switch to the Map screen to see what you know about\nyour new home.
column2: 龙隘的大部分地区仍然未知，\n因为你的氏族刚刚抵达。你对人们从前居住时的地理有个基本概念。切换到地图界面看看你了解\n新家园的哪些情况。

column1:
You can scroll or zoom the map
the usual ways. Click “Explore” to outfit
an exploration party and learn more
about Dragon Pass.
column2:
你可以
用常规方式滚动或缩放地图。点击“探索”来组建
一支探险队，了解更多
关于龙隘的信息。

column1:
The exploration cross is set to the north
of your clan. Leave it there, or click
where you wish to explore.
Then click the “Send” button.
column2:
探索十字标设置在氏族的北方
。保持原样，或者点击
你想探索的地方。
然后点击“派遣”按钮。

column1: The clan is under attack!\nUse a point of magic, and sacrifice a cow to Humakt for his favor. Click “Proceed” to get the fight underway.
column2: 氏族遭到攻击！\n使用一点魔法，并向胡玛克特献祭一头牛以获取他的恩惠。点击“前进”开始战斗。

column1: Sometimes a battle has a pivotal moment, when a leader has the chance to act heroically. This is one of those times.\nMake a decision, then proceed to the main battle.
column2: 有时战斗会有关键时刻，领袖有机会展现英雄气概。此刻便是。\n做出决定，然后继续主要战斗。

column1: Chances are you have some wounded fighters to tend to. One quick way\nto heal people is to call on the healing goddess, Chalana Arroy, so switch to the Magic screen.
column2: 你可能有些伤员需要照料。快速治疗\n的方法之一是呼唤治愈女神——查拉娜·阿罗伊，所以切换到魔法界面。

column1: Click the “Healing” button to select that blessing. If you have no wounded, just click “×” to leave the dialog. Otherwise, choose at least 15 goods for entreating the goddess, then click “Sacrifice.”
column2: 点击“治愈”按钮选择该祝福。如果没有伤员，只需点击“×”关闭对话框。否则，选择至少15件货物来恳求女神，然后点击“献祭”。

column1: Sometimes, you’ll just want time to pass by. At the upper left, note that it’s now Earth season, when the clan takes in the harvest. You wouldn’t want to call up the farmers for a raid. Instead, click the “season wheel” to advance to the next season.
column2: 有时你只是想时间流逝。左上角提示现在是地季，氏族正在收获。你不会想召集农夫去袭击。相反，点击“季节轮”推进到下一个季节。

column1: An earlier decision has a delayed effect. See what your advisors have to say. Sometimes matters brought before the clan ring are not truly issues for the\nring to settle, so choose “Leave this matter to her kinfolk.”
column2: 之前的决定有延迟效果。看看你的顾问怎么说。有时提交给氏族议会的事项并非真正需要\n议会来解决，所以选择“将此事交给她的族人处理”。

column1: Your expedition has returned with another opportunity. Decide how to handle it (your clan ring can advise you). The newly explored territory will be shown the next time you look at the map.
column2: 你的远征队带回了另一个机会。决定如何处理（你的氏族议会可以给你建议）。新探索的领土将在下次查看地图时显示。

column1: It’s Dark season, and Minara reports the final tally of the harvest. (It’s worth paying attention to the agricultural calendar, even if this tutorial didn’t.) Click the “×.”
column2: 现在是暗之季，米娜拉汇报了收成的最终数字。（即使本教程没有，也值得关注农业历法。）点击“×”。

column1: The game keeps track of what’s been going on. Switch to the Saga screen, which shows your clan’s history.
column2: 游戏会记录发生过的事情。切换到史卷界面，那里显示氏族的历史。

column1:
Later, you may decide to restore a game by using the 'Restore' button.

Click the season wheel so more time
can pass.
column2:
之后，你可能会通过“恢复”按钮来恢复游戏。

点击季节轮让更多时间
流逝。

column1: Although members of the clan ring are in a sense your playing pieces, they do have minds of their own. There are sound mythic reasons to have a Trickster on the ring, but sometimes practical reasons not to. Remove Bastakos from the ring.
column2: 虽然氏族议会的成员在某种意义上是你的棋子，但他们有自己的想法。让一个恶作剧者加入议会有神话上的充分理由，但有时也有实际理由不这样做。将巴斯塔科斯从议会中移除。

column1: The ring now has only six members, so go to the Clan screen.
column2: 议会现在只有六名成员，所以前往部落界面。

column1: You can sort the clan leaders in several ways. Click a leader for their opinion. Note that Bastakos can’t return to the ring for a while. Find Brenna (she has high Bargaining), then click the box to choose her. Click “Reorganize” to appoint the ring.
column2: 你可以用多种方式对氏族领袖排序。点击一位领袖查看其意见。注意巴斯塔科斯暂时无法回到议会。找到布伦娜（她拥有高超的议价技能），然后点击方框选中她。点击“重组”任命议会。

column1:
Although the ring reorganization
ceremonies take a while, there are no
new events to deal with, so click
the season wheel.
column2:
虽然议会重组
仪式需要一段时间，但没有
新事件要处理，所以点击
季节轮。

column1: A problem has arisen within the clan. Choose the first option to try\nto smooth things over.
column2: 氏族内部出现了问题。选择第一个选项试图\n化解矛盾。

column1:
You have played one full year now!
That’s it for the tutorial.
Learn more from the manual.

Click “Proceed.”
column2:
你已经玩满一整年了！
教程到此结束。
从手册中了解更多。

点击“前进”。

column1:
You have played one full year now!
That’s it for the tutorial.
Learn more from the manual.

Keep playing (with the consequences of the previous decisions), or start a new game from the Controls screen. Have fun!
column2:
你已经玩满一整年了！
教程到此结束。
更多内容请参阅手册。

继续游玩（接受先前决策的后果），或从控制界面开始新游戏。祝你好运！

column1: …then click “Sacrifice” to choose\nthe sacrifice.
column2: …然后点击“献祭”以选择\n祭品。

column1: Sick and wounded people get better over time; switch to the Magic screen and sacrifice to Chalana Arroy to hasten the process.
column2: 伤病者会随时间康复；切换到魔法界面并献祭给查拉娜·阿罗伊以加速进程。

column1: Most of your people are farmers, but a few specialize. Change the task assignment and the number assigned to different tasks by tapping the appropriate button.
column2: 你的人民大多是农夫，但少数人专精于其他领域。点击相应按钮可更改任务分配和人数。

column1: Thralls are treated as property. If you have any, you can free them by pressing the button.
column2: 奴隶被视为财产。如果你有奴隶，可以按下按钮释放他们。

column1: Clans can focus their energies on war magic, peace magic, or a balance between the two. Click Reorganize to change this. Reorganize also lets you pick a new clan ring of advisors.
column2: 氏族可以将力量集中于战争魔法、和平魔法，或两者平衡。点击“重组”可更改此设定。重组也可让你挑选新的氏族顾问议会。

column1: The clan mood is an aggregate of popular sentiment. You can improve people’s opinions by holding feasts or distributing goods as gifts. Or sacrifice for Chalana Arroy’s Hope blessing.
column2: 氏族情绪是民众情感的综合体现。你可以通过举办宴席或分发礼物来改善人们的看法。也可以为查拉娜·阿罗伊的希望祝福进行献祭。

column1: The Sound controls let you choose whether or not to play music while in management screens or interactive scenes, and whether or not to play sound effects in dialogs.
column2: 声音控制让你选择是否在管理界面或互动场景中播放音乐，以及是否在对话框中播放音效。

column1: Click New Game to start a new game. King of Dragon Pass saves a single game, so be sure you’re giving up before restarting.
column2: 点击新游戏开始新游戏。龙隘之王仅保存一个存档，请确保在重新开始前放弃当前游戏。

column1: Have questions?\na-sharp.com/kodp/faq.html has answers.
column2: 有疑问？\na-sharp.com/kodp/faq.html 有答案。

column1: We’re happy to hear from you via our Facebook page www.facebook.com/ASharpLLC or Twitter @KingDragonPass. If you find a problem with the game, please visit a-sharp.com/support (we have no way of answering App Store comments).
column2: 我们期待通过我们的脸书页面 www.facebook.com/ASharpLLC 或推特 @KingDragonPass 收到您的来信。如果您发现游戏存在问题，请访问 a-sharp.com/support（我们无法回复应用商店评论）。

column1: This screen lets you allocate land among different food production. Food is measured in Ernalda’s Bushels. One Bushel of food will feed one person for a year (though some classes of people expect more).
column2: 此界面让您在不同食物生产之间分配土地。食物以厄娜尔达的蒲式耳计量。一蒲式耳食物可养活一人一年（但某些阶层的人期望更多）。

column1: Click the Slaughter button to convert some of your livestock into food.
column2: 点击屠宰按钮将部分牲畜转化为食物。

column1: Only the most valuable herds are shown, but your clan also keeps sheep, pigs, and domestic fowls. Given enough Pastures, there are about twice as many sheep as cows. With sufficient Wildlands, there are about twice as many pigs as cows.
column2: 只显示最有价值的畜群，但您的氏族还饲养绵羊、猪和家禽。如果有足够的牧场，绵羊数量大约是牛的两倍。如果有足够的荒野，猪数量大约是牛的两倍。

column1: The Land sliders allocate your clan’s land use. Land is measured in hides. One hide is enough land to support a family. Pastures are converted to or from Cropland. Wildlands are cleared to become Pastures.
column2: 土地滑块分配您的氏族土地使用。土地以海德计量。一海德足够养活一户家庭。牧场可与耕地互相转换。荒野可被开垦为牧场。

column1: The Lore screen shows important myths your clan knows. Many of these have secrets which you can learn by communing with the gods (sacrifice for Mysteries on the Magic screen).
column2: 知识界面显示您氏族知晓的重要神话。其中许多含有奥秘，您可以通过与神祇沟通来学习（在魔法界面为奥秘进行献祭）。

column1: It also has stories about important historical events, information about the Orlanthi culture, and a map of the region around Dragon Pass.
column2: 它还包含关于重要历史事件的故事、奥兰提文化的信息，以及龙隘周边区域的地图。

column1: Click an item to read it. This shows the summary version of the myth or story. To see more detail, click the Details ⊝ (or Secrets ⊜) button. To see the picture, click it. Click it again to show the text.
column2: 点击条目进行阅读。显示神话或故事的摘要版本。要查看详情，点击详情 ⦿（或奥秘 ⦾）按钮。要查看图片，点击图片。再次点击显示文字。

column1: Click the Manual button for a detailed manual that you can page through.
column2: 点击手册按钮可获取可翻页的详细手册。

column1: Every clan member knows some magic, but the largest magical effects are obtained from the gods. The list shows deities you know how to contact, their identifying rune, what sort of temple you have (if any), and whether you’ve sacrificed in the past year.
column2: 氏族每个成员都知晓一些魔法，但最强大的魔法效果来自神祇。列表显示您知晓如何联系的神祇、其标识符文、您拥有的神殿类型（如有），以及您在过去一年中是否献祭过。

column1: Click a deity, then click Sacrifice for a one-time, short-term blessing.
column2: 点击一位神祇，然后点击献祭以获得一次性、短期的祝福。

column1: To change temple size, click a deity, then the Build button. Having allies and tribe-mates allows you to build more and bigger temples in exchange for sharing blessings.
column2: 要改变神殿规模，点击一位神祇，然后点击建造按钮。拥有盟友和部落同胞后，您可以建造更多更大的神殿，以分享祝福作为交换。

column1: Temples provide continual blessings. To choose them, click the deity, then turn on the appropriate checkboxes (you may have to turn off an existing blessing first). Larger temples provide more blessings.
column2: 神殿提供持续祝福。要选择它们，点击神祇，然后开启相应的复选框（您可能需要先关闭已有的祝福）。更大的神殿提供更多祝福。

column1: Heroquests are the reenactment of myths on the Other Side. If the quest is successful, the clan can reap impressive magical benefits. If it’s a failure, the entire clan may suffer.
column2: 英雄任务是在彼岸对神话的重演。如果任务成功，氏族可收获令人印象深刻的魔法利益。如果失败，整个氏族可能遭受苦难。

column1: Before heroquesting, review the myth in the Lore screen. You need to know the details of a myth in order to reenact it. During a quest, you can use a hint to show the response that best fits the myth. Things don’t always go according to plan, so the myth can’t offer guidance for every situation.
column2: 在英雄任务之前，先在知识界面重温神话。您需要了解神话的细节才能重演它。在任务期间，您可以使用提示来显示最符合神话的回应。事情并不总是按计划进行，因此神话无法为每种情况提供指引。

column1: This screen marks heroquests you’ve performed with ★.
column2: 此界面会以★标记您已完成的英雄任务。

column1: The map shows how much of Dragon Pass your explorers or emissaries have visited at least once.
column2: 地图显示您的探索者或使者至少访问过一次的龙隘区域。

column1: Click Explore to send out an exploration party. Choose a leader by pressing his name, and provide guards. Click the map, and the exploration cross will move there, showing where your party is headed. Set a speed (faster exploration is riskier), and click Explore.
column2: 点击探索派出探索队。按下名字选择队长，并提供护卫。点击地图，探索十字标将移动到那里，显示您的队伍前往的方向。设置速度（更快的探索风险更高），然后点击探索。

column1: You can explore regions multiple times, and can find something different almost every time. This even goes for your own clan tula (which is where the exploration cross begins).
column2: 您可以多次探索区域，几乎每次都能发现不同的东西。这同样适用于您自己的氏族图拉领地（即探索十字标的起始位置）。

column1: This screen shows the other clans of Dragon Pass. Pressing a clan name shows what you know about it, and scrolls the map to show its location. (Nearby clans are marked with ‘ɴ.’) Click an item above the list to filter (i.e. to show only allied clans). Or just slide the item to the center.
column2: 此界面显示龙隘的其他氏族。按下氏族名称显示您对该氏族的了解，并滚动地图显示其位置。（附近氏族用‘ɴ’标记。）点击列表上方的条目进行筛选（例如只显示盟友氏族）。或者将条目滑动到中央。

column1: Click the Emissary button to send a diplomatic mission.
column2: 点击使者按钮派遣外交使团。

column1: Once you’ve formed a tribe, the Tribe button lets you choose how to handle routine clan moots. And clans in your tribe are marked with ‘τ.’
column2: 一旦您组建了部落，部落按钮让您选择如何处理常规氏族集会。您部落内的氏族以‘τ’标记。

column1: On the map, feuding clans are shown in red, allied clans are shown in blue, and colors in between indicate the relative attitude of other clans. Change the magnification with the usual pinch/zoom gestures.
column2: 在地图上，敌对氏族以红色显示，盟友氏族以蓝色显示，中间颜色表示其他氏族的相对态度。通过常用的捏合/缩放手势改变放大倍率。

column1: The Saga screen is your clan’s history in Dragon Pass. It automatically keeps track of the most important events.
column2: 史卷界面是您的氏族在龙隘的历史。它自动记录最重要的事件。

column1: “Lore” summarizes your clan’s God Time history; it can refresh your memory of your starting choices.
column2: “知识”总结您的氏族在神代的历史；可刷新您对初始选择的记忆。

column1: Each year’s saga begins with its omen, so you can easily be sure to follow up on any course of action it suggested.
column2: 每年的传说始于其征兆，这样你就能轻松确保跟进它建议的任何行动路线。

column1: At the end of every complete year is a Restore button. Click this to rewind time to that point. Once you go back, any subsequent progress is lost.
column2: 每个完整年份的末尾都有一个恢复按钮。点击它可将时间倒回至那一点。一旦回退，之后的所有进度都会丢失。

column1: This screen lists clans you’ve established trade routes with. It shows how large and frequent the clan market is, and any exotic trade items you’ve discovered. It also lists any treasures the clan owns. Click a treasure for an explanation.
column2: 此界面列出与你建立贸易路线的氏族。它显示氏族市场的规模和活跃频率，以及你发现的所有异域贸易品。同时列出氏族拥有的任何宝物。点击宝物可查看说明。

column1: Click the Caravan button to send a trade mission.
column2: 点击商队按钮派遣贸易任务。

column1: Click the Map button to show the map. On the map, feuding clans are shown in red, allied clans are shown in blue, and colors in between indicate the relative attitude of other clans. Lines show your trade routes. Change the magnification with the usual pinch/zoom gestures.
column2: 点击地图按钮显示地图。地图上，敌对氏族以红色显示，同盟氏族以蓝色显示，中间的颜色表示其他氏族的相对态度。线条显示你的贸易路线。使用常规捏合/缩放手势改变放大比例。

column1: The clan’s military consists of a small number of mounted warriors (weaponthanes), and any able-bodied men (and women) who can be mustered.
column2: 氏族的军队由少量骑兵（武器领主）和任何能征集的健壮男女组成。

column1: Adjust the number of weaponthanes by pressing the button.
column2: 通过按钮调整武器领主的数量。

column1: Cattle raids are attempts to steal cows without being seen. Raids are full-blown attacks on another clan.
column2: 偷牛是试图在不被发现的情况下偷走牛只。袭击则是对另一个氏族的全面攻击。

column1: In Raid lists, a sword shows where you won a battle, a broken sword where you lost. A cow head indicates a successful cattle raid, a faded cow head shows an unsuccessful cattle raid.
column2: 在袭击列表中，剑表示你赢得战斗的地点，断剑表示你失败的地点。牛头表示一次成功的偷牛行动，暗淡的牛头表示一次失败的偷牛行动。

column1: Fortifications help if you’re attacked. Click Fortify to build one.
column2: 防御工事在你遭到攻击时有所帮助。点击“加固”来建造一个。

column1: Achievements
column2: 成就

column1: Your device must support Game Center. For example, an iPhone 3G does not.
column2: 你的设备必须支持 Game Center。例如，iPhone 3G 不支持。

column1: While the basic goal of KoDP is kingly victory, there are plenty of other goals. Achievements provide a way to track them (and share them with your friends). To enable achievements, you must log in to Game Center. You can do this when the game starts, or use the Game Center app before launching KoDP.
column2: 虽然《龙之隘口之王》的基本目标是王者胜利，但还有许多其他目标。成就提供了一种追踪（以及与朋友分享）这些目标的方式。要启用成就，你必须登录 Game Center。你可以在游戏开始时进行此操作，或在启动《龙之隘口之王》前使用 Game Center 应用。

column1: Achievements include such things as collecting many treasures, winning not only as a king but as a queen, or exploring every last bit of the map. Some (like becoming Queen of Dragon Pass) are all or nothing. For others, you can see your progress.
column2: 成就包括收集众多宝物、不仅作为国王还作为女王获胜，或者探索地图的每一寸角落。有些（例如成为龙之隘口女王）是零和一的。对于其他成就，你可以看到自己的进度。

column1: You’ll get a brief on-screen indication when you earn an achievement. You can review your achievements by tapping the trophy button in the Controls screen, or in the Game Center app. (You’ll need to be connected to the Internet.)
column2: 当你获得成就时，屏幕会显示简短提示。你可以通过点击控制界面中的奖杯按钮，或在 Game Center 应用中查看你的成就。（你需要连接互联网。）

column1: Note that not every possible achievement will be listed. Accomplishing some achievements may reveal new ones, while others you’ll earn due to story events.
column2: 请注意，并非所有可能的成就都会被列出。完成一些成就可能会揭示新的成就，而另一些则会因故事事件而获得。

column1: Starting a new game doesn’t reset your achievements — after all, you might want to win both as a Queen and a King. If you want to start over, you can clear all achievements from the Controls screen. Each player has their own achievements, so you could also log out using the Game Center app, and log in as a different player.
column2: 开始新游戏不会重置你的成就——毕竟，你可能既想作为女王获胜又想作为国王获胜。如果你想重新开始，可以从控制界面清除所有成就。每个玩家都有自己的成就，因此你也可以使用 Game Center 应用退出登录，然后以不同玩家的身份登录。

column1: Clan Screen
column2: 部落界面

column1: The first screen you see after every Sacred Time, the Clan screen provides information on the clan’s mood and the people’s health. Here, you manage your people, shift the focus of their activities, recruit new clansmen, and reorganize your clan ring.
column2: 作为每次神圣时间后首先看到的界面，部落界面提供关于氏族士气和人民健康状况的信息。在这里，你管理人民，调整他们的活动重点，招募新族人，并重组你的氏族议会。

column1: We’ve already detailed the Reorganize button’s functions, so this chapter will focus on the rest of the Clan screen.
column2: 我们已经详细介绍了重组按钮的功能，因此本章将重点讲述部落界面的其余部分。

column1: Sickness & Health
column2: 疾病与健康

column1: Sick people are more likely to die of old age or starvation than healthy people. Sick and wounded people cannot work, farm, fight, go on patrol, produce crafts, or lend their talents to the ring.
column2: 患病的人比健康的人更容易因年老或饥饿而死。伤病患者无法工作、耕作、战斗、巡逻、制作工艺品，或为议会贡献他们的才能。

column1: Sickness
column2: 疾病

column1: A small portion of your population is liable to fall sick in any given season. If you have a Chalana Arroy healer on the clan ring or spent magic on Health rituals in the Sacred Time, such illnesses should pass quickly. If you do not have a healer on the ring, sickness can become more of a problem, particularly if you have not yet learned Chalana Arroy’s Curing blessing.
column2: 在每个季节中，你的人口中有小部分容易生病。如果你的氏族议会中有查拉娜·阿罗伊的治愈者，或在神圣时间将魔法用于健康仪式，此类疾病便会迅速消退。如果议会中没有治愈者，疾病就可能成为一个更大的问题，尤其当你尚未学会查拉娜·阿罗伊的治愈祝福时。

column1: Wounds
column2: 创伤

column1: Wounds occur in battles and sometimes in fights that take place during other crises.
