As with sickness, wound recovery rates speed up when you have a healer on the ring, when you allocate magic to the Health ritual in the Sacred time, and when you have the proper Chalana Arroy blessing. When you sacrifice to Chalana Arroy for Healing of your wounded, she will heal leaders as her first priority, weaponthanes second, and farmers/footmen third.
column2: 创伤出现在战斗中，有时也出现在其他危机期间发生的打斗中。与疾病类似，当议会中有治愈者、在神圣时间将魔法分配给健康仪式、以及拥有适当的查拉娜·阿罗伊祝福时，创伤恢复速度会加快。当你向查拉娜·阿罗伊献祭以治疗伤员时，她会优先治疗领袖，其次治疗武器领主，最后治疗农夫/步兵。

column1: Who is in your clan?
column2: 你的氏族中有哪些人？

column1: The population categories make no distinction between men and women. Both men and women farm, fight, hunt, and serve as nobles responsible for the ceremonies that maintain contact with the gods. More men than women fight as weaponthanes and as footmen in the fyrd, but even that balance shifts slightly if the clan worships Vinga, goddess of adventurers.
column2: 人口分类不区分男女。男女都耕作、战斗、狩猎，并担任负责举行维持与神明联系的仪式的贵族。作为武器领主和民兵中的步兵战斗的男性多于女性，但如果氏族崇拜冒险女神温加，这种平衡会略有改变。

column1: Farmers are the backbone of the clan, comprising the great majority of your people.
column2: 农夫是氏族的支柱，构成你人口的绝大多数。

column1: Farmers care for the crops and tend the herds. There are two social classes within the farming population, carls and cottars. Carls are wealthier farmers who own cattle and farm good land; they can afford better weapons and sometimes even armor. Cottars own less land, they generally tend sheep rather than cattle and perform many of the more onerous tasks (particularly if the clan does not take thralls). Although this will not come up often in play, its important to note that cottars can sometimes become carls. There is no hard line dividing the two classes, it’s truly a matter of wealth.
column2: 农夫照料庄稼、放牧畜群。农耕人口中有两个社会阶层：自由民与佃农。自由民是较富裕的农夫，拥有牛群并耕种良田；他们买得起更好的武器，有时甚至能置办盔甲。佃农拥有较少的土地，通常牧羊而非牧牛，并承担许多更繁重的劳役（尤其是当氏族不蓄奴隶时）。尽管这在游戏中不常涉及，但值得注意的是，佃农有时也能晋升为自由民。两者之间并无截然分界，说到底只是财富之别。

column1: Tap the Farmers button for advice on how many farmers you need for the land you have chosen to cultivate and to show the dialog that allows you to recruit new carls and cottars.
column2: 点击“农夫”按钮，可获取关于你需要为已选耕地招募多少农夫的建言，并调出允许你招募新自由民与佃农的对话框。

column1: The morale of your farmers has a great deal of impact on whether the clan functions smoothly or wallows in nasty disputes.
column2: 你麾下农夫的士气，对氏族能否平稳运转——还是深陷于肮脏的争斗——有着巨大影响。

column1: You have several options if you wish to recruit more farmers. In general, each of these will be more effective the more generous you are to those you’re seeking to recruit. Unfortunately, you’re also liable to anger your current farmers if you are too generous to newcomers, so you would do well to study your clan ring’s advice. There are other advantages and disadvantages to each of the farmer recruitment options, ranging from the dubious moral fiber of newcomers who used to be outlaws to the irritation you’ll cause other clans by luring away their people.
column2: 若想招募更多农夫，你有若干选项。大体而言，你对招募对象越是慷慨，每个选项的效果就越佳。不幸的是，若你对新来者过于慷慨，又容易激怒现有的农夫，因此最好先听取氏族议会的建议。每个招募农夫选项各有其他利弊，从那些曾是亡命之徒的新人可疑的道德品性，到诱走他人族人而惹恼其他氏族，不一而足。

column1: After choosing how you’d like to attract new farmers, you’ll have to wait a season or two to see if you have any success.
column2: 选定吸引新农夫的方式后，你需等待一两季，才能知晓是否有所收获。

column1: If you aren’t having any luck recruiting new farmers, or don’t want to bring newcomers into the clan, there’s another option: reassign some of the hunters to be farmers.
column2: 若招募新农夫始终不顺，或你不想将新来者引入氏族，还有另一个选择：将部分猎人重新指派为农夫。

column1: All the recruitment dialogs (Farmers, Weaponthanes, and Hunters) give a good deal of situational advice through the clan ring. If you’re in doubt about what to do with your people, find out what the ring members have to say.
column2: 所有招募对话框（农夫、武器领主与猎人）都会通过氏族议会提供大量情境性建言。若你对如何安置族人举棋不定，不妨听听环成员有何见解。

column1: The clan chief supports a number of full-time warriors, called weaponthanes, who live in the chief’s hall. They are equipped with armor and a horse, and carry a sword and shield. Although they ride into battle, they dismount to fight. In battle they are five times as effective as a normal footman, in part because normal footmen fear going up against a warrior who is so much better armed and trained.
column2: 氏族酋长供养着一批名为武器领主的全职武士，他们居住在酋长的大厅里。这些武士装备盔甲与战马，佩剑持盾。虽骑马奔赴战场，但他们会下马作战。在战斗中，他们的效力是普通步兵的五倍——部分原因在于普通步兵畏惧与武装和训练都远胜于己的武士交锋。

column1: Winning a battle increases your warrior’s morale. Losing a battle takes it down a notch. Losing a battle and suffering huge casualties will reduce the warrior’s morale by a great deal if their morale was previously high. Similarly, utterly routing a foe will greatly increase the warrior’s morale if it was bad to begin with. A host of other factors and choices affect warrior morale, so it is possible that your warriors will be despondent despite winning most of their recent battles, or vice versa.
column2: 打赢一场战斗会提升你方武士的士气。输掉一场战斗则会使其低落一截。若此前士气高昂，而战败且伤亡惨重，则会大幅挫伤士气。同理，若此前士气低迷，而彻底击溃敌军，则会极大提振士气。还有众多其他因素与抉择会影响武士士气，因此你的武士仍可能在近期多数战役获胜时意志消沉，反之亦然。

column1: Weaponthanes expect better food, and regular gifts. In return they are willing to fight in most battles, perform special acts of derring-do, guard emissaries, look after trading missions, and go exploring. Not to mention die. An awful lot of them die.
column2: 武器领主期望得到更好的食物与定期的礼物。作为回报，他们愿意参与多数战斗、执行特殊勇武之举、护卫使者、照管贸易任务并外出探索，更不必说赴死——他们中有极多人都死了。

column1: So you will need to tap the Weaponthanes button frequently to recruit more of them. Usually, there are carls willing to become warriors or weaponthanes can be recruited outside the clan, from neighbors and immigrants. Outsiders will be more likely to join your ranks if you offer extra gifts.
column2: 因此你需要频繁点击“武器领主”按钮来招募更多此类武士。通常，会有愿意成为武士的自由民，或者你可以从氏族外部——从邻邦与移民中——招募武器领主。若你提供额外礼物，外人会更有可能加入你的行列。

column1: Your stock of available goods and the number of horses limit your ability to hire more weaponthanes. You can’t hire new weaponthanes if you can’t afford to give them goods as welcoming gifts or if you lack enough horses to keep both your nobles and your current weaponthanes mounted.
column2: 你可用的商品库存与马匹数量，限制了你雇佣更多武器领主的能力。若你无法提供足以作为迎宾礼物的商品，或缺乏足够的马匹来同时让你的贵族与现有武器领主保持骑乘，你就无法雇佣新的武器领主。

column1: If you feel that you have too many weaponthanes, you can also use the Weaponthanes button to dismiss your full-time warriors. This isn’t likely to gain you anything except relief from the weaponthanes’ large appetites and a possible rise in banditry.
column2: 若你觉得自己拥有的武器领主过多，也可使用“武器领主”按钮解雇你的全职武士。此举除了让你从武器领主巨大的胃口下解脱，并可能引发盗匪活动加剧之外，不太可能给你带来任何收益。

column1: It takes fifteen years for a baby to grow up, become initiated as an adult, and become a farmer or noble. At KoDP’s level of simulation, children play little role in the clan’s affairs. As a player, you’ll want to watch for the situation in which you have more children than farmers, since this puts you at greater risk of starvation.
column2: 一个婴儿需要十五年才能长大成人、通过成年礼，并成为农夫或贵族。在《龙之隘口之王》的模拟层次中，儿童在氏族事务中扮演的角色微乎其微。作为玩家，你需留意儿童数量超过农夫数量的情况，因为这会使你面临更高的饥荒风险。

column1: You will note that your Clan screen indicates that you have more nobles than clan leaders… some of these extra nobles are the families of the leaders, or people too unskilled or too shy to take a leadership role in the clan. Others are god-talkers unwilling to take leadership roles on the clan ring.
column2: 你将会注意到，你的部落界面显示你拥有的贵族多于部落领袖……这些多出的贵族中，一部分是领袖们的家人，或是那些技能不足或过于羞怯、不愿在氏族中担任领袖角色的人。另一些则是不愿在氏族议会中担任领导角色的神言者。

column1: The god-talkers who serve on the clan ring, lead missions to other clans and act as emissaries are drawn from your clan’s nobles. Like carls, nobles are created by both birth and wealth. To some extent, nobles are also defined by ability: magically skilled or otherwise gifted individuals rise to be considered nobles when they prove that they are exceptional people who deserve to lead and represent the clan. You can’t recruit more nobles, but as your pool of advisors dies of old age or accidents in war, new leaders will rise from the clan to take their place.
column2: 在氏族议会中任职、领导出使其他氏族并担任使者的神言者，均从氏族贵族中选拔。与自由民一样，贵族既由出身也由财富造就。某种程度上，贵族也由能力定义：那些拥有魔法天赋或其他非凡才能之人，一旦证明自己是值得领导并代表氏族的杰出者，便会晋升为贵族。你无法招募更多贵族，但随着顾问团因年老或战争事故而离世，氏族中将有新的领袖崛起并接替他们的位置。

column1: Don’t be surprised if the number of hunters in your clan goes up without your permission. Hunters teach their children how to hunt rather than how to farm.
column2: 如果氏族内猎人的数量未经你许可就增加，不必惊讶。猎人教导子女的是狩猎之道，而非农耕之法。

column1: Hunters usually provide the clan with about two Bushels of food each year (one Bushel feeds one person for a year). They’re not the most efficient food-providers, so it’s good that hunters do more than simply provide food. Hunters fight as part of the fyrd, improve your skirmishing ability (see battle tactics notes), improve the odds for your exploration missions, help your weaponthanes spot enemy raids, and even provide the clan with some goods by selling the pelts and horns of their prey. You may not need to field as many hunters as your wildlands can support, but think twice if you’re considering telling them all to put down the bow and take up the plow. Use the Hunters button to change the number of hunters in your clan.
column2: 每名猎人通常每年为氏族提供约两蒲式耳食物（一蒲式耳可供一人食用一年）。他们并非最高效的食物提供者，好在猎人不止提供食物。猎人作为民兵参战，提升你的散兵战能力（参见战斗战术说明），提高探索任务的成功率，协助武器领主发现敌方突袭，甚至通过出售猎物的毛皮和角为氏族提供物资。你可能无需派出超出荒野承载力的猎人，但若考虑让他们放下弓箭拿起犁铧，还请三思。使用“猎人”按钮可调整氏族中的猎人数量。

column1: Crafters are farmers who make goods for trade with other clans. There’s a limit to the number of crafters that your clan can usefully employ (and normally that’s the number you’ll have). To increase the number of effective crafters, try any of the following: build up your shrine to Issaries, place an Issaries worshipper on the ring, establish as many trade routes as possible with other clans, and start a tribe!
column2: 工匠是那些制作货物与其他氏族交易的农夫。氏族能有效雇佣的工匠数量存在上限（通常你拥有的数量即为此上限）。若要增加有效工匠的数量，可尝试以下方法：扩建伊莎里斯神庙、让伊莎里斯信徒进入长老会、尽可能多与其他氏族建立贸易路线，以及建立部落！

column1: Unlike farmers and hunters, crafters’ work does not keep them in combat shape, so they do not fight as part of the fyrd.
column2: 与农夫和猎人不同，工匠的工作无法使其保持战斗状态，因此他们不会作为民兵参战。

column1: Thralls are essentially slaves. They may be other Orlanthi captured in battle, hapless strangers purchased from traders, or even non-Orlanthi pressed into servitude.
column2: 奴隶本质上就是奴役。他们可能是战斗中俘虏的其他奥兰斯人、从商人手中购买的不幸陌生人，甚至是被迫为奴的非奥兰斯人。

column1: Thralls help the farmers care for the fields and the herds. Even if your clan was not a thrall-taking clan in the Great Darkness, your carls are likely to be pleased when the clan takes thralls and upset if the clan frees them.
column2: 奴隶帮助农夫照料田地与牲畜。即使你的氏族在大黑暗时期并非掠奴氏族，当你族俘获奴隶时，自由民也多半会感到欣喜；而若释放奴隶，他们则会感到不安。

column1: Unlike slavery, thralldom is not passed down to succeeding generations. The children of thralls are born free and become full members of the clan.
column2: 与奴隶制不同，奴役身份不会代代相传。奴隶的子女生来自由，并将成为氏族的正式成员。

column1: Sacrificing thralls increases the potency of your sacrifices: in the eyes of the gods, one sacrificed thrall is worth ten cows. But neighboring clans, and many of your own people, view human sacrifice as a sign of desperation. If you sacrifice thralls when times are good, expect your own and other clans to think poorly of your leadership. If the clan’s mood is already desperate, or if the clan magic is in dire straits, sacrificing a thrall or two may not upset your own people.
column2: 献祭奴隶能增强献祭的效力：在诸神眼中，一名被献祭的奴隶价值十头牛。但邻近氏族以及你族中的许多人，会将活人献祭视为绝望之举。若在盛世献祭奴隶，你会招致本族与他族对你领导力的非议。若氏族情绪已然绝望，或氏族魔法陷入困境，献祭一两名奴隶或许不会激起族人的反感。

column1: Thralls may grow restless or intractable. This is more likely when you’ve taken thralls from feuding clans or from non-Orlanthi enemies. It’s even more likely if you have sacrificed some thralls to the gods.
column2: 奴隶可能会变得焦躁不安或难以管束。当你从有世仇的氏族或非奥兰斯敌人处俘获奴隶时，这种情况更易发生。若你已向诸神献祭过一些奴隶，则风险更大。

column1: Whenever you own thralls, you can use the Thralls button to free some or all of them. If you’re playing a clan that adopted strangers as family in the Great Darkness and you took thralls for some reason that seemed good at the time, this is your chance to return to your ancestors’ path. Your farmers might not be happy with your decision, but your ancestors will be.
column2: 只要你拥有奴隶，便可使用“奴隶”按钮释放部分或全部奴隶。如果你操控的氏族曾在大黑暗时期接纳异族为家人，并因当时看似合理的原因俘获过奴隶，那么现在正是回归祖先之路的时机。你的农夫或许会不满你的决定，但你的祖先会感到欣慰。

column1: Other Clan Screen Features
column2: 其他部落界面功能

column1: The Clan Mood
column2: 氏族情绪

column1: The clan’s mood indicator gives a rough sense of whether the people are happy with the ring’s leadership or whether they fear they’re being led down the road to ruin. If the people are happy, problems that start small are more likely to stay small. If the people are already angry, ill feeling can spiral out of control. Clans can forgive their leaders for occasional unpopular decisions; it is repeated failure or clear signs of going against the will of the gods that are most likely to drive people to rebellion.
column2: 氏族情绪指示器大致反映了民众对长老会领导是否满意，或是担忧正被引向毁灭之路。若民众愉悦，小问题更易止于微小。若民众已生怨怼，怨气可能失控蔓延。氏族可以原谅领袖偶尔不得人心的决定；但屡次失败或明显违逆神意的迹象，最易激起叛乱。

column1: Few divine blessings directly affect the clan mood. Lhankor Mhy’s Lawspeaker blessing and Chalana Arroy’s Hope blessing are exceptions.
column2: 少数神恩会直接影响氏族情绪。兰科·麦的律法师祝福和查拉娜·阿罗伊的希望祝福是例外。

column1: In descending order, from the happiest condition to the depths of the spirit, the terms used to describe clan mood are:
column2: 从最愉悦到最绝望，描述氏族情绪的词语依次为：

column1: jubilant, splendid, happy, contented, optimistic, reserved, worried, dissatisfied, gloomy, ugly, and grim. Anything below reserved is a bad mood.
column2: 欢腾、灿烂、快乐、知足、乐观、含蓄、忧虑、不满、阴郁、恶劣、冷酷。任何低于“含蓄”的状态皆为不良情绪。

column1: Clan mood is somewhat linked to the morale of the farmers and the warriors. If the farmers and the warriors are both happy, their good spirits can raise clan mood. The reverse is true if both the farmers and the warriors are unhappy.
column2: 氏族情绪与农夫及战士的士气有一定关联。若农夫和战士都很愉悦，他们的好心情可提升氏族情绪；若两者皆不快，则反之。

column1: Farmers and weaponthanes often compete with each other for the ring’s attention. This conflict is a standard part of Orlanthi life. You generally don’t need to take it too seriously unless one or the other of the two sides is extremely unhappy.
column2: 农夫与武器领主常常相互争夺氏族议会的关注。这种冲突是奥兰提生活的常态。你通常不必太过当真，除非其中一方极度不满。

column1: Farmer Morale and Weaponthane Morale
column2: 农民士气与战士士气

column1: The morale of the farmers and the weaponthanes is distinct from the overall clan mood. The clan’s mood expresses how the people feel about their place in Dragon Pass, the clan’s prospects, and their hopes for the future. Farmer morale and weaponthane morale are better understood as professional assessments of how well the different branches of the clan are doing their jobs and how well they are being treated by the clan’s leaders.
column2: 农民的士气与武器领主的士气与氏族整体情绪有所区别。氏族情绪表达的是人民对自己在龙隘中的处境、氏族的前景以及对未来的期望。农民士气与战士士气则更适合理解为对氏族不同分支工作表现以及族中领袖对待他们的方式的专业评估。

column1: From the highest morale to the despondent lows, the ratings for both types of morale are:
column2: 从最高士气到低落低谷，这两种士气的评级如下：

column1: unshakeable, confident, secure, resolved, uncertain, discontented, disgruntled, shaken, despairing. Anything below resolved is bad morale.
column2: 坚不可摧、自信、安稳、坚定、不安、不满、怨愤、动摇、绝望。低于“坚定”即代表士气不佳。

column1: Feasting
column2: 宴会

column1: Feasts are another way to raise the clan’s mood. Tap the Feast button and ask your advisors if they think it’s a good time for feasting. Decide if you want to make your neighbors happy by inviting them. The bigger the feast the more food it will consume and the more pleased your people (and any guests) will be.
column2: 宴会是提升氏族情绪的另一种方式。点击“宴会”按钮，询问你的顾问们是否认为现在是举办宴席的好时机。决定是否邀请邻居让他们欢喜。宴会规模越大，消耗的食物就越多，你的人民（以及任何宾客）就越满意。

column1: Feasting isn’t so effective that you should consider spending all your time doing it. Caligula-style binge-feasting only sets you up for a big mood hit when your clan starts starving to death. But in times of plenty, feasting in moderation will help the clan and your relations with neighbors.
column2: 宴会并非高效到值得你花费所有时间。卡利古拉式的狂欢盛宴只会让你的氏族在开始饿死时遭受巨大的士气打击。但在丰饶时期，适度举行宴会将有助于氏族以及与邻居的关系。

column1: Distributing Gifts
column2: 分发礼物

column1: Gifts are goods assigned to the weaponthanes or the farmers or split between the two. Actions taken during game-initiated crises will affect the morale of the warriors and the farmers more than the gift-giving on this screen.
column2: 礼物是分配给武器领主、农夫，或两者平分的物资。游戏触发危机时所采取的行动对战士和农夫士气的影响，比在此界面赠送礼物更为显著。

column1: Controls Screen
column2: 控制界面

column1: While you can control overall sound volume using the buttons on your device, the Controls screen lets you decide whether certain sounds are played at all. Background Music plays in the various management screens. Adventure Music is associated with the various crises. And Sound Effects relate to dialogs.
column2: 虽然你可以使用设备上的按钮控制整体音量，但控制界面允许你决定是否播放某些声音。背景音乐在各个管理界面播放。冒险音乐与各种危机相关。而音效则与对话相关。

column1: Tap New Game to start over from scratch. Once you confirm this, there’s no way to return to the current game.
column2: 点击“新游戏”从头开始。一旦确认，将无法返回当前游戏。

column1: Crises and Adventures
column2: 危机与冒险

column1: As you go about running your clan, things happen that demand your immediate attention. You’ll know when you are facing a crisis or adventure because the screen will change, and you will be in a place where you must make a decision. There are many, many of these stories in the game.
column2: 在管理氏族的过程中，总会有事情需要你立即关注。当面临危机或冒险时，你会知道——因为屏幕会改变，你将处于必须做出抉择的地方。游戏中有非常多这样的故事。

column1: During crises, choices that ask you to choose a leader generally begin by listing the recommended leaders in the order of their Combat skill. That’s not necessarily the wisest choice. Decide for yourself which skill is called for in special circumstances.
column2: 在危机中，要求你选择领袖的选项通常以战斗技能为顺序列出推荐人选。这未必是最明智的选择。自行判断在特殊情况下需要哪种技能。

column1: There is no way to duck an event in progress, except by deciding what to do about it. There is seldom just one right answer to these events. Some answers will end the situation, others may delay any consequences for a while, still others will cause more events in the future. As in other screens, your advisors have their own opinions as to the best course of action. Despite their opinions, they will pursue the course of action you set for them. Success depends on your ring member’s skills, on luck, and on paying attention to what your advisors have to say about each specific situation.
column2: 无法回避正在发生的事件，只能用决策来应对。这些事件很少只有一种正确答案。有些答案会结束当前局面，有些可能暂时推迟后果，还有一些则会在未来引发更多事件。与其他界面一样，你的顾问对最佳行动方案有自己的看法。尽管他们有不同意见，但会执行你为他们设定的行动方案。成功取决于你氏族议会成员的技能、运气，以及留意你的顾问对每个具体情况所说的话。

column1: Although you don’t have access to all the detail shown in say the Clan screen, you can review the most important information by tapping the Info button.
column2: 虽然你无法查看例如部落界面中展示的所有细节，但可以通过点击“信息”按钮查看最重要的信息。

column1: Tap the background image to toggle the parchment and text off and on so that you can see the art. This also reveals six important values: your herds, food stockpile, total population, goods, clan magic, and weaponthanes.
column2: 点击背景图像可以切换羊皮纸和文字显示，以便欣赏美术画面。这也会揭示六个重要数值：你的畜群、食物储备、总人口、物资、氏族魔法，以及武器领主。

column1: If you don’t read manuals, read this
column2: 如果你不阅读手册，请至少读读这个

column1: The tutorial introduces most aspects of play, and this manual covers everything in detail. But if you like to dive straight in, at least read the following…
column2: 教程介绍了游戏的多数方面，而本手册则详细涵盖一切。但如果你喜欢直接上手，至少请阅读以下内容……

column1: Advice: Tap the face at the bottom of the screen. You'll see the leaders of the clan, known as the Clan Ring. They can offer good advice, particularly if their skills are high. (To check their skills, tap their picture.) Your advisors have personalities, so their advice sometimes serves their own agendas better than it serves the clan. Change advisors via the Clan screen's Reorganize button.
column2: 建议：点击屏幕底部的面孔。你会看到氏族的领袖，即氏族议会。他们能提供良好建议，尤其是当他们的技能很高时。（要查看他们的技能，点击他们的头像。）你的顾问各有性格，因此他们的建议有时更服务于自身目的而非氏族。可通过部落界面的“重组”按钮更换顾问。

column1: Basic Info: The Menu button switches between screens. The More Info button at the bottom of the menu gives useful pointers and information about the current screen. Go to the Lore screen and poke around for information on the clan, its culture, and the myths of the gods which determine its fate. In game-initiated adventures, check the season and the identity and status of other clans by tapping the Info button.
column2: 基本信息：“菜单”按钮用于切换界面。菜单底部的“更多信息”按钮提供关于当前界面的有用提示和信息。前往知识界面，浏览关于氏族、其文化以及决定其命运的神话的信息。在游戏触发的冒险中，通过点击“信息”按钮查看季节及其他氏族的身份与状态。

column1: Art Without Text: Tap a picture to see the game's art without text in the way.
column2: 无文字艺术图：点击图片可查看游戏艺术图，文字不会遮挡画面。

column1: The Many Paths: There is seldom just one proper response. Many choices test the abilities of your leaders against some level of difficulty. Most have a chance of succeeding, but even the best choices have a chance of failing. If you fail the first time you try something, that doesn't mean that it's impossible. Luck plays a big role, but you can improve your luck by choosing responses that seem to best match your leaders' abilities.
column2: 多条路径：鲜有唯一正确的应对。许多抉择会以一定难度考验领袖们的能力。多数情况下有成功的机会，但即使是最佳选择也可能失败。若首次尝试未果，并不表示此事无望。运气扮演重要角色，但你可以通过选择似乎最契合领袖能力的应对来改善运气。

column1: Roleplaying Your Clan: Although you can have a lot of fun playing KoDP in a variety of styles, you're not likely to fully succeed until you get into the spirit of acting like the king of an Orlanthi tribe. 21st-century ethics and morality won't take you to the end of the game. Neither will acting like Arnold Schwarzenegger in a fur loincloth.
column2: 角色扮演你的氏族：尽管尝试多种风格玩《龙之隘口之王》能带来许多乐趣，但除非你真正融入奥兰西部落之王的精神，否则不太可能完全成功。21世纪的伦理道德无法带你走到游戏终点。像阿诺德·施瓦辛格那样披着毛皮腰布行事也同样行不通。

column1: Advice: The seven faces at the bottom of most screens are the leaders of the clan, known as the Clan Ring. They can offer good advice, particularly if their skills are high. (To check their skills, tap their picture.) Your advisors have personalities, so their advice sometimes serves their own agendas better than it serves the clan. Change advisors via the Clan screen's Reorganize button.
column2: 建议：多数界面底部的七张面孔是氏族的领袖，被称为"氏族议会"。他们能提供良好建议，尤其是当他们的技能高超时。（查看技能请点击他们的画像。）你的顾问各有性格，因此他们的建议有时更服务于自身议程而非氏族利益。通过部落界面的重组按钮更换顾问。

column1: Basic Info: The icons on the left switch between screens. Go to the Lore screen and poke around for information on the clan, its culture, and the myths of the gods which determine its fate.
column2: 基本信息：左侧图标用于切换界面。前往知识界面，四处查看关于氏族、其文化以及决定其命运的神话信息。

column1: Map Screen
column2: 地图界面

column1: The Map screen shows you how much of Dragon Pass your explorers or emissaries have visited at least once.
column2: 地图界面显示你的探索者或使者至少造访过一次的龙之隘口区域范围。

column1: Tap the checkboxes next to the map to hide or show clan names or tribal borders.
column2: 点击地图旁的复选框可隐藏或显示氏族名称或部落边界。

column1: Scroll or zoom the map using the usual gestures.
column2: 使用常规手势滚动或缩放地图。

column1: Exploring
column2: 探索

column1: At some point in the game, you may be advised to make a pilgrimage to Kero Fin, the holy mountain who is Orlanth’s mother. To make a pilgrimage, send an exploration party!
column2: 在游戏中的某个时刻，你可能会被建议前往凯罗·芬——这位圣山是奥兰斯的母亲——进行朝圣。要进行朝圣，就派出一支探索队！

column1: You can learn more about Dragon Pass by sending clan members to explore your own lands, and the lands of Dragon Pass. Tap the Explore button to send out an exploration party.
column2: 你可以通过派出氏族成员探索自家领地以及龙之隘口的土地，来了解更多关于龙之隘口的信息。点击探索按钮派出探索队。

column1: Choosing Exploration Leaders
column2: 选择探索领袖

column1: Exploration is fraught with risks. The leader chosen for you stands the best chance of success. If you want to choose a different leader for the exploration party, consider this: successful explorers have high Combat and Bargaining skills. Worshippers of Vinga and Issaries make better explorers because of their gods’ emphases on travel and movement. To a lesser degree, worshippers of Odayla make good explorers because of their familiarity with the wilds.
column2: 探索充满风险。为你选定的领袖拥有最大的成功机会。若你想为探索队另选领袖，请考虑这一点：成功的探索者拥有高超的战斗与议价技能。崇拜文加与伊萨里斯的人更适合成为探索者，因为他们的神明强调旅行与移动。较低程度上，崇拜奥达拉的人也是不错的探索者，因为他们熟悉荒野。

column1: As with trading missions and emissaries, ring members, thanks to their support from the clan magic, will have more success than non-ring members of equal ability.
column2: 如同贸易任务和使者一样，议会成员凭借氏族魔法的支持，会比同等能力的非议会成员获得更多成功。

column1: Assigning Guards
column2: 指派护卫

column1: Like emissaries and traders, explorers can fall prey to bandits and other enemies. Unlike trading missions, weak exploration parties can disappear without a trace in the untravelled and unknown parts of the land. The more warriors you send, the less likely your explorers are to fall prey to such ambushes. As in most military situations, each weaponthane counts as five footmen.
column2: 与使者和商人一样，探索者可能沦为强盗和其他敌人的猎物。与贸易任务不同，弱小的探索队可能在未经踏足和未知的土地上消失得无影无踪。你派出的战士越多，探索者遭遇此类伏击的可能性就越小。在大多数军事情况下，每位武器领主相当于五名步兵。

column1: The Exploration Cross
column2: 探索十字标

column1: Tap the map and the exploration cross will move there, to show where your party is headed. Exploration missions take the most direct route to their destination; they do not follow any contours on the map.
column2: 点击地图，探索十字标将移至该处，显示你的队伍前往的目的地。探索任务采取最直接的路线抵达目标；它们不会沿地图上的任何等高线行进。

column1: Exploration Speed
column2: 探索速度

column1: Fast missions are slightly riskier and do not map as much terrain, but they return sooner. Normal missions are safer, but take slightly longer. Slow missions are even safer, take a lot longer, and map slightly more terrain.
column2: 快速任务风险略高，且绘制的地形较少，但返回更快。普通任务更安全，但耗时稍长。缓慢任务更加安全，耗时长得多，绘制的地形略多。

column1: Familiar vs. Unfamiliar Terrain
column2: 熟悉地形 vs. 陌生地形

column1: When you have explored an area at least once, it will be shown in greater detail on your map. This does not necessarily mean that your explorers have discovered that region’s deepest secrets or that it is now safe for future explorations. You can explore familiar regions many times; odds are you’ll find something different almost every time.
column2: 当你至少探索过某个区域一次后，该区域会在地图上以更详细的方式显示。这并不一定意味着你的探索者已发现那片区域最深的秘密，或者它现在对未来的探索来说是安全的。你可以多次探索熟悉区域；几乎每次都会发现不同的事物。

column1: Under unusual circumstances, the starting position won’t quite match your clan name. As long as you don’t move the exploration cross, the game knows you’re exploring your tula.
column2: 在特殊情况下，起始位置可能与你的氏族名称不完全匹配。只要你不移动探索十字标，游戏就会知道你正在探索你的图拉领地。

column1: This even goes for your own clan tula. To explore your home tula, tap the Explore button, then send the Exploration mission without moving the cross off its starting position. Your explorers will poke around your land and quite possibly find something you hadn’t known about before. Exploring your home tula is safer than exploring outside the tula.
column2: 这甚至适用于你自己的氏族领地。要探索你的家园图拉，点击探索按钮，然后在没有将十字标移离起始位置的情况下派出探索任务。你的探索者将在你的土地上四处探查，很可能发现一些你之前不知道的东西。探索家园图拉比探索图拉外部更安全。

column1: Geography
column2: 地理

column1: As your explorers stumble across Dragon Pass’s various lands, labels corresponding to those areas will appear on your map, guiding future explorations.
column2: 当你的探索者偶然发现龙之隘口各地时，对应这些区域的标签会出现在你的地图上，为未来的探索提供指引。

column1: What You Haven’t Found Will Hurt You
column2: 尚未发现之物终将伤你

column1: Behind the scenes, explorers help suppress bandits, Chaos monsters, and other nasty denizens of Dragon Pass. If you go several years without exploring, you increase the risk that your clan will fall prey to Chaos or other foes.
column2: 在幕后，探索者有助于压制强盗、混沌怪物以及龙之隘口其他邪恶居民。如果你连续数年不进行探索，氏族落入混沌或其他敌人之手的风险就会增加。

column1: Sending an exploration party into unknown territory at least once a year will maximize your clan’s chances of survival. Once the map is mostly known to you, sending one exploration party per year into familiar territory (outside your tula) will continue to keep bandits and inhumans at bay.
column2: 每年至少派出一支探索队进入未知领土，将最大化你的氏族生存的机会。一旦地图基本为你所知，每年派出一支探索队进入熟悉领土（在你的图拉领地之外）将继续遏制盗匪和非人。

column1: Farming Screen
column2: 农耕界面

column1: The quickest way to lose the game is to starve your people to death.
column2: 输掉游戏最快的方式就是让你的子民饿死。

column1: The Farming screen allows you to manage your herds of cattle, sheep, and pigs, and to clear land for planting. On the Farming screen, the clan ring provides advice on all facets of agricultural progress, as well as warnings when you have too few farmers or are near starvation.
column2: 农耕界面允许你管理牛、羊和猪的牧群，以及开垦土地用于种植。在农耕界面上，氏族议会会就农业进展的各个方面提供建议，并在你的农民过少或濒临饥荒时发出警告。

column1: The Bushel we use as the unit of food in KoDP is the amount of food it takes to feed one person for a year. A normal bushel is just a medium-sized basket, but our Bushel comes from the Godplane: these are Ernalda’s Bushels, and the Earth Mother’s basket holds enough to feed one of us little people for a year.
column2: 我们在《龙之隘口之王》中用作食物单位的蒲式耳，是供一人一年食用的食物量。一个普通蒲式耳只是一个中等大小的篮子，但我们的蒲式耳来自神界：这些是厄娜尔达的蒲式耳，大地母亲的篮子足以养活我们这些小个子中的一人一整年。

column1: Farming has two main components: land and herds. Your management of these resources determines whether you will harvest enough food to feed the clan.
column2: 农耕有两个主要组成部分：土地和牧群。你如何管理这些资源将决定是否能收获足够的食物来养活氏族。

column1: Get the most out of your agricultural production by clever use of labor, magical blessings, magical treasures, and Sacred Time magic. You can trade your crop surpluses or simply give them away to neighboring clans to prove your generosity.
column2: 通过巧妙利用劳动力、魔法祝福、魔法宝器和神圣时间魔法，从你的农业生产中获取最大产出。你可以用作物盈余进行交易，或者干脆赠送给邻近氏族来展示你的慷慨。

column1: Under normal circumstances, you won’t need to pay much attention to managing your farmers; farming is such a basic part of the clan’s activity that most farming activities are automatic. Your farmers plant the fields in Sea season, harvest the crops in Earth season, and perform routine slaughter of herd animals throughout the year without you needing to intervene.
column2: 在正常情况下，你不必过多关注农民的管理；农耕是氏族活动的基础部分，因此大多数农耕活动都是自动进行的。你的农民在海季播种，在地季收割，并在全年进行例行屠宰牧畜，无需你干预。

column1: Inter-linked sliders enable you to shift your clan’s land between wildlands, pastures, and cropland. Let’s take the three in reverse order to simulate the natural progression of land use.
column2: 连锁滑块使你能在荒野、牧场和耕地之间调整氏族的土地。我们按逆序介绍这三种类型，以模拟土地使用的自然进程。

column1: Wildlands are mostly forested, and provide hunting grounds for hunters and foraging space for pigs. You can cut down wildlands to give the clan more land for farming by increasing your pastures. This land-clearing operation requires some labor that would ordinarily be used for farming, so you may not want to clear your land indiscriminately.
column2: 荒野大部分为森林，为猎人提供狩猎空间，也为猪提供觅食空间。你可以通过增加牧场来砍伐荒野，为氏族提供更多农耕土地。这种开垦操作需要一些通常用于农耕的劳动力，因此你可能不想随意开垦土地。

column1: You will usually start the game with more than enough pastures for your herds. But pastures in excess of what your animals normally graze tend to gradually revert to wildlands. Be careful if some of your land is taken from you; it’s possible that you will no longer be able to support the herds, which will suffer greatly until you clear more land.
column2: 游戏开始时，你的牧场通常足以支撑牧群。但超过牲畜正常放牧量的牧场会逐渐恢复成荒野。如果你的部分土地被夺走，要小心；你可能无法再支撑牧群，牧群会遭受严重损失，直到你开垦更多土地。

column1: Pastures can be turned into cropland. The amount of cropland you can effectively farm is determined by the number of healthy farmers who are not occupied with the herding. Ask your clan ring to find out how much cropland your farmers can presently support.
column2: 牧场可以转为耕地。你能有效耕种的耕地数量取决于不从事放牧的健康农民数量。请咨询你的氏族议会，了解你的农民目前能支撑多少耕地。

column1: It’s possible to have too much cropland. If you try to spread your farmers too thin, your farmers will be overworked, slightly less productive, and increasingly restive.
column2: 也可能拥有过多耕地。如果你试图让农民过于分散，他们会过度劳累，效率略微降低，并越来越不安。

column1: For simplicity, KoDP lumps cows, sheep, and pigs into one statistic. This is called “cows” or “cattle” because that’s the most important animal, but it reflects all three. Game crises may deal with sheep or pigs, in which case the aggregate “cow” value will change.
column2: 为了简化，《龙之隘口之王》将牛、羊、猪合并为一个统计量。这个量称为“牛只”，因为牛是最重要的牲畜，但它反映了所有三种牲畜。游戏中的危机可能会涉及羊或猪，届时汇总的“牛”值会发生变化。

column1: The Farming screen tells you how many cattle, sheep, horses, and pigs you have in your herds. Although you can’t use the Farming screen to immediately increase the size of your herds, you can use the Slaughter button to kill animals to provide food for the clan when you’re facing Starvation (see below).
column2: 农耕界面告诉你牧群中有多少头牛、羊、马和猪。虽然你不能通过农耕界面立即增加牧群规模，但当你面临饥荒（见下文）时，你可以使用“屠宰”按钮宰杀动物为氏族提供食物。

column1: Cows: the Measure of Wealth
column2: 牛：财富的尺度

column1: Orlanthi clans measure wealth by how many cows they have. Crops provide more food, in absolute numbers, but any clan with few cattle will be considered poor. In general, herds of under 500 cattle are considered disastrously small. Herds between 600 and 700 cattle are usually too small, between 700 and 800 is probably good. Anything over 900 is excellent unless your population has grown so large that the people require more support than the herds can provide. If you’re not certain how well your herds are doing, tap your advisors. Economic exchanges, petitions from other clans, and sacrifices to the gods generally require you to give up cows or an equivalent amount of goods. Unless your herds are in excellent shape, try to sacrifice goods rather than actual cows. There are certain situations, and certain gods, for which only cows will do, but you can figure those out by thinking like an Orlanthi.
column2: 奥兰提氏族以拥有的牛只数量衡量财富。作物能提供更多食物（绝对数量上），但牛只稀少的氏族会被视为贫穷。通常，牧群低于500头牛被认为是灾难性地少。600至700头之间通常偏少，700至800之间可能不错。超过900头则优秀，除非你的氏族人口增长到人民所需的支撑超过牧群所能提供。如果你不确定牧群状况如何，可以咨询你的顾问。经济交换、其他氏族的请求以及献祭通常需要你交出牛只或等值的货物。除非你的牧群状况极佳，否则尽量献祭货物而非活牛。某些情况和某些神灵只接受牛只，但你可以像奥兰提人一样思考来弄清楚这些。

column1: Some of your cattle are oxen, used to plow the fields. Your advisors will remark on this as necessary.
column2: 你的部分牛只是用于耕地的公牛。你的顾问会在必要时提及这一点。

column1: Sheep: the Lesser Beast
column2: 羊：次要牲畜

column1: Sheep and pigs are important to Orlanthi, but not nearly as important as cows. You won’t have to think much about sheep while playing. Occasionally you’ll have them stolen or wiped out by various disasters, which affects your total herd value.
column2: 羊和猪对奥兰提人很重要，但远不如牛重要。游玩时你不需要过多考虑羊。偶尔它们会被偷走或因各种灾难灭绝，从而影响你的总畜群价值。

column1: If your herds are getting too small, try any of the following: Trade: Send a trade mission to another clan. War: Launch a cattle raid on a neighbor, or send a full raid and choose Plunder as the objective to bring back some cattle if you win. Magic: Sacrifice to Uralda for Mysteries to learn the myth of Uralda’s Blessing, then perform the Uralda’s Blessing heroquest. Or learn and obtain any of the following blessings: Uralda’s Calf Blessing, Elmal’s Horsefriend, or Ernalda’s Pig Blessing.
column2: 如果你的畜群变得太小，请尝试以下任何方法：贸易：派遣贸易使团到其他氏族。战争：对邻居发动牛群袭击，或发动全面袭击并选择“劫掠”作为目标，胜利后带回一些牛。魔法：向乌拉尔达献祭以求奥秘，学习“乌拉尔达的赐福”神话，然后执行乌拉尔达的赐福英雄任务。或者学习并获得以下任何祝福：乌拉尔达的小牛祝福、埃尔马尔的马友、或厄尔纳尔达的猪祝福。

column1: There’s not much to say about pigs, except that they require Wildlands for foraging. If you clear all your wildlands, your pigs will suffer until their numbers drop to a level your wildlands can sustain or until you return some of your cleared lands to wildland status.
column2: 关于猪没什么好说的，除了它们需要荒野来觅食。如果你清除了所有荒野，你的猪会受苦，直到它们的数量下降到你的荒野能够维持的水平，或者直到你将一些已清理的土地恢复为荒野状态。

column1: Although you can slaughter horses for food in cases of dire necessity, they are more of a military than an agricultural resource. For a fully effective military, you need enough horses for all your nobles and all your weaponthanes. Advisors on the Farming screen will tell you when you need more horses. The Trade screen will let you trade for more horses, but they aren’t cheap. You may be better off trying to win battles against enemies who have lots of horses, such as the Horse-Spawn, and induce them to leave their mounts behind when they flee.
column2: 尽管在极度必要时你可以屠宰马匹作为食物，但它们更多是军事资源而非农业资源。要拥有完全有效的军事力量，你需要足够的马匹供所有贵族和武器领主使用。耕种界面上的顾问会告诉你何时需要更多马匹。贸易界面允许你交易获得更多马匹，但它们不便宜。你最好尝试战胜拥有大量马匹的敌人，例如马裔，并诱使它们在逃跑时留下坐骑。

column1: Three of the most common agricultural blessings come from the chief gods, Orlanth, Ernalda and Elmal. Orlanth’s Rain and Elmal’s Sun help all crops equally, while Ernalda’s Bless Crops does the most good for barley.
column2: 三种最常见的农业祝福来自主神：奥兰斯、厄尔纳尔达和埃尔马尔。奥兰斯的雨和埃尔马尔的太阳同等帮助所有作物，而厄尔纳尔达的作物赐福对大麦最有利。

column1: Your fields are planted with a mix of three main crops. Barley is a fine food provider, and important to your people because it’s used to make beer. Rye is not as tasty as wheat, nor is its yield as high, but it is the most reliable grain. Rye never has bad harvests or blights, so farmers plant some just in case. Wheat is riskier than rye, but richer in yield and in greater demand as a trading commodity.
column2: 你的田地种植三种主要作物的混合物。大麦是一种良好的粮食供应者，对你的民众很重要，因为它用于制作啤酒。黑麦不如小麦美味，产量也不如小麦高，但它是最可靠的谷物。黑麦从不歉收或遭受枯萎病，所以农民种一些以防万一。小麦比黑麦风险更大，但产量更丰富，作为贸易商品需求量更大。

column1: The Expected Harvest
column2: 预期收获

column1: The Farming screen lets you know what your farmers expect to harvest in a normal year from crops, herds, and hunting. Your actual harvest will vary depending on your relations with the gods, the magic you’ve put into the different Sacred Time rituals, weather, and luck.
column2: 耕种界面让你了解你的农民在正常年份预期从作物、畜群和狩猎中收获多少。你的实际收获会因你与众神的关系、你在不同神圣时间仪式中投入的魔法、天气和运气而有所变化。

column1: Not all members of your clan eat the same amount of food. Weaponthanes and nobles eat more, thralls eat less. Children eat slightly less than an adult.
column2: 并非所有氏族成员吃同样多的食物。武器领主和贵族吃得更多，奴隶吃得少。儿童比成人略少。

column1: When Things Go Wrong: Starvation
column2: 当事情出错时：饥荒

column1: Starvation is a constant threat in Dragon Pass. When you don’t have enough food left to feed the clan for the next season, one of your advisors will probably show up to warn you.
column2: 饥荒是龙隘的持续威胁。当你没有足够的食物来维持氏族下一个季节时，你的顾问之一很可能会出现警告你。

column1: One of the simplest responses to imminent starvation, particularly if you know that you are going to take in the Earth season harvest soon, is to slaughter enough animals to get through this hard spot. To feed the clan for one full season, you usually need food equivalent to at least 1/5th of your population. A clan of 800 people might need 160 food to survive a season without suffering from starvation.
column2: 面对迫在眉睫的饥荒，最简单的应对措施之一，特别是如果你知道你即将迎来地季的收成时，就是屠宰足够的牲畜以度过这个难关。要喂养整个氏族一个完整的季节，你通常需要相当于你人口至少1/5的食物。一个800人的氏族可能需要160食物才能度过一个季节而不遭受饥荒。

column1: What went wrong? Check with your advisors. Perhaps your herds are so low that you no longer have enough oxen to plow your fields in Sea season. Maybe too many farmers are unhealthy, and they weren’t able to take in the harvest. Or your pastures or wildland are no longer sufficient for the animals trying to feed off them.
column2: 出了什么问题？与你的顾问核实。也许你的畜群太少，以至于在海季时没有足够的牛来犁地。也许太多农民身体不健康，无法收获。或者你的牧场或荒野不再足以供养试图以此为食的动物。

column1: Other solutions to imminent starvation are a bit riskier. You can send a trading mission to buy food, or an emissary to ask for food as a favor, but unless you send the mission to an adjacent clan, you can’t rely on them coming home in time to save your people.
column2: 其他应对迫在眉睫的饥荒的方法风险稍大。你可以派遣贸易使团购买食物，或派遣使者请求恩惠来获得食物，但除非你将使团派往相邻的氏族，否则你不能指望他们及时返回拯救你的民众。

column1: The amount of food an emissary can acquire with a favor is usually not enough to save you from starvation, but if you ask an ally or a tribe-mate for food, they may be willing to give you much more than the customary amount.
column2: 使者通过恩惠能获得的食物量通常不足以让你摆脱饥荒，但如果你向盟友或部落成员请求食物，他们可能愿意给予你比惯常数量多得多的食物。

column1: More About Glorantha
column2: 更多关于格洛兰萨

column1: Moon Design LLC publishes more games and books on the world of Glorantha. See their website at moondesignpublications.com.
column2: Moon Design LLC 出版更多关于格洛兰萨世界的游戏和书籍。请访问他们的网站 moondesignpublications.com。

column1: There’s also a mailing list, a Facebook page, and more. And fans have created over a hundred web sites related to Glorantha (in various languages). www.pensee.com/dunham/glorantha.html has Gloranthan information and many links.
column2: 还有邮件列表、Facebook页面等。粉丝们创建了数百个与格洛兰萨相关的网站（多种语言）。www.pensee.com/dunham/glorantha.html 有格洛兰萨信息和许多链接。

column1: In King of Dragon Pass, you play generations in the life of a barbarian clan. Every decision becomes part of your clan's saga, and echoes in the clan's future adventures. Some choices have immediate effects, but others won't come back to haunt you for years or decades of play.
column2: 在《龙隘之王》中，你将扮演一个蛮族氏族数代人的命运。每一个决策都将融入你氏族的传说，并在氏族未来的冒险中回响。有些选择会有立竿见影的效果，而另一些则要在游戏进行数年甚至数十年后才会重现并困扰你。

column1: You are mortals living in a magical world. The world is alive. Every river and rock has a spirit, as does your clan. These spirits sometimes share their magic with humans. The very greatest of the spirits are the gods. And the greatest god is the storm king, Orlanth.
column2: 你们是生活在魔法世界中的凡人。这个世界充满生机。每一条河流、每一块岩石都有其精魂，你们的氏族也是如此。这些精魂有时会与人类分享它们的魔法。最伟大的精魂便是诸神。而最伟大的神是风暴之王——奥兰斯。

column1: Your eventual goal is to become king of a tribe and then king of all Dragon Pass. Military might will aid in your quest, but strength alone won't suffice. You'll need allies, magical blessings, the favor of the gods, and the courage to follow Orlanth's least-understood example: the willingness to try a Big New Idea coupled with the power and charisma to make that idea work.
column2: 你的最终目标是成为部落之王，继而成为整个龙隘之王。军事力量将在你的征途中提供助力，但仅凭武力并不足够。你需要盟友、魔法祝福、诸神的恩惠，以及追随奥兰斯最不被理解之典范的勇气：即愿意尝试一个伟大的新构想，并拥有让这一构想成真的力量与魅力。

column1: The tutorial introduces most aspects of play, and the Lore screen includes the Manual. But if you like to dive straight in, at least read the following…
column2: 教程介绍了游戏的大部分内容，知识界面中包含了手册。但如果你喜欢直接开始，至少请阅读以下内容……

column1: Introduction
column2: 引言

column1: Two hundred years ago, in the shadow of the mountain at the center of the world, your ancestors fought a great war against the dragons.
column2: 两百年前，在世界中心之山的阴影下，你们的祖先与龙族进行了一场大战。

column1: Your ancestors lost.
column2: 你们的祖先战败了。

column1: The dragons ate every warrior who marched against them. They ate every magician who supported the warriors. Then they ate everyone else.
column2: 巨龙吞噬了所有向它们进军的战士。它们吞噬了所有支持战士的法师。然后它们吞噬了其余所有人。

column1: The only survivors were those who had remained in the south, outside the land called Dragon Pass. For two hundred years, Dragon Pass was nothing to you but a death sentence, a haunted boneyard, an enemy camp.
column2: 唯一的幸存者是那些留在南方、离开龙隘之地的人。两百年来，龙隘对你们而言不过是一纸死刑判决、一片阴魂不散的骸骨之地、一座敌营。

column1: But civil war in your ancestral lands forced your clan to find a new home. A few heroes dared to explore the forbidden land to the north. That these heroes returned at all was amazing. That they returned to tell you that the dragons are gone and that Dragon Pass is nearly empty, open for the taking — this is a gift from the gods.
column2: 但故土的内战迫使你们的氏族寻找新家园。几位英雄敢于探索北方的禁忌之地。这些英雄能够活着归来本就令人惊叹。而他们归来后告诉你们，巨龙已经消失，龙隘几乎空无一人，任人取用——这是诸神的恩赐。

column1: Your clan is part of the second wave of resettlement of Dragon Pass. You number some seven or eight hundred souls: mostly farmers and children, some warriors, a few nobles and magicians and god-talkers.
column2: 你们的氏族是龙隘重新定居的第二波浪潮的一部分。你们大约有七八百口人：多数是农夫与孩童，还有一些战士、少数贵族、法师和神言者。

column1: You seized land not far from the holy mountain called Kero Fin, the mountain that gave birth to your chief god, the god of Storm named Orlanth.
column2: 你们夺取了距离圣山凯罗·芬不远的一片土地，这座山诞生了你们的主神，名为奥兰斯的风暴之神。

column1: You are not the only clan that came north. As many as twenty other clans or splinters of clans separated themselves from kinfolk and carved homes in this new frontier. Like you, they are Orlanthi. Your relations with these clans, for good or for war, determine whether your clan starts up a path of glory or drifts forgotten with the spirits who haunt this ancient land.
column2: 你们并非唯一北上的氏族。多达二十个其他氏族或氏族分支脱离了亲族，在这片新边疆开辟家园。和你们一样，他们都是奥兰斯信徒。你们与这些氏族的关系，无论是友善还是战争，将决定你们的氏族是踏上荣耀之路，还是与萦绕在这片古老土地上的精魂一同被人遗忘。

column1: As you are gradually becoming aware, the land was never entirely empty. While humans were gone, non-humans such as elves, trolls and dragonewts thrived here unmolested.
column2: 你们逐渐意识到，这片土地从未完全空无一人。当人类离去时，非人种族——如精灵、巨魔和龙人——在此不受打扰地繁衍生息。

column1: Your Place in the Cosmos
column2: 你在宇宙中的位置

column1: You are mortals living in a magical world. The world is alive. Every river and rock has a spirit, as does your clan. The greatest of these spirits sometimes share their magic with humans. The very greatest of the spirits are the gods.
column2: 你们是生活在魔法世界中的凡人。这个世界充满生机。每一条河流、每一块岩石都有其精魂，你们的氏族也是如此。这些精魂中最伟大的有时会与人类分享它们的魔法。最伟大的精魂便是诸神。

column1: Your gods are the source of nearly all the advantages that let your clan survive and prosper. Without the blessings of the gods, your crops will fail, your herds will dwindle, your traders will make stupid bargains and your warriors will fall beneath enemy swords.
column2: 你们的诸神是你们氏族得以生存和繁荣的几乎所有优势的源泉。没有诸神的祝福，你们的庄稼会歉收，你们的牲畜会减少，你们的商人会做出愚蠢的交易，你们的战士会倒在敌人的刀剑之下。

column1: You worship the Orlanthi pantheon, the group of gods headed by Orlanth, King of Gods. Orlanth is the god of moving Air, of life-giving Rain, and also of devastating Lightning and sudden Change. He is the unpredictable god of the Storm.
column2: 你们崇拜奥兰斯万神殿，即由众神之王奥兰斯统领的诸神群体。奥兰斯是流动之空气、赋予生命之雨水、同时也是毁灭性的闪电和突如其来之变化的神。他是不可预测的风暴之神。

column1: You live inside Time, separate from the timeless realm of the immortals, but able to join with your deities through rituals and quests. Your god-talkers perform rituals to gain divine blessings for trade, farming, and war. Your mightiest leaders heroquest to the Godplane to perform the gods’ original mythic events anew, returning with gifts from the time of Creation.
column2: 你们生活在时间之内，与不朽者的永恒领域相分离，但能通过仪式和任务与你们的神祇联结。你们的神言者举行仪式，为贸易、农耕和战争获取神圣祝福。你们最强大的领袖们则英雄探索至神界，重新演绎诸神最初的神话事件，带着创世时代的恩赐归来。

column1: Your Place in the World
column2: 你在世界中的位置

column1: Your lives are dictated by the wheel of the seasons. In Sea season, the earth shakes off the cold, fresh life springs up in gentle rains, and you plant your crops. In Fire season, the fields take care of themselves and the warriors cry for battle and a chance for glory. In Earth season, you put aside the sword and take up the scythe. In Dark season, with the harvest finished, sensible folk stay inside out of the reach of blizzards and ice demons. In Storm season, all things are possible, but nothing is certain.
column2: 你们的生活由季节之轮主宰。在海季，大地抖落寒冷，新生在细雨之中萌发，你们播种庄稼。在火季，田地自行照料，战士们渴望战斗和荣耀的机会。在地季，你们放下剑，拿起镰刀。在暗季，收获结束，明智之人待在室内，躲避暴风雪与冰魔。在风暴季，一切皆有可能，但无一是确定的。

column1: And, at the end of the year, there are two magical weeks when you return to the timeless realm of the Godplane. You, and all other intelligent beings, perform the Sacred Time rituals that heal and recreate the world, allowing the wheel of Time to begin again with a new year.
column2: 此外，在年末，有两周魔法时间，你们会回到神界那永恒的领域。你们和所有其他智慧生物一起，举行神圣时间的仪式，治愈并重塑世界，让时间之轮得以在新的一年重新开始。

column1: The first law of the Orlanthi peoples is that “No one can make you do anything you don’t want to do.” Your chiefs rule by charisma and the consent of the clan, not by force or by bloodline.
column2: 奥兰提民族的第一条法律是：“没有人能强迫你做任何你不想做的事。”你的酋长凭借个人魅力和氏族的同意进行统治，而非武力或血统。

column1: The second law of the Orlanthi is “But no one can live alone.” All good Orlanthi live in clans, with their kin. This tension between the first law and second law summarizes life in your clan: you are a tradition-bound and violent group of armed and individually-minded farmers who consider generosity and justice to be their chief virtues.
column2: 奥兰提人的第二条法律是：“但没有人能独自生活。”所有好奥兰提人都与亲属生活在氏族中。第一条和第二条法律之间的这种紧张关系概括了氏族中的生活：你们是一群受传统束缚、暴力的武装农民，各自有独立思想，视慷慨和正义为主要美德。

column1: Your leaders, chiefs and kings include both men and women. The differences between the sexes, as you Orlanthi perceive them, are that men are more emotional, prone to uncontrolled anger and impulsive acts. Women are more calculating, capable of keeping track of their original reasons for choosing a path instead of getting caught up in the moment. Men are more often warriors and fighters, but a substantial number of women put aside cooking and rearing children to practice with the sword. The abilities of your clan’s heroes and leaders have less to do with their gender than with the gods they worship: worshippers of war gods excel in combat, the farming gods’ devotees are more at home behind the plow.
column2: 你们的领袖、酋长和国王有男有女。你们奥兰提人所认知的两性差异在于，男性更情绪化，容易失控发怒和冲动行事。女性更善于算计，能够记住自己选择道路的初衷，而不是被当下冲昏头脑。男性更常成为战士和斗士，但也有相当数量的女性放下厨育儿去练习剑术。氏族英雄和领袖的能力与其性别关系不大，而与所崇拜的神祇有关：战争之神的信徒擅长战斗，农业之神信徒在犁后更自在。

column1: Despite your clan’s reliance on its crops, cattle are considered the source of its wealth. Without a good harvest, your people will starve; without large herds of cattle, your people will be seen as stupid beggars. A wealthy clan is a clan with many cattle, and all forms of wealth are measured in cows. A fine silver bracelet worthy of a chief might be worth four or five cows, the timber and materials required to build a tribal hall might be worth as many as thirty cows.
column2: 尽管氏族依赖庄稼，但牛被认为是财富的来源。没有好收成，你们的人会挨饿；没有大群牛，你们的人会被视为愚蠢的乞丐。富裕的氏族就是拥有许多牛的氏族，所有形式的财富都以牛只衡量。一个值得酋长佩戴的精致银手镯可能值四五头牛，建造部落大厅所需的木材和材料可能值多达三十头牛。

column1: You, the Player
column2: 你，玩家

column1: In King of Dragon Pass, you play generations in the life of a barbarian clan. Every decision you make becomes part of your clan’s saga, and echoes in the clan’s future adventures. As in real life, some of your choices have immediate consequences, but others won’t come back to haunt you for years or decades of play.
column2: 在《龙隘之王》中，你将扮演一个蛮族氏族的数代人。你的每个决定都成为氏族传说的一部分，并在氏族未来的冒险中回响。如同现实生活，有些选择有即时后果，但其他可能需要数年或数十年的游戏才会让你付出代价。

column1: In one crucial sense, King of Dragon Pass is a roleplaying game: your best chance to succeed is to get into the spirit of playing an Orlanthi clan. Cunning calculations of risk and gain will take you only so far. If you do not accompany such stratagems with a sense of what it means to be a fair and powerful monarch, like Orlanth himself, your clan will go down to defeat.
column2: 在一个关键意义上，《龙隘之王》是一款角色扮演游戏：你成功的最佳机会是沉浸于扮演奥兰提氏族的精神。对风险和收益的精明算计只能带你走这么远。如果你不将这种策略与理解成为公正而强大的君主（如同奥兰斯本人）的意义相结合，你的氏族将会失败。

column1: Your eventual goal is to become king of a tribe and then king of all Dragon Pass. Military might aids you in this quest, but military strength alone won’t suffice. You will need allies, magical blessings, the favor of the gods, and the courage to follow Orlanth’s least-understood example: the willingness to try a Big New Idea coupled with the power and charisma to make that idea work.
column2: 你的最终目标是成为部落之王，然后成为整个龙隘之王。军事力量有助于这项任务，但仅靠军事力量是不够的。你需要盟友、魔法祝福、众神的恩惠，以及追随奥兰斯最不为人知榜样的勇气：愿意尝试一个宏大的新想法，并拥有让这个想法奏效的力量和魅力。

column1: Lore Screen
column2: 知识界面

column1: As you will have gathered, this is the place to look for myths, stories on the history of the world and your clan, and notes on Orlanthi culture. The myths and histories are illustrated.
column2: 你已猜到，这里是查找神话、世界和氏族历史故事以及奥兰提文化笔记的地方。神话和历史配有插图。

column1: We have already discussed the myths’ relation to heroquesting.
column2: 我们已经讨论过神话与英雄任务的关系。

column1: Some myths are not associated with a particular in-game heroquest. The most important of these is the Lightbringers myth, a cycle of seven connected myths.
column2: 有些神话与特定的游戏内英雄任务无关。其中最重要的是光明使者神话，一个由七个相互关联的神话组成的循环。

column1: If you’re confused about the meanings of certain terms, the powers associated with the runes, or the origins of the clan, see the notes on Culture.
column2: 如果你对某些术语的含义、符文相关力量或氏族起源感到困惑，请参阅文化笔记。

column1: The Map included as one of the Culture notes shows the immediate surroundings of Dragon Pass in the world of Glorantha. Your clan lives somewhere just to the southeast of Kero Fin, the mountain also called Wintertop. You know little of the outside geography shown on the map.
column2: 作为文化笔记之一的地图显示了格洛兰萨世界中龙隘的周边区域。你的氏族居住在凯罗芬（又称冬顶山）东南方某处。你对地图上显示的外部地理知之甚少。

column1: The clan’s previous home was in Heortland, to the south and east. On an island just off the map is the City of Wonders, the magical home of the Pharaoh, the enemy who drove your clan north. The line above Heortland is the Cross Line, a magical barrier the dragons erected after the Dragonkill War. For centuries, the Cross Line killed any humans who tried to return to Dragon Pass.
column2: 氏族之前的家在赫奥兰，位于东南方。在紧邻地图边缘的一个岛屿上是奇迹之城，法老的神奇居所，法老是驱赶你们氏族北上的敌人。赫奥兰上方的那条线是十字线，是龙在屠龙战争后竖起的魔法屏障。几个世纪以来，十字线杀死了任何试图返回龙隘的人类。

column1: Magic Screen
column2: 魔法界面

column1: The Magic screen lets you:
column2: 魔法界面允许你：

column1: The deity list uses these icons to show the current temple size: blank - no temple built - shrine - temple - Great Temple - The flame shows that you sacrificed within the last year.
column2: 神祇列表使用这些图标来显示当前神殿大小：空白 - 未建造神殿 - 神殿 - 大神殿 - 火焰表示你在过去一年内献祭过。

column1: • sacrifice to the gods for their blessings • sacrifice to the gods to learn their myths • perform heroquests
column2: • 向神献祭以获得祝福 • 向神献祭以学习神话 • 执行英雄任务

column1: Blessings: the Basics
column2: 祝福：基本概念

column1: Clans that sacrifice wisely for blessings can improve all aspects of their existence. The gods on the Magic screen are the major supernatural powers of the Orlanthi pantheon. There are other gods and other blessings, but gods like Minlister (god of brewing beer!) and blessings such as Cheese-Making (from Uralda, the cow-goddess) aren’t relevant to the road of kings, and therefore fall below the scope of this game.
column2: 明智地献祭祈求祝福的氏族可以改善生活的方方面面。魔法界面上的神祇是奥兰提万神殿的主要超自然力量。还有其他神祇和祝福，但像米尼斯特（啤酒酿造之神！）这样的神祇和诸如奶酪制作（来自牛女神乌拉尔达）之类的祝福与王者之路无关，因此不属于本游戏范围。

column1: Heroquests: the Basics
column2: 英雄任务：基础概念

column1: Heroquests are journeys into the timeless world of the gods. The quester assumes the identity of a deity and attempts to recreate the deity’s mythic actions. If the quester succeeds, he can harness huge supernatural powers for the good of the clan. If the quester fails, he risks death and bad consequences for the clan. Succeeding at a minimum number of heroquests is required to win the game.
column2: 英雄任务是前往神之永恒世界的旅程。探索者会化身为某位神明，尝试重现该神祇的神话事迹。若探索者成功，就能为氏族获取巨大的超凡力量；若失败，则可能丧命并给氏族带来恶果。在游戏中，完成最低数量的英雄任务是获胜的必要条件。

column1: Learning Blessings by Sacrificing for Mysteries
column2: 通过献祭学习祝福：为奥秘而献祭

column1: Your clan’s sudden emigration to Dragon Pass cut the god-talkers off from much of their former spiritual power. Reforge your links with the gods by sacrificing to individual deities. Sacrifice for a god’s mysteries will either reveal knowledge of one of the god’s blessings or increase your understanding of one of the god’s sacred myths. Spending magic on Mysteries rituals in the Sacred Time helps your first few sacrifices for Mysteries each year.
column2: 氏族突然迁居龙隘，切断了神言者与原有大部分精神力量的连结。通过向各位神明献祭，重新锻造与神的联系。为某位神的奥秘献祭，可能会揭示该神一项祝福的知识，或加深你对这位神圣神话的理解。在神圣时间内将魔法投入奥秘仪式，有助于每年最初几次为奥秘进行的献祭。

column1: You can see a summary of the blessings you know on each screen’s More Info page.
column2: 你可以在每个界面的“更多信息”页面中看到已知祝福的概要。

column1: Shrines, Temples and Great Temples
column2: 圣坛、神殿与大神殿

column1: Once you learn a blessing, you can either build a shrine to gain the blessing on a permanent basis, or sacrifice to the god again to gain that blessing for a year. Once you know two blessings for a particular deity, you can build a temple and gain those blessings year-round. When you know three or more blessings for a particular deity, you can build a Great Temple. A Great Temple gives you three permanent blessings, improves your reputation, and gives you an extra point of magic every year.
column2: 一旦你学会一项祝福，你可以建造一座圣坛来永久获得该祝福，或者再次向神献祭以将该祝福保持一年。当你为某位神祇学会两项祝福后，你可以建造一座神殿，从而全年获得这些祝福。当你为某位神祇学会三项或更多祝福后，你可以建造一座大神殿。大神殿会提供三项永久祝福，提升你的声望，并且每年额外获得一点魔法。

column1: We often use the word temple to refer to any shrine, temple, or Great Temple. We’ll use the specific term when we need to be specific, but temple is the generic term for any god-house.
column2: 我们常用“神殿”一词泛指任何圣坛、神殿或大神殿。在需要明确区分时，我们会使用具体术语，但“神殿”是任何神之屋舍的通用称呼。

column1: When you gain a blessing, it will be available in the Sacrifice dialog and usually the temple. A blessing connected to a shrine or temple will stay on until you change blessings or something happens to the temple; a blessing you sacrificed for will stay active for a year, then go off. With a couple of exceptions, sacrificing for a blessing when it is already in effect does not add to its potency. (You can also see a summary of active blessings on each screen’s More Info page.)
column2: 当你获得祝福后，它将在献祭对话框以及通常的神殿中可用。与圣坛或神殿关联的祝福会持续生效，直到你更换祝福或神殿发生变故；通过献祭获得的祝福会持续一年后失效。除少数例外情况，在祝福已生效时再次为其献祭不会增强其效果。（你同样可以在每个界面的“更多信息”页面中看到活跃祝福的概要。）

column1: Building Temples & Temple Maintenance
column2: 建造神殿与神殿维护

column1: Use the Build button to create a shrine or temple for a god whose blessings you know, or to reduce that god’s temple if you no longer wish to support it. Your advisors will remind you that shrines and temples require annual sacrifices of goods and cattle. If you have too many temples, your clan will be spread too thin to support them all. If you can’t support all your temples in the Sacred Time, one of them will be reduced for you.
column2: 使用“建造”按钮来为某位你已知祝福的神祇建造圣坛或神殿，或者在你不再支持某位神祇时将其神殿降级。你的顾问会提醒你，圣坛和神殿每年都需要以货物和牛只献祭。如果你拥有的神殿过多，氏族的力量就会分散，无法维持所有神殿。如果在神圣时间内你无法维持所有神殿，其中一座会被自动降级。

column1: Sacrificing to the gods on the Magic screen doesn’t always succeed. Your basic chance of success depends on your ring’s highest Magic skill. There are many other factors, a few of which are listed below:
column2: 在魔法界面向神献祭并不总能成功。基础成功率取决于你氏族议会的最高魔法技能。还有其他许多因素，以下列举部分：

column1: Size: Most gods accept both cattle and goods equally happily. Sacrificing fewer than 7 cows worth of cattle and goods hurts your chances. Sacrificing double or triple that amount greatly increases your chance of success.
column2: 规模：大多数神祇对牛只和货物的接受程度相同。献祭少于7头牛价值的牛只和货物会降低成功率。献祭双倍或三倍于该数量的物品能大幅提高成功率。

column1: Worshippers: Your sacrifice is more likely to succeed if at least one member of the clan ring is a devotee of the god you are sacrificing to.
column2: 信徒：如果氏族议会中至少有一人是你所献祭神祇的虔诚信徒，献祭更有可能成功。

column1: Clan magic: The higher the current magic, the greater the chance of success. A low magic pool is bad luck.
column2: 氏族魔法：当前魔法值越高，成功率越高。低魔法池是不祥之兆。

column1: Treasures: A few treasures can aid sacrifices.
column2: 宝物：少数宝物能辅助献祭。

column1: Omens: When a Sacred Time omen suggests sacrificing to a particular deity, you can expect sacrifices to that god to have a better chance of success.
column2: 征兆：当神圣时间的征兆建议向某位特定神祇献祭时，可以预期向该神的献祭有更高成功率。

column1: Special Cases:
column2: 特殊情况：

column1: Mysteries: As mentioned above, sacrificing for Mysteries works much better when you first spend magic on Mysteries rituals in Sacred Time. This effect decreases each time you sacrifice for Mysteries in a given year.
column2: 奥秘：如前所述，在神圣时间内先为奥秘仪式投入魔法时，为奥秘献祭的效果会好得多。这种效应在一年中每次为奥秘献祭后会递减。

column1: Divinations: Divinations, such as those performed to Lhankor Mhy and the Ancestors, are cheap: they do not require you to sacrifice as much for a good chance of success.
column2: 占卜：诸如向兰卡尔·米与祖先进行的占卜，成本较低——不需要为获得较高成功率而献祭太多。

column1: Human Sacrifice: Most clans performed some form of human sacrifice during the Great Darkness, so the gods will accept sacrificed thralls. In purely mechanical terms, sacrificing a thrall has the same effect as sacrificing ten cows. But times are not nearly as bad as they were during the Great Darkness, and human sacrifice is regarded as the sign of a desperate clan.
column2: 人祭：大多数氏族在大黑暗时期曾进行过某种形式的人祭，因此神祇会接受被献祭的奴隶。纯粹从机制上讲，献祭一个奴隶等同于献祭十头牛。但如今时局远不如大黑暗时期那样恶劣，人祭被视为绝望氏族的标志。

column1: The Gods and Their Blessings
column2: 众神及其祝福

column1: Several deities have blessings available only through sacrifice. The most useful of these are from Chalana Arroy. Other gods with sacrifice-only blessings include Eurmal, Malia, Maran Gor, Lhankor Mhy, and the Ancestors.
column2: 几位神祇的祝福只能通过献祭获得。其中最有用的是查拉娜·阿洛伊的祝福。其他只有通过献祭才能获得祝福的神祇包括欧尔马、玛利亚、马兰·格尔、兰卡尔·米以及祖先。

column1: Many of our ancestors still keep watch over the clan, even long after their death. None of the ancestors have the power of a god, but their collective benevolence is vital to the clan’s magic.
column2: 我们的许多祖先，即使在死后很久，仍在守护着氏族。没有哪位祖先拥有神祇的力量，但他们共同的仁慈对氏族的魔法至关重要。

column1: There are two standard questions you can pose to your ancestors:
column2: 你可以向祖先提出两个标准问题：

column1: • Is the clan suffering under any curses? • Are there any treasures to be found on the tula?
column2: • 氏族是否正遭受诅咒？• 图拉上是否藏有宝藏？

column1: Being spirits themselves, the ancestors can provide protection against hostile spirits, including those sent by enemy shamans.
column2: 祖先本身即是灵体，能提供保护以抵御敌对灵体，包括敌方萨满派来的那些。

column1: Orlanth himself used this ritual to draw his foe to him so he could defeat it. The Summons of Evil draws some aspect of your ancient enemy upon you. Defeating your enemy gives you other clans’ respect, and may give magical benefits.
column2: 奥兰斯本人曾用此仪式将敌人引至面前以便击败它。“邪恶召唤”会将你古老敌人的某一方面引到你身上。击败你的敌人能赢得其他氏族的尊重，并可能获得魔法增益。

column1: Barntar (BARN-tar)
column2: 巴恩塔（BARN-tar）

column1: The son of Orlanth and Ernalda, Barntar the Plowman is the most important god to those who till the soil.
column2: 奥兰斯与厄娜尔达之子，犁者巴恩塔是耕种者最重要的神祇。

column1: Of Barntar’s blessings, Plowsong is useful when your cattle herds are in bad shape and you can’t muster enough oxen to plow the fields properly. Vigor helps more often, reducing the number of farmers you need to tend the crops and herds.
column2: 在巴恩塔的祝福中，“犁歌”在牛群状况不佳、无法召集足够耕牛正常犁地时很有用。“活力”则更常用，能减少照料庄稼和牲畜所需的农夫数量。

column1: This blessing gives each ox additional strength and stamina, reducing the number of oxen you need to plow your fields.
column2: 此祝福赋予每头耕牛额外的力量和耐力，从而减少你犁地所需的耕牛数量。

column1: This blessing keeps your farmers from tiring, letting them work longer and harder.
column2: 此祝福使你的农夫不易疲惫，能工作得更久更卖力。

column1: Chalana Arroy (chah-LAH-nuh a-ROY)
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊（chah-LAH-nuh a-ROY）

column1: Chalana Arroy is the goddess of healing, and one of the Lightbringers. Her god-talkers wear a green sash, and are sworn to nonviolence. She is not impressed by sacrifice that unnecessarily spills blood.
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊是治愈女神，也是光明使者之一。她的神言者佩戴绿色绶带，并立誓非暴力。她不赞赏无谓流血的献祭。

column1: This blessing restores the sick to health. If it’s an ongoing blessing from a shrine or temple, it hastens the normal recovery rate. Unlike most blessings, it can be performed as a sacrifice even when you have the blessing from a shrine. Performed as a one-time sacrifice, it will cure people immediately. The larger the sacrifice, the more will be cured.
column2: 此祝福使病者恢复健康。如果是从神龛或神殿获得的持续性祝福，它会加快正常的恢复速度。与大多数祝福不同，即使你已从神龛获得祝福，仍可进行献祭来施行此祝福。若作为一次性献祭施行，它将立即治愈人们。献祭越大，治愈人数越多。

column1: This blessing heals the wounded. If it’s an ongoing blessing from a shrine or temple, it hastens the normal healing rate. Unlike most blessings, it can be performed as a sacrifice even when you have the blessing from a shrine. Performed as a one-time sacrifice, it will heal people immediately. The larger the sacrifice, the more will be healed.
column2: 此祝福治愈伤者。如果是从神龛或神殿获得的持续性祝福，它会加快正常的治愈速度。与大多数祝福不同，即使你已从神龛获得祝福，仍可进行献祭来施行此祝福。若作为一次性献祭施行，它将立即治愈人们。献祭越大，治愈人数越多。

column1: When times are bad, Chalana Arroy improves the spirits of those who are most troubled: the farmers, the warriors, or the clan as a whole.
column2: 时局艰难时，查拉娜·阿罗伊会提升最受困扰者的士气：农夫、战士，或整个氏族。

column1: Resurrection requires a relatively whole body that is still close to its severed spirit. If you’re going to try to resurrect a dead leader, don’t dally. Take the first chance you get or it will be too late.
column2: 复活需要一具相对完整的尸体，且其灵魂尚未远离。如果你打算复活一位死去的领袖，切勿耽搁。抓住第一个机会，否则为时已晚。

column1: One of Chalana Arroy’s amazing powers is the ability to restore the recently dead to life. The circumstances of death or the magical affiliation of the deceased can prevent this. Humakti, for example, are pledged to the god of Death, and can never be resurrected. Unlike more common sacrifices, Resurrection expends a great deal of the clan’s magic.
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊的惊人力量之一，是能令刚死者复生。死亡的情状或逝者的魔法归属可能阻止此事。例如，胡玛克提人已向死亡之神立誓，永不可被复活。与更常见的献祭不同，复活会消耗氏族大量的魔法。

column1: Elmal (EL-mahl)
column2: 埃尔马尔（EL-mahl）

column1: Elmal is god of the sun and has a special affinity for horses. He befriended Orlanth, and was adopted into the Storm Tribe. He served Orlanth loyally, staying behind to guard what was left of the world while Orlanth went on the Lightbringers Quest. A few clans worship Elmal as their main god, initiating boys into manhood with Elmal’s mysteries instead of Orlanth’s secrets.
column2: 埃尔马尔是太阳神，与马有特殊的亲和力。他与奥兰斯交友，并被风暴部落接纳。他忠诚侍奉奥兰斯，在奥兰斯踏上光明使者追寻时留守守护世界的残余。少数氏族以埃尔马尔为主神，用埃尔马尔的奥秘而非奥兰斯的秘密为男孩举行成年礼。

column1: This blessing reduces horse mortality rate, effectively increasing the size of the herd.
column2: 此祝福降低马匹死亡率，有效增加马群规模。

column1: Elmal’s brightly polished shield can protect your weaponthanes from injury and death in battle.
column2: 埃尔马尔擦得锃亮的盾牌能保护你的武器领主免于战斗中的伤亡。

column1: Improves your chances of winning battles when you are defending your home tula.
column2: 提升你在保卫家园图拉时赢得战斗的几率。

column1: Improves the yield of all crops.
column2: 提升所有作物的收成。

column1: Ernalda (er-NAHL-duh)
column2: 厄娜尔达（er-NAHL-duh）

column1: Ernalda is the great goddess of the earth, and Orlanth’s wife. She heads a pantheon of agricultural deities and household spirits. She is worshipped by most women. Some clans consider Ernalda their most important deity, since she orchestrated the creation of the first tribe.
column2: 厄娜尔达是伟大的大地女神，也是奥兰斯的妻子。她统领着农业神祇与家庭灵体的神系。多数女性崇拜她。一些氏族认为厄娜尔达是他们最重要的神祇，因她策划了第一个部落的创建。

column1: Increases the number of children born each year.
column2: 增加每年出生的孩子数量。

column1: Although this blessing helps all crops, it has the best effect on barley, Ernalda’s favorite plant.
column2: 尽管此祝福对一切作物都有帮助，但对大麦——厄娜尔达最喜爱的植物——效果最佳。

column1: This blessing reduces the amount of stored food which spoils every year.
column2: 此祝福减少每年腐坏的储存食物量。

column1: Remember, pigs — and all your herds — are included in your clan’s Cows value. So increasing pigs increases Cows.
column2: 记住，猪——以及你所有的牲畜——都计入氏族的牛只价值。因此增加猪的数量就增加了牛只。

column1: Increases the number of piglets born each year.
column2: 增加每年出生的猪崽数量。

column1: Eurmal (YUR-mahl)
column2: 尤尔马尔（YUR-mahl）

column1: Eurmal is the Trickster, always causing trouble. But he is also one of the Lightbringers, and helps bring about change in the world. Orlanthi clans do not build shrines to the trickster, so his blessings are only available through sacrifice when you have a Trickster on the ring. Eurmal is not as picky as the other deities, and often responds well to small sacrifices the other gods wouldn’t touch.
column2: 尤尔马尔是恶作剧者，总是惹麻烦。但他也是光明使者之一，促成了世间的变革。奥兰西氏族不为恶作剧者建造神龛，因此只有在你长老会中有一位恶作剧者时，才能通过献祭获得他的祝福。尤尔马尔不像其他神祇那样挑剔，常对别的神不屑一顾的小型献祭报以良好回应。

column1: The Trickster’s blessing can help the clan, though it’s hard to predict how.
column2: 恶作剧者的祝福能帮助氏族，尽管很难预测其方式。

column1: The Trickster’s curse will cause another clan some nasty trouble.
column2: 恶作剧者的诅咒会给另一个氏族带来棘手的麻烦。

column1: Humakt (HOO-makt)
column2: 胡玛克特（HOO-makt）

column1: If you choose not to obtain War blessings, and then make war against other clans, they may well use War blessings against you.
column2: 如果你选择不获得战争祝福，却又向其他氏族发动战争，他们很可能会用战争祝福来对付你。

column1: Humakt was Orlanth’s brother, but severed himself from his kin. He is still worshipped as the deadliest war god.
column2: 胡玛克特曾是奥兰斯的兄弟，但后来与亲族断绝了关系。他仍被奉为最致命的战争之神。

column1: This blessing improves your odds of winning any battle, even if you are otherwise entirely outmatched.
column2: 此祝福能提升你在任何战斗中获胜的几率，即使你完全处于劣势。

column1: Improves the ability of your warriors in battle, helping them inflict more casualties on the enemy.
column2: 提升你战士的战斗能力，使他们能对敌人造成更多伤亡。

column1: Humakt is the god of Truth and of oaths. This blessing helps convince other clans of your sincerity and strengthens your alliances.
column2: 胡玛克特是真理与誓言之神。此祝福有助于说服其他氏族相信你的诚意，并强化你的联盟。

column1: Humakt’s weapon is the sword. This blessing allows your weaponthanes to fight twice as effectively.
column2: 胡玛克特的武器是剑。此祝福让你的武器领主发挥双倍战力。

column1: Issaries (IS-sar-eez)
column2: 伊萨里斯（IS-sar-eez）

column1: Issaries is known as the Talking God, because his blessings help speakers ranging from storytellers to traders to poets. He is widely worshipped as the god of trade and as one of the Lightbringers.
column2: 伊萨里斯被称为谈判之神，因为他的祝福能帮助从说书人到商贾再到诗人的各种演说者。他被广泛奉为贸易之神，也是光明使者之一。

column1: This blessing makes your market more profitable, and lets you support an additional trading partner (unless the Trading blessing already allows one).
column2: 此祝福让你的市场获利更丰，并允许你额外支持一个贸易伙伴（除非贸易祝福已允许一个）。

column1: This blessing helps your traders and negotiators.
column2: 此祝福帮助你的商人和谈判者。

column1: This blessing is associated with Issaries’ son Harst. It provides extra food each year, allowing your farmers to profit with many small barters of their own that are not controlled by the clan ring.
column2: 此祝福与伊萨里斯之子哈斯特有关。每年提供额外食物，让你的农夫通过许多不受氏族议会控制的小规模物物交换获利。

column1: This blessing helps your trading caravans, and allows one additional trading partner (unless the Market blessing already allows one).
column2: 此祝福帮助你的贸易商队，并允许增加一个贸易伙伴（除非市场祝福已允许一个）。

column1: Lhankor Mhy (LANK-er MIGH)
column2: 兰克尔莫（LANK-er MIGH）

column1: Lhankor Mhy is called the Knowing God, for he knows all the precedents of the law, and much more. In Heortland, many of his god-talkers are literate. Lhankor Mhy was one of the Lightbringers.
column2: 兰克尔莫被称为全知之神，因为他通晓所有法律先例，且远不止于此。在霍特兰德，他的许多神言者都具备读写能力。兰克尔莫曾是光明使者之一。

column1: Divination is Lhankor Mhy’s stock in trade, and a smaller sacrifice is often answered. There are three standard divinations:
column2: 占卜是兰克尔莫的拿手本领，较小的献祭也常常得到回应。有三种标准占卜：

column1: Attitude: Reports the attitude of another clan’s leadership towards you, as well as whether its populace holds any hidden grudges. Strength: What is the battle strength and magic of another clan? Threats: Who is your worst enemy? Who hates you the most? Another clan? Or one of the inhuman peoples of Dragon Pass?
column2: 态度：报告另一个氏族领导层对你的态度，以及其民众是否怀有隐藏的积怨。力量：另一个氏族的战斗力量与魔法如何？威胁：谁是你最危险的敌人？谁最恨你？另一个氏族？还是龙隘中某个非人种族？

column1: This blessing increases the accuracy of divinations you perform during scenes.
column2: 此祝福提高你在场景中进行的占卜的准确度。

column1: By resolving small legal cases and disputes, this blessing helps maintain your clan mood.
column2: 通过解决小的法律案件和争端，此祝福有助于维持你的氏族情绪。

column1: This blessing helps your god-talkers record your dealings with other clans, thereby avoiding inadvertent violations of treaties and bargains. Literacy helps you get along better with your neighbors by avoiding stupid disputes.
column2: 此祝福帮助你的神言者记录与其他氏族的交易，从而避免无意中违反条约和协议。读写能力有助于你避免愚蠢的争端，与邻居更好地相处。

column1: Malia (MAL-ee-uh)
column2: 玛利亚（MAL-ee-uh）

column1: Although no clan would worship Malia, Mother of Disease, it’s not unheard of to propitiate her. As mistress of all illnesses, she is quite capable of curing them, when she chooses.
column2: 虽然没有任何氏族会崇拜疾病之母玛利亚，但安抚她也并非闻所未闻。作为所有疾病的主宰，只要她愿意，她完全有能力治愈它们。

column1: This blessing restores the sick to health. It will cure people immediately. The larger the sacrifice, the more will be cured.
column2: 此祝福使病者康复。它能立即治愈人们。献祭越大，治愈的人越多。

column1: Malia is always willing to bring disease to another clan.
column2: 玛利亚总是乐于将疾病带给另一个氏族。

column1: Malia is willing to grant immunity from disease to those who sacrifice to her.
column2: 玛利亚愿意向那些向她献祭的人赐予疾病免疫。

column1: Maran Gor (MAH-rahn GOR)
column2: 马兰·戈尔（MAH-rahn GOR）

column1: Maran Gor is Ernalda’s sister. Where Ernalda controls the fertile earth, Maran Gor represents its powers of destruction. She controls earthquakes and is said to be the mother of the creatures known as earthshakers.
column2: 马兰·戈尔是厄纳尔达的姐妹。厄纳尔达掌管肥沃的大地，而马兰·戈尔则代表其毁灭之力。她控制地震，据说是被称为地动者的生物之母。

column1: Maran Gor can curse another clan’s fields with infertility.
column2: 马兰·戈尔可以诅咒另一个氏族的田地使其贫瘠。

column1: This blessing grants fertility to your crops when people are killed in battle on your tula. Maran Gor loves blood sacrifices, and accepts the deaths of your own warriors as readily as the deaths of invaders.
column2: 当有人在你的领地上战死时，此祝福会赐予你的作物丰饶。马兰·戈尔喜爱血祭，她既接纳入侵者的死亡，也接纳你自己战士的死亡。

column1: For mythic reasons, Orlanthi are cat-lovers and dog-haters. The alynx is a semi-domesticated hunting cat that grows as large as a bobcat.
column2: 出于神话原因，奥兰斯人爱猫憎狗。艾林克斯猫是一种半驯化的狩猎猫，体型能长到山猫那么大。

column1: Odayla (oe-DAY-lah)
column2: 奥达拉（oe-DAY-lah）

column1: Odayla, half-brother to Orlanth, is the god of the hunt in all its forms. He is a good friend with another of Orlanth’s half-brothers, Yinkin the Alynx god. A worshipper on the ring will get more productivity out of your hunters.
column2: 奥达拉，奥兰斯的同父异母兄弟，是各式狩猎的守护神。他与奥兰斯的另一个同父异母兄弟、艾林克斯猫之神因金是好友。氏族议会中若有他的信徒，你的猎人产出会更高。

column1: This blessing ensures that the alynxes pay special attention to the vermin that would otherwise eat your stored grain.
column2: 此祝福确保艾林克斯猫特别关注那些会吃掉你储存谷物的害虫。

column1: Helps your hunters hit their prey and bring home more game. It also helps your skirmishers in combat.
column2: 帮助你的猎人击中猎物并带回更多猎物。也帮助你的散兵在战斗中发挥作用。

column1: This blessing helps your hunters and trackers locate what they search for.
column2: 此祝福帮助你的猎人和追踪者找到他们搜寻的目标。

column1: Orlanth (OR-lanth)
column2: 奥兰斯（OR-lanth）

column1: Orlanth proved himself the preeminent god when he cast down Emperor Yelm and led the world during the Storm Age. When Chaos threatened to destroy everything, he embarked on the Lightbringers Quest to save and remake the world.
column2: 奥兰斯在推翻皇帝耶尔姆并领导世界度过风暴时代时证明了自己是卓越之神。当混沌威胁要毁灭一切时，他开启了光明使者追寻之旅以拯救并重塑世界。

column1: Orlanth’s lightning dances among your warriors in battle, inflicting more casualties upon your enemies.
column2: 奥兰斯的闪电在战斗中于你的战士之间舞动，对敌人造成更多伤亡。

column1: Orlanth’s gentle rains improve the yield of all your crops.
column2: 奥兰斯的温和雨水提高你所有作物的产量。

column1: This blessing, used on stones cast by your slingers, makes your skirmishers more effective in battle.
column2: 此祝福用于投石兵投掷的石块，让我们的散兵在战斗中更高效。

column1: This blessing lets your clan war paint protect the footmen from wounds and even death in battle.
column2: 此祝福让氏族战纹保护步兵免受伤害，甚至免于战死。

column1: Uralda (oor-AL-duh)
column2: 乌拉尔达（oor-AL-duh）

column1: Uralda is a daughter of Ernalda and the mother of all cattle.
column2: 乌拉尔达是厄纳尔达之女，所有牛只之母。

column1: This blessing increases the number of calves born to your cows.
column2: 此祝福增加母牛所产牛犊的数量。

column1: This blessing brings more milk to your cows’ udders. (In other words, more food production from your herds.)
column2: 此祝福让母牛的乳房产出更多乳汁。（换言之，增加畜群的粮食产量。）

column1: Urox (OOR-ox)
column2: 乌洛克斯（OOR-ox）

column1: Orlanth’s unruly brother is also known as the Storm Bull and the Cleansing Wind. He is fanatically devoted to the fight against Chaos.
column2: 奥兰斯不服管教的兄弟，又被称为风暴公牛与净化之风。他狂热地投身于对抗混沌的战斗。

column1: Urox is prone to fits of destructive rage, which can be useful on the battlefield. You may win battles you would otherwise have lost, but both sides will suffer more casualties.
column2: 乌洛克斯易陷入毁灭性的狂怒，这在战场上或许有用。你可能赢得原本会输的战斗，但双方都会承受更多伤亡。

column1: Urox is keenly aware of the approach of evil Chaos. By sensing small outbreaks of Chaos, he can ward off its more dangerous manifestations.
column2: 乌洛克斯敏锐地感知到邪恶混沌的逼近。通过察觉小规模的混沌爆发，他能抵御其更危险的显现。

column1: Soon or later you have to confront Chaos. This blessing aids every such battle.
column2: 迟早你必须面对混沌。此祝福有助于每一场此类战斗。

column1: Vinga (VING-gah)
column2: 温加（VING-gah）

column1: Vinga is a granddaughter of Orlanth. She travelled widely during the Darkness, protecting women, serving her king, and showing that women could flourish on the field of battle.
column2: 温加是奥兰斯的孙女。她在黑暗时代广游四方，保护妇女，效忠其王，并证明女性同样能在战场上大放异彩。

column1: This blessing gives many of the clan’s women the confidence to take up arms. You gain more warriors for the fyrd but suffer a penalty for childrearing.
column2: 此祝福赐予氏族中许多女性拿起武器的信心。你获得更多民兵战士，但育儿能力受到惩罚。

column1: Vinga guides your explorers’ steps, helping them return home safely and quickly.
column2: 温加指引探索者的步伐，帮助他们安全快速地返回家园。

column1: Several deities do not start on your clan’s list of worshipped deities; you will have to persuade them to bless your clan during the game. One is important enough to mention here. The others you may find through exploration.
column2: 若干神祇并不在你的氏族初始崇拜神祇名单上；你必须在游戏中说服他们赐福于你的氏族。其中一位重要到值得一提。其余的你或许能通过探索发现。

column1: Kero Fin (KERR-oh FIN)
column2: 凯罗·芬（KERR-oh FIN）

column1: The great mountain, Orlanth’s mother, occasionally known as Wintertop. As the symbol of the union of Earth and Air, Kero Fin provides behind-the-scenes supernatural aid to would-be unifiers of Dragon Pass that is much greater than her relatively minor permanent blessing.
column2: 大山，奥兰斯之母，有时被称为冬峰。作为地与风结合的象征，凯罗·芬为龙隘的潜在统一者提供幕后的超自然援助，其作用远大于她相对较小的永久祝福。

column1: Prevents children from getting sick.
column2: 防止孩童染病。

column1: Heroquests
column2: 英雄任务

column1: Four myths have another level of knowledge, secrets that give you a bonus to complete their quests: The Making of the Storm Tribe, Ernalda Feeds the Tribe, Elmal Guards the Stead and Uralda’s Blessing. These deeper secrets appear as shaded text in the myth and are marked on the Lore Screen with ⊜ beside their titles.
column2: 四则神话拥有更深层的知识，这些秘密让你在完成任务时获得加成：《建造风暴部落》《厄纳尔达哺育部落》《艾尔玛守护家园》与《尤拉尔达的赐福》。这些更深层的秘密以阴影文字出现在神话中，并在知识界面中于标题旁标记⊜。

column1: Learning how to do the Quest
column2: 学习如何执行任务

column1: The basic information on each myth is available on the Lore screen. To attempt a heroquest, your clan needs to know the details of the quest’s associated myth. The game shows when you have sufficient knowledge of a myth: the myth acquires a mark ⊝ on the Lore screen to show that you’ve learned the details (or ⊜ if you know additional secrets). Read the myth to discover the best way to win the quest. Not all myths have heroquests associated with them.
column2: 每则神话的基本信息可在知识界面查看。要尝试英雄任务，你的氏族需了解任务相关神话的细节。当你有足够的神话知识时，游戏会显示：该神话在知识界面上获得标记⊝，表示你已掌握细节（若知道额外秘密则为⊜）。阅读神话以发现赢得任务的最佳途径。并非所有神话都有对应的英雄任务。

column1: Succeeding with Quests
column2: 成功完成任务

column1: Worshippers
column2: 崇拜者

column1: Heroquests are major undertakings. All the adults of your clan help prepare the quester, donating as much of their personal magic and worship as possible. The larger the number of people supporting the quest, the more likely it is to succeed. You can ask allies or clans that owe you a favor to send supporters. When you’re in a tribe, your quester enjoys a great deal more support when you ask for helpers from the tribe.
column2: 英雄任务是重大事业。氏族中的全体成年人都帮助准备探索者，尽可能捐献他们的个人魔法与崇拜。支持任务的人越多，成功可能性越大。你可以请求盟友或欠你恩惠的氏族派遣支持者。当你属于一个部落时，向部落请求帮助，你的探索者将获得更多支持。

column1: While the quester bears the brunt of the responsibility to perform the heroquest, sometimes the worshippers back home get an opportunity to help. This can significantly improve the odds of success.
column2: 尽管探索者承担执行英雄任务的主要责任，但有时家乡的崇拜者有机会提供帮助。这能显著提高成功几率。

column1: You need to prove yourself to the gods and the other clans with successful heroquests in order to win the game. Winning the Short Game requires you to perform the Making of the Storm Tribe quest, then succeed at three more heroquests in the ten years after you have attained kingship of your tribe. Winning the Long Game requires the Making of the Storm Tribe quest and seven subsequent successful heroquests.
column2: 你需要通过成功的英雄任务向众神和其他氏族证明自己，才能赢得游戏。赢得短游戏需要你执行建造风暴部落任务，然后在获得部落王权后的十年内再成功完成三次英雄任务。赢得长游戏则需要建造风暴部落任务及其后续七次成功的英雄任务。

column1: The Quester
column2: 探索者

column1: The game selects the quester it thinks has the best chance of success. Criteria include the quester’s god (Orlanth worshippers have a much better chance of succeeding at an Orlanth quest than at the Elmal quest, for example) and skills (primarily Combat, Magic, and Leadership, though specific quests test all the other skills).
column2: 游戏会选择它认为成功几率最高的探索者。标准包括探索者所崇拜的神（例如，奥兰斯崇拜者在奥兰斯任务中成功的几率远高于艾尔玛任务）以及技能（主要是战斗、魔法和领导力，但特定任务会测试所有其他技能）。

column1: If you’d like to choose a different leader to attempt a quest, that’s your prerogative. You’ll want to know that…
column2: 若你想选择另一位领袖来尝试任务，那是你的权利。你会想知道……

column1: • Men can’t attempt the Ernalda or Uralda quests. • Humakti are forbidden from performing the Chalana Arroy quest. • Female worshippers of Issaries or Humakt can attempt their god’s heroquests with no penalties, as can male worshippers of Chalana Arroy. The text and art will often look strange since the female (or male) quester will be assuming the male (or female) god’s role. • Vinga-worshippers can perform any Orlanth quest as if they were Orlanth-worshippers.
column2: • 男性无法尝试厄纳尔达或尤拉尔达任务。 • 胡马科提信徒被禁止执行查拉娜·阿罗伊任务。 • 伊萨里斯或胡马克特的女信徒可以尝试其神祇的英雄任务而不受惩罚，查拉娜·阿罗伊的男信徒也同样可以。不过文本和画面往往会显得奇怪，因为女性（或男性）探索者将扮演男性（或女性）神祇的角色。 • 温加信徒可以执行任何奥兰斯任务，就像他们是奥兰斯信徒一样。

column1: Sacred Time Rituals
column2: 神圣时间仪式
