column1: The first step in a quest is to cross over to the Other Side. The entire clan participates in sending the quester from the world of Time into the timeless Godplane. Sometimes your quester will fail to make the transition, burning your Quest magic for the year to no effect. To increase the chances of success in crossing to the Godplane, make sure your ring includes a leader with high Magic skill.
column2: 任务的第一步是跨越到彼岸。整个氏族都会参与，将探索者从时间世界送入永恒的神界。有时你的探索者会无法完成过渡，白白消耗你当年的任务魔法，毫无效果。要提高成功跨越到神界的机会，请确保你的长老会中包含一位拥有高技能魔法值的领袖。

column1: Before you attempt a heroquest, it’s a good idea to allocate magic to Quest rituals in the Sacred Time. The Quest rituals will often make the difference between success and failure, but they only aid the first heroquest you attempt each year. Attempting multiple heroquests in the same year is extremely risky.
column2: 在尝试英雄任务之前，最好在神圣时间内将魔法分配至任务仪式。任务仪式往往是成败的关键，但它们只对每年第一次尝试的英雄任务有效。同年尝试多次英雄任务风险极高。

column1: Recall that a worshipper of Eurmal on the ring gives you the chance to spend an extra point of magic on Quests.
column2: 请记住，长老会上若有一位欧尔玛信徒，你就有机会在任务上额外花费一点魔法。

column1: Clan Magic
column2: 氏族魔法

column1: High clan magic gives a better chance of success. Negative clan magic hurts your chances.
column2: 高氏族魔法能提高成功率。低氏族魔法则会降低你的机会。

column1: Benefits of Heroquests
column2: 英雄任务的收益

column1: You can perform quests more than once. To win the game, however, you must succeed at three (Short Game) or seven (Long Game) different quests after forming a tribe. Performing the Making of the Storm Tribe quest again after you receive the Ten Year Ring in a short game will count as one of those quests.
column2: 你可以多次执行同一任务。但要想赢得游戏，你必须在组建部落后成功完成三（短游戏）或七（长游戏）个不同的任务。在短游戏中获得十年之环后，再次执行建造风暴部落任务将计入这些任务之一。

column1: Each of the nine heroquests provides a number of benefits appropriate to the individual deity’s powers. You select the benefit you’re aiming at before your quester crosses over to the Godplane. In addition, succeeding with any heroquest increases your clan’s reputation and provides a basic magical benefit corresponding to the quest. These basic benefits generally last three years (unlike the specific benefits you choose, which are often permanent). The basic benefits are never cumulative, so performing the same quest twice in a three-year span won’t get you double the benefit, though it could provide you with two specific benefits.
column2: 九个英雄任务各自提供若干与对应神祇能力相匹配的收益。你在探索者跨越到神界之前选择目标收益。此外，成功完成任何英雄任务都会提高氏族的声望，并提供与该任务对应的基础魔法收益。这些基础收益通常持续三年（与你选择的具体收益不同，后者通常是永久性的）。基础收益不会累积，因此在三年内两次执行同一任务不会使收益翻倍，但你可以获得两个具体收益。

column1: Basic Heroquest Benefits:
column2: 英雄任务基础收益：

column1: Chalana Arroy Heals the Scars: Reduces rate of sickness and disease. Elmal Guards the Stead: Lessens the threat of Chaos; provides horses if our horse herds are too small. Ernalda Feeds the Tribe: Aids cattle fertility, grain yield, and farmer productivity. Humakt the Champion: Five of your warriors fight as well as six of your enemies. Issaries the Conciliator: Reduces the threat of banditry. Lhankor Mhy Finds the Truth: Bonus in situations involving Custom, Mystery, and Divination. Making of the Storm Tribe: Bonus in situations in which you’re trying to persuade others. Orlanth and Aroka: Prevents drought, gives your warriors a bonus in battle. Uralda’s Blessing: Increases cattle fertility and reduces cattle diseases.
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊治愈伤痕：降低疾病与瘟疫发生率。埃尔马尔守护家园：减轻混沌的威胁；若我们的马群过小则提供马匹。厄纳尔达养育部落：促进牛群繁殖、粮食产量和农夫生产力。胡马克特冠军：你的五名战士可匹敌六名敌人。伊萨里斯调解者：降低匪患威胁。兰科尔·姆伊发现真相：在涉及习俗、神秘和占卜的情境中获得加成。建造风暴部落：在试图说服他人的情境中获得加成。奥兰斯与阿罗卡：防止干旱，使你的战士在战斗中获加成。尤拉尔达的赐福：提高牛群繁殖率，减少牛群疾病。

column1: Just knowing what to do doesn't mean your quester can succeed at what it originally took a god to do. The previously-trodden paths are easier, however.
column2: 仅仅知道该做什么，并不意味着你的探索者就能完成那些原本只有神才能做到的事。不过，前人已经走过的路会更容易些。

column1: Mythic Hints
column2: 神话提示

column1: Many — but not all — choices in a heroquest correspond to elements of the myth. At these points, you can tap the Mythic Hint button to see the choice that best matches.
column2: 英雄任务中的许多——但并非全部——选择都对应于神话元素。在这些节点，你可以点击神话提示按钮，查看最匹配的选择。

column1: You only get one hint per quest. You'll get an extra hint for the quest associated with your main deity — your quester is presumably very familiar with the story.
column2: 每个任务你只能获得一次提示。与你的主神相关的任务会额外获得一次提示——你的探索者想必对该故事非常熟悉。

column1: You can see a summary of the blessings you know at the bottom right of each screen.
column2: 你可以在每个屏幕的右下角查看已知赐福的摘要。

column1: When you gain a blessing, it will be available in the Sacrifice dialog and usually the temple. A blessing connected to a shrine or temple will stay on until you change blessings or something happens to the temple; a blessing you sacrificed for will stay active for a year, then go off. With a couple of exceptions, sacrificing for a blessing when it is already in effect does not add to its potency. (You can also see a summary of active blessings at the bottom right of each screen.)
column2: 当你获得一项赐福后，它将出现在献祭对话框以及通常的寺庙中。与神社或寺庙关联的赐福会持续生效，直到你更换赐福或寺庙发生变故；通过献祭获得的赐福将保持活跃一年，然后失效。除少数例外，在赐福已生效时再次献祭不会增强其效力。（你也可以在每个屏幕的右下角查看活跃赐福的摘要。）

column1: General Notes
column2: 通用说明

column1: Getting Started
column2: 开始游戏

column1: Try to establish a few trade routes, learn some useful blessings and build shrines or temples to activate them. Explore the tula, and don’t forget to hire weaponthanes. Send an emissary to give gifts or try to end a feud.
column2: 尝试建立几条贸易路线，学习一些有用的赐福，并建造神社或寺庙来激活它们。探索图拉领地，别忘了雇佣武器领主。派遣使者赠送礼物或尝试结束世仇。

column1: Tips
column2: 提示

column1: Remember that each screen has a More Info side, which shows magic that’s relevant to that screen. It also has a brief summary of the screen.
column2: 请记住，每个屏幕都有一个更多信息侧栏，显示与该屏幕相关的魔法。它还有该屏幕的简要摘要。

column1: Don’t forget to check what your advisors have to say. If nothing else, you can learn a little of their personality.
column2: 别忘了查看顾问们的意见。至少，你能了解一点他们的性格。

column1: Tap the art behind text to see it.
column2: 点击文字背后的画面即可查看。

column1: Turns
column2: 回合

column1: The game moves forward in time allowing two player-initiated actions per season. Though you will have crises and situations that come to you, time will pass only when you initiate an action. If you cannot think of any good thing to do, but want to move the game along, tap the season wheel to force time to pass.
column2: 游戏随时间推进，每季允许玩家发起两次行动。虽然会有危机和情况找上门，但时间只会在你发起行动时流逝。若想不出什么好事可做，却又希望游戏继续，轻点季节轮盘强制时间前进。

column1: Saving
column2: 保存

column1: KoDP saves the game when things change, so you don’t have to worry about getting interrupted or running out of batteries. It will reopen to where you were, assuming your device supports multitasking (and other apps don’t reclaim its memory). If necessary, it will restart before an interactive scene.
column2: 当游戏状态发生变化时，KoDP 会自动保存，因此你不必担心被打断或电量耗尽。假设你的设备支持多任务（且其他应用不会占用其内存），游戏会重新打开到你离开的位置。必要时，会在交互场景前重新启动。

column1: To restore to an earlier point in time, use the Saga screen to choose the end of a year to go back to.
column2: 要恢复到更早的时间点，请使用“史卷”界面选择某年的年底回退。

column1: You’ll only see the tutorial the very first time you play. You can start it again (for example, if another player is using the same device) from the Controls screen.
column2: 你只在初次游玩时看到教程。你可以从“控制界面”重新开始教程（例如，如果其他玩家使用同一设备）。

column1: Remember that magic relevant to each screen is shown at the bottom. The rune indicates which deity provides the magic.
column2: 请记住，每个界面相关的魔法都会显示在底部。符文指明提供该魔法的神祇。

column1: KoDP saves the game when things change, so you don’t have to worry about getting interrupted or running out of batteries. It will reopen to where you were, assuming other apps don’t reclaim its memory. If necessary, it will restart before an interactive scene.
column2: 当游戏状态发生变化时，KoDP 会自动保存，因此你不必担心被打断或电量耗尽。假设其他应用不会占用其内存，游戏会重新打开到你离开的位置。必要时，会在交互场景前重新启动。

column1: Clan Questionnaire
column2: 氏族问卷

column1: Starting the Game
column2: 开始游戏

column1: You begin the game by running through a short interactive history of your clan's actions in the Godtime, the days of creation when humans and gods lived side-by-side. This interactive history runs up to the time that your clan left its ancestral home to move north to Dragon Pass.
column2: 你通过一段简短的交互式历史开始游戏，这段历史讲述你的氏族在神代（创世之日，人类与诸神并存的时代）的事迹。这段交互式历史一直延续到你的氏族离开祖地、北迁至龙之隘口之时。

column1: The questionnaire has no right or wrong answers — you're creating backstory. Each answer molds the mythological profile of the clan you will play. Playing the game well often depends on living up to the example set by your ancestors, so it's worthwhile considering your answers.
column2: 问卷没有正确或错误答案——你正在创造背景故事。每个答案都会塑造你将扮演的氏族的神话轮廓。玩好游戏往往取决于不辜负祖先树立的榜样，因此仔细考虑你的答案是值得的。

column1: Choose your answers by tapping. At any point, you can skip to the end. Once you've completed the clan history, you can go back and start over from the Questionnaire Review screen.
column2: 通过点击选择答案。你可以随时跳到结尾。完成氏族历史后，你可以从“问卷回顾界面”返回并重新开始。

column1: You'll need to scroll to see all choices. Be sure to flick briskly so you don't pick an answer. You'll know you're at the end of the list when you see a thin gold bar. And remember, you can tap on the illustration to see it without text.
column2: 你需要滚动才能查看所有选项。务必快速划过，以免误选答案。看到一条细金条即表示到达列表末尾。切记，你可以点击插图查看无文字版本。

column1: Questionnaire Flow
column2: 问卷流程

column1: Most screens want you to make a decision, others just contain information.
column2: 大多数界面要求你做出决定，其他界面仅包含信息。

column1: The Mythic Age
column2: 神话时代

column1: The Marriage of Orlanth and Ernalda
column2: 奥兰斯与厄尔纳达的婚姻

column1: Decide which is your clan's most important deity: Orlanth, Ernalda, or Elmal. The game is slightly easier if Orlanth is your main god, but if you would rather be devoted to the Earth Mother or the Sun Defender, here's your chance. The game starts with a temple for the deity chosen here.
column2: 决定哪个是你的氏族最重要的神祇：奥兰斯、厄尔纳达还是埃尔马尔。若以奥兰斯为主神，游戏会稍显容易；但若你更愿侍奉大地母亲或太阳捍卫者，这便是你的机会。游戏开始时将有一尊所选神祇的神庙。

column1: Winning as an Elmal clan can be significantly harder.
column2: 以埃尔马尔氏族获胜可能困难得多。

column1: Earliest Famous Event
column2: 最早知名事件

column1: Each event starts your clan with knowledge of a different divine blessing. Most events also affect your clan leaders' skills:
column2: 每个事件都会让你的氏族知晓一种不同的神圣祝福。大多数事件还会影响氏族领袖的技能：

column1: Healing of Orlanth: start with an extra Chalana Arroy blessing.
column2: 奥兰斯之愈：以一份额外的查拉纳·阿罗伊祝福开始。

column1: Hundred-Day Hunt: leaders are above average in Animals, Combat, and Plants.
column2: 百日狩猎：领袖在动物、战斗和植物技能上高于平均水平。

column1: Jested's Settlement: leaders are above average in Bargaining.
column2: 杰斯特定居点：领袖在议价技能上高于平均水平。

column1: Procession of the Animals: leaders are above average in Animals.
column2: 动物行列：领袖在动物技能上高于平均水平。

column1: Barntar Harnessing the Oxen: leaders are above average in Plants.
column2: 巴恩塔驾驭公牛：领袖在植物技能上高于平均水平。

column1: Lhankor Mhy Learns to Use the Marking Bone: leaders are above average in Custom.
column2: 兰科·米学会使用刻骨：领袖在习俗技能上高于平均水平。

column1: The First Pot: support more crafters than usual.
column2: 第一只陶罐：比往常多供养工匠。

column1: The Clan-making Dance: leaders are above average in Leadership.
column2: 部落创立之舞：领袖在领导力技能上高于平均水平。

column1: Stick Farmers
column2: 棍棒农夫

column1: If your ancestors adopted remnant people, they dislike the institution of slavery. Conversely, if they took the Nalda Bin as thralls, they see nothing wrong with the practice.
column2: 如果你的祖先收养了遗民，他们便不喜奴隶制度。反之，若他们将纳尔达·宾人收为奴隶，则视这种习俗为理所当然。

column1: Ancient Enemies
column2: 宿敌

column1: Your clan's ancient enemies are still around to bedevil you in one form or another today. Your ancestors expect you to maintain the enmity.
column2: 你氏族的宿敌至今仍以各种形式缠扰不休。你的祖先期望你维系这份仇怨。

column1: History and the conventional measurement of time began at the Dawn. Before the Dawn, in the Gods Age, Time hadn't even been born. Events happened all at once, in pieces, or whenever they pleased. Myths of the Godplane which seem vague or contradictory may be strictly accurate records of an era that did not operate by the same standards as current time-bound reality.
column2: 历史与常规的时间度量始于黎明时代。在黎明之前，众神时代，时间甚至尚未诞生。事件同时、零碎或随心所欲地发生。神界那些看似模糊或矛盾的神话，或许正是对一个时代严格准确的记录——那个时代遵循的标准与当下受时间束缚的现实截然不同。

column1: King Heort
column2: 赫尔特王

column1: Your clan will begin its life in Dragon Pass organized the same way it was at the end of the Darkness. War clans can allocate more clan magic towards war magic, and more of the farmers muster to fight in the fyrd (the fyrd is the total number of battle-ready adults in your clan.) Peace clans can allocate more clan magic towards fertility magic, and the fyrd is smaller. Balanced clans are in the middle. It's possible to switch your clan type later, during play, but some of the benefits require you to remain the same type for several years.
column2: 你的氏族将在龙之隘口以黑暗时代结束时同样的组织方式开始生活。战争氏族可以将更多氏族魔法分配用于战争魔法，并有更多农夫应征加入民兵（民兵是你氏族中所有能战斗的成年人数目）。和平氏族可以将更多氏族魔法分配用于丰收魔法，民兵规模也更小。平衡氏族则介于两者之间。游戏过程中你可以在后期切换氏族类型，但某些好处要求你保持同一类型数年。

column1: The Dawn
column2: 黎明时代

column1: When your clan arrives in Dragon Pass, it builds a shrine to whichever deity you first awakened at the Dawn. Note that three gods who remained awake during the Darkness, Odayla, Elmal, and Urox, are grouped as Living Deities on this screen. Choosing one of them indicates that you worshipped a living god throughout the Darkness, but is not functionally different than choosing a god who had to be awakened.
column2: 当你们的氏族抵达龙之隘口时，会为黎明时代最先唤醒的那位神祇修建一座神龛。请注意，黑暗时期仍保持清醒的三位神——奥达拉、埃尔玛尔和乌洛克斯，在此界面被归为“现世神祇”。选择其中一位表示你们在整个黑暗时期都信奉着一位现世神，但在功能上与被唤醒的神并无区别。

column1: See the Lore screen's History & Culture section's notes on the Dragonkill for more on the civilization that last occupied Dragon Pass.
column2: 关于上次占据龙之隘口的文明详情，请参阅知识界面的历史与文化板块中关于龙杀的备注。

column1: Dragons
column2: 龙

column1: Whatever attitude your ancestors had towards dragons in the past is how you will want to treat dragonewts and their kin today.
column2: 你们祖先过去对龙所持的态度，就是你们今天对待龙人及其亲族应有的方式。

column1: The Migration
column2: 迁徙

column1: Land Claim
column2: 土地声索

column1: The more land you have, the easier it is to support a large clan. However, larger borders are harder to patrol and your enemies will find it easier to elude your patrols.
column2: 土地越多，越容易供养一个庞大的氏族。然而，边境越大就越难巡逻，敌人也更容易避开你们的巡逻队。

column1: Questionnaire Review
column2: 问卷回顾

column1: Making Changes
column2: 做出更改

column1: If you decide to make changes, tap Back to return to the beginning of the questionnaire.
column2: 如果决定更改，点击“返回”回到问卷开头。

column1: Clan Name
column2: 氏族名称

column1: If you want, tap on the name given to your clan and enter a new name.
column2: 如有需要，点击系统赋予的氏族名称，输入新名称。

column1: Difficulty Level
column2: 难度等级

column1: The difficulty level affects starting conditions such as fortifications, trading partners, feuds, and allies, among other things. If you haven't managed your clan well at the Normal level, beware the harder games.
column2: 难度等级影响起始条件，例如防御工事、贸易伙伴、世仇和盟友等。如果你在普通难度下未能妥善管理氏族，请警惕更高难度的游戏。

column1: The Hard game can be very difficult. We highly recommend trying Normal first.
column2: 困难模式可能非常艰难。我们强烈建议先尝试普通模式。

column1: Game Length
column2: 游戏时长

column1: The short game consists of building up your clan's reputation and convincing neighboring clans to form a tribe. Once one of your clan leaders is elected tribal king, he or she must hold the throne for ten years. If you have maintained your herds, performed at least two heroquests, and built a solid reputation with your neighbors, you'll win.
column2: 短游戏包括：提升氏族声望，说服邻近氏族组建部落。一旦你们的某位氏族领袖当选部落王，他或她必须维持王位十年。如果你保住了畜群、完成了至少两次英雄任务、并在邻邦中建立了良好声望，即可获胜。

column1: As in the short game, you need to found a tribe. While performing seven different heroquests, you'll need to convince the other tribes to form together into a kingdom, then prove yourself worthy of ruling that kingdom. The winner is crowned High King or High Queen of Dragon Pass.
column2: 与短游戏类似，你需要建立一个部落。在完成七个不同的英雄任务的同时，你还需要说服其他部落联合成一个王国，并证明自己值得统治该王国。获胜者将被加冕为龙之隘口的至高王或至高女王。

column1: Relations Screen
column2: 关系界面

column1: One of the first things you’ll want to do is check the Relations screen and find out about your nearest neighbors. Clans that share a border with your clan, or that are only one clan away from your clan, are marked with an ‘N’, and are the clans you will have the most interaction with during the pre-tribal game. (Once you’re in a tribe, tribe-mates are marked with a ‘T’.)
column2: 首先要做的事情之一就是查看关系界面，了解最近的邻居。与你们氏族接壤，或仅隔一个氏族的部落会标有“N”标记，这些是在前部落时期与你们互动最频繁的氏族。（一旦加入部落，部落成员会标有“T”标记。）

column1: To show feuding clans, allies, etc., slide the list of categories to the left or right. The list shows whatever you put over the pointer in the center.
column2: 要显示世仇氏族、盟友等，请左右滑动分类列表。列表显示的是你置于中央指针上的内容。

column1: The Relations screen tracks basic information about all the other clans in Dragon Pass, the names of their chiefs, whether they owe you a favor (or if you owe them) and if you have a formal relationship with them, such as an alliance or a feud. Once you get to the tribal level, the Relations screen can help you keep track of which clans are in which tribes.
column2: 关系界面追踪龙之隘口所有其他氏族的基本信息：其首领姓名、是否欠你们人情（或你们欠他们人情）、以及是否与你们有正式关系（如联盟或世仇）。进入部落层面后，关系界面可帮助你掌握哪些氏族属于哪些部落。

column1: At a quick glance, the map in the Relations screen provides a color-coded summary of how the leaders of the other clans in Dragon Pass feel about your clan. The colors range from the bright blue of allies to the red of your enemies, the clans you are feuding with. This color coded summary does not entirely account for grudges which the common people of those clans may have accumulated against you. Feuds generally start when the people of another clan have had enough of your slights against them, a response that does not always correspond to poor relations with the other clan’s nobles.
column2: 关系界面中的地图通过颜色编码，快速呈现龙之隘口其他氏族首领对你们氏族的态度。颜色范围从盟友的亮蓝色到敌人的红色（即与你们有世仇的氏族）。这种颜色编码并不能完全反映那些氏族平民对你们积累的怨气。世仇通常始于另一氏族的人民对你们冒犯行为的忍无可忍，这种反应并不总是与对方贵族与你们关系恶劣相对应。

column1: To find out whether a clan has hidden grudges against you, or if you have some room to offend them without causing a feud, go to the Magic screen and sacrifice to Lhankor Mhy to discover any hidden wrinkles in that clan’s attitude towards you.
column2: 要了解某个氏族是否对你们暗藏怨气，或者你们是否还有冒犯余地而不引发世仇，请前往魔法界面，向兰科·莫献祭，以揭示该氏族对你们态度中隐藏的疙瘩。

column1: Lhankor Mhy can also tell you how the various non-human groups regard your clan.
column2: 兰科·莫还能告诉你各种非人群体如何看待你们的氏族。

column1: Feuds represent formal declarations of animosity that suspend many of the norms of courtesy and proper conduct extended between clans. A feud is not quite the same as a war. There can still be friendly (or at least non-hostile) interactions between feuding clans, including trade, offers or requests for magical assistance, and even marriages. But if the normal state of relations between Orlanthi clans amounts to armed readiness, feuding relations may be understood as hair-trigger expectancy. You expect a feuding clan to stab you in the back. Feuding clans may raid your herds, kill your livestock, send spirits against you, try to burn down your steads, and even kill members of your clan whom they can catch without adequate protection.
column2: 世仇代表着正式的敌意宣告，暂搁了氏族间诸多礼仪与正当行为规范。世仇与战争并不完全相同。世仇氏族之间仍可有友好（或至少非敌对）互动，包括贸易、提供或请求魔法援助，甚至通婚。但如果奥兰斯氏族间的正常关系状态相当于武装戒备，那么世仇关系则可理解为一触即发的警惕。你预期一个世仇氏族会从背后捅你一刀。世仇氏族可能劫掠你们的畜群、杀死你们的牲畜、派遣灵体攻击你们、试图烧毁你们的农庄，甚至杀害你们那些缺少足够保护的氏族成员。

column1: Orlanthi worship a god who embodies both Air and Movement. Not surprisingly, few of their social relations are permanent, not even their worst feuds. Many things can end feuds, including marriages, extreme generosity, messengers from the gods, heroquests, forming a tribe with a feuding neighbor, and emissaries laden with gifts offering peace.
column2: 奥兰斯人信奉一位兼具空气与运动之力的神祇。毫不意外，他们的社会关系很少有永久性的，甚至连最深的世仇也不例外。许多事物可以终结世仇，包括通婚、极度的慷慨、神使、英雄任务、与世仇邻族组建部落、以及满载和平礼物的使者。

column1: Feuding clans will expect you to behave the same way towards them, so you can sometimes make peace with them by treating them better than they had expected. If such strategies fail, be prepared for your people to resent the fact that you appeased their hated foes.
column2: 有世仇的部族会期望你以同样的方式对待他们，因此你有时可以通过比他们预想中更好的态度来与他们讲和。如果这类策略失败了，就要做好准备：你的人民会因你安抚了他们憎恶的敌人而心生怨恨。

column1: To succeed in making a tribe and winning the game, you need to convince nearby clans to join with you. Clans far across Dragon Pass are much less likely to join your tribe. Be careful about your relations with nearby clans. You don’t have to be friendly with everyone, but if all your neighbors hate you, you will be so busy fighting off raids that forming a tribe will be a problem you never get around to solving.
column2: 要成功建立一个部落并赢得游戏，你需要说服附近的氏族加入你。远在龙隘彼岸的氏族接受你组建部落的可能性要小得多。请谨慎处理与附近氏族的关系。你不必与所有人都友善，但如果所有邻族都憎恨你，你将忙于抵御突袭，组建部落就会变成一个你永远无暇解决的问题。

column1: Allies
column2: 盟友

column1: Allies are precious. Depending on the level of difficulty you’ve chosen for your game, you may start the game with one or more alliances with other clans. Later, after you’ve succeeding in improving another clan’s attitude towards you, you can send an emissary to ask them to formalize the relationship by allying with your clan.
column2: 盟友是宝贵的。根据你选择的游戏难度，你一开始可能就拥有一项或多项与其他氏族的联盟。之后，当你成功改善了另一个氏族对你的态度，你可以派遣一名使者，请求他们与你的氏族结盟，以正式确定关系。

column1: Unless relations go sour, you can count on an ally to:
column2: 除非关系恶化，否则你可以指望盟友做到以下几点：

column1: • support you in negotiations with other clans, especially in tribal politics, • look more favorably on requests for repayment of favors, • provide you with favors even when they don’t owe you a favor, • refrain from sending full-scale raids against you, though they may occasionally hit you with a small cattle raid if you are careless about guarding your herd.
column2: • 在与其他氏族的谈判中支持你，尤其是在部落政治中； • 更倾向于同意你偿还恩惠的请求； • 即使他们不欠你恩惠，也愿意提供恩惠； • 避免对你发动全面突袭，不过如果你疏于守护畜群，他们偶尔也可能发动一次小规模的偷牛行动。

column1: Your allies expect similar considerations, and may be offended if you treat them as if they were just any other clan.
column2: 你的盟友也期待得到同样的关照，如果你像对待其他普通氏族那样对待他们，他们可能会感到冒犯。

column1: The other choices by the clan list provide information that is explained later:
column2: 氏族列表中的其他选项提供了将在后文解释的信息：

column1: • clans that owe you favors (below) • clans you owe favors to (below) • the clans in a tribe… at the start of the game, the Colymar are the only tribe • the clans in your tribe … blank until you put a tribe together
column2: • 欠你恩惠的氏族（见下文） • 你欠恩惠的氏族（见下文） • 某个部落中的氏族……游戏开始时，科利玛尔是唯一的部落 • 你所在部落中的氏族……在你组建部落之前为空白

column1: Emissaries
column2: 使者

column1: Most of the mechanics of choosing and sending an emissary also apply to the mechanics of sending trading missions from the Trade screen.
column2: 选择和派遣使者的多数机制，也适用于从贸易界面派遣贸易使团的机制。

column1: Tap the Emissary button to send a diplomatic envoy to another clan. You can preselect the clan you want to send an emissary to by tapping on the clan list or the map on the Relations screen, or pick in the Emissary dialog.
column2: 点击“使者”按钮，向另一个氏族派遣外交使节。你可以通过点击关系界面上的氏族列表或地图预先选定要派遣使者的氏族，也可以在使者对话框中选择。

column1: Choosing Your Emissary
column2: 选择你的使者

column1: When you send an emissary, the game will choose your most qualified leader. You may have reasons to send a different emissary, in which case tap the Leader button. In general, the best emissaries have high Leadership, Bargaining, and Custom skills.
column2: 当你派遣使者时，游戏会为你选择最称职的领袖。你可能出于某些原因想派遣不同的使者，此时请点击“领袖”按钮。一般来说，最好的使者具备高超的领导力、议价和习俗技能。

column1: Devotees of Issaries, the silver-tongued god of communication, have better emissary skills than worshippers of other gods, and get preference over others of roughly equal abilities. Conversely, there are less dependable gods whose worshippers can turn routine gift-giving into an adventure.
column2: 伊萨里斯——巧舌如簧的沟通之神——的信徒拥有比其他神祇的信徒更好的使者技能，并且在能力大致相当的人中会得到优先考虑。反之，有些神祇不那么可靠，他们的信徒可能会把例行送礼变成一场冒险。

column1: Due to the rituals that make them representatives of your clan, ring members have more success as emissaries, traders, and explorers than non-ring members.
column2: 由于作为氏族代表的仪式，部族成员比非部族成员更容易成为成功的使者、商人和探险者。

column1: Emissaries to nearby clans will return quickly, while emissaries to distant clans may take a season or more to complete the trip and return. If you’ve been sending out a number of emissaries at the same time, the Emissary dialog will tell you which of your emissaries are still traveling.
column2: 派往附近氏族的使者会很快返回，而派往遥远氏族的使者可能需要一个季节或更长时间才能完成旅途并返回。如果你同时派遣了多名使者，使者对话框会告知你哪些使者仍在旅途中。

column1: In the Emissary and the Mission dialogs, tap the small icon to call up the map.
column2: 在使者对话框和任务对话框中，点击小图标可调出地图。

column1: Choosing an Escort for Your Emissary
column2: 为你的使者选择护卫

column1: The roads and trails in Dragon Pass are dangerous. If bandits don’t get you, feuding clans will. You’ll want to send several weaponthanes or footmen along with your emissary, particularly if she is carrying rich gifts. Each weaponthane provides as much protection as five footmen, and every footman you send is one less farmer who can work in the fields. How many escorts will your emissary need? That depends on how well you’ve kept down bandits and how many enemy clans you have, but in general you’ll want to send at least two or three weaponthanes as guards, more if you want to be sure to avoid trouble.
column2: 龙隘的道路和小径充满危险。即使没遇上强盗，世仇的部族也会找上你。你需要派遣几名武器领主或步兵与使者同行，尤其当她携带贵重礼物时。每个武器领主提供的保护相当于五名步兵，而你派出的每名步兵都意味着田地里少了一名农夫。你的使者需要多少护卫？这取决于你对强盗的压制程度以及你有多少敌对氏族，但一般来说，你至少需要派遣两到三名武器领主作为护卫，如果你想确保万无一失，则需要更多。

column1: Clan members sent away from the tula are temporarily subtracted from the population. You get them back if they return alive. Such temporary absences may cause Sacred Time reports to say that your clan shrunk when in truth many members are simply away from the tula on missions.
column2: 被派离图拉的氏族成员会临时从人口中扣除。如果他们活着回来，你就能重新获得他们。这种临时缺席可能会导致神圣时间报告显示你的氏族人口减少了，而实际上许多成员只是离开图拉执行任务而已。

column1: Emissary Options
column2: 使者选项

column1: Gift Giving
column2: 赠送礼物

column1: To get proactive about your relations with other clans, instead of simply waiting for them to come to you with problems or opportunities, send emissaries with gifts to improve their attitudes towards you.
column2: 要想主动改善与其他氏族的关系，而不是坐等他们带着问题或机遇来找你，就派遣使者带着礼物去提升他们对你的态度。

column1: Gift-giving proves that your clan can afford to be generous, like Orlanth, the King of the Gods. Early in the game, giving generous gifts is one of the best means of raising your standing, giving the clan the good reputation that will be crucial to forming a tribe and winning the game.
column2: 赠送礼物证明了你的氏族有能力慷慨大方，如同众神之王奥兰斯一样。在游戏早期，慷慨送礼是提升你地位的最佳手段之一，能够为氏族赢得良好声誉，这对组建部落并赢得游戏至关重要。

column1: Note that gifts of magical treasures or horses are even more likely to increase your stature in Dragon Pass, but you should exercise caution and refrain from giving such militarily useful gifts to a clan that thinks of you as an enemy.
column2: 请注意：赠送魔法宝物或马匹更有可能提升你在龙之隘口的声望，但你也应谨慎行事，避免将这类有军事用途的礼物送给视你为敌人的氏族。

column1: If you are feeling impoverished, and don’t want to send a large gift, it might be better not to bother; Orlanthi do not approve of stingy gift-givers, so sending gifts worth less than a dozen cows might hurt your reputation.
column2: 如果你感到拮据，不想送出大礼，那还不如干脆别送；奥兰斯人不喜欢吝啬的送礼者，所以送价值不足一打牛的礼物反而会损害你的声誉。

column1: Ask for Favor
column2: 请求恩惠

column1: There is some benefit to holding off on collecting favors you are due. Clans which owe you favors will be more inclined to see things your way in political disputes and delicate negotiations.
column2: 暂缓收回你应得的恩惠是有好处的。欠你恩惠的氏族在政治争端和微妙谈判中更倾向于站在你这边。

column1: A clan which is said to owe you a favor may owe you more than one favor. Similarly, a clan that you owe favors to may come to you asking for many favors before the debt you owe them is fully repaid.
column2: 一个据说欠你恩惠的氏族可能欠你不止一次恩情。同样，你欠恩惠的氏族可能会多次向你索取，直到还清你欠他们的债务。

column1: Favors keep track of which clan is more indebted to the other; there’s never a circumstance in which your clan will simultaneously owe a favor to another clan and be owed a favor by that same clan. If a clan that you owe favors to says they will owe you a favor, the truth is that you now owe them one less favor.
column2: 恩惠机制记录着哪个氏族欠对方更多；永远不会出现你的氏族同时欠另一个氏族恩惠又被同一个氏族欠恩惠的情况。如果你欠恩惠的氏族说他们会欠你一次恩惠，实际上是你现在少欠他们一次。

column1: In two special cases you may be able to ask for a favor when the clan in question does not owe you one: allies and tribe-mates may be willing to aid you because of the bonds between your clans. This can come in particularly handy if your clan is running out of cows or food.
column2: 在两种特殊情况下，即使对方氏族不欠你恩惠，你也可以请求恩惠：盟友和同部落成员可能因氏族间的纽带而愿意帮助你。如果你的氏族牛只或食物短缺，这一点尤其有用。

column1: If you’re looking for a way to repay favors you owe, there’s no such button. Generally you can only repay favors when another clan comes asking for repayment. But if you are extremely generous in giving gifts, some clans will accept the gifts and consider them payment for favors they expected to receive from you later.
column2: 如果你想找一种偿还欠下恩惠的方法，并没有这样的按钮。通常你只能在另一个氏族前来要求偿还时才能偿还。但如果你在赠送礼物时格外慷慨，有些氏族会接受礼物并将其视为你未来应给他们的恩惠的偿还。

column1: Propose Alliance
column2: 提议联盟

column1: As mentioned above, alliances can make the difference between spiraling into defeat or forging friendships that can lead you to victory. It’s generally wise to send gifts at the outset, though you may also end up giving gifts during negotiations.
column2: 如上所述，联盟能决定你是走向失败深渊，还是缔结友谊并最终获胜。一开始就送礼通常是明智的，尽管你在谈判过程中也可能需要送礼。

column1: End Feud
column2: 结束世仇

column1: Ending a feud isn’t easy. Generosity helps.
column2: 结束世仇并不容易。慷慨解囊会有帮助。

column1: Demanding tribute from another clan is difficult. It helps if your weaponthanes and footmen outnumber theirs, if you have beaten them in battle a lot, and if you are near enough to enforce your demand. They will, naturally, resent you and plan to weasel out of the arrangement at the first chance they get. To stop tribute or try to increase the amount, send an emissary to “demand tribute” from a clan that is already paying.
column2: 向另一个氏族索取贡品很难。如果你的武器领主和步兵数量超过他们，如果你在多次战斗中击败过他们，并且你离得足够近可以强制执行要求，那会有所帮助。他们自然会怨恨你，并计划一有机会就摆脱这个安排。若要停止贡品或试图增加数量，派一名使者向已经进贡的氏族“索取贡品”。

column1: Reorganization Screen
column2: 重组界面

column1: We’ll cover the rest of the Clan screen later. This section covers the Reorganization screen.
column2: 我们稍后会介绍部落界面的其余部分。本节介绍重组界面。

column1: Clan Ring
column2: 氏族议会

column1: You already reorganized your clan ring during the tutorial; if not, just tap the box to include or exclude a leader. One tip: tap the Reorganize button when you’re done to make any changes stick. Or, take a quick glance at all your leaders’ skills without changing anything or eating up any time and tap X to return to the Clan screen.
column2: 你已经在教程中重组过氏族议会；如果没有，只需点击方框来包含或排除一位领袖。小提示：完成后点击重组按钮以保存更改。或者，快速浏览所有领袖的技能而不做任何更改、不消耗任何时间，然后点击X返回部落界面。

column1: A good, standard opening move for playing KoDP is to rearrange your clan ring.
column2: 玩《龙之隘口之王》的一个好的标准开局操作是重新调整你的氏族议会。

column1: The Reorganization screen lets you change your clan type: War, Balanced, or Peace. Unless your play style pivots around alternately thumping your neighbors and then making nice, you’re not likely to use this feature often. You’ll probably want to pick the clan type that suits your situation and stick with it. (For more on clan types, see Questionnaire.)
column2: 重组界面允许你更改氏族类型：战争型、平衡型或和平型。除非你的玩法是轮流痛揍邻居然后又去修好，否则你不大可能经常使用这一功能。你可能会想选择适合自己情况的氏族类型并坚持下去。（关于氏族类型的更多信息，请参阅问卷。）

column1: The Reorganization screen also allows you to sort through your clan’s leaders, weigh their relative abilities, and choose a chief along with six other advisors for your clan ring. This is the meat of the Reorganization Screen, a feature you’ll use often as leaders die, get badly wounded, or improve their abilities to the point that they deserve to join the ring.
column2: 重组界面还允许你筛选氏族的领袖，权衡他们的相对能力，并为酋长和六位其他顾问选入氏族议会。这是重组界面的核心部分，随着领袖死亡、重伤或能力提升到足以加入议会，你会经常用到这一功能。

column1: Leader Skills
column2: 领袖技能

column1: Nearly every challenge your clan faces pivots upon the abilities of its leaders. A few actions are based on the abilities of a lone explorer or emissary, but most challenges in KoDP use the highest skill of a clan ring member as the basic chance of success.
column2: 你的氏族面临的几乎每一个挑战都取决于领袖的能力。少数行动基于单独探索者或使者的能力，但《龙之隘口之王》中的大多数挑战使用氏族议会成员的最高技能作为基础成功几率。

column1: Skill Ratings
column2: 技能等级

column1: Each leader is rated for seven skills. If a leader isn’t rated for a skill, their skill in that area is too poor to mention. The skills are rated on the following scale, from lowest to highest:
column2: 每位领袖在七项技能上都有评级。如果某位领袖没有某项技能评级，则该领域的技能水平太低，不值一提。技能按以下等级从低到高评定：

column1: Fair — Good — Very Good — Excellent — Renowned — Heroic
column2: 一般 — 良好 — 优秀 — 卓越 — 著名 — 英雄级

column1: Leaders who achieve Heroic skill operate at a different plane than normal mortals, and can be counted on to achieve results that exceed lower-skilled characters.
column2: 达到英雄级技能的领袖与凡人在不同层面运作，可以指望他们取得超越低技能角色的成果。

column1: The Skills
column2: 技能

column1: How to care for herd animals and knowledge of animals in the wild. The health of your herds depends in part on the ring member with the highest Animals skill. Primarily important for farmers, also important in hunting.
column2: 如何照料牧群以及关于野生动物的知识。你的牧群健康部分取决于议会中拥有最高动物技能的成员。对农夫尤其重要，在狩猎中也很重要。

column1: Vital in all negotiations and economic haggling. Primary skill of traders, of secondary importance for emissaries and even explorers, since Bargaining can help you talk your way out of trouble when you would otherwise have to fight.
column2: 在所有谈判和经济讨价还价中至关重要。商人的首要技能，对使者和探险家也属次要重要，因为议价能帮你用话语摆脱本需战斗的麻烦。

column1: Skill with weapons, toughness in battle, ability to survive wounds. Primary skill of warriors, also important in exploration and hunting.
column2: 武器技巧、战场坚韧、伤口存活能力。战士的首要技能，在探索和狩猎中也很重要。

column1: Knowledge of the sacred Orlanthi laws laid down by King Heort. Familiarity with legal precedents, ability to argue based on the power of tradition. Primary skill for emissaries and the clan lawspeaker, of secondary importance for poets.
column2: 知晓赫奥特王订立的圣奥兰斯律法。熟悉法律先例，能凭借传统力量进行辩论。使者和氏族律法师的首要技能，对诗人属次要重要。

column1: Ability to motivate others, persuade others to see things your way by charisma and charm rather than guile or force. Vitally important for keeping your clan from coming apart at its weak spots, frequently important in inter-clan negotiations. Primary skill for chiefs and kings. Also useful for emissaries and poets.
column2: 激励他人、凭个人魅力而非诡计或武力说服他人接受你的观点。对防止氏族在薄弱处分裂至关重要，常在部族间谈判中重要。酋长和国王的首要技能。对使者和诗人也有用。

column1: Understanding of the supernatural forces that shape and control the world, knowledge of the gods and the rituals that ask for their favor, ability to manipulate magic spells and powers, perspective on the clan’s roots in the Godtime and the expectations of the ancestors. Primary skill for clan members performing special sacrifices, vitally important for the success of heroquests.
column2: 理解塑造并掌控世界的超自然力量，知晓诸神及祈求其恩惠的仪式，能操纵魔法咒语和力量，洞察氏族在神代的根源及祖先的期望。氏族成员进行特殊献祭的首要技能，对英雄任务的成功至关重要。

column1: Farming skill. Successful harvests depend in part upon the ring member with the highest Plants skill.
column2: 农耕技能。丰收部分取决于氏族议会中拥有最高植物技能的成员。

column1: Choosing Your Clan Ring
column2: 选择你的氏族议会

column1: It’s a good idea to fill a vacant spot on the ring as quickly as possible. If a ring member dies or is otherwise removed from the ring, reorganize soon to avoid hurting your clan magic, your Sacred Time rituals, mood, and a dozen other factors. A ring member’s temporary absence (while exploring, or wounded, or on a mission) slightly hurts the Sacred Time rituals, but won’t trigger the other problems associated with a broken ring.
column2: 尽快填补议会空缺是个好主意。若环成员死亡或离任，应尽早重组，以免损害氏族魔法、神圣时间仪式、情绪及其他诸多因素。环成员临时缺席（如探索、受伤或执行任务）会轻微影响神圣时间仪式，但不会引发其他与环破裂相关的问题。

column1: Organizing a good clan ring isn’t necessarily as simple as just sorting through the abilities and choosing the highest-rated clan member in each to be on the ring. For mythic reasons, Orlanthi clans work better if all the ring members worship different gods. You can tell who worships which deity by looking at the rune on the right of their faces. There’s nothing to prevent you from putting three Ernalda-worshippers on the ring, but if you do you’ll lose at least two magical bonuses: more Sacred Time rituals to spend magic on, and bonuses when Heroquesting.
column2: 组建良好的氏族议会不一定像只筛选能力并挑出每项最高评价的成员那么简单。出于神话原因，若所有环成员崇拜不同神祇，奥兰斯部族运作更佳。查看人物脸部右侧的符文可得知其崇拜对象。把三位厄尔纳达信徒都塞进议会也并无不可，但会失去至少两种魔法增益：更多可用魔法的神圣时间仪式，以及英雄任务时的加成。

column1: Another important consideration is that sacrifices on the Magic screen are more likely to succeed when the clan ring includes a worshipper of the god you are sacrificing to. Your Elmal worshipper (also known as an Elmali) might not be the best warrior in the clan, but if you want to sacrifice to Elmal, it makes sense to put him on the ring, at least until you have finished making your planned sacrifices to Elmal.
column2: 另一个重要考虑是，当氏族议会包含你所献祭神祇的信徒时，魔法界面上的献祭更容易成功。你的埃尔马尔信徒（又称埃尔马尔追随者）可能并非氏族最佳战士，但若你想向埃尔马尔献祭，将他纳入议会是合理的，至少在你完成计划中的埃尔马尔献祭之前。

column1: For hints about why Orlanthi rings function better when they embody diverse powers, go to the Lore Screen and read The Lightbringers Quest.
column2: 关于为什么奥兰斯议会体现多元力量时运作更佳，可前往知识界面阅读《光明使者追寻》。

column1: One warning: this doesn’t necessarily mean you should shuttle leaders on and off the ring every time you’re planning a different sacrifice. You’ll waste time and risk damaging the clan mood; if your people are already contented they prefer that the ring remain the same unless it loses one or more of its members. A clan that is already in a bad mood is less likely to care.
column2: 一个警告：这并不意味着每次计划不同献祭时都要把领袖推上推下。你会浪费时间并有损氏族情绪；若人民已然满足，他们更希望议会保持原样，除非失去一名或多名成员。情绪不佳的氏族则不太在意。

column1: Specific Positions on the Ring:
column2: 议会中的具体职位：

column1: The Chief
column2: 酋长

column1: The only position that you officially choose is the chief, who can be male or female and worship any god. As mentioned above, a chief without Leadership skill is like a warrior without weapons.
column2: 你正式选择的唯一职位是酋长，可为男性或女性，崇拜任何神祇。如上所述，没有领导力技能的酋长就像不带武器的战士。

column1: Your chief always occupies the left-hand position on the ring and is marked with the torc of leadership, the symbol.
column2: 你的酋长总是占据议会左位，并以领导项圈标记。

column1: Later in the game, after you make a tribe and win the throne, your king or queen will be marked with the crown of the mastery rune .
column2: 游戏后期，在建立部落并赢得王座后，你的国王或女王将以支配符文王冠标记。

column1: Your choice of chief might also depend on your main god. If you are playing an Orlanth clan and have an Orlanth worshipper as chief, you get one extra point of magic each Sacred Time. Ditto for an Ernalda clan with an Ernaldan chief or an Elmal clan with an Elmali chief.
column2: 酋长的选择也可能取决于你的主神。若你玩奥兰斯氏族且以奥兰斯信徒为酋长，每个神圣时间获得额外一点魔法。厄尔纳达氏族以厄尔纳达信徒为酋长同理，埃尔马尔氏族以埃尔马尔信徒为酋长同理。

column1: Behind-the-Scenes Positions
column2: 幕后职位

column1: There are two other important positions on the ring, the roles of warleader and lawspeaker. Unlike the chief, neither the warleader or lawspeaker are marked with a rune or occupy a specific spot on the ring. At any given time, both positions are filled by the most qualified member of the ring. Not infrequently, the chief also serves as the warleader and/or lawspeaker.
column2: 议会中还有两个重要职位：战争领袖和律法师的角色。与酋长不同，战争领袖或律法师均不以符文标记，也不占据议会特定位置。任何时刻，这两个职位均由议会中最合格的成员担任。酋长也常兼任战争领袖和/或律法师。

column1: In rare cases, a less-skilled worshipper of one of the war gods will take over as warleader despite the presence of another ring member whose superior Combat and Leadership skills would make him or her more suited to the position. To give the more skilled leader a clear path to command, you might have to take the war god’s devotee off the ring.
column2: 罕见情况下，某位战争之神信徒（技巧较低）会接任战争领袖，即使议会中另有其他成员有更卓越的战斗和领导力技能更适合此职。若要让更熟练的领袖掌握指挥权，你可能需要将那位战争之神的虔诚者请出议会。

column1: The Warleader
column2: 战争领袖

column1: Your warleader is the most battle-savvy member of the ring. Your warleader’s skills play a key role in determining the outcome of battles and raids. If your normal warleader is wounded or absent, another ring member takes over.
column2: 你的战争领袖是氏族议会中作战经验最丰富的成员。战争领袖的技能在决定战斗和劫掠的胜负中起关键作用。若你的常规战争领袖负伤或缺席，则由另一位议会成员接替。

column1: The Lawspeaker
column2: 律法师

column1: Like the position of warleader, the post of lawspeaker is as much a functional necessity as an official seat. Your lawspeaker is likely to have a high Custom skill, possibly high Bargaining, and preference is given to Lhankor Mhy worshippers.
column2: 与战争领袖之位相同，律法师一职既是功能性必需，也是正式席位。你的律法师通常拥有高水平的习俗技能，可能拥有高水平的议价技能，且优先选择兰科·米信徒。

column1: Clan magic represents your potential to perform rituals and call on the gods and clan ancestors in a crisis. It can fluctuate in response to events, and can sometimes dip below zero. It’s renewed each Sacred Time.
column2: 氏族魔法代表你在危机中举行仪式、召唤神明与氏族祖先的潜力。它会随事件而波动，有时可能降至零以下。每个神圣时间都会重新恢复。

column1: Each year ends with the Sacred Time, a two-week celebration in which every Orlanthi clan recreates the myths of creation in order to reaffirm the cosmic order and the clan’s place in the world. Your clan performs many sacred rituals, particularly to Orlanth and Ernalda. These rituals take place off-screen, but you must decide how much magical power to allocate among them. Each ritual makes the clan more effective for that type of action in the upcoming year.
column2: 每年以神圣时间结束，这是一个为期两周的庆典，每个奥兰斯氏族都会重演创世神话，以重申宇宙秩序与氏族在世界中的地位。你的氏族会举行许多神圣仪式，尤其是向奥兰斯和厄尔纳达致敬。这些仪式在屏幕之外进行，但你必须决定如何分配魔法力量给它们。每个仪式都会让氏族在新的一年中对此类行动更有效。

column1: Reputation and Recap
column2: 声望与回顾

column1: Sacred Time begins with a recap of the previous year, as well as an indication of how other clans view your potential to be king.
column2: 神圣时间始于对过去一年的回顾，以及关于其他氏族如何看待你称王潜力的提示。

column1: Forecasts and Omens
column2: 预兆与异象

column1: Your god-talkers do their best to divine what dangers, blessings or opportunities the next year will provide. Predicting the harvest allows the clan to plan how to survive a bad year. Dreams and visions suggest special sacrifices to particular deities. Note that when the gods are kind enough to give you a glimpse of your future, they become sorely affronted if you ignore their information.
column2: 你的神言者竭尽全力占卜来年将面临的危险、赐福或机遇。预测收成能让氏族规划如何度过荒年。梦境与异象会提示向特定神灵进行特殊献祭。注意：当诸神仁慈地让你瞥见未来时，你若忽视他们的信息，便会严重触怒他们。

column1: Clans have chiefs chosen from among their nobles, tribes have kings or queens chosen from among the nobles of the tribe’s clans. Anything Orlanthi say about kings is meant to apply equally to queens; Orlanthi use the term kings to include queens.
column2: 氏族从其贵族中选择首领，部落则从各氏族贵族中选择国王或女王。奥兰斯人关于国王的任何说法同样适用于女王；奥兰斯人使用“国王”一词时也包括女王。

column1: The Clan Ring
column2: 氏族议会

column1: At the bottom of most screens is the Advisor button. Tap it to see the group of people chosen to provide advice and leadership to the clan. The composition of your clan ring also influences the strength of the Sacred Time rituals available to your clan. For example, having a War god worshipper on the ring makes your War magic stronger. This bonus is not cumulative; if your ring includes two War god worshippers, you only get one extra point of magic for the War ritual.
column2: 大多数屏幕底部都有顾问按钮。点击它可查看被选为氏族提供建议和领导的人群。你的氏族议会组成也会影响神圣时间仪式的强度。例如，议会中有一位战争之神信徒会让你的战争魔法更强。此加成不累积；若议会中有两位战争之神信徒，你只会为战争仪式获得一个额外魔法点。

column1: For a look at the heart of the Sacred Time rituals, go to the Lore screen for the following myths: How Things Began, The Contests, The Storm Age, The Great Darkness, and The Lightbringers Quest.
column2: 要了解神圣时间仪式的核心，请前往知识界面查看以下神话：万物起源、竞赛、风暴时代、大黑暗、光明使者追寻。

column1: Allocating Magic
column2: 分配魔法

column1: The base amount of magic you can spend on any given ritual depends on the type of clan you are playing: War, Balanced, or Peace. War clans excel at violence but have weak agriculture. Peace clans have weak war magic but strong agriculture. Most clans are Balanced clans, and we recommend playing Balanced clans to start.
column2: 你可在任何仪式上花费的基础魔法量取决于你游玩的氏族类型：战争、平衡或和平。战争氏族擅长武力但农业薄弱。和平氏族战争魔法弱但农业强。大多数氏族是平衡氏族，我们建议新手游玩平衡氏族。

column1: The explanations of the Sacred Time ritual categories that follows includes a list of the gods that allow you another point for that ritual if you have one of their worshippers on the ring.
column2: 以下关于神圣时间仪式类别的说明包括一个神灵列表，若你在议会中有其信徒，则可多获得一点该仪式的魔法。

column1: Sacred Time rituals and specific blessings granted by the gods augment each other rather than replacing each other. For instance, Crop magic in Sacred Time and Ernalda’s Bless Crops blessing both help the crop yields.
column2: 神圣时间仪式与神灵赐予的特定祝福相互增强，而非相互取代。例如，神圣时间中的作物魔法与厄尔纳达的作物赐福都能提高作物产量。

column1: Improves the yields of all crops. (Ernalda, Barntar)
column2: 改善所有作物的收成。（厄尔纳达、巴恩塔）

column1: Aids emissaries you send to other clans. It also helps your traders and nobles maintain the clan’s good name with the other clans of Dragon Pass. (Issaries, Lhankor Mhy)
column2: 辅助你派往其他氏族的使者。也有助于你的商人和贵族维护氏族在龙隘其他氏族中的良好声誉。（伊萨里斯、兰科·米）

column1: Speeds the recovery of sick and wounded clan members. (Chalana Arroy)
column2: 加速病患与伤员的康复。（查拉娜·阿罗伊）

column1: Increases the fertility of all your herds: sheep, pigs, horses and cattle. (Uralda)
column2: 提高所有牲畜的繁殖力：羊、猪、马、牛。（乌拉尔达）

column1: Greatly increases the chances of success when you sacrifice to the gods for Mysteries; this bonus decreases each time you sacrifice for Mysteries in a given year. (Lhankor Mhy)
column2: 当您为奥秘向诸神献祭时，大幅提高成功率；此加值在您同一年内每次为奥秘献祭后递减。（兰科·米）

column1: Greatly aids the first heroquest you perform in the coming year. Generally not worth spending magic on unless you plan to heroquest, but if you fear that circumstances might force a quest, you might want to play it safe and allocate magic to Quests. (Eurmal the Trickster)
column2: 极大助益你在来年进行的首次英雄任务。除非你计划进行英雄任务，否则通常不值得花费魔法；但若你担心局势可能迫使你进行任务，或许可以稳妥行事，为任务分配魔法。（恶作剧者尤尔马尔）

column1: Performing Trade magic rituals every year lets you maximize the number of trade routes you can support, and increases the number of crafters whose products you can reliably find a market for.
column2: 每年举行贸易魔法仪式可让你最大化所能维持的贸易路线数量，并增加你的工匠产品可靠找到市场的数量。

column1: Helps numerous aspects of trade, including the strength of your clan market and the number of trading partners you can support. (Issaries)
column2: 有助于贸易的多个方面，包括你的氏族市场实力和你能维持的贸易伙伴数量。（伊萨里斯）

column1: This ritual gives your clan luck in every battle you fight during the year. This War magic is not effective unless your warriors go raiding occasionally. (Humakt, Vinga, Elmal, Urox)
column2: 此仪式为氏族在一年中每一场战斗带来好运。除非你的战士偶尔外出劫掠，否则此战争魔法效果不佳。（胡马克、文加、埃尔马尔、乌洛克斯）

column1: When you become part of a tribe, two specialized Sacred Time rituals become available:
column2: 当你加入一个部落时，两个专门的神圣时间仪式将开放：

column1: A reserve of clan magic can be useful not only in case you are attacked, but also when dealing with various crises.
column2: 氏族魔法的储备不仅能在遭受攻击时派上用场，也能在应对各种危机时发挥作用。

column1: These rituals help steer the clan to its proper destiny as leader of the tribe, and eventually of the kingdom.
column2: 这些仪式有助于引导氏族走向其作为部落领袖、并最终成为王国领袖的应有命运。

column1: You get one point of Destiny ritual for being in a tribe, an additional point if you are king or queen of the tribe, and one more point when you are on the way to winning the Long Game. Helps in all situations involving tribal politics, victory, and the clan’s fate.
column2: 身为部落一员可获得1点命运仪式；若成为部落之王或女王，则额外获得1点；在通往赢得长游戏的路上再得1点。有助于所有涉及部落政治、胜利及氏族命运的情境。

column1: These rituals help your clan leaders develop their abilities to their fullest. Improving your leaders’ abilities aids you in every facet of the game, especially in heroquests and the adventures that lead to the end of the game. Having a Great Temple gives an extra point.
column2: 这些仪式帮助氏族领袖充分发展自身能力。提升领袖能力有助于您在游戏的各个方面，尤其是在英雄任务及通向游戏结局的冒险中。拥有大神殿可额外获得1点。

column1: At the bottom of most screens are the faces of seven advisors. This is the ring, the group of people chosen to provide advice and leadership to the clan. The composition of your clan ring also influences the strength of the Sacred Time rituals available to your clan. For example, having a War god worshipper on the ring makes your War magic stronger. This bonus is not cumulative; if your ring includes two War god worshippers, you only get one extra point of magic for the War ritual.
column2: 在大多数界面的底部，是七位顾问的面孔。这便是长老会——被选来为氏族提供建议与领导的一群人。氏族议会的组成也会影响氏族在神圣时间可用的仪式强度。例如，若议会中有战争之神的信徒，战争魔法便会更强。此加成不叠加；若议会中有两位战争之神信徒，战争仪式仅额外获得1点魔法。

column1: Saga Screen
column2: 史卷界面

column1: The saga is your history of the clan's years in Dragon Pass. Often this history will omit personal details or less significant aspects of events, so the saga is not a detailed record of everything that occurs during the game.
column2: 史卷是氏族在龙之隘口岁月的历史。这份历史往往会略去个人细节或事件中较次要的方面，因此史卷并非游戏中所发生一切事的详细记录。

column1: KoDP saves the game every year, right before Sacred Time. The Saga Screen lets you pick a year to replay from. Scroll down for the Restore button.
column2: 《龙之隘口之王》每年在神圣时间前保存游戏。史卷界面允许您选取某一年从中重玩。向下滚动可找到恢复按钮。

column1: The Lore entry at the top of the saga shows your clan’s God Time history from the starting questionnaire, and can come in handy when you want to refresh your memory of your starting choices.
column2: 史卷顶部的学识条目显示初始问卷所设定的氏族神代历史，当您想重温初始选择时，可派上用场。

column1: During play, you can flip to the saga to see if the Sacred Time omen for the year suggested any course of action that you have forgotten in the press of events. The year’s omen will be conveniently located at the top of the current year’s saga.
column2: 游戏过程中，您可以翻阅史卷，查看当年神圣时间的预兆是否提示了某项因事务繁忙而遗忘的行动方向。当年预兆会方便地显示在当年史卷的顶部。

column1: The clan saga is also available within interactive scenes, by tapping the Info button. You won’t be able to restore or e-mail, however.
column2: 在交互场景中，也可通过点击信息按钮查阅氏族史卷。但无法进行恢复或发送邮件操作。

column1: To share or save the saga of a particularly enjoyable game, tap the envelope icon at the top of the Saga Screen and e-mail it to yourself. (You’ll need to have a valid account set up on your device, otherwise the button won’t appear.)
column2: 若想分享或保存某次特别愉快的游戏史卷，请点击史卷界面顶部的信封图标，将其电邮给自己。（您需在设备上设置有效账户，否则该按钮不会显示。）

column1: The clan saga is also available within interactive scenes. You won’t be able to restore or e-mail, however.
column2: 在交互场景中，也可查阅氏族史卷。但无法进行恢复或发送邮件操作。

column1: Trade Screen
column2: 贸易界面

column1: The Trade screen allows you to: • send trading missions to the other clans of Dragon Pass • keep track of the clan’s magical treasures • keep track of the clan’s trade routes • keep track of the success of the clan market
column2: 贸易界面允许您：• 向龙之隘口的其他氏族派遣贸易任务 • 追踪氏族的魔法宝藏 • 追踪氏族的贸易路线 • 追踪氏族市场的成功情况

column1: KoDP uses Goods as an abstraction for desirable material resources that are over and above what the clan needs just to get by. Goods are always valuable items that the gods, neighboring clans, or enemy weaponthanes would be happy to possess. This abstraction lets you get by without tracking specific amounts of raw silver, finely worked silver, building materials, gemstones, fur capes, and so on. Your clan isn’t destitute when it runs out of goods; instead, your people possess only the minimum they need to get by, without any surplus available for the common use of the clan.
column2: 《龙之隘口之王》将“物资”作为对氏族基本生存所需之外的理想物质资源的抽象概念。物资总是有价值的物品，神灵、邻近氏族或敌方武器领主都会乐于拥有。此抽象概念让您无需追踪具体的生银量、精银工艺品、建材、宝石、毛皮披风等等。当氏族物资耗尽时，并不意味着赤贫；而是您的子民仅拥有维持生存的最低所需，没有任何可供氏族共同使用的盈余。

column1: Missions
column2: 任务

column1: Trading missions are the heart of the Trade screen. The basic mechanics of sending a Mission are the same as for sending an Emissary. After you’ve tapped the Mission button, you’ll be presented with choices for what you want the mission to accomplish. Choose the Mission leader, choose the clan to send the Mission to, then figure out what you’d like the mission to accomplish.
column2: 贸易任务是贸易界面的核心。派遣任务的基本机制与派遣使者相同。在点击任务按钮后，您将看到任务所要达成的各种选项。选择任务领袖，选择要派遣任务的氏族，然后确定任务要完成的目标。

column1: Commodity Trading
column2: 商品贸易

column1: So long as you avoid buying or selling a treasure, you can try to trade any assortment of food, goods, cattle, and horses. You get to choose whether you are sending a small, medium or large caravan. The appropriate quantity of trade-stuffs is subtracted from your holdings as soon as you send the Mission, hopefully to be replaced with stuff you’ve traded for upon the trader’s successful return.
column2: 只要您避免买卖宝藏，就可以尝试交易任意组合的粮食、物资、牛群和马匹。您可以选择派遣小型、中型或大型商队。一旦派遣任务，相应数量的贸易品将从您的库存中扣除，希望能在商人成功返回后换回您交易得来的物品。

column1: If you are sorely in need of goods, or cattle, or any other specific item, your best bet is to keep the trade simple and focus on obtaining that item, rather than trying for a bit of everything.
column2: 如果您急需物资、牛群或任何其他特定物品，最佳做法是保持贸易简单，专注于获取该物品，而非试图样样都要一点。

column1: Spirit Fetches work differently than other treasures. They are small medicine bundles that catch lost Magic points and return the lost luck to your clan. You can’t control a Spirit Fetch’s use; it might burn itself out capturing one lost point or you might get lucky and acquire a Fetch just before the clan gets hit with a big bad magic whammy. Since Spirit Fetches are easier to get hold of than other treasures, most inhabitants of Dragon Pass will not take kindly to attempts to pass them off as a valuable treasure.
column2: 灵魂唤引与其他宝藏的运作方式不同。它们是收集流失魔力点并将失运归还氏族的小型药包。您无法控制灵魂唤引的使用；它可能因捕获一点魔力而耗尽，也可能在氏族遭受重大恶咒攻击前幸运获得一个。由于灵魂唤引比其他宝藏更容易获得，龙之隘口的大多数居民不会乐意接受试图将其冒充贵重宝藏的行为。

column1: Trading for Treasures
column2: 交易宝藏

column1: When you opt to try to trade or buy a treasure, other commodity trading choices are not available. Treasure trading takes precedence over normal trading patterns. To buy both more cows and a new treasure, you’ll have to send two missions.
column2: 当你选择尝试交易或购买一件宝物时，其他商品交易选项将不可用。宝物交易优先于正常交易模式。要想同时购买更多牛只和一件新宝物，你必须派出两次使团。

column1: If you try to sell a treasure, you’ll have to choose one for your trader to take along on the Mission. Selling a treasure will get you goods. To buy a new treasure, you’ll either have to bring a treasure of your own to trade or pay in goods or cattle once your trader has arrived at her destination. If your first mission to buy a particular treasure fails, a later attempt might succeed.
column2: 如果你试图出售一件宝物，就必须选择一件宝物让你的商人带往使命。出售宝物将让你获得货物。要购买新宝物，你的商人到达目的地后，要么自己携带一件宝物用来交换，要么用货物或牛只支付。如果你第一次购买某件宝物的使命失败，后续尝试可能会成功。

column1: Battle Treasures only take effect when you choose to use them in a specific battle. Unlike most treasures, most Battle Treasures may break when you use them. Other Battle Treasures must be broken to be used. Battle treasures are flagged with the parenthetical label (use in battle).
column2: 战斗宝物仅在你选择在特定战斗中使用它们时才生效。与大多数宝物不同，多数战斗宝物在使用时可能会损坏。另一些战斗宝物则必须被破坏才能使用。战斗宝物会以括号标签（战斗中使用）标注。

column1: Treasures have magic powers that can help your clan thrive. Some treasures are more powerful than others. Some are mysterious, and won’t tell you exactly what they do, but you can generally be assured that the mysterious treasures are among the most powerful in the game.
column2: 宝物拥有魔法力量，能帮助你的氏族繁荣昌盛。一些宝物比其他更强大。有些宝物则神秘莫测，不会明确告诉你它们的具体作用，但你可以大致放心，神秘宝物通常是游戏中最强大的。

column1: Treasures, their abundance or their lack, also factor heavily into your chances to win both the Short Game and the Long Game.
column2: 宝物，无论是丰富还是匮乏，也对你赢得短游戏和长游戏的机会有重大影响。

column1: Trading Partners & Trade Routes
column2: 贸易伙伴与贸易路线

column1: Increase your ability to support trade routes by increasing the size of your Issaries shrine, spending magic on Sacred Time Trading rituals, increasing your population, and creating a tribe. Also, finding unusual raw materials on your lands will let your crafters make unique items which can boost your trading prowess.
column2: 通过扩大你的伊萨里斯神庙规模、在神圣时间贸易仪式上消耗魔法、增加人口以及创建部落，来提升你维持贸易路线的能力。此外，在你的领地上发现稀有原材料，将使你的工匠能制造出独特物品，从而提升你的贸易实力。

column1: Some Missions are principally concerned with establishing new trade routes. Clans with a trade route between them are said to be trading partners. Every trade route increases the amount of goods that your crafters can find markets for.
column2: 部分使命主要关注建立新贸易路线。两条贸易路线相连的氏族被称为贸易伙伴。每一条贸易路线都会增加你的工匠能找到市场的货物数量。

column1: To try to set up a new trade route, tap the Mission button, then choose a clan you do not already have a trading partnership with. When you tap the Establish Trade Route radio button, any other goals will toggle off. You will still be able to choose whether you want to send a large, medium-sized, or small Mission, since there will be a small amount of side-trading taking place even when your trader is focusing on setting up a trade route.
column2: 要尝试建立新贸易路线，点击使命按钮，然后选择一个你尚未建立贸易伙伴关系的氏族。当你点击建立贸易路线单选按钮时，任何其他目标都会关闭。你仍可以选择派出大型、中型或小型使团，因为即使你的商人专注于建立贸易路线，也会发生少量附带贸易。

column1: The Clan Market
column2: 氏族市场

column1: Back on the main Trade screen, at the lower left, you’ll see a line saying something like ‘Market: Seasonal.’ Your market represents other clans coming to you to trade instead of you having to make special missions to trade with them. As the strength of the clan market improves, your traders will be able to generate more goods for the clan. In general, what’s good for your trade is good for your market.
column2: 回到贸易主界面，左下方你会看到一行文字，类似于“市场：季节性”。你的市场代表其他氏族来找你交易，而不是你必须派出特殊使命去与他们交易。随着氏族市场力量增强，你的商人将能为氏族创造更多货物。总的来说，有利于你贸易的，也有利于你的市场。

column1: The Tribe
column2: 部落

column1: You can play KoDP for a long while without winning or losing. Eventually, however, if you don’t win, you will lose.
column2: 你可以在不赢不输的情况下长久游玩《龙之隘口之王》。然而，最终如果你不赢，你就会输。

column1: You’ll know you are on the right track in either the Short Game or the Long Game when it becomes possible to form a tribe. Prophecies and crises will make it clear when and how to go about starting a tribe. Tribeless clans in your area aren’t going to come to you about starting a tribe, you’ll have to prove yourself to them and convince them to join together.
column2: 当组建部落变为可能时，你就知道自己在短游戏或长游戏中走上了正轨。预言和危机会明确何时以及如何着手创建部落。你所在地区的无部落氏族不会主动来找你谈创建部落的事，你必须向他们证明自己，并说服他们联合起来。

column1: There are two prerequisites for starting a tribe: Kingship and the Making of the Storm Tribe heroquest.
column2: 创建部落有两个先决条件：王权与完成建造风暴部落英雄任务。

column1: Kingship is a reputation for noble, generous and daring actions that would have suited Orlanth himself. In practice, the two common methods of gaining such a reputation are heroic acts and kingly generosity.
column2: 王权是一种名誉，代表着高贵、慷慨和英勇的行为，这些行为本应适合奥兰斯本人。实际上，获得这种声誉的两种常见方法是英雄行为和王者慷慨。

column1: Heroic acts include slaying monsters, defeating enemies, uniting many clans against a terrible foe, and successfully performing heroquests. Clans that never dare great things fail to live up to Orlanth’s example.
column2: 英雄行为包括斩杀怪物、击败敌人、联合众多氏族对抗可怕强敌，以及成功执行英雄任务。从不敢于成就伟大事业的氏族无法效仿奥兰斯的榜样。

column1: One other type of action can sometimes hurt your clan’s reputation for kingship: actions that run counter to tradition.
column2: 另一类行为有时会损害你氏族的王权声誉：违背传统的行为。

column1: Kingly Generosity
column2: 王者慷慨

column1: When another clan comes calling for repayment of favors or help against supernatural menaces, generosity will spread your clan’s reputation for behavior befitting a king. Generous gift-giving by your emissaries can also improve the clan’s kingly reputation.
column2: 当另一个氏族前来请求回报恩惠或帮助对抗超自然威胁时，慷慨将传播你氏族行为符合王者风范的声誉。你的使者慷慨赠礼也能提升氏族的王权声誉。

column1: To keep rough track of how your clan is perceived as potential monarchs, the Sacred Time recap screen provides a Kingship indicator showing how your clan ranks. Before you succeed in making a tribe, the low end of the scale is for clans that conduct themselves like stickpickers and the high end of the scale is for clans that conduct themselves like kings. The scale and names for the ratings change once you’ve succeeded in making a tribe, but the principle remains the same.
column2: 要大致掌握你的氏族作为潜在君主被如何看待，神圣时间回顾界面提供了王权指示器，显示你的氏族排名。在你成功创建部落之前，量表低端代表行事如同拾柴人的氏族，高端代表行事如同君王的氏族。一旦你成功创建了部落，量表和评分名称会发生变化，但原则保持不变。

column1: The Making of the Storm Tribe Heroquest
column2: 建造风暴部落英雄任务

column1: One good way of increasing your kingship in a hurry is to succeed with a heroquest — any heroquest. But if you want to form a tribe and win the game, you must duplicate Orlanth’s mythical feat of tribe-creation and perform the Making of the Storm Tribe quest.
column2: 快速提升王权的一个好方法是成功执行英雄任务——任何英雄任务都行。但如果你想创建部落并赢得游戏，你必须重现奥兰斯创造部落的神话壮举，并执行建造风暴部落任务。

column1: Tribe-making Negotiations
column2: 建立部落谈判

column1: Once you succeed at the Making of the Storm Tribe quest and proved yourself as a kingly clan, you’ll start getting chances to put together a tribe. If you choose to ignore them all…well…you’ll lose.
column2: 一旦你在建造风暴部落任务中成功，并证明自己是一个王者氏族，你便会开始获得整合部落的机会。若你选择无视所有机会……呃……你便会失败。

column1: To increase your odds of success, start each negotiation by offering gifts to the other chief. They won’t always be accepted outright, but even reciprocal gift-giving will soften the other clan’s attitude towards you and make it more likely that you will succeed. In some cases, successful gift-giving greatly increases your odds of success.
column2: 为提高成功几率，每次谈判开始时先向对方酋长赠送礼物。礼物不一定总是被立刻接受，但即使是互赠礼物也能软化对方氏族对你的态度，使你更有可能成功。在某些情况下，成功的赠礼能大幅提高成功几率。

column1: Negotiations with the clans in your area will be the first order of business once the tribe-making process gets rolling. You can set yourself up for success by establishing good relations with most of your neighbors earlier in the game. It’s fine to have a couple of hated feud clans to use for sword-practice, but if you’ve made yourself a royal nuisance to each of your neighbors, you may never become a royal presence.
column2: 一旦建立部落的流程启动，与周边氏族的谈判便成为首要事务。你可以通过游戏早期与大部分邻居建立良好关系来为成功铺路。有一两个结仇的世仇氏族来磨炼剑术并无不可，但若你成了每个邻居的眼中钉，那便永远无法成为王者。

column1: In order to talk other clans into joining the tribe, you will have to make promises about the good things that the tribe will do for them. Clans that are already your friends will be much more likely to listen to your entreaties; an ally who trusts you already may require only one promise whereas a clan that distrusts you may not be satisfied after three.
column2: 要说服其他氏族加入部落，你必须承诺部落将为他们带来的好处。已经与您交好的氏族更有可能倾听你的恳求；一个已经信任你的盟友或许只需一个承诺，而一个不信任你的氏族即便三个承诺也未必满意。

column1: You needn’t entirely discard the idea of inviting feuding clans into your tribe. If you succeed in bringing the tribe together at its confederation moot, all feuds within the tribe will be settled. Your former enemies still might not like you much, but if you treat them better in the future you should be able to prevent a feud from starting up again. And yes, it’s perfectly possible for new feuds to start up inside your tribe. The tribe provides alternative frameworks for settling disputes but it doesn’t entirely overshadow clan-based interactions.
column2: 你无需完全放弃将世仇氏族纳入部落的念头。若你成功召集部落联盟大会，部落内的所有世仇都将被化解。你昔日的敌人也许仍不太喜欢你，但若你日后善待他们，便应能阻止世仇重燃。没错，部落内部完全可能滋生新的世仇。部落为解决争端提供了替代框架，但它并未完全取代氏族间的互动。

column1: The negotiations require a delicate balance. If you promise too little, other clans will turn you down. Bigger promises make it more likely that a clan will join the tribe. Pay careful attention to your ring’s different angles on the correct course of action. Your advisors aren’t likely to present a unified front, they’re different people after all, so you’ll have to choose a path from their mixture of signals.
column2: 谈判需要微妙的平衡。承诺太少，其他氏族会拒绝你。承诺越大，氏族加入部落的可能性就越高。请密切关注你的议会成员对正确行动方针的不同看法。你的顾问们不太可能口径一致——毕竟他们是不同的人——所以你必须从他们各异的信号中择路而行。

column1: If your first tribe-making attempt fails, don’t despair, you’ll get another chance. Don’t relax too much, either, because your second chance may be your last.
column2: 若你的首次建部尝试失败，不要绝望，你还有机会。但也别太放松，因为第二次机会可能就是最后一次。

column1: Tribe Size
column2: 部落规模

column1: You need at least three other clans to form a viable tribe. More is usually better. The bigger your tribe, the stronger it will be, particularly in relation to military adventurism by other tribes. On the other hand, the bigger the tribe, the more likely it is that you will have made many difficult promises during the tribe-making negotiations.
column2: 你需要至少三个其他氏族才能形成一个可行的部落。通常越多越好。部落越大，实力越强，尤其是在应对其他部落的军事冒险时。另一方面，部落越大，你在建部谈判中可能做出的艰难承诺也越多。

column1: Like clans, tribes use special magical items to focus their magic and collective spirit. Unlike clans, tribes often use actual magical treasures as part of their regalia. There’s no simple way to manage the tribal regalia, the magic forces involved are beyond the control of the god-talkers.
column2: 与氏族一样，部落也使用特殊魔法物品来凝聚魔力与集体精神。与氏族不同的是，部落常将真正的魔法宝物用作圣物的一部分。管理部落圣物并无捷径，涉及的魔法力量超出了神言者的掌控。

column1: Tribal Politics & The Game of Kings
column2: 部落政治与王者游戏

column1: Once you’ve succeeded in establishing the tribe, the clans will come together to choose the first king. Only a few of your leaders are viable candidates: your chief, your warleader, your lawspeaker, your best hunter, your best farmer, and the leader with the highest score in each of the seven skills (although often such people have already qualified as candidates by occupying some of the previous positions).
column2: 一旦成功建立部落，众氏族将齐聚一堂，选举首任国王。只有你的少数几位领袖有资格成为候选人：你的酋长、战争领袖、律法师、最优秀的猎人、最优秀的农夫，以及七项技能中每一项得分最高的领袖（尽管这类人通常已通过担任前述职位之一而具备了候选人资格）。

column1: To win the game, you need to have one of your leaders chosen as the king or queen. But this does not necessarily mean that you need to win the first election. If you are unable to become the first king, you will have other chances later in the game when the current king dies or steps down.
column2: 要赢得游戏，你需要让你的某位领袖被选为国王或女王。但这并不一定意味着你必须赢下第一次选举。若你未能成为首任国王，日后当现任国王去世或退位时，你还有别的机会。

column1: Things that Change in a Tribal Game
column2: 部落游戏中的变化事项

column1: The king bears the crown of the Mastery rune. If you wish, you can choose to keep the king off your clan ring. This is not a good idea: tribal mood, clan mood, your magic and several other things will suffer… but if the king is removed from the ring somehow, that alone won’t cost you the game.
column2: 国王佩戴着掌控符文王冠。若你愿意，你可以选择不让国王加入你的氏族议会。这不是个好主意：部落情绪、氏族情绪、你的魔法以及其他若干方面都会受损……但若国王以某种方式离开了议会，单凭这一点并不会让你输掉游戏。

column1: The tribal game isn’t a complete departure from the clan-level game, but there are several significant differences.
column2: 部落游戏并非对氏族层面游戏的彻底颠覆，但存在若干显著差异。

column1: • Sacred Time Magic • Raid targets • Tribal favors • Conflicts within the tribe decided by moots
column2: • 神圣时间魔法 • 劫掠目标 • 部落恩惠 • 部落内由集会裁决的冲突

column1: Sacred Time Magic
column2: 神圣时间魔法

column1: Forming a tribe gains you access to two new types of Sacred Time ritual: Destiny and Heroism.
column2: 组建部落使你能获得两种新的神圣时间仪式：命运与英雄主义。

column1: Destiny: Putting magic into Destiny will help you in tribal politics, particularly the tribal gatherings called moots that settle disputes. It also helps you when you are on the way to winning the game.
column2: 命运：将魔法投入命运将有助于你在部落政治中的表现，尤其是在称为集会、解决争端的部落聚会上。在你迈向胜利的途中，它也会帮助你。

column1: Heroism: Heroism increases the abilities of your clan leaders. You can influence which leaders will benefit most from Heroism by selectively building up your shrines and temples; preference for Heroism bonuses goes to leaders devoted to the gods which the clan has supported with the largest temples.
column2: 英雄主义：英雄主义提升你的氏族领袖的能力。你可以通过有选择地建造神龛和神殿来影响哪些领袖将从英雄主义中获得最大收益；英雄主义加成的优先权给予那些献身于氏族用最大神殿供奉的神祇的领袖。

column1: Long-distance raids take the quickest and safest path to attack their foe. That path can change depending on weather, patrols set up by the target clan and other clans, omens from the gods, and the war-leader’s hunches. There’s no one obvious path between two clans, particularly when you’re trying to elude someone else’s patrols.
column2: 远程突袭会选取最快且最安全的路径来攻击敌人。这条路径会根据天气、目标氏族及其他氏族设置的巡逻队、神祇的预兆以及战争领袖的直觉而改变。两个氏族之间没有一条显而易见的路，尤其是当你想避开别人的巡逻队时。

column1: Raid Targets
column2: 突袭目标

column1: You can’t launch raids against tribe-mates unless you are also feuding with them, except in very rare circumstances. You can still send cattle raids against your tribe-mates. The Orlanthi opinion of cattle raiding is that everybody does it, it gives the young warriors a chance to prove themselves and it keeps warriors ready for real battles.
column2: 除非你与部落同胞正处于世仇状态，否则你不能向他们发动突袭——极少数特殊情况除外。你仍可以向部落同胞发起劫牛突袭。奥兰达人如何看待劫牛行为？人人都干这事，这能让年轻战士有机会证明自己，也能让战士随时为真正的战斗做好准备。

column1: But, taking advantage of your tribe’s larger base of military operations, you can now launch raids against distant clans even if you are not feuding with them. Now you can raid every clan that’s not in your tribe and they, of course, can raid you too.
column2: 但凭借部落更庞大的军事行动基础，你现在可以向那些与你并无世仇的遥远氏族发动突袭。现在你可以袭击所有不在你部落内的氏族，当然，他们也能袭击你。

column1: Tribal Favors
column2: 部落恩惠

column1: Before you put together a tribe, clans only came asking for cows and food and magic when you owed them a favor. Being in a tribe changes the rules. Now your tribe-mates may ask you for a favor in advance, promising to owe you a favor in the future. If you’re the king of the tribe, expectations of you will be even higher. Having other clans indebted to you is not a bad thing. And if times get hard for your clan, you can ask tribe-mates who don’t owe you anything for a favor.
column2: 在组建部落之前，只有当你欠下恩惠时，氏族才会前来索要牛只、食物和魔法。加入部落改变了规则。现在你的部落同胞可能会提前向你请求恩惠，承诺日后欠你一个人情。如果你身为部落之王，人们对你的期望会更高。让其他氏族欠你人情并非坏事。而如果你的氏族时运艰难，你也可以向那些并不欠你任何东西的部落同胞请求恩惠。

column1: Tribal Moots
column2: 部落大会

column1: If two clans within the tribe cannot settle a dispute themselves, they can take their cases in front of a gathering of the full tribe known as the tribal moot. Tribal moots see to it that clans do not have to go to war to settle disputes within the tribe. Each side presents its case, gives gifts to the leaders of the other clans, brings warriors to war-whoop during the opponent’s arguments, and hopes that the rest of the tribe decides to rule in their favor.
column2: 如果部落内两个氏族无法自行解决争端，他们可以将案件提交到被称为“部落大会”的全部落集会面前。部落大会确保氏族无需通过战争来解决部落内部的争端。每方陈述自己的案情，向其他氏族的首领赠送礼物，在对手辩论时让战士们发出战吼，并希望部落的其他成员判决对自己有利。

column1: War-whooping derives from Orlanth’s dance in the “The Contests.”
column2: 战吼源自欧兰在“竞赛”中的舞蹈。

column1: Economic Lobbying
column2: 经济游说

column1: Orlanthi law is marvelously flexible: it’s amazing how often legal rulings happen to coincide with the perspective of the clan that has been the most generous with its gifts. Of course a clan ring that spends more on gifts than the dispute in question was worth won’t win the praise of its people.
column2: 奥兰达法律具有惊人的灵活性：法律裁决居然常常与那些出手最大方的氏族的观点不谋而合，这实在令人惊叹。当然，如果一个氏族议会在礼物上的花费超过了争议本身的价值，它就不会赢得族人的赞誉。

column1: War-whooping
column2: 战吼

column1: How many warriors can you take to the moot without overtly slighting the clan you’re in a dispute with? Your advisors may give you an indication of how many weaponthanes your rivals are likely to bring to the moot, and therefore how many they would expect you to bring. Remember that each weaponthane counts as five footmen. You can usually count on taking around four weaponthanes or twenty footmen without offending all but the prickliest clans. For disputes that are already somewhat violent, you might be able to take three or four times as many warriors. For disputes which are already bloody and headed towards war, you might be able to take the entire fyrd without raising eyebrows.
column2: 在不明显冒犯与你发生争端的氏族的前提下，你能带多少战士去参加部落大会？你的顾问可能会暗示你的对手会带多少武器领主与会，从而让你知道他们期待你带多少人去。记住，每位武器领主抵得上五名步兵。通常你可以带大约四位武器领主或二十名步兵，而不会冒犯除了最挑剔氏族之外的所有人。对于已经有些暴力的争端，你可能可以带上三到四倍的战士。对于已经流血并走向战争的争端，你或许可以带上全部民兵而不会引人侧目。

column1: Bringing many warriors to whoop at the moot is another way of swaying the tribe’s opinion in your favor, but might-makes-right diplomacy has its cost. If the matter in dispute is not already a military confrontation, the clan you are arguing against is likely to take offense if you bring many warriors to the moot. Their displeasure may not surface immediately, but clans that have consistently had your fyrd shaking spears in their faces at moots will eventually find ways to make their displeasure known.
column2: 带大量战士到部落大会上咆哮是另一种左右部落舆论、使其对你有利的方式，但“强权即公理”的外交有其代价。如果争端事项并非军事对峙，而你带大量战士去参加部落大会，对方氏族很可能会感到冒犯。他们的不满可能不会立即表露，但那些在部落大会上屡次被你方民兵当面挥舞长矛的氏族，终究会找到方式来表达他们的不满。

column1: The same could be said of clans that lose all their moots for any reason. Clans want to believe that the tribe sometimes works in their favor. If they have evidence to the contrary, they may get restless.
column2: 同样的情况也适用于那些因任何原因在部落大会上屡次败诉的氏族。氏族愿意相信部落在某些时候会站在他们一边。如果他们掌握相反的证据，就可能变得不安分。

column1: The Tribe Button and Moot Policy
column2: 部落按钮与集会政策

column1: The personalities of the clans in your tribe can affect your tribe’s actions. Tribes full of warlike clans are more likely to succeed making war, tribes full of peaceful-types will be slightly better at making peace.
column2: 部落内各氏族的性格会影响部落的行动。充满好战氏族的部落更有可能在战争中获胜，而充满和平主义者的部落则略擅于缔造和平。

column1: The Tribe button on the Relations screen allows you to see the status of the tribe’s king, to check the tribal mood, and to choose your clan’s standard policy at routine tribal moots.
column2: 关系界面中的部落按钮允许你查看部落之王的状态、检查部落情绪，并为你的氏族在常规部落大会上选择标准政策。

column1: Kingship: If another clan has the throne, don’t worry too much, you’ll get another chance at the kingship in a few years.
column2: 王权：如果另一个氏族占据了王座，不必太过担心，几年后你会有再次争夺王权的机会。

column1: Tribal Mood: Tribal mood represents the tribe’s assessment of its past performance and its prospects for the future. It’s not as important as the clan mood, but for some interactions between tribal members, it can be key.
column2: 部落情绪：部落情绪代表了部落对其过往表现及未来前景的评估。它不如氏族情绪那么重要，但对于部落成员之间的某些互动而言，它可能是关键因素。

column1: Moot Policy: How you judge cases that come before the tribal moot
column2: 集会政策：你如何评判提交到部落大会的案件

column1: According to their merits: Worst choice for the amount of goods you’ll receive from the judicial process, but other clans in the tribe won’t think ill of you.
column2: 根据案件本身的是非曲直：从司法程序中获得的物资数量而言，这是最差的选择，但部落中的其他氏族不会因此对你有恶感。

column1: Support the most generous party: Best choice for receiving big gifts, but each year a random clan in the tribe will be irked by your behavior.
column2: 支持最慷慨的一方：获得厚礼的最佳选择，但每年部落中会有一个随机氏族因你的行为而恼火。

column1: Support your friends: Second worst choice in terms of the gifts you’ll receive. Your friends will like you more and more, clans that already dislike you will hate you.
column2: 支持你的朋友：就礼物而言是第二差的选择。你的朋友们会越来越喜欢你，而本就讨厌你的氏族会更加憎恨你。

column1: Support those who think ill of you: Second best choice for gifts. Clans that like you will like you a bit less each year, clans that dislike you will improve their attitude towards you.
column2: 支持那些对你心存芥蒂的人：礼物方面是次优选择。喜欢你的氏族每年会稍微降低好感，而讨厌你的氏族则会改善对你的态度。

column1: To check on which clans are in other tribes, and who their kings are, go to the Relations screen and slide the filter to All Tribes. Within crises and adventures, tap the Info button for the same information.
column2: 要查看其他部落有哪些氏族及其首领是谁，请前往关系界面并将筛选器滑动至“所有部落”。在危机与冒险中，点击信息按钮可获取相同信息。

column1: Inter-Tribal Relations
column2: 部落间关系

column1: To check on which clans are in other tribes, and who their kings are, go to the Relations screen and slide the filter to All Tribes. Within crises and adventures, tap the same information is at the bottom of the screen.
column2: 要查看其他部落有哪些氏族及其首领是谁，请前往关系界面并将筛选器滑动至“所有部落”。在危机与冒险中，屏幕底部有相同信息可点击。

column1: War Screen
column2: 战争界面

column1: The War screen allows you to: • recruit weaponthanes • build fortifications • launch raids and cattle raids against other clans • track the clan’s recent military history
column2: 战争界面允许您：• 招募武器领主 • 建造防御工事 • 针对其他氏族发起突袭与掠夺牲畜 • 追踪氏族近期军事历史

column1: Military Organization
column2: 军事组织

column1: Weaponthanes are dedicated warriors whose only responsibilities are to fight, patrol, and guard their clan-mates from attack, either at home or while traveling through Dragon Pass. The Weaponthanes recruitment button here works the same as the button on the Clan screen.
column2: 武器领主是专职战士，其唯一职责是战斗、巡逻，并在族人身处家园或穿越龙隘时守护他们免遭袭击。此处的武器领主招募按钮与部落界面的按钮功能相同。

column1: The Fyrd, a.k.a. the Footmen
column2: 民兵，亦称步兵

column1: War Clans have bigger fyrds, Peace Clans have smaller fyrds. If you don’t want to change your clan type to increase your fyrd, go to the Magic screen and sacrifice for Vinga’s Fyrdwomen blessing. Female farmers will take up the practice of arms and join your footmen in the field. The penalty is a slight drop in agricultural productivity and childbirth.
column2: 战争氏族的民兵规模更大，和平氏族的民兵规模较小。若你不想通过改变氏族类型来扩充民兵，可前往魔法界面献祭以获取“维娜的民兵女眷”赐福。女性农夫将开始习武，加入你的步兵行列。代价是农业生产力与生育率略有下降。

column1: Every Orlanthi man is expected to be able to fight. Many women choose to do so as well. Every farmer has a spear and a strong hat and is ready to muster as part of the clan fyrd. Members of the fyrd do not have horses, they walk to battle, and are therefore known as footmen. Given enough warning, the entire fyrd will muster to fight off an enemy raid.
column2: 每个奥兰瑟男子都应能作战。许多女性也选择如此。每位农夫都配有长矛与坚固的头盔，随时准备作为氏族民兵应召。民兵成员没有马匹，步行上阵，故称步兵。若有足够预警，全体民兵将集结抵御敌人的突袭。

column1: The Short-Call
column2: 快速召集队

column1: Your short-call will start small. To make it bigger, sacrifice for more War blessings. When More Info is chock-full of War blessings, you’ll have many more farmers who are ready for adventure.
column2: 你的快速召集队起初规模很小。要扩大它，需献祭以获取更多战争赐福。当“更多信息”栏充满战争赐福时，你将拥有更多准备好冒险的农夫。

column1: Cattle raids require a quick response, too quick for the fyrd to muster. Footmen who can quickly arm themselves to respond to enemy aggression or to launch a quick attack are known as the short-call. Along with the ever-vigilant weaponthanes, the short-call warriors also stand ready to guard traders, emissaries, and explorers.
column2: 掠夺牲畜需要快速反应，快到民兵来不及集结。那些能迅速武装以应对敌人侵略或发动快速突袭的步兵，被称为快速召集队。与始终警惕的武器领主一起，快速召集队战士随时准备护卫商人、使节与探索者。

column1: The Auxiliaries
column2: 辅助者

column1: Auxiliaries are noncombatants (usually but not always women) who accompany the warriors, cheering them on and supporting them with healing magic. On raids against your steads (but not in cattle raids against your herds), your auxiliaries will always be present. In full raids against other clans, you can choose whether you want auxiliaries to accompany your warriors.
column2: 辅助者是非战斗人员（通常但不总是女性），他们随战士同行，以欢呼鼓舞并用治疗魔法提供支持。在针对你农庄的突袭中（但不包括针对你畜群的牲畜掠夺），你的辅助者始终在场。在对其他氏族的全面突袭中，你可以选择是否让辅助者随战士一同出征。

column1: Fortifications cost goods to build but do not subtract further goods for maintenance.
column2: 防御工事建造需要消耗物资，但后续无需再消耗物资维护。

column1: A handful of the first clans to enter Dragon Pass, most of whom are in the Colymar tribe, settled around ancient hill forts. The hill forts provide superior defense, but are beyond the building capabilities of present-day clans.
column2: 最早进入龙隘的少数氏族，其中多数属于科利马尔部落，定居在古代山堡周围。这些山堡提供优越的防御，但已超出当今氏族的建造能力。

column1: Most fortifications reduce the amount of wealth taken from you when enemies defeat you in battle and plunder your steads. They also reduce the number of casualties your forces suffer when you choose Survival as your battle goal (see below). Fortification effects are cumulative; a stone wall and a ditch are better than just a stone wall.
column2: 多数防御工事能减少敌人在战斗中击败你并劫掠你农庄时夺走的财富量。它们还能在你选择“生存”作为战斗目标时降低部队的伤亡人数（见下文）。防御工事效果可叠加；石墙加壕沟优于仅有石墙。

column1: Two fortifications have special functions:
column2: 两种防御工事具有特殊功能：

column1: • a watch tower increases your patrol’s chances of spotting raids and cattle raids. • a stake perimeter offers extra protection against mounted foes.
column2: • 瞭望塔提高巡逻队发现突袭与牲畜掠夺的几率。• 木桩防线提供对抗骑乘敌人的额外防护。

column1: Raids, Battles, and Bloodshed
column2: 突袭、战斗与流血

column1: When To Raid
column2: 何时突袭

column1: During Sea season, the farmers are planting, and may refuse to muster for a raid. When you do manage to launch a raid anyway, the farmers will have had to ignore some of their work and the harvest will suffer. On the plus side, your enemies do not expect to be raided in Sea season (or in Earth season, for that matter) and will be easier to surprise.
column2: 在海之季，农夫们正在播种，可能拒绝为突袭集结。即便你设法发动突袭，农夫们也将不得不忽略部分工作，收成将受损。好处是，你的敌人不会预料到在海之季（或地季）遭到突袭，因此更容易被奇袭。

column1: Non-humans and other foreigners aren’t tied to the same agricultural cycle.
column2: 非人类与其他外来者不受同一农业周期约束。

column1: In Fire season, the warriors expect to raid and be raided, since the weather is fine and the crops need little attention. Raiding in Fire season will increase the morale of your warriors slightly, even if they get unlucky and lose the battle.
column2: 在火之季，战士们预期会发动突袭或遭到突袭，因为天气晴好，作物无需太多照料。在火之季进行突袭会略微提升战士们的士气，即使他们运气不佳战败也是如此。

column1: Every hand is needed for the Earth season harvest, and the fyrd is unlikely to be willing to raid. If they do, some of the harvest will be left in the field.
column2: 地季收获需要所有人手，民兵不太愿意出征突袭。若他们执意如此，部分收成将遗留在田间。
