column1: Dark season is usually too cold to venture on a raid, though clans which fought Valind in the Great Darkness know the magic rituals which can make such raiding easier.
column2: 黑暗季通常过于寒冷，不宜发起袭击，不过那些在大黑暗时期与瓦林德作战过的氏族知晓能使这种袭击更轻松的魔法仪式。

column1: Storm season is a fine time for raiding, although the weather changes unpredictably.
column2: 风暴季是袭击的好时节，尽管天气变化无常。

column1: Nobody raids during the Sacred Time rituals. It’s far more important to properly perform the ceremonies that renew the world.
column2: 神圣时间举行仪式期间无人发动袭击。妥善执行那些让世界重焕生机的仪式要重要得多。

column1: Cattle Raids
column2: 劫牛袭击

column1: Stealing your neighbor’s cows is an ancient and honorable Orlanthi tradition. Ideally, a small group of raiders sneaks onto another tula and drives home a small herd, unnoticed. In practice, the target clan’s outer patrol often spots the raiders, and either chases them off or engages in a small battle. If you never seem to succeed in getting away with the enemy’s cows, you are probably sending too many warriors.
column2: 偷走邻居的牛是奥兰斯人古老而光荣的传统。理想情况下，一小队袭击者偷偷潜入另一片图拉领地，赶回一小群牛，无人察觉。实际上，目标氏族的外围巡逻队常常会发现袭击者，要么将他们赶走，要么爆发一场小规模战斗。如果你似乎从未成功带着敌人的牛逃脱，那你派去的战士很可能太多了。

column1: You can only launch cattle raids against neighboring clans. Cattle raids are quick strikes that attempt to take advantage of another clan’s lax patrols; the idea is to get in and out without fighting a pitched battle.
column2: 你只能对邻近氏族发动劫牛袭击。劫牛袭击是快速突击，试图利用另一氏族松懈的巡逻；其想法是潜入潜出，无需打一场阵地战。

column1: When cattle raiders are spotted by their enemies and forced to fight, the resulting confrontation is treated like any other battle, with one exception: any plunder seized by the cattle raiders will consist only of animals stolen from the herd, not goods taken from the steads.
column2: 当劫牛者被敌人发现并被迫战斗时，引发的冲突与其他战斗无异，只有一个例外：劫牛者缴获的任何战利品将仅包含从牛群中偷来的牲畜，而非从农庄夺得的财物。

column1: It’s generally not possible to launch raids against non-human or non-Orlanthi enemies. Their homes are usually either distant, secret, incredibly well-defended by Orlanthi standards, or entirely nomadic. However, there is a way to force a fight with non-humans that are your ancient enemy: the Summons of Evil ritual. Perform the ritual and prepare yourself for your ancient enemy’s assault.
column2: 通常不可能对非人类或非奥兰斯人的敌人发动袭击。他们的家园通常或遥远、或隐秘、或按奥兰斯人标准防御极其严密，又或是完全游牧的。然而，有一种方法能迫使与你久为宿敌的非人类与你交战：召唤邪恶仪式。执行此仪式，准备好迎接你古老宿敌的进攻。

column1: Raids are determined attacks against a clan’s steads, usually in search of plunder. Unlike cattle raids, raids always force a battle with at least some of the defending warriors, even if the raid manages to slip past the defending patrols.
column2: 袭击是针对氏族农庄的蓄意攻击，通常是为了抢夺战利品。与劫牛袭击不同，袭击总会迫使至少部分防御战士投入战斗，即便袭击者设法避开了防御巡逻队。

column1: As with cattle raids, the normal targets for raids are neighboring clans. But you can also raid feuding clans, no matter how distant.
column2: 与劫牛袭击一样，袭击的通常目标是邻近氏族。但你也可以攻击世仇氏族，无论它们多么遥远。

column1: Raiding options:
column2: 袭击选项：

column1: Should you ask another clan for help?
column2: 你是否应请求另一氏族帮助？

column1: Outside of planting and harvest season, a clan that is allied to you or that owes you a favor may send warriors to help your raid. These warriors will be a mix of footmen and weaponthanes, and will demand a share of the plunder if you win. Win or lose you will owe their clan a favor.
column2: 除了播种和收获季节，一个与你结盟或欠你恩惠的氏族可能会派出战士援助你的袭击。这些战士将由步兵和武器领主混合组成，若你获胜，他们将要求分得一份战利品。无论胜败，你都将欠他们氏族一个恩惠。

column1: Should you take along auxiliaries?
column2: 你是否应带上辅助者？

column1: Auxiliaries inspire your warriors to keep fighting when they would ordinarily flee, then heal those who are mortally or heavily wounded. Unfortunately, auxiliaries don’t defend themselves well and can be taken prisoner if your warriors lose the battle.
column2: 辅助者激励你的战士在通常要溃逃时继续战斗，然后治疗那些受致命伤或重伤者。不幸的是，辅助者自身防御不佳，若你的战士战败，他们可能被俘。

column1: How many warriors should you take?
column2: 你应派出多少战士？

column1: The more warriors you take, the better chance you have of winning the battle. As in most other military situations, a single weaponthane fights as well as 5 footmen. If you take all your warriors on a raid, other clans may seize the chance and raid your cattle while the herds are undefended.
column2: 你派出的战士越多，获胜的几率就越大。与大多数其他军事情况一样，一名武器领主的战斗力相当于五名步兵。若你将所有战士都投入袭击，其他氏族可能会趁虚而入，在你的牲畜无人防守时劫掠你的牛群。

column1: The Structure of Battle
column2: 战斗的结构

column1: Each battle is divided into two main parts, the initial clash and the melee.
column2: 每场战斗分为两个主要部分：初次交锋和混战。

column1: Sometimes one of the clan’s leaders faces a pivotal choice in the middle of a battle. Your leader’s actions help determine the results of the battle as well as the leader’s odds of survival, your clan’s reputation for heroism, and the leader’s standing in the clan.
column2: 有时氏族的一位领袖会在战斗中途面临关键抉择。你的领袖的行动将决定战斗的结果、领袖的生存几率、你氏族在英雄主义方面的声誉，以及领袖在氏族中的地位。

column1: The initial clash is when the two sides size each other up or try to force their vision of how the battle should be fought onto their enemy. Your battle tactics are compared to the enemy’s battle tactics to determine which side gains an advantage in the melee to come. In most cases, winning the initial clash confers advantages for the rest of the battle, but does not guarantee victory. Occasionally one side’s success in the initial clash determines that the two sides disengage before entering the melee.
column2: 初次交锋是双方互相试探实力，或试图将他们对战斗方式的构想强加于敌人。你的战斗战术与敌人的战斗战术相比较，以决定哪方在后续的混战中占据优势。在多数情况下，赢得初次交锋会为剩余战斗带来优势，但并不保证胜利。偶尔，一方在初次交锋中的成功会导致双方在进入混战前脱离接触。

column1: The second part of the battle, the melee, decides the outcome of the fight. Melee begins when the warriors have moved from missile weapon distance into sword-and-spear range. The melee ends when one side breaks and runs. If the raider wins the melee, they will take plunder or have a chance of achieving other objectives. After the melee is resolved, your warleader reports on the battle’s results.
column2: 战斗的第二部分——混战，决定战斗的结果。当战士从远程武器距离移动到刀剑和长矛距离时，混战开始。当一方崩溃逃跑时，混战结束。若袭击者赢得混战，他们将夺取战利品或有机会实现其他目标。混战解决后，你的战争领袖会报告战斗结果。

column1: The Tactics Screen
column2: 战术界面

column1: Before each battle, you’ll be given several interrelated options for how you would like your forces to fight on the Tactics screen.
column2: 每场战斗前，你将在战术界面上获得数个相互关联的选项，供你选择如何指挥部队作战。

column1: Your choices include:
column2: 你的选择包括：

column1: • how much clan magic you use in the battle • whether you pause to sacrifice a cow to Orlanth or Humakt • whether you use a battle treasure in the fight to come • your Tactic for the initial clash • the Objective that your warriors will pursue as their main goal in the melee
column2: · 你在战斗中使用的氏族魔法量 · 你是否暂停并献祭一头牛给奥兰斯或胡马克特 · 你是否在即将到来的战斗中使用一件战斗宝物 · 你在初次交锋中的战术 · 你的战士在混战中追求的主要目标

column1: Using Magic in Battle
column2: 在战斗中使用魔法

column1: The main advantage of playing a War Clan is to start with two points of War magic ritual during Sacred Time. If you’d rather not live with the agricultural drawbacks of life as a War Clan, consider putting a devotee of Humakt, Vinga, Urox or Elmal on your clan ring: if you have at least one war god worshipper on the ring, you’ll get an extra point of War magic ritual in the Sacred Time.
column2: 选择战争氏族的主要优势，是在神圣时间开始时就拥有两点战争魔法仪式。如果你不想承受战争氏族农耕方面的劣势，可以考虑在氏族议会中安排一位胡马克特、温加、乌洛克斯或埃尔马尔的信奉者：只要议会里至少有一位战争之神的信徒，你在神圣时间就能额外获得一点战争魔法仪式。

column1: The clan magic you allocated to War rituals during Sacred Time will be used in every battle in the following year, though you won’t receive any on-screen reminders of this fact. To increase the amount of magic on your side in a specific battle, use the slider at the top of the Battle screen.
column2: 你在神圣时间分配给战争仪式的氏族魔法，将在接下来一年里的每一场战斗中使用，不过你不会收到任何屏幕上的提醒。要在某场特定战斗中增加己方魔法量，请使用战斗屏幕上方的滑块。

column1: The more magic you have on your side in a battle, the better your chance of overcoming the enemy’s magic in the initial clash. The side that bests the other’s magic gets a bonus in the melee.
column2: 战斗中己方魔法越多，在初次交锋中压制敌方魔法的机会就越大。在魔法较量中占优的一方，将在混战中获得加成。

column1: Battle Treasures
column2: 战斗宝物

column1: If you have one or more battle treasures, a list will be available. Tap a treasure to choose it; tap it again if you change your mind. You can only use one treasure per battle.
column2: 如果你拥有一件或多件战斗宝物，将显示列表。点击宝物进行选择；如果改变主意，再次点击即可。每场战斗只能使用一件宝物。

column1: Some battle treasures can be used only once. Most have a chance of breaking when used.
column2: 有些战斗宝物只能使用一次。大多数在使用时有损坏的可能。

column1: Sacrificing Cows to Orlanth and Humakt
column2: 向奥兰斯和胡马克特献祭牛

column1: Sacrificing a cow to Orlanth improves your odds of coming out on top in the initial clash.
column2: 向奥兰斯献祭一头牛，可以提高你在初次交锋中占据上风的几率。

column1: Sacrificing a cow to Humakt improves your odds of winning the melee, and hence the entire battle. Sacrificing to Humakt also reduces the effectiveness of the enemy’s auxiliaries.
column2: 向胡马克特献祭一头牛，可以提高你赢得混战、进而赢得整场战斗的几率。向胡马克特献祭还能降低敌方辅助者的效力。

column1: Sacrifices take time. If your enemy charges or otherwise forces the melee when you are still sacrificing, sacrifice will have no effect. This also applies to the enemy if you charge while they are sacrificing. All your warriors participate in each sacrifice, so making two sacrifices takes twice as long as making one.
column2: 献祭需要时间。如果在你仍在献祭时，敌人发起冲锋或以其他方式迫使进入混战，那么献祭将无效。如果在你冲锋时敌人正在献祭，这一点同样适用。你所有的战士都参与每次献祭，因此进行两次献祭所需的时间是进行一次的两倍。

column1: Objectives
column2: 目标

column1: Once the two sides come together in the melee, it is difficult for your leaders to enforce command and control. Your warriors will fight to attain the overall objective you chose before the battle. Battles resulting from cattle raids disallow several of these objectives.
column2: 一旦双方在混战中交锋，你的首领就很难维持指挥与控制。战士们会为达成你在战前选择的总体目标而战斗。由劫牛引发的战斗会禁止使用其中几个目标。

column1: Plunder is the standard objective, allowing victorious warriors to concentrate on what they enjoy most: making off with cattle and goods. The larger the plundering force, the more plunder it will seize. There are a couple of wrinkles to the Plunder objective. For one, cattle raids never take goods; instead, they seize cattle and occasionally sheep. Second, if starvation is imminent, Orlanthi warriors who win a full raid will seize food as well as goods and cattle.
column2: 劫掠是标准目标，让得胜的战士专注于他们最享受的事：抢走牛和货物。劫掠部队规模越大，掠夺到的战利品就越多。劫掠目标有几个变数。首先，劫牛战从不夺取货物；它们只抢夺牛，偶尔也抢羊。第二，如果饥荒迫在眉睫，赢得一场全面袭击的奥兰斯战士会同时夺取食物、货物和牛。

column1: Warriors who attempt to burn steads will pass up some opportunities for plunder in order to inflict as much physical damage as possible on the other clan’s possessions. Stead burning is a ferocious insult. Even when you don’t succeed in burning another clan’s steads, they’ll probably hate you for trying. But if you do manage to burn an enemy’s steads, they’ll have fewer resources to devote to making war against you.
column2: 试图烧毁农庄的战士会放弃一些劫掠机会，以尽可能对其他氏族的财产造成物理破坏。烧农庄是一种极其严重的侮辱。即使你没成功烧掉另一个氏族的农庄，他们多半也会因你的企图而恨你。但如果你确实烧毁了敌人的农庄，他们将拥有更少的资源来用于对你发动战争。

column1: To soften up an opponent, or just to show them that you hate them, direct your warriors to try to kill as many of the enemy as possible. If victorious, your warriors will pass up some of their opportunities for plunder in order to kill more of the enemy. In a losing fight your warriors will also inflict more casualties, though they may also suffer more as a consequence of their bloodlust.
column2: 为了削弱对手，或者仅仅是为了向他们表达你的仇恨，你可以命令你的战士尽可能多地杀死敌人。如果获胜，你的战士会放弃部分劫掠机会，以击杀更多敌人。在败局中，你的战士也会造成更多伤亡，不过他们也可能因嗜血而遭受更大损失。

column1: Seize land
column2: 夺取土地

column1: If your clan is adjacent to another clan’s tula, you might be able to drive them off some of their land. This is not easy — odds are that your efforts will fail even if you win the battle.
column2: 如果你的氏族与另一个氏族的图拉领地相邻，你或许能将他们从部分土地上赶走。但这并不容易——即使你赢得了战斗，你的努力也很可能失败。

column1: While it may sometimes be useful to seize territory, winning the game depends on influence, not conquest.
column2: 虽然夺取领土有时可能有帮助，但赢得游戏取决于影响力，而非征服。

column1: Prisoners taken in battle can be ransomed, freed, turned into thralls, or killed. Ransoming prisoners provides you with goods. Freeing prisoners makes the other clan less likely to raid you in the future. Thrall-taking clans will certainly want to consider keeping prisoners as thralls, though their own thralls may grow restless when members of enemy clans or non-Orlanthi prisoners are pressed into servitude. Killing prisoners is always an option. Not a great option, perhaps, but it makes sure that these particular enemies won’t be back to raid you again.
column2: 战斗中抓获的俘虏可以被赎回、释放、变成奴隶或处死。赎回俘虏能为你提供货物。释放俘虏会降低其他氏族未来袭击你的可能性。蓄奴氏族肯定会考虑将俘虏保留为奴隶，不过当敌对氏族成员或非奥兰斯俘虏被强迫奴役时，他们自己的奴隶可能会变得不安。处死俘虏始终是一个选项。也许不是好选项，但它能确保这些特定的敌人不会再回来袭击你。

column1: If you are heavily outnumbered, keeping your warriors alive might be your best bet. Survival works even better when you have good fortifications. But be warned: choosing Survival means that your warriors are concentrating on making a shield wall and staying alive, not on winning the battle or preventing the enemy from plundering your tula.
column2: 如果你在人数上严重劣势，让战士存活可能是最佳选择。拥有良好防御工事时，生存策略的效果更佳。但请注意：选择生存意味着你的战士专注于构筑盾墙、保命，而不是赢得战斗或阻止敌人劫掠你的图拉领地。

column1: Your choice of tactics determines the initial clash of the two forces. The four possible tactics are Skirmish, Maneuver, Charge, and Evade.
column2: 你对战术的选择决定了双方部队的初次交锋。四种可能的战术是：散兵战、机动、冲锋和规避。

column1: Hurl slingstones, throw javelins, and fire arrows at the enemy for as long as possible, trying to inflict maximum casualties before the melee. Skirmishing is also a useful tactic if you do not wish to press the fight but are unwilling to choose to Evade. If your opponent also opts to Skirmish or Evade, your forces will never come into contact.
column2: 尽可能长时间地向敌人投石、掷标枪、射箭，力求在混战前造成最大伤亡。如果你不想强行战斗，又不愿选择规避，散兵战也是一种有用的战术。如果对手也选择散兵战或规避，双方兵力将永远不会接触。

column1: Orlanthi troops don’t practice marching in formation, but it is possible to maneuver your forces to seek tactical advantage. Maneuvering means looking for high ground, trying to take the enemy from its flank, or luring them into a bad position. You have more luck maneuvering on your home terrain.
column2: 奥兰西部落并不训练列队行进，但你可以机动部队以寻求战术优势。机动意味着寻找高地、试图从侧翼攻击敌人，或诱使其进入不利位置。在己方领土上机动更为顺利。

column1: Charging is the tactic Orlanthi clans use most, partly because a successful Charge gives the biggest bonus in the second half of the battle. The intent is to hit the enemy hard and fast and drive them back in the crucial first seconds of the melee.
column2: 冲锋是奥兰西部族最常用的战术，部分原因在于成功冲锋能在战斗后半段提供最大加成。其意图是在混战的最初几秒内迅猛打击敌人，将其击退。

column1: Successfully evading an opponent is tough to pull off, but if you’re successful you may be able to avoid a battle entirely. If you lose the initial clash, trying to evade will hurt your chances of winning the battle.
column2: 成功规避对手并不容易，但一旦成功，你可能完全避免战斗。如果在初次交锋中失利，试图规避将降低赢得战斗的几率。

column1: If your clan members were taken as prisoner you can usually free them with a later successful raid. When you take prisoners from other clans as thralls, their clansmen have a similar chance of freeing those thralls with a successful raid.
column2: 如果你的氏族成员被俘，通常可以通过后续成功的袭击解救他们。当你将其他氏族的俘虏变为奴隶时，他们的族人也同样有机会通过成功的袭击解救这些奴隶。

column1: Tracking Your Recent Military History
column2: 追踪近期军事史

column1: The War screen keeps track of your last five raids and the last five raids against you. Here are the codes for the icons in the records:
column2: 战争界面记录了你最近五次袭击以及针对你的最近五次袭击。以下是记录中的图标代码：

column1: Sword: a battle you won Broken sword: a battle you lost Cow: a successful cattle raid Empty cow: a cattle raid that turned back because of its target’s patrols Blank space: a battle that broke off after the initial clash
column2: 剑：你赢得的战斗；断剑：你输掉的战斗；牛：成功的劫牛袭击；空牛：因目标巡逻队而折返的劫牛袭击；空白：初次交锋后中止的战斗。

column1: The logic applied for the results of raids and cattle raids follow different tracks. The symbol for a successful cattle raid that avoids a battle is the same regardless of who stole the cattle, whereas the symbols for full battles pivot on your clan’s success or failure.
column2: 袭击与劫牛袭击的结果判定遵循不同逻辑。成功规避战斗的劫牛袭击，无论偷牛者是谁，符号都相同；而完整战斗的符号则取决于你氏族的成败。

column1: Your short-call will start small. To make it bigger, sacrifice for more War blessings. When the list at the bottom right is chock-full of War blessings, you’ll have many more farmers who are ready for adventure.
column2: 你的快速召集队起初规模很小。要扩大它，就通过献祭获取更多战争祝福。当右下角的列表充满战争祝福时，你将拥有更多准备投身冒险的农夫。

column1: The Short Game
column2: 短游戏

column1: To win the Short Game, you need to put together a tribe. Once one of your leaders becomes king or queen of the tribe, you will have ten years to perform two heroquests. One of these heroquests must be the quest related to your main deity: Orlanth and Aroka, Ernalda Feeds the Tribe, or Elmal Guards the Stead. If you’re still king in ten years, and the clans in your tribe think somewhat highly of you, and your clan has enough cows, you will win.
column2: 要赢得短游戏，你需要组建一个部落。一旦你的某位首领成为部落的国王或女王，你将有十年的时间进行两次英雄任务。其中一次必须是与你主神相关的任务：奥兰斯与阿罗卡、埃尔纳达养育部落、或埃尔马尔守护庄园。如果在十年后你仍是国王，且部落中的氏族对你颇为敬重，同时你的氏族拥有足够的牛只，你便获胜。

column1: One warning: once you win the Short Game, you can’t simply keep playing and go for the Long Game win, your game ends when you win or lose the Short Game.
column2: 警告：一旦你赢得短游戏，你不能简单地继续游戏去争取长游戏胜利——当你赢得或输掉短游戏时，游戏即告结束。

column1: The Long Game
column2: 长游戏

column1: Put together the tribe, then build up your herds and your leaders. You will need a king or queen who is made of strong stuff.
column2: 组建部落，然后壮大你的畜群和首领。你需要一位意志坚韧的国王或女王。

column1: Build your reputation while performing the seven heroquests necessary to win the game.
column2: 在完成胜利所需的七次英雄任务的同时，建立你的声望。

column1: The long game will eventually lead you into a series of adventures where your king or queen tries to unify all of Dragon Pass.
column2: 长游戏最终会将你带入一系列冒险，你的国王或女王将试图统一龙之隘口全境。

column2: 如需支援，请访问我们的网站 www.a-sharp.com/kodp/ 或发送邮件至 support@herocraft.com。

column1: In the beginning, the great powers of the goddess Glorantha's Cosmic Court created the world. These eight gods and goddesses lived on the perfect mountain. We call the mountain "The Spike," because it nailed all reality together with perfect Truth and Justice.
column2: 起初，女神格洛兰萨宇宙法庭的八大神力创造了世界。这八位神祇居住在完美的山峰上。我们称这座山为“尖峰”，因为它用至高的真理与正义将一切现实钉合在一起。

column1: But of course the world itself was not composed only of these noble qualities. It was made of a changing mix of the original Elemental gods and goddesses. Darkness came first, at the bottom of the world, just above the great nothing. Water came next, moving in an endless ocean around the Darkness. Earth came to lie upon the waters, square-shaped like the Earth rune, floating strongly and anchoring all that was to come. Then came Sky, hanging above all, shining down with its Fire half on everything below it.
column2: 但世界本身自然并非仅由这些高贵品质构成。它由原始元素神祇的变幻混合铸成。黑暗最先出现，位于世界底部，紧邻巨大虚无之上。水流随后而来，在黑暗周围形成无尽海洋。大地安卧于水上，形如大地符文那般方正，稳固漂浮，锚定一切将成之物。随后天空降临，悬于万物之上，以其火之半照耀下方的一切。

column1: The gods of the Cosmic Court and the original Elementals were distant, all powerful, nearly too huge for people our size to worship, much less talk with or even see.
column2: 宇宙法庭的众神与原始元素神祇遥远而全能，几乎庞大到像我们这般渺小的人无法崇拜，更不用说交谈或瞻仰。

column1: So smaller but still powerful gods fit into the spaces which the early gods left open. One of these mighty gods, bright-faced Yelm, thought of himself as the best god of all. He set himself on the Spike as if it were merely the throne to his palace. For a time, Yelm's claims of perfection went unchallenged and Yelm's Fire Tribe lorded it over everyone.
column2: 于是，更渺小但同样强大的神祇填补了早期众神留下的空隙。其中一位强大的神祇，容光焕发的耶尔姆，自视为众神之首。他端坐于尖峰之上，仿佛它只是其宫殿的王座。一度，耶尔姆对完美的宣称无人质疑，耶尔姆的火部落凌驾于众生之上。

column1: Then our ancestors arrived. When I listed the original elements, you noticed that Air wasn't there, didn't you? Air wasn't there yet, but all creation had been holding its breath, waiting for our arrival. Umath blew into Yelm's would-be empire and showed the Sky gods that they weren't the only powers who soared above the Earth.
column2: 然后我们的祖先降临了。当我列举原初元素时，你注意到了吗？风不在其中。风那时还未出现，但所有造物都屏住呼吸，等待我们的到来。乌玛斯吹入耶尔姆那自封的帝国，向天空诸神证明：翱翔于大地之上的，并非只有他们。

column1: And while Yelm and his kind just hung there, motionless in the sky, the Air people flew with the power of the Storm, roaming the entire world, making friends, beating enemies, shaking up gods and places that had grown stale and stupid under Yelm's thumb.
column2: 当耶尔姆和他的同类只是悬在天空中一动不动时，风族却驾驭着暴风之力，巡游整个世界，结交朋友，击败敌人，撼动那些在耶尔姆统治下变得陈腐愚蠢的神祇与地方。

column1: Yelm was too stuck in his ways to fight back. Umath's most powerful son, Orlanth, showed Yelm that sitting on the throne of the universe wasn't any good if you couldn't fight to keep your seat. Yelm didn't just fall out of the sky, he ended up in Hell because the sword in Orlanth's hand was Death.
column2: 耶尔姆因循守旧，无力还击。乌玛斯最强大的儿子奥兰斯向耶尔姆证明：若连自己的宝座都守不住，坐在宇宙的王座上又有何用？耶尔姆不仅从天空坠落，更堕入了地狱——因为奥兰姆手中的剑，即是死亡。

column1: From there, things got crazy. The gods of the Waters invaded the Earth, and then the Water gods invaded the Air and turned it blue before Orlanth pushed them back. The Gods of Darkness came up from below and overran much of Yelm's old territory, and Orlanth had to fight them too. Orlanth won all these battles, and life was good, but then the Spike exploded from all the stress caused by these wars and the new power of Death. Chaos came into the world and reality really began to shake to pieces. Everyone had bad times in the Great Darkness. So many gods died that every soldier and army in history carries weapons made out of dead gods' bones. We nearly all died too.
column2: 从此，一切疯狂起来。水神们侵入大地，随后水神又侵入天空，将它染成蓝色，直到奥兰斯将他们击退。黑暗诸神从下方涌出，占领了耶尔姆旧日疆域的大半，奥兰斯也不得不同他们交战。奥兰斯赢下了所有战斗，日子一度太平。但随后，尖峰因战争与死亡新力量的巨大压力而爆炸。混沌涌入世界，现实开始碎裂。大黑暗时期，众生皆苦。无数神祇死去，以至历史上每个士兵和军队所持的武器，都由亡神之骨制成。我们几乎也全数灭亡。

column1: It took powerful magic to put the world together again, but Orlanth and the Lightbringers finally succeeded. We helped. But that's another story.
column2: 需要强大的魔法才能将世界重新拼合，但奥兰斯与光明使者们最终成功了。我们助了一臂之力。不过那是另一个故事了。

column1: Our world of Glorantha was created by great powers and the four Elements: Darkness, Water, Earth, and Fire. Smaller, more accessible gods like Yelm the Sun ruled Glorantha.
column2: 我们的世界格洛兰萨由伟大的力量和四大元素——黑暗、水、大地、火——创造而成。像太阳神耶尔姆这样更亲近凡间的较小神祇统治着格洛兰萨。

column1: Umath, god of Air, made a place for himself in the world, and the Air gods stirred up the stale places. Then his son Orlanth challenged Yelm and changed Glorantha forever.
column2: 风神乌玛斯为自己在世界中寻得一席之地，风神们搅动了陈腐之地。随后他的儿子奥兰斯挑战耶尔姆，永远改变了格洛兰萨。

column1: Time began over thirteen hundred years ago, when the sun first rose. Before that was the God Time.
column2: 时间始于一千三百多年前，当太阳第一次升起之时。那之前是神代。

column1: A year is made up of five seasons, and the Sacred Time. Each season consists of eight weeks, named for the rune that most influences that seven-day period. Sacred Time is two weeks.
column2: 一年由五个季节加上神圣时间组成。每个季节包含八个周期，每个周期以对那七天影响最大的符文命名。神圣时间持续两周。

column1: Sea season is first, a time of planting, new births, and gentle rains. It’s a hungry time for people, but the animals begin to fatten. This is when the ravages of the storm are repaired.
column2: 海季居首，是播种、新生与细雨时节。对人们而言这是饥馑之季，但野兽开始育肥。风暴造成的破坏在此季修复。

column1: Fire season is hot and dry. While the crops are ripening, the men are free from the toils of the soil, and can take up arms.
column2: 火季炎热干燥。作物成熟时，男人们得以免于土地劳役，可以拿起武器。

column1: Earth season is harvest time. Every able hand brings in the grain. When it’s harvested, we thank Ernalda. At the end of the season, we slaughter animals to prepare for the oncoming cold.
column2: 地季是收获时节。每一双能干的手都用来收粮入仓。收割完毕，我们感谢厄纳尔达。此季末尾，我们宰杀牲畜，为将至的寒冷做准备。

column1: Dark season is the time of snow. Night and ice demons wander the land afflicting us with freezing storms. Trolls are most active during this time, but many elves sleep.
column2: 暗之季是雪的季节。黑夜与冰魔游荡大地，以冰风暴折磨我们。巨魔在此期间最为活跃，但许多精灵陷入沉睡。

column1: Storm season is when life and darkness spirits wage battle. Sometimes the darkness spirits win and the ice and cold drags on for weeks. Sometimes the spirits of life win, with balmy weather and new shoots and buds. Usually neither is entirely victorious, and it’s a season of violent weather changes. Orlanth’s most sacred day occurs in Storm season, so it’s the best time of year to fight in his name.
column2: 风暴季是生命之灵与黑暗之灵交战的时节。有时黑暗之灵获胜，冰寒延续数周。有时生命之灵获胜，带来暖风与新芽嫩蕾。通常双方都无法完全取胜，于是成为气象剧变的季节。奥兰斯最神圣的日子在风暴季，因此这是一年中最适合以他之名作战的时节。

column1: Sacred Time is a period of rebirth during which great ceremonies are held. We cast oracles and spells to protect the land. All our religious people participate in the Lighbringers Quest and other reenactments of creation. This massive release of energy rejuvenates the cosmos. Failure to complete these acts would probably result in Chaos seeping again into the world.
column2: 神圣时间是重生的时期，举行着隆重的仪式。我们降下神谕与法术以庇护大地。所有宗教人士都参与光明使者追寻及其他创世重演。这股庞大的能量释放令宇宙恢复活力。若未能完成这些仪式，必将导致混沌再次渗入世间。

column1: As we pray for the Chalana Arroy priestess to heal the injuries and illnesses that afflict our kinfolk, it is up to us to remember what the goddess did for us in the God Time.
column2: 当我们祈祷查拉娜·阿罗伊的女祭司治愈困扰族人的伤痛与疾病时，我们必须铭记这位女神在神代为我们所做的一切。

column1: Chalana Arroy was not kin to the storm gods. She was an attendant of the Bad Emperor. When Orlanth slew the Bad Emperor, war broke out between his too-bright followers and the Storm Clan. At first, Orlanth thought that Chalana Arroy was an enemy. She healed the Bad Emperor's thanes when they were wounded. This made it harder for Orlanth to win and bring about the Storm Age. Orlanth wanted to kill her once, but then she healed part of him, something he didn't even know was hurt. We must thank her for that, as Orlanth thanked her by making her one of his attendants.
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊并非风暴诸神的亲族。她是恶皇帝的侍从。当奥兰斯弑杀恶皇帝时，皇帝那过于光明的追随者与风暴氏族之间爆发了战争。起初，奥兰斯视查拉娜·阿罗伊为敌人。她治愈了恶皇帝受伤的侍从们，这使奥兰斯更难获胜并开启风暴时代。奥兰斯一度想杀死她，但她随后治愈了他身上连他自己都未曾察觉的伤。我们必须为此感谢她，就如同奥兰斯以擢升她为侍从来答谢她一样。

column1: The Unholy Trio appeared in the world, but no one knew just how dangerous they were going to become. Orlanth's brother, Kolat, argued with them. So Malia first used her terrible gift, the scar of disease, and made Kolat unwell. Chalana Arroy struggled with Malia. She cured Kolat, so Malia went away. We must thank her for curing diseases.
column2: 不洁三神组降临世间，但无人知晓他们将变得何等危险。奥兰斯之兄科拉特与他们争辩。于是玛利亚首次动用了她那可怕的赠礼——疾病之疤——使科拉特染恙。查拉娜·阿罗伊与玛利亚搏斗。她治愈了科拉特，玛利亚便退去了。我们必须感谢她治愈疾病。

column1: The Unholy Trio got even worse, created Wakboth the Devil, and embroiled the world in war. Urox the Storm Bull decided to kill all of them, starting with his brother, Ragnaglar, who he said was the worst of the betrayers. The two of them fought at the Shrieking Falls, which is no longer part of the world. Urox wounded Ragnaglar and was ready to deliver the killing blow. But Chalana Arroy was there, and she threw herself between Urox's axe and Ragnaglar's corrupt and seething body. Urox did not kill Ragnaglar that day. We must thank her for her mercy, even when she gives it to our foes.
column2: 不洁三神组变本加厉，创造了恶魔瓦克博斯，并将世界卷入战争。风暴公牛乌罗克斯决心将他们全部杀死，首先拿他的兄弟拉格纳格拉开刀——他说拉格纳格拉是背叛者中最恶劣的一个。两人在尖叫瀑布交战，那地方如今已不复存在。乌罗克斯击伤了拉格纳格拉，正要给予致命一击。但查拉娜·阿罗伊在那里，她扑到乌罗克斯的斧刃与拉格纳格拉那腐朽沸腾的身体之间。那天乌罗克斯没有杀死拉格纳格拉。我们必须感谢她的仁慈，即使她将仁慈施予我们的敌人。

column1: The war between Orlanth and Wakboth got very bad. There was much healing for Chalana Arroy to do. Our ancestors were dying all the time, but Chalana Arroy refused to accept these deaths. Whenever possible she saved our ancestors, interrupting their journeys to the halls of the dead, bringing them back to the places where the living dwelled. This caused a quarrel with Humakt, the Death God. It came to a head just before the Lightbringers Quest, when King Heort, father of our tribal ways, was seized and pierced in a hundred places by Thed, third member of the Unholy Trio. He was dead, and Chalana Arroy was about to put him back together, when Humakt stood in her way. Chalana Arroy looked under Humakt's tongue and saw a scar there, the scar of certitude. She healed it, and then healed King Heort, who went on to keep people alive when Chalana Arroy and the other gods went to Hell to heal Yelm and the world. We thank her for giving even Humakt the ability to make an exception now and then.
column2: 奥兰斯与瓦克博斯的战事变得极其惨烈。查拉娜·阿罗伊有无数伤痛要治愈。我们的祖先不断死去，但查拉娜·阿罗伊拒绝接受这些死亡。只要可能，她就拯救我们的祖先，打断他们前往死者之厅的旅程，将他们带回生者所居之处。这引发了与死亡之神胡马克特的争执。争执在光明使者追寻前达到顶点——当时我们部落法典之父赫奥特王被不洁三神组的第三位成员塞德擒获并刺穿百处。他死了，查拉娜·阿罗伊正要将他重新拼合，胡马克特却挡在她面前。查拉娜·阿罗伊朝胡马克特舌下望去，看到那里有一道疤——确信之疤。她治愈了那道疤，然后治愈了赫奥特王。赫奥特王后来在查拉娜·阿罗伊与其他诸神前往地狱治愈耶尔姆与世界时，继续保护着人们的性命。我们感谢她，连胡马克特都因她而能偶尔破例。

column1: Now we are at the end of this healing story. I think you have listened well. If you have, the scars on our kinfolk will soon be gone.
column2: 现在我们到了这个治愈故事的结尾。我认为你听得很好。如果是这样，我们族人身上的伤疤很快就会消失。

At first, Orlanth thought that Chalana Arroy was an enemy. She healed the Bad Emperor’s thanes when they were wounded. This made it harder for Orlanth to win and bring about the Storm Age. Orlanth wanted to kill her once, but then she healed part of him, something he didn’t even know was hurt. We must thank her for that, as Orlanth thanked her by making her one of his attendants.
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊并非风暴诸神的亲族。她是恶皇帝的侍从。当奥兰斯杀死恶皇帝时，他那过于耀眼的追随者与风暴氏族之间爆发了战争。起初，奥兰斯以为查拉娜·阿罗伊是敌人。她在恶皇帝的侍从受伤时为他们治疗。这使奥兰斯更难取胜并迎来风暴时代。奥兰斯一度想杀死她，但那时她治愈了他的一部分——他自己都不知道受伤的地方。我们必须为此感谢她，正如奥兰斯通过封她为自己的侍从来感谢她一样。

So Malia first used her terrible gift, the scar of disease, and made Kolat unwell. Chalana Arroy struggled with Malia. She cured Kolat, so Malia went away. We must thank her for curing diseases.
column2: 不洁三神组出现在世界上，但没人知道它们会变得多么危险。奥兰斯的兄弟科拉特与它们争论。于是玛利亚首先使用了她的可怕天赋——疾病之疤，使科拉特生了病。查拉娜·阿罗伊与玛利亚搏斗。她治愈了科拉特，玛利亚便离开了。我们必须感谢她治愈疾病。

Urox the Storm Bull decided to kill all of them, starting with his brother, Ragnaglar, who he said was the worst of the betrayers. The two of them fought at the Shrieking Falls, which is no longer part of the world. Urox wounded Ragnaglar and was ready to deliver the killing blow. But Chalana Arroy was there, and she threw herself between Urox’s axe and Ragnaglar’s corrupt and seething body. Urox did not kill Ragnaglar that day. We must thank her for her mercy, even when she gives it to our foes.

Whenever possible she saved our ancestors, interrupting their journeys to the halls of the dead, bringing them back to the places where the living dwelled. This caused a quarrel with Humakt, the Death God. It came to a head just before the Lightbringers Quest, when King Heort, father of our tribal ways, was seized and pierced in a hundred places by Thed, third member of the Unholy Trio. He was dead, and Chalana Arroy was about to put him back together, when Humakt stood in her way. Chalana Arroy looked under Humakt’s tongue and saw a scar there, the scar of certitude. She healed it, and then healed King Heort, who went on to keep people alive when Chalana Arroy and the other gods went to Hell to heal Yelm and the world. We thank her for giving even Humakt the ability to make an exception now and then.
column2: 奥兰斯与瓦克博斯之间的战争变得非常糟糕。查拉娜·阿罗伊有很多治愈工作要做。我们的祖先不断死去，但查拉娜·阿罗伊拒绝接受这些死亡。只要可能，她就拯救我们的祖先，打断他们前往死者之厅的旅程，将他们带回生者居住的地方。这引起了与死亡之神胡马克特的争执。在光明使者追寻前夕，争执达到了顶点——我们部落习俗之父赫奥特王被不洁三神组的第三位成员塞德抓住，在身上刺穿了一百处。他死了，查拉娜·阿罗伊正要把他重新拼凑起来，胡马克特却挡在她面前。查拉娜·阿罗伊看了看胡马克特的舌头下面，看到那里有一道疤痕，即确信之疤。她治愈了那道疤痕，然后治愈了赫奥特王。后来，当查拉娜·阿罗伊和其他神前往地狱治愈耶尔姆和世界时，赫奥特王继续让人们活下去。我们感谢她甚至给了胡马克特偶尔破例的能力。

column1: Chalana Arroy summary
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊总结

column1: Chalana Arroy performs four great acts of mercy, curing Orlanth of his bloodlust, healing a disease suffered by Kolat, convincing Urox not to slay a Chaos god, and bringing King Heort back to life over the protests of the death god, Humakt.
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊施行了四大仁慈之举：治愈奥兰斯的嗜血欲，治愈科拉特所患的疾病，说服乌罗克斯不要杀死一位混沌神，以及在死亡之神胡马克特的反对下使赫奥特王复生。

column1: We have many enemies, but our worst enemy is Chaos. Chaos first came during the Godtime. It came to ruin the golden period known as the Storm Age, when Orlanth had conquered all, and everything was good. But then Chaos came, and turned virtue into evil.
column2: 我们有许多敌人，但我们最坏的敌人是混沌。混沌最初在神代到来。它来毁灭那个被称为风暴时代的黄金时期——那时奥兰斯征服了一切，万物皆善。但随后混沌降临，将美德变成了邪恶。

column1: First, the goddess Thed came and showed Orlanth that there could be too much justice. Thed had been overcome by Orlanth’s brother, Ragnaglar. She showed everyone her gaping wound, which had never healed, and demanded full recompense. Orlanth, of course, agreed, even though it brought him great shame. Thed thought of the worst thing that she could do to her enemy, and she said that she wanted to be the Goddess of Rape, so that Orlanth’s own wife and daughters would fear the same thing forever. And they did.
column2: 首先，女神塞德来了，向奥兰斯展示正义也可能过度。塞德曾被奥兰斯的兄弟拉格纳格拉征服。她向所有人展示她那从未愈合的豁口伤口，并要求全额补偿。奥兰斯当然同意了，尽管这给他带来了巨大的耻辱。塞德想到了她能对敌人做的最坏之事，她说她想成为强暴女神，这样奥兰斯自己的妻子和女儿就会永远害怕同样的事。而她们确实如此。

column1: Then, the goddess Malia came to court and showed Orlanth that there could be too much change. At first everyone ignored her, but she was so persistent that they were all afflicted anyway. The more they ignored her, the worse their affliction got until finally they were diseased. And that is what Malia is, the Goddess of Disease and Suffering.
column2: 接着，女神玛利亚来到宫廷，向奥兰斯展示变化也可能过度。起初每个人都忽视她，但她如此执着，以至于他们最终还是全都受到了折磨。他们越忽视她，折磨就越严重，直到最终他们染上疾病。而这就是玛利亚的本质——疾病与苦难女神。

column1: Finally, Orlanth’s own brother, Ragnaglar, showed him that even his sacred progenitive urges could become vices. Orlanth’s brother was so overcome with sexuality that he had no limits to what he would take as a partner, and he was so fecund that everything he mated with bore children. In this way a horrible race of monsters was born, the broos, who are like their father, and who have no sisters. And that is what Ragnaglar is, God of Evil.
column2: 最终，奥兰斯自己的兄弟拉格纳格拉向他表明，就连他神圣的繁衍冲动也会变成恶习。奥兰斯的兄弟被性欲彻底吞没，对择偶毫无限制，而且他如此多产，与他交配的一切都产下了后代。就这样，一个恐怖的怪物种族诞生了——布鲁斯，他们如同其父，并且没有姐妹。拉格纳格拉就是那样一位神，邪神。

column1: These three together became the Unholy Trio. And although they were bad, the things they brought into the world were even worse. They spawned Wakboth the Devil, who tore the Storm Age apart, and destroyed everything. To save the world from evil, Orlanth embarked on the Lightbringers Quest. He defeated Chaos and made life good again, although life was never again as good as it was during the Storm Age.
column2: 这三者一起成了不洁三神组。尽管他们本身邪恶，但他们带入世界的东西更为糟糕。他们生下了恶魔瓦克博斯，他撕裂了风暴时代，摧毁了一切。为了从邪恶中拯救世界，奥兰斯踏上了光明使者追寻。他击败了混沌，让生活重归美好，尽管生活再也无法像风暴时代那样美好。

column1: One reason the world is no longer as good is that Chaos is still around us. Some say it is even getting worse. The foul goat-men known as broos are still everywhere; some say they lurk in Dragon Pass. Wherever there is disease, there is Malia. In the darkest places of the world skulk ogres, scorpion men, vampires, walktapi, and harpies. Some misguided individuals secretly worship Chaos gods; they may steal people’s heads in the name of Thanatar, or hatch intrigues and conspiracies in the name of Krarsht. A new, red moon rose in the sky a hundred years ago; it stinks so much of Chaos that it gave our holy people headaches, at first.
column2: 世界不再那么美好的一个原因是混沌仍在我们周围。有人说它甚至变得更糟。被称为布鲁斯的污秽山羊人依然无处不在；有人说他们潜伏在龙之隘口。哪里有疾病，哪里就有玛利亚。在世界最黑暗之处潜藏着食人魔、蝎人、吸血鬼、步行者和哈比。一些误入歧途者暗中崇拜混沌众神；他们可能以萨纳塔之名偷窃人们的头颅，或以克拉什特之名策划阴谋与诡计。一百年前，一颗新的红月升上天空；它弥漫着如此浓烈的混沌气息，起初让我们神圣的人们头痛不已。

column1: To fend off disease, we might be tempted to sacrifice to Malia. To become more powerful, we might be tempted to accept the mutations that come with Chaos taint.
column2: 为了抵御疾病，我们可能会忍不住向玛利亚献祭。为了变得更强大，我们可能会忍不住接受混沌污秽带来的突变。

column1: Resist these temptations at all costs! It’s our duty to fight Chaos wherever we find it, even if it infects our own herds or our own kin. It’s up to all of us to destroy Chaos, protect our people and discharge our sacred duty as Orlanthi.
column2: 不惜一切代价抵制这些诱惑！无论在哪里发现混沌，战斗就是我们的职责，哪怕它感染了我们的牲畜或我们的亲人。摧毁混沌、保护我们的人民、履行我们身为奥兰斯民的神圣职责，是我们所有人的重任。

column1: Orlanth was not content with the way that things were. He felt he too deserved a part of the leadership of the world, but his desires were refused by Yelm. Nonetheless, he kept trying.
column2: 奥兰斯对现状并不满足。他觉得他也理应获得世界的一部分领导权，但他的愿望被耶尔姆拒绝了。尽管如此，他仍不断尝试。

column1: Orlanth would go to the Emperor and challenge him in some art or skill, trying to prove that he was worthy of command in that realm. They had many contests. Three were most important.
column2: 奥兰斯会去找皇帝，在某项技艺或技能上挑战他，试图证明自己在那领域值得统领。他们进行了许多竞赛。其中三项最为重要。

column1: First, the young Orlanth challenged Yelm to a dancing contest. Yelm performed a courtly ballet. Orlanth took along his rattle, and did a whooping war dance. The gods who judged it were so shocked by Orlanth's behavior that they awarded the prize to Yelm. Orlanth went away angry and disappointed.
column2: 首先，年轻的奥兰斯向耶尔姆挑战一场舞蹈比赛。耶尔姆表演了宫廷芭蕾。奥兰斯带着他的响板，跳起了呼号战舞。评判的众神被奥兰斯的行为震惊，将奖项判给了耶尔姆。奥兰斯愤怒而失望地离去。

column1: The next contest was one of magic. Yelm displayed all the wonder and glory of the magic of Being. Then Orlanth displayed the magic of Becoming. The gods, staid and conservative, did not like this idea and so awarded the prize to Yelm.
column2: 下一场竞赛是魔法。耶尔姆展现了存在之魔法的所有奇迹与荣耀。然后奥兰斯展示了变化之魔法。众神严肃而保守，不喜这个理念，于是将奖项判给了耶尔姆。

column1: There was also a contest of music. Orlanth made a type of instrument which had not been seen, ever. When people heard it they laughed out loud. This was part of Orlanth's plan, for there was not enough laughter among the lords of the world. But the judges did not accept Orlanth's music, even though many of their servants did.
column2: 还有一场音乐竞赛。奥兰斯制作了一种从未见过的乐器。人们听到它时放声大笑。这也是奥兰斯计划的一部分，因为世界的统治者们之间笑声太少。但评判者没有接受奥兰斯的音乐，尽管他们许多仆从接受了。

column1: In that way, Orlanth was rejected every time by the Emperor of the World.
column2: 就这样，奥兰斯每一次都被世界皇帝拒绝。

column1: Orlanth seethed and raged and roamed the world, until finally he got another chance with a new contest. This was a contest of weapons. The Emperor had never held a contest of weapons before, but he wanted to show off his great bow. Yelm took his bow and shot far-flying arrows to the edge of the world, and the judges acted as if he had already won. Orlanth then took out the Sword, called Death, which was a new weapon. With it Orlanth proved that he was superior. The judges fled in terror, leaving the field to the storm god. This ended the contests. Orlanth not only had command of weapons, he had command of the world.
column2: 奥兰斯愤怒翻腾，咆哮着漫游世界，直到他终于凭借一场新竞赛获得了另一次机会。这是一场武器竞赛。皇帝从未举办过武器竞赛，但他想炫耀他的巨弓。耶尔姆拿起弓，将远飞之箭射到世界边缘，而评判者表现得仿佛他已获胜。接着奥兰斯取出剑，名为死亡，那是一把新武器。凭借它，奥兰斯证明了自己更为优越。评判者惊恐逃窜，将场地留给了风暴之神。这结束了竞赛。奥兰斯不仅掌控了武器，也掌控了世界。

column1: First, the young Orlanth challenged Yelm to a dancing contest. Yelm performed a courtly ballet. Orlanth took along his rattle, and did a whooping war dance. The gods who judged it were so shocked by Orlanth’s behavior that they awarded the prize to Yelm. Orlanth went away angry and disappointed.
column2: 首先，年轻的奥兰斯向耶尔姆挑战一场舞蹈比赛。耶尔姆表演了宫廷芭蕾。奥兰斯带着他的响板，跳起了呼号战舞。评判的众神被奥兰斯的行为震惊，将奖项判给了耶尔姆。奥兰斯愤怒而失望地离去。

column1: There was also a contest of music. Orlanth made a type of instrument which had not been seen, ever. When people heard it they laughed out loud. This was part of Orlanth’s plan, for there was not enough laughter among the lords of the world. But the judges did not accept Orlanth’s music, even though many of their servants did.
column2: 还有一场音乐的较量。阿兰特制作了一种前所未见的乐器。人们听到它的声音时放声大笑。这正是阿兰特计划的一部分——因为世间领主们的笑声实在稀少。但评判者们没有接受阿兰特的音乐，尽管他们许多的仆从接受了。

column1: contests
column2: 竞赛

column1: Orlanth challenges Yelm the Emperor to a series of contests: one of dancing, one of magic, and one of music. Each time he is denied by the conservative old gods, even though his performances are better than Yelm's. Then the War of the Gods begins. In the final test, the test of battle, Orlanth takes the new weapon called Death and slays Yelm.
column2: 阿兰特向皇帝耶尔姆发起一系列挑战：一场舞蹈、一场魔法、一场音乐。尽管他的表现胜过耶尔姆，每一次都被守旧的古老神祇驳回。于是众神之战开启。在最后的考验，即战斗的考验中，阿兰特拿起名为“死亡”的新武器，杀死了耶尔姆。

column1: Orlanth challenges Yelm the Emperor to a series of contests: one of dancing, one of magic, and one of music. Each time he is denied by the conservative old gods, even though his performances are better than Yelm’s. Then the War of the Gods begins. In the final test, the test of battle, Orlanth takes the new weapon called Death and slays Yelm.
column2: 阿兰特向皇帝耶尔姆发起一系列挑战：一场舞蹈、一场魔法、一场音乐。尽管他的表现胜过耶尔姆，每一次都被守旧的古老神祇驳回。于是众神之战开启。在最后的考验，即战斗的考验中，阿兰特拿起名为“死亡”的新武器，杀死了耶尔姆。

column1: We Orlanthi recognize the existence of hundreds of gods, but you don't have to learn about all of them at once.
column2: 我们阿兰特族承认数百位神祇的存在，但你不必一下子全部了解。

column1: The gods everyone talks about every day are Orlanth and Ernalda. One day, every one of you boys will be initiated into the worship of Orlanth. When the girls become women, they will learn the secrets of Ernalda.
column2: 人们天天谈论的神祇是阿兰特和厄纳尔达。终有一天，你们每个男孩都将被启蒙，成为阿兰特的信徒。女孩们成为女人后，则会习得厄纳尔达的秘密。

column1: A few of you might go on to become a god-talker, or holy man, for other gods in Orlanth's clan of deities. If you do, you will gain special duties, and with them, special abilities.
column2: 你们中少数人或许能成为神言者，或圣者，侍奉阿兰特神族中的其他神祇。如果你们这样做了，就将获得特殊的职责，以及随之而来的特殊能力。

column1: The gods we worship are: Barntar the Plowman; Chalana Arroy the Healer; Elmal god of the Sun; Ernalda, Orlanth's wife and Queen of the Earth; Eurmal the Trickster; Humakt, god of War and Death; Issaries, god of Trade, Travel, and Conciliation; Lhankor Mhy, god of Lawspeaking and Knowledge; Maran Gor, goddess of Earthquakes and Destruction; Odayla, god of Hunting; Orlanth, King of the Gods, and god of Storm; Uralda the Cow Mother; Urox, also called Storm Bull, berserker Chaos-fighter; Vinga the Adventuress. Some are not important enough to build a shrine to: Gustbran the Smith; Heler, god of Rain; Minlinster the Brewer; Mralota the Pig Mother; Nevala the Sheep Mother; Yinkin, god of Alynxes.
column2: 我们崇拜的神祇包括：犁者巴恩塔；医者查拉娜·阿罗伊；太阳神埃尔马尔；阿兰特之妻、大地女王厄纳尔达；恶作者尤尔马尔；战争与死亡之神胡马克特；贸易、旅行与和解之神伊萨里斯；律法与知识之神兰科·米；地震与毁灭女神玛兰·戈尔；狩猎之神奥代拉；众神之王、风暴之神阿兰特；母牛女神乌拉尔达；乌罗克斯，又名风暴公牛，狂战士般的混沌斗士；女冒险家文加。还有一些神祇不够重要，未为其建立神龛：铁匠古斯特布兰；雨神赫勒尔；酿酒师明林斯特；猪母姆拉洛塔；羊母内瓦拉；艾林克斯猫之神因金。

column1: Many other gods appear in the myths, although we rarely if ever support them with worship. You will need to know these gods to understand our stories, although it is unlikely that their powers will enter your lives.
column2: 众多其他神祇出现在神话中，尽管我们极少甚至从不供奉他们。你需要知晓这些神祇才能理解我们的故事，尽管他们的力量不太可能介入你的生活。

column1: Aldrya, Mother of the Aldryami or elves; Arachne Solara, mystical goddess of Nature; Babeester Gor the Avenging Goddess of the Earth, Flesh Man, a mortal and one of the Lightbringers; Ginna Jar the most mysterious of the Seven Lightbringers; Glorantha, Goddess of the World, destroyed during the Gods War; Grandfather and Grandmother Mortal, first man and woman; Heort, founder of our Heortling culture; Kero Fin, goddess of great Wintertop mountain; Mahome, goddess of the Hearthfire; Mastakos, Orlanth's charioteer; Mostal, god of Dwarfs; Ty Kora Tek, goddess of the Dead; Uleria, goddess of Love; Umath, father of Orlanth; Voria, goddess of Spring; Yelm the Emperor, ruler of the Fire Tribe.
column2: 阿尔德里亚或精灵之母阿尔德里亚；自然的奥秘女神阿拉克涅·索拉拉；大地的复仇女神巴比斯特·戈尔；血肉之人，一位凡人，也是七位光明使者之一；七位光明使者中最神秘的金娜·贾尔；世界女神格洛兰萨，在神战中毁灭；凡人始祖与祖母，第一个男人和女人；我们赫厄廷文化的奠基人赫厄特；伟大的冬顶山女神凯罗·芬；炉火女神马霍梅；阿兰特的御者马斯塔科斯；矮人之神莫斯塔尔；死亡女神泰·科拉·特克；爱神乌莱里亚；阿兰特之父乌马特；春之女神沃里亚；皇帝耶尔姆，火焰部落的统治者。

column1: There are other gods that we never worship, but whose worshippers might try to enter your lives in order to do you harm. These are Orlanth's ancient enemies. You must know them in order to avoid them when you are weak, and defeat them when you are strong.
column2: 还有其他一些神祇，我们从不禁拜，但他们的信徒可能试图侵入你们的生活以加害于你们。他们是阿兰特的宿敌。你们必须了解他们，才能在弱小之时避开他们，在强大之时击败他们。

column1: Daga, god of Drought; Gagarth, god of the Wild Hunt; Gbaji the Deceiver; Malkion, god of Sorcery; Malia, Mistress of Disease; Ragnaglar, father of broos; Telmor the werewolf god; Thed, mother of broos and goddess of Rape; Valind, god of Winter; Wakboth the Devil.
column2: 干旱之神达加；狂猎之神加加斯；欺诈之神格巴吉；巫术之神马尔基翁；疾病女主人玛利亚；布鲁斯之父拉格纳格拉；狼人之神泰尔莫尔；布鲁斯之母、强暴女神塞德；寒冬之神瓦林德；恶魔瓦克博斯。

column1: dragonkill
column2: 屠龙

column1: The Dragonkill War
column2: 屠龙战争

column1: From the beginning of time, Orlanth and the dragons have been enemies. Orlanth slew the mighty dragons Aroka and Sh'hakarzeel and many of their lesser cousins. In their turn, the dragons had ever after plotted against Orlanth and humankind, who had robbed them of their ancient world.
column2: 自混沌初开之时起，阿兰特与巨龙便已是敌人。阿兰特曾杀死巨龙阿洛卡、沙卡泽尔以及它们许多低等同类。从此以后，巨龙们便始终谋划着对抗阿兰特和那些从它们手中夺走了古老世界的人类。

column1: We good Orlanthi know better than to trust dragonkind, but 800 years ago the people who lived here made the mistake of making friends with the dragonewts. The dragonewts are one of the Elder Races; they walk like men but are lizards, like the dragons. They are very unpredictable, and even though they are our neighbors here in Dragon Pass, it is stupid to try to befriend them, as this story will explain.
column2: 我们善良的奥兰西人深知不该信任龙族，但八百年前，居住在此地的人们却犯下错误，与龙人结交为友。龙人属于古老种族之一；他们如人般行走，但实为蜥蜴，一如龙类。他们极难预测，尽管他们是我们在龙之隘口的邻居，试图与之交友实属愚蠢，正如这个故事所将阐明的那样。

column1: It all started when Eurmal found a new way to betray us. He found a foolish man, and Eurmal split his tongue, the way that a bird's tongue can be split to make it talk. And Eurmal also split the man's brain, and his heart. That way the man would understand dragon speech.
column2: 一切始于欧尔马尔找到背叛我们的新法子。他找到一个愚蠢之人，撕裂了他的舌头，如同鸟舌被撕裂后能学人言那般。欧尔马尔还撕裂了那人的大脑与心脏。如此，那人便能听懂龙语。

column1: The man, Rostand the Speaker, enjoyed the effect. The dragonewts, which were always something to fear, spoke to him and he understood. He found his way to a dragon, and instead of eating him the dragon taught him a song!
column2: 此人，即说话者罗斯坦，对此效果甚为享受。那些向来令人畏惧的龙人开口与他交谈，而他竟能听懂。他寻路找到一条龙，而那条龙非但没有吃掉他，反而教会他一首歌谣！

column1: Rostand then taught his friends and family his secret. They passed the secret along to others. Soon it was not really a secret at all. It was easy to understand the dragon speech, and to learn to do new magic from them.
column2: 罗斯坦随后将他的秘密传授给朋友和家人。他们又将秘密传给其他人。很快这根本就算不上秘密了。龙语变得容易理解，也能从龙那里学到新的魔法。

column1: Orlmandan the Red, a righteous priest of Orlanth, protested this. He was unhappy that everyone was so willing to befriend the enemy of the god. The dragon lovers did not agree, and instead they stopped going to Orlanth's sacrifices. Naturally the spirits of reprisal for the god came to exact vengeance, but the dragon friends used their spells to banish the spirits. Orlmandan the Red was unlucky enough to lose his temper, and the Ring of Dragons slew him with fire.
column2: 红发奥曼丹，奥兰斯的一位正直祭司，对此提出抗议。他对所有人都如此乐意与神为敌交好感到不满。龙之爱好者并不认同，反而停止参加奥兰斯的献祭。自然，神明的复仇之灵前来讨还血债，但龙之友人们用法术驱逐了这些灵体。红发奥曼丹不幸动了怒，龙之环用火焰将他击杀。

column1: The region filled up with people from all over, who had heard of the wondrous new magics taught by the dragons. Before anyone knew what was happening, some people started to build a new nation with dragon laws and dragon thoughts. These people did not always agree, and fought among themselves. The nation of the winners became very powerful in no time at all, and was called the Empire of Wyrm's Friends.
column2: 四面八方的人听闻龙所传授的奇妙新魔法，纷纷涌入这片地区。人们还未及弄清状况，一些人就开始建立一个新的国度，奉行龙的法律与龙的思想。这些人并非总能达成一致，内部纷争不断。胜利者的国家迅速变得极为强大，被称为龙友帝国。

column1: During this time, a man named Obduran the Flyer taught people how to be a dragonfriend and an Orlanthi at the same time. This was a marvel to the people of Dragon Pass, and some of them began sacrifices to Orlanth again, although they continued sacrificing to the dragons. This custom spread anyplace that the dragon friends went. So many people followed it that Obduran the Flyer sat upon the high council of the Empire of Wyrm's Friends. The ways of the dragon thinkers spread, even though most Orlanthi priests did not like it.
column2: 在此期间，一位名叫飞行者奥布杜兰的人教导人们如何同时成为龙友和奥兰蒂。这令龙之隘口的人们惊叹不已，一些人重新开始向奥兰斯献祭，虽然他们仍继续向龙献祭。这一习俗随龙友所到之处四处传播。追随者如此之多，以至飞行者奥布杜兰坐上了龙友帝国的高议会席位。龙之思想者的方式传播开来，尽管大多数奥兰斯祭司并不喜欢。

column1: Not all Orlanthi were impotent against the power of the Empire of Wyrm's Friends. When the Empire tried to take over the Orlanthi land of Ralios they encountered great resistance. A great hero named Alakoring Dragonbreaker drove all of the traitors out of his land. The traitors came back with dragonewt allies, but Alakoring destroyed them too. Alakoring took his war to other lands infested by the Empire. His enemies woke up the Diamond Storm dragon, and sent it against Alakoring. But when the clouds of battle lifted, it was Alakoring who was alive. He has been worshipped as a dragon slayer ever since then. Even though Alakoring was finally killed by a cowardly elf, the elf took the dragonslayer's example and went on to make war against the Empire of Wyrm's Friends, too.
column2: 并非所有奥兰斯人都对龙友帝国的权势束手无策。当帝国试图吞并奥兰斯人的拉利奥斯之地时，遇到了顽强抵抗。一位名为屠龙者阿拉科林的伟大英雄将所有叛徒逐出了他的土地。叛徒们带着龙人盟友卷土重来，但阿拉科林同样将他们消灭殆尽。阿拉科林将战火蔓延至帝国肆虐的其他领地。他的敌人唤醒了钻石风暴巨龙，并令其与阿拉科林为敌。但当战云散去，活下来的是阿拉科林。自那以后，他被奉为屠龙者受人崇拜。尽管阿拉科林最终死于一个懦弱的精灵之手，那精灵却承袭了屠龙者的榜样，继续向龙友帝国宣战。

column1: The Empire of Wyrm's Friends' arrogance made other powerful enemies. The God Learners, another bad lot of people, tried to steal their magical secrets. The Dragon Empire also fought with the great empire to the north, called the Dara Happan Empire.
column2: 龙友帝国的傲慢为自己树起了其他强敌。神学者——另一群恶徒——试图窃取他们的魔法秘密。龙之帝国还与北方的伟大帝国——达拉·哈潘帝国——交战。

column1: But in the end, the Empire destroyed itself instead of falling to outside conquerors. Each generation of leaders was worse than the last. In order to gain supplies for their terrible projects, they became evil conquerors. The people had ignored Orlanth's warning to avoid all contact with dragonewts, so it took dragonewt betrayal to show that Orlanth had been right all along.
column2: 但最终，帝国并非亡于外敌，而是自毁于内。一代代统治者每况愈下，为给其骇人工程筹集物资，竟沦为邪恶的征服者。民众无视奥兰斯关于远离龙人的警告，直到龙人背叛，才证明奥兰斯始终正确。

column1: Overnight, the dragonewts betrayed the Empire and slew and ate all its leaders. Suddenly, everyone forgot how to speak the dragon tongue. Then the dragonewts slew and ate many other people. You can never predict what a dragonewt will do, because dragon thoughts are very different from rightful thoughts.
column2: 一夜之间，龙人背叛帝国，屠戮并吞噬了所有领袖。突然之间，所有人都忘记了如何说龙语。接着龙人又杀害吞噬了许多人。你永远无法预测龙人会做什么，因为龙的心思与正道思绪截然不同。

column1: People from all around decided to march into Dragon Pass and kill the dragon menace forever. From the four quarters, an army of a million people called the Invincible Golden Horde marched into Dragon Pass to kill the dragonewts.
column2: 四方之人决心进军龙之隘口，永绝龙患。从东西南北，一支号称“无敌金色大军”的百万雄师开入龙之隘口，意图剿灭龙人。

column1: Then the dragons sprang their trap, for at last they had enough people in one place to make a good meal. This incident was called the Dragonkill War, not for what happened to the dragons, but for what the dragons did. The sun was blocked out with their wings as they swooped down and consumed the best of manhood from all across the continent. They ate so much that they have been sleeping it off ever since.
column2: 巨龙们终于布下了陷阱，因为它们总算把足够多的人聚集到了一处，能好好吃上一顿了。这一事件被称为屠龙战争，不是因为龙族遭遇了什么，而是因为龙族做了什么。它们俯冲而下，翅膀遮天蔽日，吞食了来自整片大陆最优秀的人类。它们吃得太多，从那以后一直沉睡消化。

column1: That happened a little over two hundred years ago. For most of that time, people have been too afraid to go back to Dragon Pass. Do not think that the dragons are all gone because you cannot see them: not all of the mountains around us are ordinary rock, some of the mountains are vast, sleeping dragons! They are too powerful for anyone but a god or hero to fight. Even the sleeping dragons' dreams are dangerous. We would be fools if we were not worried about the dragons rising again. But we are Orlanthi, and we will not fall for their tricks again. Next time, we will listen to our priests.
column2: 那件事发生在两百多年前。在之后的大部分时间里，人们都恐惧万分，不敢返回龙之隘口。别因为你看不见龙，就以为它们全都消失了：我们周围的山脉并非全是普通岩石，有些山脉就是沉睡的巨龙！它们太强大了，除了神明或英雄，无人能敌。就连沉睡巨龙的梦境也十分危险。我们要是不担心巨龙再次苏醒，那便是愚人。但我们奥兰斯人不会再次落入它们的诡计。下一次，我们会听从祭司的话。

column1: From the beginning of time, Orlanth and the dragons have been enemies. Orlanth slew the mighty dragons Aroka and Sh’hakarzeel and many of their lesser cousins. In their turn, the dragons had ever after plotted against Orlanth and humankind, who had robbed them of their ancient world.
column2: 自时间开端起，奥兰斯与巨龙便是仇敌。奥兰斯斩杀了强大的巨龙阿罗卡与沙哈卡泽尔，以及它们许多弱小的近亲。而作为回报，巨龙从此一直在密谋对抗奥兰斯与人类，因为人类夺走了它们的古老世界。

column1: It all started when Eurmal found a new way to betray us. He found a foolish man, and Eurmal split his tongue, the way that a bird’s tongue can be split to make it talk. And Eurmal also split the man’s brain, and his heart. That way the man would understand dragon speech.
column2: 一切始于尤尔马尔找到了背叛我们的新方法。他找到一个愚蠢的人，劈开了他的舌头——就像劈开鸟舌能让它说话那样。尤尔马尔还劈开了那人的大脑与心脏。这样，那人就能理解龙语了。

column1: Orlmandan the Red, a righteous priest of Orlanth, protested this. He was unhappy that everyone was so willing to befriend the enemy of the god. The dragon lovers did not agree, and instead they stopped going to Orlanth’s sacrifices. Naturally the spirits of reprisal for the god came to exact vengeance, but the dragon friends used their spells to banish the spirits. Orlmandan the Red was unlucky enough to lose his temper, and the Ring of Dragons slew him with fire.
column2: 红发奥曼丹，一位奥兰斯的正义祭司，对此提出抗议。他对众人如此乐意与神明的敌人交好感到不满。龙友并不认同，反而不再参加奥兰斯的献祭。自然，神明的复仇之灵前来索取报复，但龙友用他们的咒语驱逐了这些灵体。红发奥曼丹不幸动了怒气，龙之环便用火焰将他击杀。

column1: The region filled up with people from all over, who had heard of the wondrous new magics taught by the dragons. Before anyone knew what was happening, some people started to build a new nation with dragon laws and dragon thoughts. These people did not always agree, and fought among themselves. The nation of the winners became very powerful in no time at all, and was called the Empire of Wyrm’s Friends.
column2: 这片地区涌满了来自各地的人，他们听说了巨龙传授的奇妙新魔法。在任何人意识到发生了什么之前，有些人已经开始按照龙的法律和龙的思想建立新国度。这些人并不总是一致，彼此间争斗不休。胜利者的国度迅速变得极其强大，被称为龙之友帝国。

column1: During this time, a man named Obduran the Flyer taught people how to be a dragonfriend and an Orlanthi at the same time. This was a marvel to the people of Dragon Pass, and some of them began sacrifices to Orlanth again, although they continued sacrificing to the dragons. This custom spread anyplace that the dragon friends went. So many people followed it that Obduran the Flyer sat upon the high council of the Empire of Wyrm’s Friends. The ways of the dragon thinkers spread, even though most Orlanthi priests did not like it.
column2: 在此期间，一个名叫飞行者奥布杜兰的人教人们如何同时成为龙友和奥兰斯信徒。这在龙之隘口的人们眼中是个奇迹，有些人重新开始向奥兰斯献祭，尽管他们继续向巨龙献祭。这一习俗随着龙友所到之处传播开来。信奉者如此之多，以至于飞行者奥布杜兰坐上了龙之友帝国的高议会席位。龙之思潮的方式传播开来，尽管大多数奥兰斯祭司并不喜欢。

column1: Not all Orlanthi were impotent against the power of the Empire of Wyrm’s Friends. When the Empire tried to take over the Orlanthi land of Ralios they encountered great resistance. A great hero named Alakoring Dragonbreaker drove all of the traitors out of his land. The traitors came back with dragonewt allies, but Alakoring destroyed them too. Alakoring took his war to other lands infested by the Empire. His enemies woke up the Diamond Storm dragon, and sent it against Alakoring. But when the clouds of battle lifted, it was Alakoring who was alive. He has been worshipped as a dragon slayer ever since then. Even though Alakoring was finally killed by a cowardly elf, the elf took the dragonslayer’s example and went on to make war against the Empire of Wyrm’s Friends, too.
column2: 并非所有奥兰斯人都对龙之友帝国的力量无能为力。当帝国试图占领奥兰斯人的土地拉利奥斯时，遭遇了强烈抵抗。一位名叫屠龙者阿拉科林的伟大英雄将所有叛徒赶出了他的土地。叛徒们带着龙人盟友回来，但阿拉科林也摧毁了他们。阿拉科林将战争带入帝国盘踞的其他土地。他的敌人唤醒了钻石风暴巨龙，派它去对付阿拉科林。但当战云散去时，活着的却是阿拉科林。此后，他便被当作屠龙者受到崇拜。尽管阿拉科林最终被一个懦弱的精灵杀死，但那个精灵以屠龙者为榜样，继续对龙之友帝国开战。

column1: The Empire of Wyrm’s Friends’ arrogance made other powerful enemies. The God Learners, another bad lot of people, tried to steal their magical secrets. The Dragon Empire also fought with the great empire to the north, called the Dara Happan Empire.
column2: 龙之友帝国的傲慢为自己树敌众多。另一伙坏人——神学者——试图窃取他们的魔法秘密。龙之帝国还与北方的强大帝国——达拉·哈潘帝国——交战。

column1: But in the end, the Empire destroyed itself instead of falling to outside conquerors. Each generation of leaders was worse than the last. In order to gain supplies for their terrible projects, they became evil conquerors. The people had ignored Orlanth’s warning to avoid all contact with dragonewts, so it took dragonewt betrayal to show that Orlanth had been right all along.
column2: 但最终，帝国并非亡于外敌之手，而是自我毁灭。一代代的领袖一代不如一代。为了给他们的可怕工程获取供给，他们变成了邪恶的征服者。人们无视奥兰斯的警告，避免与龙人接触，因此正是龙人的背叛证明了奥兰斯一直都是对的。

column1: That happened a little over two hundred years ago. For most of that time, people have been too afraid to go back to Dragon Pass. Do not think that the dragons are all gone because you cannot see them: not all of the mountains around us are ordinary rock, some of the mountains are vast, sleeping dragons! They are too powerful for anyone but a god or hero to fight. Even the sleeping dragons’ dreams are dangerous. We would be fools if we were not worried about the dragons rising again. But we are Orlanthi, and we will not fall for their tricks again. Next time, we will listen to our priests.
column2: 那件事发生在两百多年前。之后的大部分时间里，人们都恐惧得不敢返回龙隘。别以为你看不见龙就以为它们都消失了：我们周围的群山并非全是普通岩石，有些山岳就是沉睡的巨龙！它们强大到只有神祇或英雄才能与之对抗。就连沉睡之龙的梦境都充满危险。如果我们不担心巨龙再度苏醒，那我们就是傻瓜。但我们是奥兰斯人，不会再上它们的当了。下一次，我们会听从祭司的话。

column2: 八百年前，人类与龙族摒弃了古老的敌意，联合建立了龙友帝国。人们割开舌头，以便能说龙语，并学习他们奇异的魔法。

column1: The Empire had powerful enemies, but it fell from its own corruption. The dragonewts ate its evil leaders, and everyone forgot how to speak the dragon language.
column2: 帝国曾有强大的敌人，但它因自身的腐化而崩溃。龙人吃掉了邪恶的领袖，所有人都忘记了如何说龙语。

column1: People from all around decided to march into Dragon Pass and kill the dragon menace forever.
column2: 四面八方的人们决定进军龙隘，永远消灭龙的威胁。

column1: But the dragons were simply waiting to have enough people in one place to make a good meal, and they shook the mountains off their backs and rose up and ate a million-strong army.
column2: 但巨龙只是等着有足够多的人聚在一处，好大吃一顿。它们抖落背上的山峦，起身而起，吃掉了一支百万大军。

column1: For two hundred years, nobody dared return to Dragon Pass.
column2: 两百年来，无人敢返回龙隘。

column2: 早期定居点

column1: Our new home is here, in the southeast corner of Dragon Pass. Our land, between Beast Valley and the plains of Prax, is a rugged region filled with rounded hills and deep, twisting valleys. At its center rise the steep Quivin Mountains. We are Orlanthi, and we are here to make new, free lives for ourselves.
column2: 我们的新家在这里，龙隘的东南角。我们的土地位于野兽谷和普拉克斯平原之间，是一片崎岖的地区，遍布圆丘和幽深蜿蜒的山谷。中心耸立着陡峭的奎文山脉。我们是奥兰斯人，我们要在这里为自己创造新的自由生活。

column1: All but the youngest among our clan still remember Heortland, our old home, a rich land to the south of Dragon Pass. Heortland is part of a nation once called Kethaela. Kethaela's new master, the Pharaoh, now calls it the "Holy Country."
column2: 我们氏族中除了最年幼者，都还记得我们的旧家园赫奥特兰，那是龙隘以南的一片富饶之地。赫奥特兰曾是名为凯瑟拉的国家的一部分。凯瑟拉的新主人法老如今称其为“神圣国度”。

column1: Although Dragon Pass is still a frontier, a few other Heortlanders arrived here before us. The earliest settlers arrived two generations ago. This is the story of how they came here, and why.
column2: 尽管龙隘仍是一片边疆之地，但有少数其他赫奥特兰人比我们先到这里。最早的定居者是在两代人之前抵达的。这就是他们如何来到这里、以及为何而来的故事。

column1: In the wake of the Dragonkill, Dragon Pass was a virgin land. No humans lived here, only the Elder Races. The Dragons, darker than shadow, had swept all human life from the land. They decreed that it would be restored to its original purity, and that no humans born of living flesh would survive if they came north of Centaur Cross. So for two centuries the land lay wild. Everyone was afraid to come here because of the dragons' decree.
column2: 龙杀之后，龙隘成为一片处女地。没有人类居住，只有古老种族。比阴影更暗的巨龙将这片土地上的人类生命全部扫除。它们下旨：这片土地将恢复原本的纯净，任何血肉之躯的人类若敢越过半人马十字以北，都将无法存活。于是两个世纪以来，这片土地荒芜不羁。所有人都因龙的谕令而不敢前来。

column1: One hundred and twenty years after the Dragonkill, a terrible thing happened. A new, red moon rose in the sky. Our chiefs and priests could tell that the red moon was a thing of Chaos, and that Orlanth had been wounded. A priest had a vision, and said: "The god's wound can be healed by a healer from the cleansed land where no men now live. When monsters are slain, and mountains are made, and rivers change course, is the time to plant the vine."
column2: 龙杀一百二十年之后，一件可怕的事情发生了。一轮新的红月升上天空。我们的首领和祭司都能看出，红月是混沌之物，奥兰斯也因此受伤。一位祭司得见异象，说道：“神祇的伤口，要靠来自那洁净之地（如今无人居住）的医者来治愈。当怪物被屠、山峦成形、河流改道之时，便是种植葡萄藤的时机。”

column1: Many took this prophecy to mean that Dragon Pass could safely be resettled. But it took another fifty years before any dared come here. The first were members of a clan later called the Colymar. At the border, at the place called Centaur Cross, Chief Colymar and his wife, Hareva, led a prayer. Then the two of them, hand in hand, stepped across the invisible boundary, followed by their household. The rest of the clan, seeing no ill effects, followed. They were unharmed, and so Colymar triumphantly led the people northward. When they walked in the river valleys, they followed the directions of his wife. When they went over hills, they followed his hawk.
column2: 许多人认为这个预言意味着龙隘可以安全地重新定居。但又过了五十年，才有人敢前来。第一批人是一个后来被称为科利马尔氏族的成员。在边界，一个叫半人马十字的地方，酋长科利马尔和他的妻子哈雷瓦带领祈祷。然后他们两人手牵手跨过无形的边界，他们的家人紧随其后。氏族其余人见没有不良后果，便跟了上去。他们毫发无损，于是科利马尔胜利地带领人民向北进发。当他们走在河谷时，他们遵循他妻子的指引。当他们翻越山丘时，则跟随他的猎鹰。

column1: In one place, the goddess Ernalda gave her priestess Hareva a unique type of winter-grown grapes. The wine made from these grapes was a very pale yellow, and always cool to taste. So Colymar and Hareva called that place Clearwine, and made it their home. There they hunted and built houses to face the coming winter. They survived, and after some difficulties settled a town and several hamlets, and grew strong and stable. Colymar founded a new clan in his own name.
column2: 在一处地方，女神厄娜达赐予她的女祭司哈雷瓦一种独特的冬季葡萄。用这种葡萄酿制的酒呈极淡的黄色，口感总是清凉。于是科利马尔和哈雷瓦称那个地方为清酒镇，并安家于此。他们在那里狩猎、建造房屋以迎接即将到来的冬天。他们活了下来，克服了一些困难后，建立了一个小镇和几个村落，变得强大而稳固。科利马尔以他自己的名字创立了一个新氏族。

column1: The Colymar tried to keep their new settlement a secret, but word leaked back to Heortland anyway. By that time, the entire nation of Kethaela was embroiled in a civil war. The war was caused by the usurper called the Pharaoh. Tribes who fought the Pharaoh lost, and came to Dragon Pass as refugees.
column2: 科利马尔人试图对新定居点保密，但消息还是泄露回了赫奥特兰。那时，整个凯瑟拉国都卷入了一场内战。内战是由一个被称为法老的篡位者引起的。与法老作战的部落战败后，作为难民逃到了龙隘。

column1: The refugees came into Dragon Pass about twenty years after the Colymar. These clans were generally small, often no more than a single ragged bloodline seeking any refuge, fast. Others were disgruntled half-clans, who had sometimes left their ancestral homes without official sanction. Some departed without even the ceremonial forging of a new clan ring. Some were gangs of desperadoes, murderers, and freebooters. The refugees worshipped Orlanth and lived in towns, herded and hunted, and fought. When they settled they often took long-abandoned hill forts, as was their custom in Heortland. The tribes which moved north were collectively called the Quivini, after the Quivin peaks in the region.
column2: 难民们是在科利马尔部落之后大约二十年来到龙隘的。这些氏族通常很小，往往不过是一支衣衫褴褛的血脉，急于寻求任何庇护。另一些则是心存不满的半氏族，他们有时未经官方许可就离开了祖先的家园。有的甚至没有举行锻造新氏族环的仪式便离开了。还有些是亡命徒、杀人犯和海盗团伙。难民们崇拜奥兰斯，住在城镇里，放牧、狩猎，也战斗。他们定居时，常常占据久已废弃的山丘堡垒，正如他们在赫尔特兰的习俗那样。向北迁徙的部落被统称为基维尼人，以该地区内的基维尼山峰命名。

column1: Some of these raiders burned the settlement of Clearwine not long after they arrived. Chief Colymar called his clan together, and together they entered and cleared out the ancient hill fort which loomed over the valley. Soon they were calling the fort Clearwine. When Colymar died, his advisors decided to make the Colymar clan into the Colymar tribe. Their numbers grew as they accepted clans of refugees into their midst.
column2: 这些掠袭者中的一部分在抵达后不久就烧毁了清酒镇定居点。科利马尔酋长召集了他的氏族，他们一起进入并清理了俯瞰山谷的古老山丘堡垒。很快他们就把堡垒称为清酒镇。科利马尔去世后，他的顾问们决定将科利马尔氏族扩展为科利马尔部落。随着他们接纳难民氏族加入，他们的人数不断增长。

column1: Another ten years or so has passed since the first wave of refugees. Life goes on. The Colymar tribe and the various Quivini clans are still here. Cows are herded, crops are raised. Babies cry, children laugh, and adults sing and drink. Sometimes tribes fight one another. Sometimes clans raid other clans within their own tribe. Sometimes blood is spilled, but that is the way of things.
column2: 自第一波难民以来，又过了十年左右。生活仍在继续。科利马尔部落和各个基维尼氏族依然在此。牛只被放牧，作物被种植。婴儿啼哭，孩童欢笑，成人歌唱饮酒。有时部落之间互相争斗。有时氏族在自己部落内劫掠其他氏族。有时鲜血流淌，但世事如此。

column1: We are part of a new wave of immigrant clans. We are much better organized than the first rag-tag bands of refugees. We have blessings and information, and honor the ancient laws of King Heort. We know we might have to fight for territory. We know this dragon-haunted land still holds many perils. But we are ready. We are determined to make a home here.
column2: 我们是新一波移民氏族的一部分。我们比第一批衣衫褴褛的难民队伍组织得要好得多。我们有祝福和情报，并且尊崇赫尔特王的古老律法。我们知道可能要为领土而战。我们知道这片龙影笼罩的土地仍然充满许多危险。但我们准备好了。我们决心在这里安家。

column1: All but the youngest among our clan still remember Heortland, our old home, a rich land to the south of Dragon Pass. Heortland is part of a nation once called Kethaela. Kethaela’s new master, the Pharaoh, now calls it the “Holy Country.”
column2: 我们氏族中除了最年轻的成员，都还记得赫尔特兰，我们的旧家园，龙隘南边一片富饶的土地。赫尔特兰曾经是一个叫凯瑟拉的国度的一部分。凯瑟拉的新主人，法老，现在称它为“神圣国度”。

column1: In the wake of the Dragonkill, Dragon Pass was a virgin land. No humans lived here, only the Elder Races. The Dragons, darker than shadow, had swept all human life from the land. They decreed that it would be restored to its original purity, and that no humans born of living flesh would survive if they came north of Centaur Cross. So for two centuries the land lay wild. Everyone was afraid to come here because of the dragons’ decree.
column2: 龙杀事件之后，龙隘是一片处女地。没有人类居住在此，只有古老种族。比影子更暗的龙族扫清了这片土地上所有的人类生命。他们颁布法令，要将其恢复为原始的纯净，任何血肉所生的人类若胆敢来到半人马十字以北，都无法存活。因此两个世纪以来，这片土地一直荒芜。因为龙族的法令，人人都害怕来这里。

column1: One hundred and twenty years after the Dragonkill, a terrible thing happened. A new, red moon rose in the sky. Our chiefs and priests could tell that the red moon was a thing of Chaos, and that Orlanth had been wounded. A priest had a vision, and said: “The god’s wound can be healed by a healer from the cleansed land where no men now live. When monsters are slain, and mountains are made, and rivers change course, is the time to plant the vine.”
column2: 龙杀事件一百二十年后，一件可怕的事情发生了。一轮新的红月升上天空。我们的酋长和祭司们能够看出红月是混沌之物，而奥兰斯已经受伤。一位祭司得到异象，说道：“神明的伤口可由来自那片已净化、如今无人居住之地的治愈者医治。当怪物被屠戮，山脉被造就，河流改变河道之时，便是种植葡萄藤之时。”

column1: Colymar and his clan were the first humans to dare to return to Dragon Pass after the Dragonkill. A generation later, the clans of Heortland were embroiled in civil war against the Pharaoh. Those who fought the Pharaoh lost, and many of them came to Dragon Pass as refugees. Most of them settled near the Quivin peaks and became known as the Quivini.
column2: 科利马尔和他的氏族是龙杀事件后首批敢于返回龙隘的人类。一代人之后，赫尔特兰的氏族卷入了与法老的内战。那些与法老作战的人失败了，其中许多人作为难民来到了龙隘。他们大多定居在基维尼山峰附近，逐渐被称为基维尼人。

column1: During the Great Darkness, things got so bad that only a desperate quest on Orlanth's part could knit the shattered world back together again. He chose many companions to go on this quest, but did not choose Elmal. Elmal, who had proven his loyalty to Orlanth again and again, was distressed by this choice, and said to Orlanth, "Why do you punish me in this way? Ever since you rescued me from the tribe of the Evil Emperor, I have served you loyally, fighting always by your side. What have I done to lose your trust?"
column2: 在大黑暗时期，情况变得如此糟糕，只有奥兰斯发起的绝望寻求才能将破碎的世界重新缝合起来。他挑选了许多同伴踏上这次寻求，但没有选择埃尔马尔。埃尔马尔曾一次又一次证明自己对奥兰斯的忠诚，他对这个选择感到痛苦，对奥兰斯说：“你为什么这样惩罚我？自从你从邪恶皇帝的部落中拯救我以来，我一直忠诚地侍奉你，始终在你身边战斗。我做了什么让你失去了信任？”

column1: Orlanth said, "I do not neglect you, Bright Friend. It is to you I entrust the greatest task of all, which is the protection of my people when I am away on this dangerous quest." The two gods traded shields, to make a bond of love and allegiance between them.
column2: 奥兰斯说：“我没有忽视你，光明之友。我把最伟大的任务托付给你，那就是在我踏上这次危险寻求时保护我的人民。”两位神祇交换了盾牌，在他们之间缔结了爱与忠诚的纽带。

column1: So Orlanth left on this great quest, and Elmal remained to protect the stead against the forces of Chaos. Many Chaos foes came, and Elmal interposed himself between them and Orlanth's stead.
column2: 于是奥兰斯出发进行这项伟大寻求，而埃尔马尔留下保护庄园抵御混沌势力。许多混沌敌人来了，埃尔马尔挡在他们和奥兰斯的庄园之间。

column1: The Eater of Skin came singing the Rending Song, the one that made people bleed. Elmal leapt from his position in front of the stead and drove his spear into the creature's eye. The Eater of Skin threw its seven terrible mouths at Elmal, and he stopped every one of them with the shield Orlanth had lent to him. The Eater of Skin tried to stamp on Elmal with its five crushing feet, each of them the size of a stead. Elmal evaded the first four feet, and deliberately withstood the last. Then he seized the Eater of Skin and hurled it into the sky, where it was burnt up, and never seen again.
column2: 食皮者唱着撕裂之歌而来，那歌声让人流血。埃尔玛从农庄前的阵位跃起，将长矛刺入那怪物的眼睛。食皮者将其七张可怕的大口投向埃尔玛，他用奥兰斯借给他的盾牌一一挡下。食皮者试图用它五只碾碎一切的脚踩踏埃尔玛，每只脚都有农庄那么大。埃尔玛规避了前四只脚，然后故意承受了最后一只。接着他抓住食皮者，将其掷向天空，在那里它被烧尽，从此再未出现。

column1: Only after he had defeated the creature did the people see that the fight had broken Elmal into pieces. They despaired, wailing "Our defender is gone!" Yet when the morning came, Elmal knitted himself back together and shone again, for he had been steadfast.
column2: 直到他击败那怪物之后，人们才发现战斗已将埃尔玛撕成碎片。他们绝望地哀嚎：“我们的守护者没了！”然而当清晨来临，埃尔玛将自己重新拼合，再次闪耀光芒，因为他一直都是坚定的。

column1: The Author of Sores came, and Elmal destroyed her, too, in a battle that was even more ferocious than the last. Again Elmal, despite his victory, was torn into bits. Again, when the morning came, Elmal became whole again, for he had been steadfast.
column2: 疮痍之主来了，埃尔玛也在一次比之前更凶猛的战斗中摧毁了她。尽管赢了，埃尔玛再次被撕成碎片。当清晨再次来临，埃尔玛重新变得完整，因为他一直都是坚定的。

column1: Finally, the Maker of Bad Growth came, and tried to slay Elmal by causing the soft parts inside him to multiply like maggots, so that they would burst him open like a too-full sausage. But Elmal was steadfast, and in the morning his brightness burned all of these extra pieces away, and burned the Maker of Bad Growth, too.
column2: 最后，恶性生长制造者来了，试图通过让埃尔玛体内的柔软部分像蛆虫一样繁殖来杀死他，使得他像塞得过满的香肠一样爆开。但埃尔玛是坚定的，清晨到来时他的光芒烧掉了所有多余的部分，也烧死了恶性生长制造者。

column1: These defeats only increased the hunger of the Chaos Gods, who wanted all the more to destroy Orlanth's stead. In this way, Elmal drew attention away from other steads of the Vingkotling people, and thus indirectly protected the other steads, too. The forces of Chaos decided that it was folly to try to destroy Elmal's physical form, for his brightness remade him every morning. Instead, they would strike at his brightness, and destroy the loyalty that fueled it.
column2: 这些失败只增加了混沌众神的饥饿，他们更想摧毁奥兰斯的农庄。通过这种方式，埃尔玛吸引了注意力，远离了文戈特林人的其他农庄，从而也间接保护了其他农庄。混沌势力决定试图摧毁埃尔玛的物理形态是愚蠢的，因为他的光芒每天早上都会重塑他。相反，他们将攻击他的光芒，摧毁那个驱动光芒的忠诚。

column1: To perform this terrible task, the Chaos Gods chose The Teller of Lies, also called The Bad Questioner, also called the Breaker of Souls. This being had a thousand forms; most were horrible, but some were beautiful. When it was beautiful, it was at its most dangerous.
column2: 为了执行这项可怕的任务，混沌众神选中了谎言讲述者，他也被称为坏提问者，也被称为灵魂破坏者。这存在有一千种形态；大多数是可怕的，但有些是美丽的。当它美丽时，就是它最危险的时候。

column1: The Teller of Lies came to Orlanth's stead disguised as a woman Elmal had loved back when he belonged to the Emperor's tribe. "Elmal, Elmal," it said, "you once loved me. Come with me, for I have made a safe place for the two of us. Leave these barbarians, and we will hide away until the darkness ends."
column2: 谎言讲述者伪装成一个女人来到奥兰斯的农庄，那是埃尔玛还属于皇帝部落时所爱过的女人。“埃尔玛，埃尔玛，”它说，“你曾爱过我。跟我走吧，因为我为咱俩准备了一个安全的地方。离开这些野蛮人，我们会躲藏起来，直到黑暗结束。”

column1: Elmal was not unaffected by this plea. His tears fell on the earth, and where they fell, they burned the dry grass. The occupants of Orlanth's stead had to put out the fires before they spread. They worried that Elmal would abandon them. But then Elmal said to the Teller of Lies: "You are not the woman I loved. I married into this tribe, and love my wife only. I am loyal to her, and would never break Orlanth's laws of fidelity, no matter what sort of temptation you offer. Begone." In frustration, the Teller of Lies departed.
column2: 埃尔玛并非不为这一恳求所动。他的眼泪落在地上，落处烧焦了干草。奥兰斯农庄的居民不得不在火势蔓延前将其扑灭。他们担心埃尔玛会抛弃他们。但随后埃尔玛对谎言讲述者说：“你并非我所爱的女人。我嫁入了这个部落，只爱我的妻子。我对她忠诚，无论你提供何种诱惑，我绝不会违反奥兰斯的忠诚法则。滚开。”谎言讲述者沮丧地离去了。

column1: The next day, the Teller of Lies returned, disguised as a blind oracle known to the Storm Tribe. "Elmal, Elmal," it wailed, "your master, Orlanth, is as good as slain, defeated in the land of the dead." And it showed Elmal an image of his king, trapped in a pit and unable to escape. "You must take Orlanth's place as King of the Storm Tribe," the Teller of Lies told him, "for Orlanth's day is done. Without a king, your beloved tribe will wither and die." Some of Orlanth's people believed the false oracle, and flocked to Elmal's side, offering him a crown.
column2: 第二天，谎言讲述者回来了，伪装成风暴部落一位有名的盲眼先知。“埃尔玛，埃尔玛，”它哭喊道，“你的主人奥兰斯已如同被杀死，在死者之地战败了。”它向埃尔玛展示了一幅景象：他的国王被困在一个坑里，无法逃脱。“你必须取代奥兰斯成为风暴部落的国王，”谎言讲述者告诉他，“因为奥兰斯的时代结束了。没有国王，你心爱的部落将会枯萎死亡。”一些奥兰斯的人民相信了这假先知，聚集到埃尔玛身边，献给他一顶王冠。

column1: Elmal was not unaffected by this show of devotion. He smiled, and his smile blinded some of the people. When he saw the bad effect of this too-great radiance, he said, "This oracle is false. I would not be loyal to Orlanth if I believed him so easily defeated. If some of you wish to call me a king, I will lead you. But this does not mean that I take Orlanth's place, for Orlanth will always be my king." Again the Teller of Lies had to slink away, its powers vanquished in the face of Elmal's great steadfastness.
column2: 埃尔玛并非不为这种忠诚的表示所动。他笑了，他的笑容使一些人失明。当他看到这过于强烈的光辉带来的不良后果时，他说：“这位先知是假的。如果我相信他这么容易被击败，我就不忠于奥兰斯了。如果你们中有人想称我为王，我会领导你们。但这并不意味着我取代奥兰斯的位置，因为奥兰斯永远是我的国王。”谎言讲述者再次不得不溜走，它的力量在埃尔玛的巨大坚定面前被击败了。

column1: When the Teller of Lies next returned, this time in the form of the Emperor Elmal had once served, Elmal did not let it speak. "Lie-Teller, Lie-Teller," he said, "your dread onslaught is too much for me. You have sapped my strength, and I know when I am beaten. I have taken my soul and put it into this fine stallion." Elmal produced a great steed, for he is also Elmal Horse-Friend. "This is my offer to you, and I will leave the Storm Tribe and serve Chaos, just as I once left the Bright Tribe to serve Orlanth."
column2: 当谎言讲述者再次归来时，这次它化作了埃尔马尔曾侍奉过的那个皇帝的模样，但埃尔马尔没有让它开口。“谎言讲述者，谎言讲述者，”他说，“你那可怕的猛攻我承受不住。你已耗尽了我的力量，我知自己已然落败。我已取出我的灵魂，将其放入这匹骏马之中。”埃尔马尔召出一匹骏马，因为他亦是“骏马之友”埃尔马尔。“这便是我的提议：我将离开风暴部落，转投混沌，正如我当初离开光明部落，投奔奥兰斯一样。”

column1: The Teller of Lies slavered in hunger, and leapt upon the great steed, devouring it whole. But Elmal had tricked it; the horse was not his soul, but was also Elmal in his bright entirety. Now Elmal was inside the Teller of Lies, and could see that inside the Chaos servant was Nothing. Its ever-shifting forms masked only emptiness. Armed with this knowledge, Elmal tore it apart from the inside, using the sharpened edges of the shield Orlanth had given him. And the Teller of Lies, revealed as Nothing, was destroyed.
column2: 谎言讲述者涎水直流，饥不可耐，扑向那匹骏马，整个儿吞了下去。但埃尔马尔骗了它：那马并非他的灵魂，而是埃尔马尔光芒璀璨的完整本身。如今埃尔马尔置身于谎言讲述者体内，看见那混沌仆从的内部竟是虚无。它那不断变幻的形态不过遮掩着空虚。凭此认知，埃尔马尔用奥兰斯赐予他的盾牌的锋利边缘，从内部将其撕碎。于是，谎言讲述者——被揭示为虚无——就此被摧毁。

column1: From that day until the end of the Darkness, the Chaos Gods left Orlanth's stead alone.
column2: 从那天直至大黑暗终结，混沌众神再未侵扰奥兰斯的农庄。

column1: When the Darkness ended, Elmal helped the others to awaken Orlanth, and then Ernalda, and then the other gods who had either been slain or had journeyed with Orlanth into the land of the dead. Orlanth asked Elmal to tell of his exploits while he was gone, and Elmal told him what he had done. Then Elmal asked Orlanth to tell him of his exploits in the land of the dead, and Orlanth told him. In this way, they exchanged great secrets of the world, just as they had exchanged shields before they parted, and thus the Storm Tribe, and the world, was made stronger.
column2: 当大黑暗结束时，埃尔马尔帮助众人唤醒了奥兰斯，然后是厄纳尔达，接着是其他那些或被杀死、或随奥兰斯前往死者之地的神祇。奥兰斯请埃尔马尔讲述他离开期间的事迹，埃尔马尔便告诉了他自己的所作所为。然后埃尔马尔请奥兰斯讲述他在死者之地的功业，奥兰斯也告诉了他。就这样，他们交换了世间的大秘密，正如他们分别前交换了盾牌一般。于是，风暴部落——乃至整个世界——都变得更为强大。

column2: 埃尔玛并非未被这番忠诚示现所动。他微微一笑，微笑之光令一些子民目盲。当他看到这过于强烈的光芒带来的恶果时，他说：“这位先知是假的。若我如此轻易相信奥兰斯被打败，我便不忠于他。若你们中有人愿称我为王，我会领导你们。但这并不意味着我取代奥兰斯的位置，因为奥兰斯永远是我的王。”谎言讲述者又一次不得不溜走，它的力量在埃尔玛无比坚定的面前被击溃。

column1: When the Teller of Lies next returned, this time in the form of the Emperor Elmal had once served, Elmal did not let it speak. “Lie-Teller, Lie-Teller,” he said, “your dread onslaught is too much for me. You have sapped my strength, and I know when I am beaten. I have taken my soul and put it into this fine stallion.” Elmal produced a great steed, for he is also Elmal Horse-Friend. “This is my offer to you, and I will leave the Storm Tribe and serve Chaos, just as I once left the Bright Tribe to serve Orlanth.”
column2: 当谎言讲述者再次归来时，这次化作埃尔玛曾经侍奉的皇帝之形，但埃尔玛没让它开口。“谎言者，谎言者，”他说，“你可怕的重击对我来说太过沉重。你耗尽了我的力量，我明白自己何时被击败。我已取出我的灵魂，放进这匹骏马之中。”埃尔玛召唤出一匹伟大的战马——因为他也是“马友”埃尔玛。“这是我给你的献祭，我将离开风暴部落，侍奉混沌，正如我当年离开光明部落来侍奉奥兰斯一样。”

column1: From that day until the end of the Darkness, the Chaos Gods left Orlanth’s stead alone.
column2: 从那天直至黑暗终结，混沌众神再未侵扰奥兰斯的庄园。

column1: Orlanth, about to leave on a great quest to repair a world shattered by Chaos, leaves his loyal thane, Elmal, to defend the stead of the Storm Tribe. Elmal is shattered many times by enemies, but remakes himself each time. Finally he is tempted by a being called the Teller of Lies. Elmal resists these temptations, discovers the creature's secret, and destroys it from the inside.
column2: 奥兰斯即将踏上修复混沌破碎的世界的伟大征程，临行前留下他忠诚的侍从埃尔玛，守卫风暴部落的庄园。埃尔玛被敌人击碎多次，但每次都能重塑自身。最终，一个名叫谎言讲述者的存在前来诱惑他。埃尔玛抵抗住了这些诱惑，发现了那生物的隐秘，并从内部将其摧毁。
