column1: Orlanth said, "I do not neglect you, Bright Friend. It is to you I entrust the greatest task of all, which is the protection of my people when I am away on this dangerous quest. You must guard the stead of the Storm Tribe, for surely our enemies will come here when they know I am gone. Although our kinsman, Odayla the Hunter, is swift and clever, I cannot trust him to protect the people, for he is a creature of the wilds, and would find in our stead a cage. Although my son, Voriof, is flesh of my flesh and a protector of sheep, I cannot trust him to protect the people, for he is not steadfast enough to withstand the onslaught of Chaos. Although my brother, Storm Bull, is a stout fighter of Chaos, I cannot trust him to protect the people, for the very wildness that makes him a great warrior also makes him unreliable. Only you can I trust; by leaving you behind, I do not reject you, but rather show that I love you more than a kinsman, more than a son, more than a brother. The only light that remains in this terrible darkness is the light shone by your unwavering loyalty." The two gods traded shields, to make a bond of love and allegiance between them.
column2: 奥兰斯说道：“我并非忽视你，光明之友。正是将最重大的任务托付于你——当我远行踏上这危险征程时，守护我的人民。你必须守卫风暴部落的庄园，因为敌人一旦得知我离开，必定会来犯。尽管我们的亲族，猎人奥达亚拉迅捷而机敏，但我不能信任他来保护人民，因为他属于荒野之灵，会在我们的庄园里感到如陷牢笼。尽管我的儿子沃里奥夫是我骨中之骨、护羊之人，但我不能信任他来保护人民，因为他不够坚定，无法抵御混沌的猛攻。尽管我的兄弟风暴公牛是混沌的勇猛斗士，但我不能信任他来保护人民，因为使他成为伟大战士的那份野性也使他不可靠。只有你，我能信赖；将你留下，并非拒绝你，而是表明我爱你胜过亲族、胜过儿子、胜过兄弟。这可怕黑暗中仅存的光明，便是你忠诚不渝所散发之光。”两位神祇交换了盾牌，以此缔结爱与忠义之纽带。

column1: The Teller of Lies came to Orlanth's stead disguised as a woman Elmal had loved back when he belonged to the Emperor's tribe. "Elmal, Elmal," it said, "you once loved me, but I was unfaithful to you. You were wracked with sorrow, and that made you weak. Because of me, the upstart god, Orlanth, was able to beat you and steal your pride. Now that the world is dark and you are the only remaining light, I see the error of my ways. I have come to restore my love to you, and restore your pride. Come with me, for I have made a safe place for the two of us. Leave these barbarians, and we will hide away until the darkness ends."
column2: 谎言讲述者化作一名女子，来到奥兰斯的庄园。那女子曾是埃尔玛在归属于皇帝部落时所爱之人。“埃尔玛，埃尔玛，”它说道，“你曾爱过我，但我不忠于你。你被悲伤折磨，变得软弱。正因我，那个僭越之神奥兰斯才能击败你，夺走你的骄傲。如今世界陷入黑暗，你是唯一留存的光明，我看到了自己的过错。我来是为了重续我对你的爱，恢复你的骄傲。跟我走吧，我已为我们俩建好一处安全的所在。离开这些野蛮人，我们一起躲藏，直到黑暗终结。”

column1: Elmal was not unaffected by this plea. His tears fell on the earth, and where they fell, they burned the dry grass. The occupants of Orlanth's stead had to put out the fires before they spread. They worried that Elmal would abandon them. But then Elmal said to the Teller of Lies: "You are not the woman I loved. But even if you were, I would not follow you, for Orlanth did not steal my pride. He awakened it. I married into his tribe, and love my wife only. I am loyal to her, and would never break Orlanth's laws of fidelity, no matter what sort of temptation you offer. Begone." In frustration, the Teller of Lies departed.
column2: 埃尔玛并非不为这番恳求所动。他的泪水滴落在大地上，落处烧焦了枯草。庄园的居民不得不扑灭火焰，以免蔓延。他们担心埃尔玛会抛弃他们。但埃尔玛对谎言讲述者说：“你并非我所爱的那个女人。即便你是，我也不会跟随你，因为奥兰斯并未夺走我的骄傲——他唤醒了它。我嫁入了他的部落，只爱我的妻子。我对她忠贞不渝，无论你抛出何种诱惑，我都绝不会违背奥兰斯的忠诚律法。滚吧。”谎言讲述者恼羞成怒，离去了。

column1: But Elmal himself was weary, and afraid that one day he would fall prey to the blandishments of the Teller of Lies. He thought, "Being loyal and steadfast is one thing, but I must also be clever. Sometimes the best way to defend is to attack. This Teller of Lies is trying to tear me apart from the inside, and so I must do the same to it."
column2: 但埃尔玛自己也疲惫不堪，害怕有朝一日会被谎言讲述者的甜言蜜语所惑。他想：“忠诚与坚定是一回事，但我也必须机敏。有时最好的防御就是进攻。这个谎言讲述者妄图从内部撕裂我，那么我也必须对它做同样的事。”

column1: From that day until the end of the Darkness, the Chaos Gods left Orlanth's stead alone, for they did not want Elmal getting inside of them and finding out they were Nothing, too.
column2: 从那天起直到黑暗终结，混沌众神再不敢侵扰奥兰斯的庄园，因为它们不愿让埃尔玛钻入它们内部，发现它们同样不过是虚无。

column1: (Much later, certain over-proud Orlanthi tried to learn these secrets, secrets that were reserved for the gods. This led to the reawakening of the Teller of Lies, which then came into the world bearing the name Gbaji. If the people had stopped to think of Elmal, and his loyalty and wisdom, this terrible thing never would have happened.)
column2: （很久以后，某些过于骄傲的奥兰斯人试图学习这些秘密——那些本为众神保留的秘密。这导致谎言讲述者再度苏醒，以“格巴吉”之名降临世间。倘若人们停下来想想埃尔玛，想想他的忠诚与智慧，这件可怕的事就根本不会发生。）

column1: The bountiful mother Ernalda was once drained of everything by an enemy. But she still had to feed the tribe, which required her to find her lost kin. Uralda the Cow Mother, who told her children to provide milk and meat for Ernalda's tribe, was missing. Barntar the Plowman, who knew the ways of the earth, was missing. Esra, who made the seeds, was missing.
column2: 丰饶之母厄尔纳达曾被敌人榨尽了一切。但她仍要喂养部落，为此必须找回她失散的亲族。叮嘱子女为厄尔纳达部落提供奶与肉的母牛女神乌拉尔达失踪了。通晓大地之道的犁者巴恩塔失踪了。制作种子的埃斯拉失踪了。

column1: Ernalda knew that many things which seem to be dead are really just hiding in the earth, so that is where she went. The enemy had dried up many things, and so the old passages in the earth were gone. So Ernalda went to her grandchildren, the Aldryami, and asked them for one of their seeds. The seed was called Adborl, and it was a burrowing thing. It burrowed deep into the earth, and left a big tunnel for Ernalda to follow.
column2: 厄尔纳达知道，许多看似死去的东西其实只是藏在大地之中，因此她前往那里。敌人已使许多事物干涸，旧日的通道不复存在。于是厄尔纳达去找她的孙辈——阿尔德里亚米，向他们求取一颗种子。那颗种子名叫阿德博尔，是一种擅长掘洞之物。它深深钻入地下，留下一条大隧道供厄尔纳达跟随。

column1: Ernalda went into the tunnel, where she found her terrible sister, Maran Gor, the earthquake goddess. She had taken Barntar as her thrall. "Your son, he helps me to break up the earth into pieces, so that I can hurl it at our enemies." But Ernalda looked at Barntar, who looked sad to see his life-giving powers used to bring death. Ernalda convinced Maran Gor to give Barntar back.
column2: 厄尔纳达进入隧道，在那里找到了她可怕的姐妹——地震女神马拉·戈尔。马拉·戈尔已将巴恩塔收为奴隶。“你的儿子，他帮我将大地碎裂成块，这样我就能将其掷向我们的敌人。”但厄尔纳达看着巴恩塔，巴恩塔看到自己的生命赋予之力被用于带来死亡，神情悲伤。厄尔纳达说服了马拉·戈尔把巴恩塔归还。

column1: Ernalda took Barntar with her and went further into the tunnel, where she found the cavern of her terrible aunt, Ty Kora Tek. Ty Kora Tek had been collecting dead souls in her cavern. During the troubles with Orlanth's enemy-from-within, Uralda and Esra had wandered in there, seeking protection. Ernalda asked Ty Kora Tek to release her bountiful daughters. But Ty Kora Tek refused: "What comes into my realm cannot come out again." Despite her aunt's strong arguments, Ernalda persuaded her to relent.
column2: 厄尔纳达带着巴恩塔继续深入隧道，在那里找到了她可怕的姨母泰·科拉·特克的洞穴。泰·科拉·特克一直在她的洞穴中收集死魂。在与奥兰斯内部之敌的麻烦中，乌拉尔达和埃斯拉曾游荡到此处寻求庇护。厄尔纳达请求泰·科拉·特克释放她丰饶的女儿们。但泰·科拉·特克拒绝了：“进入我领域的东西不能再出去。”尽管姨母言辞强硬，厄尔纳达仍说服她松了口。

column1: Ernalda had the kin she was looking for, so she headed back to the tunnel mouth. But a terrible woman she had not seen before blocked their way, looking fierce and brandishing an axe. "You cannot leave here. The tribe is sundered, and cannot so easily be mended. I have been charged with the task of keeping the broken things broken." Ernalda told her why she should step aside. So the terrible woman stepped aside, now that Ernalda had learned her secret. Ernalda went back to her tula, and with Barntar, Uralda, and Esra, fed the tribe.
column2: 厄尔纳达找到了她要找的亲人，于是返回洞口。但一个她从未见过的可怕女人挡住了去路，那女人面容凶狠，挥舞着斧头。“你不能离开这里。部落已经四分五裂，没有那么容易修复。我肩负的任务就是让破碎之物保持破碎。”厄尔纳达告诉了她为何应该让开。于是，在厄尔纳达得知了她的秘密之后，那个可怕的女人让开了路。厄尔纳达回到了她的图拉领地，与巴恩塔、乌拉尔达和埃斯拉一起喂养了部落。

column2: 埃纳尔达带着巴恩塔继续深入隧道，在那里找到了她那位可怕姑母泰·科拉·特克的洞穴。泰·科拉·特克一直在她的洞穴里收集亡魂。在与奥兰斯内部敌人的纷争期间，乌拉尔达和埃斯拉曾游荡至此寻求庇护。埃纳尔达请求泰·科拉·特克释放她那丰饶的女儿们。但泰·科拉·特克拒绝了：“进入我领域者，不得再离开。”尽管姑母言辞强硬，埃纳尔达还是说服她松了口。

column1: Ernalda had the kin she was looking for, so she headed back to the tunnel mouth. But a terrible woman she had not seen before blocked their way, looking fierce and brandishing an axe. “You cannot leave here. The tribe is sundered, and cannot so easily be mended. I have been charged with the task of keeping the broken things broken.” Ernalda told her why she should step aside. So the terrible woman stepped aside, now that Ernalda had learned her secret. Ernalda went back to her tula, and with Barntar, Uralda, and Esra, fed the tribe.
column2: 埃纳尔达找到了她要找的亲人，于是返回隧道口。但一个她从未见过的可怕女人挡住了去路，那女人面容凶悍，挥舞着斧头。“你们不能离开这里。部族已经分裂，无法轻易弥合。我受命维持破碎之物保持破碎。”埃纳尔达告诉了她应该让路的理由。于是那可怕女人退到一旁，因为埃纳尔达已经知道了她的秘密。埃纳尔达回到自己的图拉领地，与巴恩塔、乌拉尔达和埃斯拉一起养育了部族。

column1: The tribe was going hungry because Ernalda's children were missing. She travelled beneath the earth, and rescued her children from the dread goddesses of the Underworld.
column2: 部族正忍饥挨饿，因为埃纳尔达的孩子们失踪了。她深入地下，从冥界的可怕女神们手中救回了自己的孩子。

column2: 部族正忍饥挨饿，因为埃纳尔达的孩子们失踪了。她深入地下，从冥界的可怕女神们手中救回了自己的孩子。

column1: The bountiful mother Ernalda was once drained of everything by an enemy who was kin to her husband. But she still had to feed the tribe, which required her to find her lost kin. Uralda the Cow Mother, who told her children to provide milk and meat for Ernalda's tribe, was missing. Barntar the Plowman, who knew the ways of the earth, was missing. Esra, who made the seeds, was missing.
column2: 丰饶之母埃纳尔达曾被一位她丈夫的亲人夺走了一切。但她仍需养育部族，这要求她找到失散的亲人。母牛女神乌拉尔达——她曾命自己的儿女为埃纳尔达的部族提供奶与肉——不见了。犁者巴恩塔——他通晓大地之道——不见了。创造种子的埃斯拉也不见了。

column1: Ernalda knew that many things which seem to be dead are really just hiding in the earth, so that is where she went. The enemy had dried up many things, and so the old passages in the earth were gone. So Ernalda went to her grandchildren, the Aldryami, and asked them for one of their seeds. The elves were reluctant to help her, because they thought she had abandoned them for their enemies. The elves do not like us; they call us forest-killers. Ernalda taught them that she was not a traitor, and they gave her the seed she needed. The seed was called Adborl, and it was a burrowing thing. It burrowed deep into the earth, and left a big tunnel for Ernalda to follow.
column2: 埃纳尔达知道，许多看似死去的东西其实只是藏在大地之中，所以她前往那里。敌人已使许多事物干涸，旧日的地道也消失了。于是埃纳尔达去找她的子孙——阿尔德里亚米，向他们讨要一颗种子。精灵们不愿帮助她，因为他们认为她为了他们的敌人而抛弃了他们。精灵们不喜欢我们；他们称我们为森林杀手。埃纳尔达教导他们自己并非叛徒，于是他们给了她所需的种子。那颗种子名叫阿德博尔，是一种会钻洞的东西。它深深钻入地下，留下一条巨大的隧道供埃纳尔达跟随。

column1: Ernalda went into the tunnel, where she found her terrible sister, Maran Gor, the earthquake goddess. She had taken Barntar as her thrall. "Your son, he helps me to break up the earth into pieces, so that I can hurl it at our enemies. You think that this fight with Orlanth's nephew was a terrible thing, but it is merely the harbinger of what is to come. The kinstrife he caused will soon bring about other bad things. Three bad gods will force Orlanth to give them his blessing, and together they will make a god that is worse than all of them put together. I need Barntar to help me fight them." But Ernalda looked at Barntar, who looked sad to see his life-giving powers used to bring death. Ernalda convinced Maran Gor to give Barntar back. She told Maran Gor that without Barntar to plow the lands, there would be no reason to fight our enemies, because all of their friends would have long since starved to death. This is why we give gifts to Maran Gor.
column2: 埃纳尔达进入隧道，在那里找到了她可怕的地震女神姐妹马兰·戈尔。马兰·戈尔已将巴恩塔收为奴仆。“你的儿子，他帮我将大地碎裂成块，这样我才能将它们掷向我们的敌人。你以为与奥兰斯侄子的这场战斗是件可怕的事，但这不过是未来之事的预兆。他引发的亲族相争很快会带来其他灾祸。三位恶神将迫使奥兰斯赐予他们祝福，而他们一起将造出一个比他们总和还要更糟的神灵。我需要巴恩塔帮我对抗他们。”但埃纳尔达看向巴恩塔，巴恩塔看到自己赋予生命的力量被用来带来死亡，神情悲伤。埃纳尔达说服马兰·戈尔归还巴恩塔。她告诉马兰·戈尔，没有巴恩塔耕种土地，就没有理由与我们的敌人战斗，因为他们所有的朋友早已饿死。这就是我们向马兰·戈尔献上礼物的缘由。

column1: Ernalda took Barntar with her and went further into the tunnel, where she found the cavern of her terrible aunt, Ty Kora Tek. Ty Kora Tek had been collecting dead souls in her cavern. During the troubles with Orlanth's enemy-from-within, Uralda and Esra had wandered in there, seeking protection. Ernalda asked Ty Kora Tek to release her bountiful daughters. But Ty Kora Tek refused: "What comes into my realm cannot come out again. I cannot set a bad precedent now and just let out anyone who has a good reason to leave. Very bad times are coming, and my halls, and the halls of the other lords of the dead, will soon be full to bursting with the slain." Despite her aunt's strong arguments, Ernalda persuaded her to relent. She pointed out that Uralda and Esra had too much life in them, and were bringing life and vitality to Ty Kora Tek's garden of carefully-tended silence. It might be acceptable if Esra spent some of her time in the cavern of the dead. "But," Ernalda said, "if both the cow and the grain goddess spend all of their time here, everything will become its opposite, and then where will anything be?"
column2: 厄娜尔达带着巴恩塔一同深入隧道，在那里找到了她可怕姨母泰·科拉·特克的洞穴。泰·科拉·特克一直在她的洞穴里收集亡魂。在奥兰斯与内在之敌的纷争期间，乌拉尔达和埃丝拉曾游荡到此处寻求庇护。厄娜尔达请求泰·科拉·特克释放她那丰饶的女儿们。但泰·科拉·特克拒绝了：“进入我领域之物不可再离开。我不能在此刻开创一个坏先例，让每个有正当理由离开者都放走。极坏的时代即将来临，我的厅堂，以及其他死亡之主的厅堂，很快就会被杀戮者挤满。”尽管姨母的理由强硬，厄娜尔达还是说服她回心转意。她指出乌拉尔达和埃丝拉体内蕴含着太多生命，她们正给泰·科拉·特克那精心维护的寂静花园带来生机与活力。让埃丝拉在死亡洞穴中待上一段时间或许可以接受。“但是，”厄娜尔达说，“如果母牛女神与谷物女神都终日待在这里，一切都会走向反面，那时万物又当如何？”

column1: Ernalda had the kin she was looking for, so she headed back to the tunnel mouth. But a terrible woman she had not seen before blocked their way, looking fierce and brandishing an axe. "You cannot leave here. The tribe is sundered, and cannot so easily be mended. Your man committed kinstrife, so I, who have not been born yet, have been charged with the task of keeping the broken things broken." Ernalda told her why she should step aside. "Although you have not been born yet, I can tell who you are. You have death and vengeance in you, things I do not have in myself. That tells me that my aunt and my sister are right, and that this bad time is only a glimpse of a worse time to come. You must be my daughter, which means that I myself will come to the place of the dead, and you will seek to avenge me. Only then will there be enough suffering to erase the stain of kinstrife. Now that you know I understand, you can go back to sleep and wait for your birth. In the meantime, I must feed my people, so that they have at least a chance of surviving this bad time." So the terrible woman stepped aside, now that Ernalda had learned her secret of kinstrife. Ernalda went back to her tula, and with Barntar, Uralda, and Esra, fed the tribe. She did this in order to lay a path for us, so that we could do the same for ourselves when she was not here to help us.
column2: 厄娜尔达找到了她要找的亲人，于是返回隧道口。但一个她从未见过的可怕女子挡住了他们的去路，那女子面目凶悍，挥舞着斧头。“你不能离开这里。部族已经分裂，不可能轻易弥合。你的男人犯下了弑亲之罪，因此我这个尚未降生者，受命来维持破碎之物的破碎。”厄娜尔达说明了为何她应当让路。“虽然你尚未降生，但我能看出你是谁。你体内蕴含着死亡与复仇——这些我自己没有。这告诉我，我的姨母和姐妹是对的，这个坏时代只是更坏时代来临的一瞥。你必是我的女儿，这意味着我自己终将前往死境，而你将寻求为我复仇。唯有如此，才会有足够的苦难洗去弑亲之污。如今你已知我明白这一切，可以回去沉睡，等待你的降生。在此期间，我必须喂养我的人民，让他们至少有机会熬过这个坏时代。”于是那可怕女子让开了路，因为厄娜尔达已洞悉她与弑亲之罪的秘密。厄娜尔达回到她的图拉领地，与巴恩塔、乌拉尔达和埃丝拉一起养育部族。她这样做是为了为我们铺路，好让我们在她不在身边相助时能够自给自足。

column1: Foreigners are people who don't speak our language, worship Orlanth, or practice our customs. Many of them aren't even human.
column2: 异乡人是不说我们语言、不崇拜奥兰斯、也不遵行我们习俗的人。他们中许多甚至不是人类。

column1: The dragonewts allied with our folk for many generations, then betrayed them. About all I know about them is that there are different types, some big, some little. And they're related to the dragons somehow.
column2: 龙人与我族结盟了许多代，后来又背叛了他们。我对他们知道的全部就是：有不同类型，有些大，有些小。而且他们与龙族有些关联。

column1: The elves, or Aldryami, pretty much stick to their woods. Many people say they're really just intelligent plants, but they can walk around, so I don't know.
column2: 精灵，或称阿尔德里亚米，基本只待在他们的森林里。很多人说他们其实只是有智慧的植物，但他们能走动，所以我也说不准。

column1: The dark folk, or trolls, often live underground, because they don't like sunlight. They're the source of the expression "hungry as a troll," because they always are. The land of Dagori Inkarth was full of them, at least before the Dragonkill.
column2: 黑暗民，或称巨魔，常居住在地下，因为他们不喜欢阳光。“饿得像巨魔”这个说法就是源自他们，因为他们总是很饿。达戈里·因卡尔斯之地到处都是他们，至少在龙杀事件之前是这样。

column1: I don't know much about the Mostali, or stone people, but they dig caves to live in. They used to have a great castle somewhere north of Wintertop. People say "don't trust a dwarf," but they were certainly a help when our ancestors fought the Machine God.
column2: 我对莫斯塔利，或称石人，知之甚少，但他们挖洞穴居住。他们从前在冬顶以北某处有一座大城堡。人们常说“别相信矮人”，但我们的祖先与机械神作战时，他们确实帮了大忙。

column1: To the east are the Praxians, who herd and ride odd beasts. They were trouble in the early days of the Empire of the Wyrm's Friends, but then they moved further east.
column2: 东边是普拉克斯人，他们放牧并骑乘奇异的野兽。在龙之友帝国早期他们成了麻烦，但后来他们迁往更东边。

column1: There used to be a big empire to the north, past Aggar and Saird where our folk lived, but as far as I know, all these people were eaten by the dragons.
column2: 北方曾经有一个大帝国，位于我们族人居住的阿加和塞尔德之外，但据我所知，所有这些人都被龙吃掉了。

column1: Bushel: the amount of food which feeds one person for one year. Short for "Ernalda's Bushel."
column2: 蒲式耳：够一个人吃一年的食物量。“厄尔纳尔达蒲式耳”的简称。

column1: carl: farmer, who plows and usually tends a few cows.
column2: 农夫：耕田并通常照料几头牛的人。

column1: cottar: lower-class farmer, who usually tends sheep and a garden.
column2: 佃农：下层农夫，通常照料羊群和菜园。

column1: fyrd: the clan army, mostly composed of armed farmers.
column2: 民兵：氏族军队，主要由武装农夫组成。

column1: god-talker: someone responsible for sacrifices to a god: priest.
column2: 神言者：负责向神献祭的人：祭司。

column1: hide: a unit of land, loosely defined as enough to support a family.
column2: 海德：土地单位，大致定义为够养活一个家庭的面积。

column1: shaman: someone practiced in dealing with spirits. Sometimes called a "spirit-talker."
column2: 萨满：擅长与精魂打交道的人。有时被称为“魂言者”。

column1: thane: someone with a leadership role, such as a head of household, god-talker, or chief's weaponthane.
column2: 首领：担任领导角色的人，例如一家之主、神谕者或酋长的武器侍从。

column1: thrall: a slave, with no legal status.
column2: 奴隶：没有法律地位的奴隶。

column1: tula: a clan's home territory.
column2: 图拉领地：氏族的家园领土。

column1: weaponthane: professional warrior in the service of a king or clan chief.
column2: 武器侍从：服务于国王或氏族酋长的职业战士。

column1: wyter: the collective spirit of a group such as a clan or tribe.
column2: 氏族灵：一个群体（如氏族或部落）的集体精神。

column1: Sometimes in war it's easy to make a mistake and think that because things have got a little better, they're going to keep on getting better. The Gods War was like that for us. Orlanth beat Yelm and became King of the Gods, so we were finally on top. Life was harder for some people, but for our Storm tribe, times were good. It was too bad that with Yelm gone the world was a darker place, but there were plenty of other stars in the sky, and we controlled the lightning. Now we call this period the Storm Age.
column2: 战争中有时容易犯一个错误，以为事情稍微好转，就会持续好转。对我们而言，神战也是如此。奥兰斯击败了耶尔姆，成为众神之王，我们终于站到了顶峰。对某些人来说生活更加艰难，但对我们风暴部落而言，日子却很不错。可惜耶尔姆消失后世界变得更加黑暗，不过天空中还有许多其他星辰，而我们掌控着闪电。如今我们称这段时期为风暴时代。

column1: Then Chaos came into the world and everything got much worse very fast. All the fighting between our gods and the weaker gods of the other tribes had weakened the power of Law. Ragnaglar began kinstrife which was the fatal flaw for the world. Inner rot destroyed the world. The Great Mountain exploded and Chaos smashed through the hole it left behind. This was the start of the Great Darkness.
column2: 随后混沌降临世界，一切迅速恶化。我们神祇与其他部落的弱小神祇之间的征战早已削弱了法则之力。拉格纳格拉引发了亲族相残，这成了世界的致命缺陷。内在的腐朽摧毁了世界。大山爆炸，混沌从它留下的窟窿中猛冲进来。这便是大黑暗的开端。

column1: Most stories about the Great Darkness tell about how our armies fought against Wakboth the Devil and his Chaos armies. Even with Orlanth and Humakt leading us, these were doomed battles. To save his people, Orlanth fought alone against Wakboth and was smashed into 24 pieces — any lesser god would have been smashed into all 25. With his allies Thed and Ragnaglar, Wakboth easily conquered Umath's Camp, the home of our tribe, and that was not even the worst of our losses.
column2: 关于大黑暗的多数故事都讲述我们的军队如何与恶魔瓦克博斯及其混沌大军作战。即便有奥兰斯和胡马特率领我们，这些也都是注定失败的战斗。为拯救他的子民，奥兰斯独自对抗瓦克博斯，被砸成二十四块——换作任何次等神祇都会碎成整整二十五块。瓦克博斯在其盟友塞德和拉格纳格拉的协助下，轻易攻占了我们部落的家园尤马斯营地，而这甚至还不是我们最惨重的损失。

column1: But telling the stories of how the armies and heroes and devils fought makes it sound like just another war. It was worse than a war. We name it the "Great Darkness," but there were lights we have wanted to forget, terrible dark lights exploding at the center and the edges of the world, and always coming closer. In the time it took a warrior to polish his sword, at least one star would surely fall from heaven, never to reappear. In the time it took a woman to unhook her blouse to nurse her child, the baby grew fangs and roared with the voice of the Devil. Chaos squirmed into everything: a stray thought could lead demons to your doorway; an unkind word might accidentally destroy the listener. Innocence didn't help, neither did strength, because Wakboth twisted all things inside out. That's why even Orlanth was beaten by the Devil.
column2: 然而，讲述军队、英雄与恶魔如何作战的故事，听起来就像另一场战争。它比战争更可怕。我们称之为“大黑暗”，但其中还有我们不愿记起的光——可怕而黑暗的光在世界中心和边缘爆炸，并不断逼近。在战士磨砺佩剑的时间里，至少会有一颗星辰从天上坠落，永不再现。在妇人解衣哺乳的时间里，婴儿便长出獠牙，以恶魔的嗓音咆哮。混沌钻进一切事物：一个杂念便可能将恶魔引至你门前；一句恶言或许无意中摧毁听者。纯真无济于事，力量也无济于事，因为瓦克博斯将一切颠倒扭曲。正因如此，连奥兰斯也被恶魔击败了。

column1: But Orlanth was only beaten, not destroyed. The only god strong enough to send Orlanth to Hell was Orlanth. And that's why the Lightbringers Quest took the Devil and all its Chaotic allies by surprise: they understand how to sacrifice others, but Chaos is unable to understand the power of sacrificing oneself for the good of the tribe.
column2: 但奥兰斯只是被击败，并未被摧毁。唯一能送奥兰斯下地狱的强大神祇，唯有奥兰斯自己。正因如此，光明使者追寻令恶魔及其所有混沌盟友措手不及：他们懂得如何牺牲他人，但混沌无法理解为了部落福祉而自我牺牲的力量。

Orlanth beat Yelm and became King of the Gods, so we were finally on top. Life was harder for some people, but for our Storm tribe, times were good. It was too bad that with Yelm gone the world was a darker place, but there were plenty of other stars in the sky, and we controlled the lightning. Now we call this period the Storm Age.

And that’s why the Lightbringers Quest took the Devil and all its Chaotic allies by surprise: they understand how to sacrifice others, but Chaos is unable to understand the power of sacrificing oneself for the good of the tribe.

column1: great darkness
column2: 大黑暗

column1: Chaos came into the world through gaps created by war between the gods, death, and kinstrife. Chaos and its champion, Wakboth the Devil, killed nearly everything good, and twisted most of what was left into perversion and despair. It took strength, self-sacrifice, and faith in Orlanth, the strongest god in creation, to survive.
column2: 混沌通过诸神战争、死亡与亲族相残所撕开的裂隙侵入世界。混沌与其冠军——恶魔瓦克博斯——几乎杀尽一切美好之物，并把残存的大部分扭转为堕落与绝望。唯有力量、自我牺牲，以及对创世中最强之神奥兰斯的信仰，才能让人存活。

column1: Heortlanders are an Orlanthi people, named after their chief god. Orlanth worshippers in other lands have many similar practices.
column2: 赫奥特兰人是奥兰斯人的一支，以其主神命名。其他地区的奥兰斯崇拜者有许多类似的习俗。

column1: Heortlanders live by farming and herding. Barley is the staple crop, pigs provide meat, sheep give meat and wool, and cattle are raised for their milk and to pull the plow. Wild food is an important supplement.
column2: 赫奥特兰人以农耕与放牧为生。大麦是主要作物，猪提供肉食，羊提供肉与羊毛，牛则提供奶并拉犁。野生食物是重要的补充。

column1: Extended families live in rectangular longhouses. They share their quarters with livestock during winter. Some live in isolated steads, others build their homes in hillforts: huge earth and wood structures large enough to hold the herds in times of trouble.
column2: 大家庭居住在长方形长屋中。冬季时与牲畜共居一室。有些人住在孤立的农庄，另一些人则把家安在山堡里——那是巨大的土木结构，足以在危难时刻容纳畜群。

column1: The clan is the most important social unit, owning all land and herds. The chief is elected, and is advised by a council, or ring, which he appoints from the leading people of the clan.
column2: 氏族是最重要的社会单位，拥有所有土地和畜群。酋长经选举产生，并由他从氏族主要人物中任命的议会——或称“环”——提供谏议。

column1: Clans frequently form into tribes, which allow for inter-clan cooperation in matters of justice, mutual defense, trade, and specialized cults. The tribal king is also elected, and has a tribal ring.
column2: 氏族常结成部落，以便在司法、共同防御、贸易和专属崇拜等方面进行跨氏族合作。部落王同样经选举产生，并设有部落议会。

column1: There are several social ranks. Most clans have two noble families, the chieftain and high priestess. Thanes are household heads, priests, leading craftspeople, housecarls, and the clan ring. Most folk are carls, free farmers who own ox-teams, or cottars, who typically herd sheep. Some clans keep thralls, who have no rights and are treated as property (though their children are free). Social mobility is common.
column2: 存在若干社会等级。多数氏族有两个贵族家族：酋长家族与大祭司家族。领主是家主、祭司、首席工匠、家臣以及氏族议会的成员。大多数人是自由民——拥有牛队的自由农夫——或佃农——通常放羊。有些氏族蓄养奴隶，奴隶无任何权利，被当作财产对待（但他们的子女是自由的）。社会流动普遍存在。

column1: Men are feisty, unpredictable, and passionate; women are calm, calculating, and possessed. Individuals aren't restricted to the gender roles — women often become warriors or chiefs.
column2: 男性暴躁、难以预测且激情洋溢；女性冷静、精明且具有附身特质。个人并不受限于性别角色——女性常成为战士或酋长。

column1: People marry outside their clan. Husband and wife are partners, sharing in property. Children are part of the husband's clan, but the woman can easily leave a bad marriage.
column2: 人们与氏族外的人通婚。夫妻是伙伴，共享财产。子女属于丈夫的氏族，但女方可以轻易离开一段糟糕的婚姻。

column1: Though most are farmers, all adult males are also warriors, usually armed with just spear, helmet, and shield. Weaponthanes are full-time warriors in the service of a chief; they're usually equipped with metal armor, and ride horses to battle.
column2: 尽管多数人是农夫，所有成年男性同时也是战士，通常仅装备矛、头盔和盾牌。武器领主是效忠于酋长的全职战士；他们通常配备金属铠甲，骑马作战。

column1: Time is the Cosmic Compromise. It was birthed at the Dawn, by Arachne Solara, at the climax of Orlanth's Lightbringers Quest. Before that, things did not always happen in a single order. Sometimes things happened different ways at the same time. Sometimes a thing would break, then fall, then it would be whole again. It's hard for us to imagine how things were back then, for we are children of time and can no more imagine a world without it than we could breathe in a world without air. The gods understood things back then, but now even they are bound by time. They cannot intervene in our world now, with limited exceptions. Instead of doing things themselves, they watch us do things for them. We call on them for aid through prayer, ritual, and heroquesting. If this Compromise is ever broken, Chaos will come back into the world. Now things always happen in one order, in one particular way. This is what we call history.
column2: 时间就是宇宙妥协。它诞生于黎明时代，由阿拉克涅·索拉拉在奥兰斯的光明使者追寻高潮之际创生。在此之前，事物并非总按单一顺序发生。有时事物会以不同方式同时发生。有时某物会先碎裂，再坠落，而后恢复完整。我们很难想象那时的一切，因为我们是时间之子，正如我们无法在没有空气的世界呼吸一样，我们也无法想象没有时间的世界。众神当时理解这一切，但如今连他们也受时间束缚。除有限例外，他们现在无法干预我们的世界。他们不再亲自行事，而是注视我们为他们行事。我们通过祈祷、仪式和英雄任务向他们呼求帮助。如果这妥协被打破，混沌将重临世间。如今，事物总按一种顺序、一种特定的方式发生。这就是我们所谓的历史。

column1: History is a continuing cycle. Bad people rise up and offend against the Compromise, and against Orlanth's ways. Some of us fall prey to the wiles of these bad people, and join them. But they are always proven wrong, and they are always destroyed. A good period comes, until the lessons of the last disaster are forgotten, and bad people rise up once again.
column2: 历史是一个连续的循环。恶人崛起，违逆宇宙妥协，违逆奥兰斯之道。我们中有些人沦为这些恶人的诡计之猎物，加入他们。但他们终被证明是错的，也终遭毁灭。之后迎来一段美好时期，直到上一场灾祸的教训被遗忘，恶人再次崛起。

column1: The period at the start of history was called the Dawn. It was not as good as the wondrous Storm Age, but it was still good.
column2: 历史开端的时期被称为黎明时代。它不如那辉煌的风暴时代美好，但也尚算不错。

column1: Then the bad people rose up. People moved from Dragon Pass to a place called Dorastor, to try to turn back the Compromise and return to the Gods Age. They planned to do this by making a god of their own. Good Orlanthi argued against it, but weak ones joined in. They created a being they called Nysalor. We remember him as Gbaji, the Chaos god. His birth made the sun stop in the sky. He was finally destroyed by a man named Arkat, who was a good Orlanthi but betrayed us by turning into a troll. This happened about a thousand years ago. This was called the First Age.
column2: 后来恶人崛起了。人们从龙隘迁徙到一个叫多拉斯特的地方，企图逆转宇宙妥协，回归众神时代。他们计划通过制造一个自己的神来达成此目的。善良的奥兰斯人据理反对，但软弱者加入了他们。他们创造了一个称为尼萨洛尔的存在。我们记得他是格巴吉，混沌之神。他的诞生使太阳停驻于天空。他最终被一个名叫阿尔卡特的人摧毁，那人本是个善良的奥兰斯人，却因化为巨魔背叛了我们。这大约发生在一千年前。这段时期被称为第一纪元。

column1: The bad people of the Second Age were the God Learners. They were sorcerers from the far west, where they don't believe that gods and spirits are real, and regularly rob them of their life force with cruel magic. The God Learners tried to enslave all peoples, and to promote the worship of their own fake deities over everyone's real gods. They made a parody of the god Mostal, who is the Maker. To hurt Mostal more, it was constructed without respect or dignity, and so although it could do almost anything that a real god could do, it was not living. It was Zistor, a huge monster, made of gleaming metal and wires. It had an island called Machine City. Everyone in Machine City worked to make themselves into better parts of the machine, or to make the machine better. And that way Zistor grew. And somewhere, sometime, the machine belief of Zistor became a god. And when that occurred, then Orlanth could act, by himself. For as everyone knows, every god and goddess of Glorantha is bound by their promises at the Compromise. None of them may ever step out of their natural being, unless the destruction of the universe is imminent. Orlanth helped our ancestors destroy Zistor and the Machine City. Many of our ancestors died in this war, but there could be no better death than to die stopping bad people from destroying the world. This happened about four hundred years ago.
column2: 第二纪元的恶人是神学者。他们是来自远西的巫师，在那片土地上，人们不信神灵真实存在，并惯用残酷的魔法劫掠神灵的生命力。神学者试图奴役所有民族，并推广他们自己伪造的神祇，取代众人真正的神。他们制造了一个对莫斯塔尔（造物者）的拙劣模仿。为更重创莫斯塔尔，这造物被建成毫无尊崇与尊严的样子——因此，尽管它几乎能做到真神能做的一切，它却并无生命。它就是齐斯托，一头由闪亮金属与导线构成的庞大怪兽。它拥有一个名为机器城的岛屿。机器城中的每个人都致力于将自己改造成机器更好的部件，或让机器变得更完美。齐斯托就这样不断成长。而不知在何时何地，齐斯托的机械信仰变成了神。当此事发生时，奥兰斯就能亲自行动了。因为众所周知，格洛兰萨的每一位神祇都受宇宙妥协中誓言的约束。除非宇宙即将毁灭，否则他们绝不可逾越自己的本性分毫。奥兰斯帮助我们的祖先摧毁了齐斯托与机器城。许多祖先在这场战争中丧生，但若能在阻止恶人毁灭世界时死去，便无更光荣的死法。这大约发生在四百年前。

column1: There were other bad or foolish people during the Second Age, like the Empire of Wyrm's Friends, who thought they could befriend dragons. They learned their lesson when the dragons ate them all. That happened about two hundred years ago.
column2: 第二纪元还有另一些恶人或蠢人，比如龙友帝国，他们以为能与龙交好。当巨龙将他们尽数吞噬时，他们便领受了教训。这大约发生在两百年前。

column1: We are living in a good time, then. We reckon that it is now the Third Age. We know that if we are not vigilant, bad people will rise up yet again. Is the Pharaoh, who drove us from our homes in Heortland, part of a new wave of dangerous enemies, or is he merely another unjust ruler? Is the strange Red Moon that rose in the sky about a hundred years ago a harbinger of bad times? We don't know yet. So we wait and watch, and meanwhile tend our herds, plant our fields, and raid our neighbors, as any good Orlanthi should.
column2: 我们如今正生活在美好时期。我们认定现在是第三纪元。我们知道，若不加警惕，恶人还会再次崛起。那将我们从赫特兰家园逐出的法老，是一波危险敌人的新成员，抑或只是又一个不义的统治者？那约一百年前升起于天空的怪异红月，是不祥之兆吗？我们尚不得而知。所以我们等待与观察，同时照顾牧群、耕种田地、劫掠邻人——正如任何善良的奥兰斯人当行之事。

column1: Time is the Cosmic Compromise. It was birthed at the Dawn, by Arachne Solara, at the climax of Orlanth’s Lightbringers Quest. Before that, things did not always happen in a single order. Sometimes things happened different ways at the same time. Sometimes a thing would break, then fall, then it would be whole again. It’s hard for us to imagine how things were back then, for we are children of time and can no more imagine a world without it than we could breathe in a world without air. The gods understood things back then, but now even they are bound by time. They cannot intervene in our world now, with limited exceptions. Instead of doing things themselves, they watch us do things for them. We call on them for aid through prayer, ritual, and heroquesting. If this Compromise is ever broken, Chaos will come back into the world. Now things always happen in one order, in one particular way. This is what we call history.
column2: 时间就是宇宙妥协。它诞生于黎明时代，由阿拉克涅·索拉拉在奥兰斯的光明使者任务之高潮中创生。在那之前，万物并非总以单一顺序发生。有时不同的事会同时以不同方式发生。有时某物会破碎、坠落，然后重归完整。我们很难想象那时的世界，因为我们是时间之子，正如无法在无空气的世界中呼吸一样，也无法想象一个没有时间的世界。诸神当时能理解那一切，但现在连他们也被时间束缚。如今他们无法干预我们的世界——除少数例外。他们不再亲自行事，而是看着我们替他们行事。我们通过祈祷、仪式和英雄任务呼唤他们援助。若这宇宙妥协被打破，混沌将重临世间。如今万物总以单一顺序、以特定方式发生，这便是我们所谓的历史。

column1: History is a continuing cycle. Bad people rise up and offend against the Compromise, and against Orlanth’s ways. Some of us fall prey to the wiles of these bad people, and join them. But they are always proven wrong, and they are always destroyed. A good period comes, until the lessons of the last disaster are forgotten, and bad people rise up once again.
column2: 历史是一个连续的循环。恶人崛起，违逆宇宙妥协，违逆奥兰斯之道。我们中有些人沦为这些恶人的诡计之猎物，加入他们。但他们终被证明是错的，也终遭毁灭。之后迎来一段美好时期，直到上一场灾祸的教训被遗忘，恶人再次崛起。

column1: The bad people of the Second Age were the God Learners. They were sorcerers from the far west, where they don’t believe that gods and spirits are real, and regularly rob them of their life force with cruel magic. The God Learners tried to enslave all peoples, and to promote the worship of their own fake deities over everyone’s real gods. They made a parody of the god Mostal, who is the Maker. To hurt Mostal more, it was constructed without respect or dignity, and so although it could do almost anything that a real god could do, it was not living. It was Zistor, a huge monster, made of gleaming metal and wires. It had an island called Machine City. Everyone in Machine City worked to make themselves into better parts of the machine, or to make the machine better. And that way Zistor grew. And somewhere, sometime, the machine belief of Zistor became a god. And when that occurred, then Orlanth could act, by himself. For as everyone knows, every god and goddess of Glorantha is bound by their promises at the Compromise. None of them may ever step out of their natural being, unless the destruction of the universe is imminent. Orlanth helped our ancestors destroy Zistor and the Machine City. Many of our ancestors died in this war, but there could be no better death than to die stopping bad people from destroying the world. This happened about four hundred years ago.
column2: 第二纪元的坏人是神学者。他们是来自远西的巫师，那里的人不相信神明与神灵真实存在，还经常用残酷的魔法抢夺它们生命力。神学者试图奴役所有民族，并推广对自己虚假神祇的崇拜，压制众人真正的神明。他们嘲弄般造出了一个仿冒造物主莫斯塔尔的神。为了更深的伤害莫斯塔尔，这个造物毫无敬意与尊严，因此尽管它能做几乎任何真神能做的事，它却没有生命。它就是齐斯托，一个由闪亮金属和导线组成的巨大怪物。它拥有一座名为机器城的岛屿。机器城里的每个人都努力把自己变成机器更好的部件，或者让机器更完美。齐斯托就这样成长。而在某处、某时，机器的信仰让齐斯托变成了一位神。当那发生时，奥兰斯便能够亲自行动了。因为人人都知道，格洛兰萨的每一位神祇都被自己在《妥协》中立下的誓言所束缚。除非宇宙的毁灭迫在眉睫，否则他们绝不可超出自己的本性。奥兰斯帮助我们的祖先摧毁了齐斯托和机器城。许多祖先在这场战争中死去，但没有什么死亡比阻止坏人毁灭世界更光荣了。这大约发生在四百年前。

column1: There were other bad or foolish people during the Second Age, like the Empire of Wyrm’s Friends, who thought they could befriend dragons. They learned their lesson when the dragons ate them all. That happened about two hundred years ago.
column2: 第二纪元还有其他坏人或蠢人，比如龙之友帝国，那些人以为能和龙交朋友。当巨龙把他们全部吃掉时，他们才尝到教训。那大约发生在两百年前。

column1: We are living in a good time, then. We reckon that it is now the Third Age. We know that if we are not vigilant, bad people will rise up yet again. Is the Pharaoh, who drove us from our homes in Heortland, part of a new wave of dangerous enemies, or is he merely another unjust ruler? Is the strange Red Moon that rose in the sky about a hundred years ago a harbinger of bad times? We don’t know yet. So we wait and watch, and meanwhile tend our herds, plant our fields, and raid our neighbors, as any good Orlanthi should.
column2: 所以我们生活在好时代。我们认定现在是第三纪元。我们知道，若不警惕，坏人还会再次崛起。那位将我们从赫特兰家园赶走的法老，是一波危险新敌人的一部分，还是仅仅又一个不义的统治者？大约一百年前升入天空的奇异红月，是不祥之兆吗？我们尚不得而知。所以我们等待、观察，同时放牧、耕种、袭击邻居，一如所有好奥兰斯人应有的作为。

column1: history summary
column2: 历史概要

column1: Since the Dawn, we have lived in a world of history instead of a world of myth. Various bad people have risen up, like the people who tried to make a new god during the First Age, or the people who tried to learn too much about the gods in the Second Age. People like this cause great misery, but are inevitably destroyed. We are now living in the Third Age, and hope that no more bad people will come to spoil things.
column2: 自黎明时代以来，我们便生活在历史的世界中，而非神话的世界。各式各样的坏人曾崛起，比如第一纪元试图造出新神的人，或第二纪元试图窥探神明太多奥秘的人。这类人带来巨大苦难，但终将被毁灭。我们如今生活在第三纪元，希望不再有坏人来败坏一切。

column1: When you grew up, you were told about the trickster Eurmal, and how he found the sword called Death. They told you that Eurmal killed Grandfather Mortal with it, which was true. They said he showed it to Humakt, which was true. They even told you that Humakt used the sword to cut his family ties to Orlanth and his brothers. But that was not true. We allow them to say it, because of what was decided in the true story, the one I tell you today, on the day you cut your old ties to your kin and form a new one to Humakt. You are not to tell the true story to others; this is part of your test, to see if you really are strong enough to cut those ties and keep them cut.
column2: 当你长大时，有人告诉过你恶作剧者尤尔马尔的故事，以及他如何找到了那柄名为死亡的剑。他们告诉你尤尔马尔用它杀死了凡人祖父，这倒是真的。他们说他把剑拿给胡马克特看，这也是真的。他们甚至告诉你胡马克特用那剑斩断了自己与奥兰斯及其兄弟的家族纽带。但那不是真的。我们允许他们那么说，是因为那个真实故事里已经决定了的事——就是今天我告诉你的这个故事，在你斩断旧日血缘纽带、与胡马克特建立新纽带的日子里。你不得将这个真实故事告诉他人；这是你考验的一部分，看你是否真的够坚强，能斩断那些纽带并保持断裂。

column1: When Orlanth saw the thing called Death, he was not a king yet. Before Humakt could lend Orlanth the new thing, he had to be sure that Orlanth would show proper respect for it.
column2: 当奥兰斯看到那名为死亡的东西时，他还不是王。在胡马克特将这件新东西借给奥兰斯之前，他必须确保奥兰斯会对其抱有应有的敬重。

column1: The first time Orlanth came to Humakt, seeking his gift, he tried to treat Humakt like a thrall.
column2: 奥兰斯第一次来找胡马克特，求取他的礼物时，他待胡马克特如同奴隶。

column1: Humakt told him that he had the wind and bearing of a god who would rule over most things, but that he would never rule over Death.
column2: 胡马克特告诉他，他拥有统治大多数事物的神之风度和气质，但永远无法统治死亡。

column1: So they fought, and the fight went on for sixteen days and sixteen nights. Orlanth was not slain, but many of his thanes were. Orlanth wept.
column2: 于是他们打了起来，战斗持续了十六天十六夜。奥兰斯未被杀死，但他的许多侍卫战死了。奥兰斯哭泣。

column1: So Orlanth came to Humakt a second time, and this time he treated Humakt like he was a cottar.
column2: 于是奥兰斯第二次来找胡马克特，这一次他待胡马克特如同佃农。

column1: Humakt told him that safety and shelter were small things, compared to the might of Death. It was not a fair exchange.
column2: 胡马克特告诉他，安全与庇护相比死亡的伟力只是小事。那不是公平的交换。

column1: So they fought, and the fight went on for four days and four nights. Orlanth was not slain, but many of his carls were.
column2: 于是他们又打，战斗持续了四天四夜。奥兰斯未被杀死，但他的许多自由民战死了。

column1: The third time he came to Humakt, he treated our god like he was a carl.
column2: 第三次他来找胡马克特时，他待我们的神如同自由民。

column1: Humakt told him that a thing, once killed, could never be the same.
column2: 胡马克特告诉他，一件事物一旦被杀，就永不复原。

column1: So they fought, and the fight went on for two days and two nights. Orlanth was not slain, but many of his cottars and thralls were.
column2: 于是他们交战，战斗持续了两天两夜。奥兰斯并未被杀死，但他的许多佃农和奴隶却死了。

column1: Then some enemies came. Orlanth was too tired to fight, but Humakt was refreshed, for these were his special foes. There were many of them, so it took a day and a night to dispatch them all to hell, but Humakt did so. Then Orlanth had an idea.
column2: 然后一些敌人来了。奥兰斯疲惫不堪无法战斗，但胡马克特精神抖擞，因为这些是他的宿敌。敌人数量众多，所以花了一天一夜才将他们全部送下地狱，但胡马克特做到了。于是奥兰斯有了一个主意。

column1: You protected me. You shall have a new place, that of champion. You shall be a thane, a weaponthane among weaponthanes, and you shall sit at my side. You shall sit on the ring, and your weaponthanes shall answer to you. You shall be separate from the clan, yet connected to it lawfully. We are partners.	你保护了我。你将获得一个新的位置，那就是冠军。你将成为一名领主，武器领主中的武器领主，并坐在我身旁。你将坐在长老会上，你的武器领主们将听命于你。你将独立于氏族，但又合法地与之相连。我们是伙伴。
Now I humbly beg of you, let me borrow that sword of yours.
column2: 现在我谦卑地恳求你，让我借用你的那把剑。

column1: And Humakt gave him the sword. A sword like the sword I give to you, now.
column2: 于是胡马克特把剑给了他。一把像我此刻赐予你的剑一样的剑。

column1: “You protected me. You shall have a new place, that of champion. You shall be a thane, a weaponthane among weaponthanes, and you shall sit at my side. You shall sit on the ring, and your weaponthanes shall answer to you. You shall be separate from the clan, yet connected to it lawfully. We are partners.
column2:
你保护了我。你将获得一个新的位置，那就是冠军。你将成为一名领主，武器领主中的武器领主，并坐在我身旁。你将坐在长老会上，你的武器领主们将听命于你。你将独立于氏族，但又合法地与之相连。我们是伙伴。
“Now I humbly beg of you, let me borrow that sword of yours.”	现在我谦卑地恳求你，让我借用你的那把剑。"

column1: humakt
column2: 胡马克特

column1: When Humakt gains the weapon called Death, he uses it to sever his ties to the Storm Tribe. Orlanth and Humakt fight until Orlanth offers Humakt a place in the Storm Tribe which is honorable, and different from his old place — the position of the champion. Humakt lets Orlanth use the weapon.
column2: 当胡马克特获得名为"死亡"的武器时，他用它斩断了自己与风暴部落的联系。奥兰斯和胡马克特交战，直到奥兰斯在风暴部落中赐予胡马克特一个荣耀的、不同于他旧日地位的位置——冠军之位。胡马克特允许奥兰斯使用那武器。

column1: Issaries teaches us that if you can travel, you can trade. After all, trading is the art of taking something from where it is not needed and delivering it to where it is needed. Issaries also says that if you can trade, you can talk and find peace. If I depend on you for your extra grain, and you depend on me for your extra meat, we can only become friends. Further, if we are friends, if we are talking, we will work together to keep the peace, driving off bandits and enemies and other bad things, allowing for safe travel. Thus we see that traveling, trading and talking are all connected in a circle, just like a trade route. So if one of those things is broken, everything shatters.
column2: 伊萨里斯教导我们：若能旅行，便能贸易。毕竟，贸易是一门将物品从不需要之处取走，运送至需要之处的艺术。伊萨里斯还说：若能贸易，便能交谈并找到和平。如果我依赖你的余粮，而你依赖我的余肉，我们只能成为朋友。进一步说，如果我们是朋友，我们在交谈，就会合力维持和平，驱逐盗匪、敌人以及其他坏东西，让旅行得以安全。由此我们看到，旅行、贸易和交谈环环相扣，恰如一条贸易路线。所以若其中一环断裂，一切便分崩离析。

column1: This is a story of the time when everything had shattered. So Issaries set out for the furthest reaches of his very long trade route. He convinced the Know-It-All God to come and assist him, because it was a very confused time and things were very mixed up. He convinced Storm Bull to come along, because there were many bad things that needed to be beaten back.
column2: 这是一个万物崩坏时代的故事。于是伊萨里斯出发前往他那漫长贸易路线的最远端。他说服全知之神前来协助他，因为那是一个非常混乱的时代，事物都混杂不清。他说服风暴公牛同行，因为有许多邪恶之物需要被击退。

column1: Issaries searched for a very long time to find the worst part of the problem. Finally, he found a special route that let him cross the big water simply by walking downstairs. There he found the people suffering greatly. He visited a clan called the Digging Stick People. Their tulas were the battleground for the Long-Noses and the Big-Teeth, two other peoples who were fighting each other. Whenever they fought, the Digging Stick pastures were trampled. Their cows were stolen and eaten by hungry soldiers. Their carls were captured and ransomed, so that the armies could buy weapons. Their weaponthanes were pressed into service, risking their lives for no reward.
column2: 伊萨里斯寻访了很久，以找出问题最糟糕的部分。终于，他找到了一条特殊的路，只需走下阶梯便能渡过大海。在那里，他发现人们遭受着巨大的苦难。他拜访了一个叫掘棍人的氏族。他们的图拉领地是长鼻族和利齿族——两个互相交战的其他种族——的战场。每当他们交战，掘棍人的牧场就被践踏。他们的牛只被饥饿的士兵偷走吃掉。他们的自由民被俘虏后索要赎金，以便军队购买武器。他们的武器领主被强行征召服役，冒着生命危险却毫无回报。

column1: Storm Bull said, "It is good to see fighting. There's another battle coming up, the biggest battle of all. Everyone should get in practice."
column2: 风暴公牛说："看到战斗是好事。还有一场仗即将来临，是最大的战役。每个人都应该练习一下。"

column1: Know-It-All said, "These people are not, technically speaking, the same as our people. Legally, we are not obligated to help them."
column2: 全知之神说："严格来说，这些人跟我们不是同一族人。从法律上讲，我们没有义务帮助他们。"

column1: But Issaries said, "Storm Bull, if a big important battle is coming up, all peoples must learn to unite, and to fight only their real foes. Know-It-All, the things we have in common with these people are more important than the things which separate us. I must help them."
column2: 但伊萨里斯说："风暴公牛，如果一场重大战役即将来临，所有族群都必须学会团结，只与真正的敌人战斗。全知之神，我们与这些人的共同之处比我们之间的分歧更重要。我必须帮助他们。"

column1: Know-It-All had never been generous, so he refused to help. So Issaries, protected by Storm Bull, went to talk to the Long-Noses. Issaries spoke to their priestess, Oriska. She was troublesome: "We have no cause to make peace with the Big-Teeth. They have always attacked and killed us. Our best and finest are murdered. They take our leaders, our priests, our healers, and our weaponthanes." Then Oriska lowered her voice and, through her enormous nose, whispered a shameful secret: "Then, they are eaten. The Big-Teeth devour our flesh and prevent our bones from being interred in my holy, secret place. We can never make peace with them so long as they eat us. Now that the thing called death has come into the world, it is impossible."
column2: 万事通从不慷慨，所以他拒绝帮忙。于是，受风暴公牛庇护的伊萨里斯去找长鼻族谈话。伊萨里斯对他们的女祭司奥里斯卡发言。她不好应付：“我们没有理由与利齿族和解。他们总是攻击并杀害我们。我们最优秀、最杰出的人遭到谋杀。他们掳走我们的领袖、我们的祭司、我们的医者，还有我们的武器领主。”接着奥里斯卡压低声音，透过她那巨大的鼻子，低语出一个羞耻的秘密：“然后，他们被吃掉。利齿族吞噬我们的血肉，阻止我们的骸骨被安葬在我神圣的秘密之地。只要他们还吃我们，我们就永远无法与他们和解。如今那名为死亡的事物已降临世间，这是不可能的。”

column1: So Issaries went to talk to the Big-Teeth. They were very fierce, and said that Storm Bull smelled like food to them. When Issaries suggested they make peace with the Long-Noses, their war leader, Paratur, laughed. "It has long been decreed that we should eat the Long-Noses, for they are large and juicy and flavorful. They can eat the grasses of the plains and the leaves of the forest, but we cannot. We won't starve just to please others. We could eat you two-legs instead, devour the villagers whose tulas you are so concerned about. But I do not think you would consider that a just solution. We cannot do as you ask, for how does one make peace with one's dinner?"
column2: 于是伊萨里斯去找利齿族谈话。他们非常凶猛，并表示对风暴公牛闻起来像食物。当伊萨里斯建议他们与长鼻族和解时，他们的战争领袖帕拉图尔大笑起来。“早已规定我们应当吃长鼻族，因为他们又大又多汁又美味。他们可以吃平原上的草和森林里的叶子，但我们不行。我们不会为了取悦他人而挨饿。我们可以改吃你们两腿族，吞食那些你们如此关心其图拉领地的村民。但我不认为你们会认为那是一个公正的解决。我们无法照你说的做，因为如何能与自己的晚餐和解呢？”

column1: Issaries was at a loss. So he asked the Know-It-All for a few answers. Know-It-All told him that the Long-Noses were, except for their noses, their fur, and their teeth, just like very large cows. Know-It-All also said that the Big-Teeth were just very big alynxes, and had to be treated like pets.
column2: 伊萨里斯不知所措。于是他去找万事通要几个答案。万事通告诉他，长鼻族除了鼻子、皮毛和牙齿之外，就像非常大的牛。万事通还说，利齿族就是非常大的艾林克斯猫，必须像对待宠物一样对待。

column1: So Storm Bull went to the Long-Nose encampment and romanced Oriska. Then Issaries said to her, "The Big-Teeth are always going to eat some of you. If you can accept that bad thing, perhaps other things could be made better."
column2: 于是风暴公牛前往长鼻族营地，追求奥里斯卡。然后伊萨里斯对她说：“利齿族总会吃掉你们中的一些人。如果你们能接受这件坏事，也许其他事情可以变得更好。”

column1: Then Storm Bull went to the Big-Teeth encampment, fought Paratur, and showed him who was boss. "You must eat, but now the Long-Noses exact a heavy toll for each of them you succeed in taking. If you are willing to lose some of your choices, other things could be made better."
column2: 接着风暴公牛前往利齿族营地，与帕拉图尔交战，向他展示了谁是老大。“你们必须吃，但现在长鼻族对你们每次成功捕获的一个都会征收沉重的代价。如果你们愿意放弃一些选择，其他事情可以变得更好。”

column1: So Oriska and Paratur agreed to meet. Oriska agreed to accept Paratur's right to eat some of her people. Paratur agreed that his people would only attack the old, the sick, and the cottars of the Long-Nose tribe. He also agreed that the Big-Teeth would meet the Long-Noses during Earth Season and turn over the bones of the eaten, so that they might be interred in Oriska's secret, holy way, and their spirits sent to the right place.
column2: 于是奥里斯卡和帕拉图尔同意会面。奥里斯卡同意接受帕拉图尔吃掉她的一些族人的权利。帕拉图尔同意他的族人只会攻击长鼻族中的老人、病人和佃农。他还同意利齿族会在地季期间与长鼻族会面，交出被吃者的骸骨，以便它们能以奥里斯卡秘密的神圣方式被安葬，让他们的灵魂去到正确的地方。

column1: It was not long before the two groups started trading things other than the bones of the dead, and the people whose tulas were once trampled soon joined in the trading as well. Gradually this spread through the world, as trade led to talking, talking allowed travel, and travel permitted trade. Things were still very bad, but they became just good enough for people to hope again, and to band together. Issaries could then get ready to leave the world, and go on his most dangerous journey ever. But that is another story, and one that everybody knows.
column2: 不久之后，两个群体开始交易除了死者骸骨之外的东西，而那些图拉领地曾经被踩踏的人们也很快加入了交易。这逐渐传遍世界，因为贸易带来对话，对话允许旅行，旅行又促进贸易。情况仍然非常糟糕，但刚好变得足够好，让人们重新怀抱希望，并团结起来。伊萨里斯于是可以准备离开世界，踏上他迄今为止最危险的旅程。但那是另一个故事，而且人人皆知。

column1: Storm Bull said, “It is good to see fighting. There’s another battle coming up, the biggest battle of all. Everyone should get in practice.”
column2: 风暴公牛说：“看到战斗是好事。还有一场更大的战斗即将到来，是所有战斗中最重大的一场。每个人都应该练习起来。”

column1: Know-It-All said, “These people are not, technically speaking, the same as our people. Legally, we are not obligated to help them.”
column2: 万事通说：“严格从技术上讲，这些人不是我们的人民。法律上，我们没有义务帮助他们。”

column1: But Issaries said, “Storm Bull, if a big important battle is coming up, all peoples must learn to unite, and to fight only their real foes. Know-It-All, the things we have in common with these people are more important than the things which separate us. I must help them.”
column2: 但伊萨里斯说：“风暴公牛，如果一场重要的重大战斗即将到来，所有民族都必须学会团结，只与真正的敌人战斗。万事通，我们与这些人共同之处比我们之间的分歧更重要。我必须帮助他们。”

column1: Know-It-All had never been generous, so he refused to help. So Issaries, protected by Storm Bull, went to talk to the Long-Noses. Issaries spoke to their priestess, Oriska. She was troublesome: “We have no cause to make peace with the Big-Teeth. They have always attacked and killed us. Our best and finest are murdered. They take our leaders, our priests, our healers, and our weaponthanes.” Then Oriska lowered her voice and, through her enormous nose, whispered a shameful secret: “Then, they are eaten. The Big-Teeth devour our flesh and prevent our bones from being interred in my holy, secret place. We can never make peace with them so long as they eat us. Now that the thing called death has come into the world, it is impossible.”
column2: 万事通从未慷慨过，所以他拒绝帮忙。于是伊萨里斯，在风暴之牛的保护下，去找长鼻族谈话。伊萨里斯对他们的女祭司奥里斯卡说话。她很难缠：“我们没有理由与利齿族讲和。他们总是攻击并杀死我们。我们最好最优秀的人被杀害。他们带走我们的领袖、我们的祭司、我们的治疗者以及我们的武器领主。”然后奥里斯卡压低声音，透过她巨大的鼻子，低声说了一个可耻的秘密：“然后，他们被吃掉。利齿族吞噬我们的肉体，阻止我们的骨头被埋葬在我神圣的秘密之地。只要他们吃我们，我们就永远无法与他们讲和。现在那个叫做死亡的东西已经降临世界，这是不可能的。”

column1: So Issaries went to talk to the Big-Teeth. They were very fierce, and said that Storm Bull smelled like food to them. When Issaries suggested they make peace with the Long-Noses, their war leader, Paratur, laughed. “It has long been decreed that we should eat the Long-Noses, for they are large and juicy and flavorful. They can eat the grasses of the plains and the leaves of the forest, but we cannot. We won’t starve just to please others. We could eat you two-legs instead, devour the villagers whose tulas you are so concerned about. But I do not think you would consider that a just solution. We cannot do as you ask, for how does one make peace with one’s dinner?”
column2: 于是伊萨里斯去与利齿族谈话。他们非常凶猛，说风暴之牛闻起来像食物。当伊萨里斯建议他们与长鼻族讲和时，他们的战争领袖帕拉图尔大笑。“自古就注定我们要吃长鼻族，因为他们又大又多汁又美味。他们可以吃平原的草和森林的叶子，但我们不能。我们不会为了取悦他人而挨饿。我们可以改吃你们两条腿的，吞噬那些你如此关心的图拉领地上的村民。但我想你不会认为那是一个公正的解决方案。我们无法按你要求的做，因为人怎么能与自己的晚餐讲和？”

column2: 于是风暴之牛去了长鼻族的营地，并向奥里斯卡求爱。然后伊萨里斯对她说：“利齿族总是会吃掉你们中的一些人。如果你能接受这件坏事，也许其他事情可以变得更好。”

Paratur agreed that his people would only attack the old, the sick, and the cottars of the Long-Nose tribe. He also agreed that the Big-Teeth would meet the Long-Noses during Earth Season and turn over the bones of the eaten, so that they might be interred in Oriska’s secret, holy way, and their spirits sent to the right place.

column1: Issaries The Conciliator
column2: 伊萨里斯 调解者

column1: During the Great Darkness, Issaries starts the world back on the road to order and good trading by journeying to a distant place and bringing peace to two warring peoples, the Long-Noses and the Big-Teeth.
column2: 在大黑暗时期，伊萨里斯通过前往遥远之地，给两个交战民族——长鼻族和利齿族——带来和平，让世界重新走上秩序与良好贸易之路。

column1: The Journey West
column2: 西行之旅

column1: One day Orlanth found his mother dead, and he saw that his father was suffering, chained between the earth and sky. He vowed to right this terrible wrong, and called his companions to accompany him on his quest.
column2: 一天，奥兰斯发现他的母亲死了，他看到他的父亲在受苦，被锁链锁在大地与天空之间。他发誓要纠正这个可怕的错误，并召唤他的同伴随他一同踏上征程。

column1: Orlanth began his journey at the Hill of Orlanth Victorious. This was a propitious place, and many friends came to see him off, wishing him well and giving him their prayers and hopes. Orlanth gave command of the stead to Elmal, his loyal thane, and they traded shields as a token of their bond.
column2: 奥兰斯从奥兰斯胜利之丘出发。这是一个吉利的地方，许多朋友前来送行，祝他好运，并献上他们的祈祷和希望。奥兰斯将庄园的指挥权交给了他的忠诚侍从埃尔玛，他们交换了盾牌作为羁绊的信物。

column1: Orlanth traveled westward, following the trail of the dead. He rode upon Mastakos' chariot. One time Jagrekriand ambushed him, and in the struggle the chariot was wrecked. After that, travel was slower.
column2: 奥兰斯向西旅行，沿着死者之路前进。他乘坐马斯塔科斯的战车。有一次贾格雷克里安德伏击了他，在搏斗中战车被毁。此后，旅行变得缓慢。

column1: One day Orlanth met two travelers. They were Lhankor Mhy and Issaries, and Orlanth knew both of them well.
column2: 一天，奥兰斯遇到了两个旅者。他们是兰克尔莫和伊萨里斯，奥兰斯与他们俩都很熟悉。

column1: Lhankor Mhy was the son of two Elder Deities, Acos the Lawgiver and Orenoar the Mistress of Truth. Lhankor Mhy was grieving because his lover, the Light of Knowledge, had been killed, so he was seeking her.
column2: 兰克尔莫是两位远古神祇之子——法律赐予者阿科斯和真理女主人奥雷诺阿尔。兰克尔莫悲伤不已，因为他的爱人“知识之光”已被杀害，所以他正在寻找她。

column1: Issaries was the son of two other Elder Deities. His father was Larnste, God of Change; his mother was Harana Ilor, Goddess of Harmony. Issaries did not fear the dark, which he had encountered before, but was seeking the Light of Communication, which he felt could heal the wounded world. The two of them had joined their search together. They were happy to join themselves to Orlanth to continue the search.
column2: 伊萨里斯是另外两位远古神祇之子。他的父亲是变化之神拉恩斯特；母亲是和谐女神哈拉娜·伊洛尔。伊萨里斯不惧怕黑暗（他以前就遇到过），而是在寻找“沟通之光”，他感觉这光芒能治愈受伤的世界。他们两个已经联合了他们的搜索。他们很高兴加入奥兰斯，继续寻找。

column1: Konagog and Vonagog, with their variant army, tried to ambush the trio when they were in the lightless forest. But the defenses of Issaries' camp delayed them. Lhankor Mhy knew that they could be neutralized with a mirror. Only Orlanth was brave enough to face the enemy, who could make your fingers and other parts fall off if they looked at you wrong. He polished Elmal's shield, and reflected Konagog and Vonagog's power back at them.
column2: 科纳戈格与沃纳戈格率领着他们那支形形色色的军队，试图在无光之林伏击三人组。但伊萨里斯营地的防御设施拖延了他们。兰科·米知道可以用一面镜子来化解他们。只有奥兰斯足够勇敢，敢于直面这些敌人——只要他们看错你一眼，就能让你的手指和其他部位脱落。他将艾尔玛之盾擦亮，将科纳戈格与沃纳戈格的力量反射回他们自己身上。

column1: Orlanth once had a choice of whether to have a quick, easy short cut or to help a living army. The living army was from the Darkness tribe, Orlanth's old enemy. They were being attacked by the Lesser Kajaboori, Orlanth's new enemy. But the Dark Tribe was really alive, and Orlanth had no problem with making a choice. He led his companions to Hankarantal, where the cliffs cannot be scaled. He summoned the local fyrd, and even though it was only a small breeze it was enough, with the three warriors, to surprise the enemy. The storm gods slew enough parts of the Lesser Kajaboori to make them run away, and saved the day.
column2: 奥兰斯曾面临一次选择：是走一条快速省事的捷径，还是去帮助一支活生生的军队。这支军队来自黑暗部落，奥兰斯的旧敌。他们正遭到小卡贾布里的攻击，而小卡贾布里是奥兰斯的新敌。但黑暗部落毕竟是活生生的存在，奥兰斯毫不迟疑地做出了选择。他率领同伴们前往汉卡拉塔尔，那里的悬崖无法攀爬。他召集了当地的民兵，虽然只是一阵微弱的清风，但配合三名战士，已足以奇袭敌人。风暴诸神斩杀了小卡贾布里足够多的肢体，迫使他们溃逃，挽救了这一天。

column1: The army of darkness was commanded by Shankgaro, Uzlord of the West. He was no friend to Orlanth since they had fought over Ernalda's farmlands. But he thanked Orlanth, and said he would tell his friends of this.
column2: 黑暗大军由西方乌兹领主尚克加罗统率。自从他们在厄纳尔达的农场打过一仗之后，他就与奥兰斯不再是朋友。但他仍向奥兰斯道谢，并说会把此事告诉他的朋友们。

column1: After that Orlanth and his friends met other companions. They were Chalana Arroy and Flesh Man.
column2: 此后，奥兰斯和他的朋友们遇到了其他同伴。他们就是查拉娜·阿罗伊与血肉之人。

column1: Chalana Arroy was the daughter of Glorantha, the mother of the Elder Gods, though no one can say who her father was. Chalana Arroy had healed everyone during the Gods War. One day, while with her son Arroin, she found a god she could not heal. She had never seen this before, for the god was dead, and death was still new then. Chalana Arroy decided to to discover the cure for this. She sought the Breath of Life.
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊是格洛兰萨——上古诸神之母——的女儿，尽管没人能说出她的父亲是谁。神战期间，查拉娜·阿罗伊治愈了所有人。有一天，她与儿子阿罗因在一起时，发现了一位她无法治愈的神祇。她从未见过这种情况，因为那神祇已经死去，而死亡在当时还是新鲜事。查拉娜·阿罗伊决心找到治愈此病的方法。她开始寻求生命气息。

column1: While she and Arroin debated how to do this they met Flesh Man. He was a mortal who had been driven mad. He had seen Grandfather Mortal die, and then he saw Yelm die, and then he had seen a vision of the death of the whole world. They could not heal Flesh Man, either, and he escaped and ran away. Then Chalana Arroy decided to seek the great wound of the universe which caused this, and set off on the trail of Flesh Man.
column2: 在她与阿罗因商议如何行动时，他们遇到了血肉之人。他是一个发了狂的凡人。他目睹了凡人祖父的死亡，然后看见耶尔姆死去，接着又看到了整个世界的死亡异象。他们也治不好血肉之人，他挣脱逃跑了。于是查拉娜·阿罗伊决定去寻找导致这一切的宇宙巨创，并踏上了血肉之人的踪迹。

column1: Unknown to Chalana Arroy, Flesh Man followed the trail of Eurmal, the Trickster. Eurmal was the cause of all the trouble anyway, since he was the one who found Death and loosed it upon the world in so many forms. Since the broken world was of his making, only Eurmal himself was not uncomfortable. As the cosmos shook upon its primeval foundations, only he could understand where he was going. Flesh Man knew that, and so he followed the trickster's trail, which was invisible to anyone not mad like him.
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊并不知道，血肉之人追踪的是尤尔马尔——恶作剧者——的踪迹。尤尔马尔本就是所有麻烦的根源，正是他找到了死亡并以如此多的形态将其释放到世间。既然这个破碎的世界是他一手造成的，只有尤尔马尔自己不感到不适。当宇宙在其原始根基上震颤时，只有他明白自己要去向何方。血肉之人知道这一点，所以他跟随着恶作剧者的踪迹——这条踪迹对任何不像他那样疯狂的人来说都是隐形的。

column1: Orlanth was glad to follow the advice of Chalana Arroy if she would join their expedition, even if it meant following the madman. Such was the nature of the times.
column2: 奥兰斯很乐意听从查拉娜·阿罗伊的建议，只要她愿意加入他们的远征队，哪怕这意味着要跟着那个疯子走。这就是那个时代的特征。

column1: One day the trail led to Sorcerer's Town. There they joined the populace to witness the execution of a criminal monster caught by the sorcerers. Flesh Man recognized Eurmal, and begged Orlanth to save the wretch. Orlanth agreed, and they revealed themselves and drove off all the executioners. But they kept Eurmal tied up until Orlanth had extracted the Bondsman's Oath from him, so that he would be obedient to the chief.
column2: 一天，踪迹引向了巫师镇。他们与镇民一同围观一场处决——处决一个被巫师们抓获的怪物罪犯。血肉之人认出了尤尔马尔，恳求奥兰斯救救那个可怜虫。奥兰斯同意了，他们现身赶走了所有行刑者。但他们一直捆着尤尔马尔，直到奥兰斯从他那里逼出了仆从誓言，让他服从首领。

column1: Orlanth ordered Eurmal to bring them to the place which they all wanted to find. Eurmal was reluctant, pleaded ignorance, mocked them, begged not to have to do this, and threatened eventual revenge for it. When Orlanth told him to stop talking, and find them the safest journey to anyplace, he consented. This way they found their way to the shores of the sea.
column2: 奥兰斯命令尤尔马尔带他们去大家都想找的地方。尤尔马尔很不情愿，假装不知情，嘲笑他们，哀求他们别让他做这事，还威胁说日后要报复。当奥兰斯让他闭嘴，并为他们找到通往任何地方的最安全的道路时，他同意了。就这样，他们找到了通往海边的路。

column1: Upon the shores of the western sea the company was joined by their last member, Ginna Jar. She suggested that they should form a new type of bond, the Lightbringers' Ring. This the seven did, and they took an oath, and so were prepared for the rest of the journey.
column2: 在西方海岸边，队伍迎来了最后一位成员，金娜·贾尔。她建议他们结成一种新的纽带——逐光者之环。七人照做了，他们立下誓言，为余下的旅程做好了准备。

He summoned the local fyrd, and even though it was only a small breeze it was enough, with the three warriors, to surprise the enemy. The storm gods slew enough parts of the Lesser Kajaboori to make them run away, and saved the day.
column2: 奥兰斯曾面临一个选择：是走一条快捷而轻松的近路，还是帮助一支生灵军队。那支生灵军队来自黑暗部落，奥兰斯的宿敌。他们正遭到小卡贾布里的攻击，这是奥兰斯的新敌人。但黑暗部落确实是活生生的生灵，奥兰斯毫不犹豫地做出了选择。他带领同伴前往汉卡拉塔尔——那里的悬崖无法攀爬。他召集了当地的民兵，尽管只是一阵微风，但配合三位战士，已足够出其不意地打击敌人。风暴诸神击杀了足够多的小卡贾布里，迫使他们逃窜，挽救了局面。

column1: The army of darkness was commanded by Shankgaro, Uzlord of the West. He was no friend to Orlanth since they had fought over Ernalda’s farmlands. But he thanked Orlanth, and said he would tell his friends of this.
column2: 黑暗大军由西方乌兹领主尚克加罗指挥。自从他们在埃尔纳尔达的农田上交战后，他就与奥兰斯不睦。但他还是感谢了奥兰斯，并说会将此事告知他的朋友们。

column1: Unknown to Chalana Arroy, Flesh Man followed the trail of Eurmal, the Trickster. Eurmal was the cause of all the trouble anyway, since he was the one who found Death and loosed it upon the world in so many forms. Since the broken world was of his making, only Eurmal himself was not uncomfortable. As the cosmos shook upon its primeval foundations, only he could understand where he was going. Flesh Man knew that, and so he followed the trickster’s trail, which was invisible to anyone not mad like him.
column2: 查拉娜·阿罗伊不知情的是，血肉之人追踪着恶作剧者尤尔马尔的踪迹。毕竟，尤尔马尔是这一切麻烦的根源——正是他找到了死亡，并将其以诸多形态释放到世上。既然这个破碎的世界是他一手造成的，只有尤尔马尔自己才不觉得不适。当宇宙在原初根基上震颤时，只有他能明白自己要去往何方。血肉之人知道这一点，于是便追随恶作剧者的踪迹——那踪迹对于任何不像他那样疯狂的人来说都是隐形的。

column1: One day the trail led to Sorcerer’s Town. There they joined the populace to witness the execution of a criminal monster caught by the sorcerers. Flesh Man recognized Eurmal, and begged Orlanth to save the wretch. Orlanth agreed, and they revealed themselves and drove off all the executioners. But they kept Eurmal tied up until Orlanth had extracted the Bondsman’s Oath from him, so that he would be obedient to the chief.
column2: 有一天，踪迹将他们引到了巫师镇。在那里，他们混入人群中，目睹巫师们抓获的一只罪犯怪物的处决。血肉之人认出了尤尔马尔，便恳求奥兰斯救下那可怜虫。奥兰斯同意了，于是他们现身，驱散了所有行刑者。但他们仍然将尤尔马尔捆绑着，直到奥兰强迫他立下誓仆之誓，使他服从于首领。

column1: Upon the shores of the western sea the company was joined by their last member, Ginna Jar. She suggested that they should form a new type of bond, the Lightbringers’ Ring. This the seven did, and they took an oath, and so were prepared for the rest of the journey.
column2: 在西海之滨，队伍迎来了最后一位成员——金娜·贾尔。她提议他们应该结成一种新的联结——光明使者之环。七位行者照做了，他们立下誓言，于是为余下的旅程做好了准备。

column1: The Lightbringers Quest
column2: 光明使者追寻

column1: One day Orlanth finds his mother dead, and sees that his father is suffering, chained between the earth and sky. He embarks on a quest to right this terrible wrong, traveling west. On his land journey, he bests many enemies, and gathers together his companions: Lhankor Mhy, Issaries, Chalana Arroy, and Flesh Man. Orlanth even rescues the trickster, Eurmal, from people who want to kill him, and makes Eurmal pledge his loyalty.
column2: 一天，奥兰斯发现他的母亲死了，又看到父亲被锁链束缚在天地之间，痛苦不堪。他踏上一场追寻，以纠正这可怕的错误，向西而行。在陆路旅程中，他战胜了许多敌人，并召集了他的同伴：兰科·米、伊萨里斯、查拉娜·阿罗伊，还有血肉之人。奥兰斯甚至还从想要杀死恶作剧者尤尔马尔的人们手中救出了他，并迫使尤尔马尔宣誓效忠。

column1: The Sea Journey
column2: 海上旅程

column1: Luathela
column2: 卢阿塞拉

column1: The Underworld
column2: 冥界

column1: Orlanth and Yelm
column2: 奥兰斯与耶尔姆

column1: The Ritual of the Net
column2: 网之仪式

column1: The Return
column2: 归途

column1: Orlanth and his friends sought the best way to cross the wretched ocean, which was dying and breaking from the forces of Chaos. Orlanth cast about for help or guidance and was answered by Sofala, the ancient Turtle Grandmother. She owed Orlanth a favor, and agreed to bear them across the seas to the best of her ability.
column2: 奥兰斯和他的朋友们寻找穿越那片可怜之海的最佳途径——那片海正因混沌之力而垂死崩裂。奥兰斯四处寻求帮助或指引，得到了古老龟祖母索法拉的回应。她欠奥兰斯一份恩惠，于是同意尽力载他们渡海。

column1: On the way they were attacked by a sea dragon, but Orlanth drove it off. They were attacked by a god, but he left when Chalana Arroy healed him. A school of small monsters tried to swarm over them, but could not penetrate Issaries' sacred camp defenses. Golod, the King of Fishes, tried to swamp them but Eurmal convinced the Old Man of the Sea that they were kinsmen. A goddess attacked, but Lhankor Mhy knew what was needed to divert her. At last they reached the western land, Luathela.
column2: 途中，他们遭到一条海龙的袭击，但奥兰斯将其击退。他们又遭到一位神祇的攻击，但查拉娜·阿罗伊治愈了他，他便离开了。一群小怪物试图蜂拥而上，却无法突破伊萨里斯神圣营地的防御。万鱼之王戈洛德试图淹没他们，但尤尔马尔说服了海老人，声称他们是同族。一位女神发起攻击，但兰科·米知道如何引开她。最后，他们抵达了西方之地——卢阿塞拉。

column1: On the way they were attacked by a sea dragon, but Orlanth drove it off. They were attacked by a god, but he left when Chalana Arroy healed him. A school of small monsters tried to swarm over them, but could not penetrate Issaries’ sacred camp defenses. Golod, the King of Fishes, tried to swamp them but Eurmal convinced the Old Man of the Sea that they were kinsmen. A goddess attacked, but Lhankor Mhy knew what was needed to divert her. At last they reached the western land, Luathela.

column1: The sea is very dangerous because it has been damaged by the forces of Chaos. Orlanth is aided by Sofala, the ancient Turtle Grandmother, who owes him a favor. She ferries Orlanth and his companions across the ocean as they use their unique talents to ward off various foes.
column2: 海洋非常危险，因为它被混沌的力量所破坏。奥兰斯得到了索法拉——古老的龟祖母——的帮助，她欠他一份恩惠。她载着奥兰斯和他的同伴们渡海，他们各自施展独特的才能击退各色敌人。

column1: The western land of Luathela is inhabited by a race of demigods called the Luatha. They are the children of many lesser gods, and all have strange magical abilities. From living in Rausa's palace their skins are all different shades of purple.
column2: 西方大陆卢阿塞拉居住着一支名为卢阿萨的半神种族。他们是众多次级神祇的子女，都拥有奇异的魔法能力。由于居住于劳萨的宫殿，他们的皮肤呈现出深浅各异的紫色。

column1: The Luatha had been warned of the coming of the Lightbringers. They did not like foreigners, and had kept all others away. When Orlanth waded ashore they opposed him. Orlanth and his companions needed assistance, and that is when they remembered that they had the Eternal Ring of the Vingkotlings. Orlanth put on the ring, and seven times seven thousand Vingkotling warriors woke from deep sleep or daily life and raced upon the winds to join their lord in battle. With a shout like thunder they charged their foes who waited on the beach. They raised a new surf, red and purple with blood, before the fight was over.
column2: 卢阿萨早已收到光明使者即将到来的警告。他们不喜外人，向来将所有人拒之门外。当奥兰斯涉水上岸时，他们便出手阻拦。奥兰斯和他的同伴需要援助，就在这时他们想起了文戈特林永恒之环。奥兰斯戴上戒指，七乘七千名文戈特林战士——无论从沉眠还是日常中——纷纷苏醒，乘风疾驰，赶来与主人并肩作战。他们发出雷霆般的呐喊，向海滩上等待的敌人发起冲锋。战斗尚未结束，血浪便已翻涌，染红并染紫了新的浪潮。

column1: At last the Luatha saw they could not win, and called for a parley. They promised that they would no longer attack Orlanth and his army if allowed to withdraw. Orlanth insisted that they escort him to their leader.
column2: 最终卢阿萨意识到无法取胜，便请求会谈。他们承诺，若允许撤退便不再攻击奥兰斯及其军队。奥兰斯坚持要他们护送自己去见他们的首领。

column1: The Luathan captain escorted Orlanth and his companions across the beautiful but shadowed land to the magnificent but nearly empty palace of their ruler. This was Rausa, goddess of the Western Gates. She hated Orlanth because he had killed her father, Yelm, and banished him to remain forever below her own Western Gates. Rausa had been the last to see Yelm in the world of the living. She hated Orlanth so much that she smeared herself with her father's crimson blood to remind herself to take revenge. She hated Orlanth so much that, whenever she had the strength, she armed and rose up from the horizon to look for him. She wished to send Orlanth to her father's fate, and then lock the Gates of the West behind him. Now, at last, he was here, in her palace.
column2: 卢阿萨的首领护送奥兰斯和他的同伴穿过美丽却阴翳的土地，来到他们统治者的宏伟却近乎空荡的宫殿。这位统治者便是西方之门女神劳萨。她憎恨奥兰斯，因为他杀死了她的父亲耶尔姆，并将其放逐，永远囚禁于她自己的西方之门下方。劳萨是在生者世界中最后一个见到耶尔姆的人。她对奥兰斯的憎恨如此之深，以至于用父亲殷红的鲜血涂抹自身，以提醒自己复仇。她对奥兰斯的憎恨如此之深，以至于每当力量积蓄足够，她便全副武装，从地平线上升起来寻觅他的踪迹。她希望将奥兰斯送向他父亲的命运，然后在他身后锁上西方之门。如今，他终于来到了这里，在她的宫殿之中。

column1: However, Rausa also feared Orlanth and what he could probably do to her, her people, and her palace if he unleashed all his powers. She knew it would be difficult to kill him if he was alone, and he was not. He would be hard to kill if he was unarmed, which he was not. He would be hard to trick, too, since he was so well advised.
column2: 然而，劳萨也畏惧奥兰斯——如果他释放全部力量，会对她、她的人民和她的宫殿造成什么后果。她知道若他孤身一人，杀死他尚且困难，而他并非独自前来。若他手无寸铁，杀死他会更难，而他并非赤手空拳。想要欺骗他也很难，因为他身边不乏智囊。

column1: So Princess Rausa asked him what he wanted here, in her house. And Orlanth spoke simply.
column2: 于是劳萨公主问他，在她的地盘上想要什么。奥兰斯简单答道。

column1: I wish to travel beyond your home, he said, "and through the Gates of the West, and have them locked behind me."
column2: “我希望穿过你的家园，”他说，“通过西方之门，并让它们在我身后锁上。”

column1: And the goddess was so happy that her wish had come true that she did not ask what his business there was, or with what intent he entered into this, or what end he hoped to accomplish. She collected the fee for going to the Underworld, then ordered the gate keepers, Vamth and Rhylor, to wrench the great doors open, and to lock them again after the travelers went through.
column2: 女神见自己的心愿得以实现，欣喜不已，竟未问他去那里有何要事，或以何种意图进入此地，或希望达成何种目的。她收取了前往冥界的费用，然后命令守门者瓦姆特和瑞洛尔用力拉开巨门，并在旅者们通过后重新锁上。

column2: “我希望穿过你的家园，”他说，“通过西方之门，并让它们在我身后锁上。”

column1: They reach the western land of Luathela, where Orlanth summons warriors to fight its purple-skinned people. Their queen, Rausa, asks to negotiate with him, and Orlanth demands the right to pass through the Western Gate to the Underworld. Rausa, who hates Orlanth, happily grants this wish, for it means that Orlanth will die.
column2: 他们抵达西方大陆卢阿塞拉，奥兰斯召唤战士对抗当地的紫肤居民。他们的女王劳萨请求与他谈判，奥兰斯要求有权通过西方之门前往冥界。憎恨奥兰斯的劳萨欣然应允，因为这意味奥兰斯将走向死亡。

column1: The gates slammed shut behind them, but the gods could still see, for before them glowed a path of Yelm's blood. Their journey was not easy, and they were not far past the gates when Canis Chaos attacked them. This was an easy attack to repel, but he would attack again and again during their journey.
column2: 大门在他们身后砰然关闭，但众神仍能看见，因为他们面前有一条耶尔姆之血铺就的道路在发光。他们的旅途并不轻松，刚过大门不久，混沌犬便袭击了他们。这次攻击不难击退，但他在旅途中会一次又一次地来袭。

column1: After some time they reached Kaldar's Gate. Eurmal said they must go through it, but the two guardians did not allow this. They were named Kaldar and Sinjota. Orlanth challenged Kaldar to fight and won, while Eurmal seduced Sinjota to divert her while the rest slipped past.
column2: 过了一段时间，他们抵达了卡尔达之门。厄尔马尔说必须穿过此门，但两位守卫不允许。他们名叫卡尔达和辛乔塔。奥兰斯向卡尔达挑战并获胜，而厄尔马尔引诱辛乔塔以分散她的注意力，其余人则趁机溜过。

column1: For a long time they marched along the Path of Silence alongside the recently dead. Lhankor Mhy knew where to leave that path, for it was a secret which had to do with the Elder Tree.
column2: 他们与刚死之人一起沿寂静之路行进了许久。兰科尔·米知道该在何处离开那条路，因为那是一个与远古之树有关的秘密。

column1: At the River of Swords, Issaries negotiated with Jeset the Ferryman for the fare of passage for a live person across it.
column2: 在剑河，伊萨里斯与渡船者杰塞特商议了一位活人渡河的船资。

column1: They passed deep places, and once found their way to the Obsidian Castle, where they were guests of the Only Old One before he betrayed them.
column2: 他们穿过幽深之地，一度找到了通往黑曜石城堡的路，在那里他们曾是唯一古老者的宾客，之后他背叛了他们。

column1: Each of the companions had a special place, where they alone knew the secret to succeed at something. If they had not shared this secret, they would have failed. And each of them had a moment of failure, when their best and proudest skills were seen to be naught.
column2: 每位同伴都有一个特殊之处，只有他们自己知道在某事上成功的秘诀。倘若他们不曾分享这个秘密，他们就会失败。而他们每个人都曾有过失败的瞬间，那时他们最出色、最引以为傲的技能被证明一无所成。

column1: Issaries could find any road, anyplace. He could make a camp which protected them in the darkness. His special skill was used when they had to negotiate, or moderate some action, or make some compromise. But he found someone who would not listen, and he lost his way so that the party was separated from each other.
column2: 伊萨里斯能找到任何道路、任何地点。他能搭起营地在黑暗中保护他们。他的特殊技能用于需要谈判、调解行动或达成妥协之时。但他遇到了一个不愿倾听的人，于是他迷失了方向，以致队伍彼此失散。

column1: Orlanth was a great fighter, and he and his companions drove off many foes, and crushed others, either in single combat or massed battle. He also had some failures, and was wounded and lost some of his most precious tools. But these were not his true failures. His failure was in his great leadership, when Eurmal betrayed him in the Obsidian Castle, and the laws of hospitality were shattered, and his companions abandoned him.
column2: 奥兰斯是一位伟大的战士，他与同伴们击退了许多敌人，碾碎了其他敌人，无论是在单挑还是混战中。他也有过一些失败，受了伤，失去了一些最宝贵的工具。但这些并非他真正的失败。他的失败在于他杰出的领导力，当时厄尔马尔在黑曜石城堡背叛了他，好客的法则被打破，他的同伴们也离他而去。

column1: Chalana Arroy healed anything and anyone that she met. This was how she saved them all, for compassion is always in great demand in the underworlds. When the Greater Ungoron came it spared them all for her sake. But she met a demon to whom kindness meant nothing, and which could not be healed. She was foully treated by it, and hurt so badly that she could not even heal herself.
column2: 查拉娜·阿洛伊能治愈她遇到的任何事物和任何人。她正是这样拯救了他们所有人，因为在冥界中，慈悲总是极被需要。当大乌戈隆降临之时，它因她的缘故放过了他们所有人。但她遇到了一个恶魔，对恶魔而言仁慈毫无意义，而且它无法被治愈。她被恶魔残暴地对待，伤得如此之重，甚至无法治愈自己。

column1: Lhankor Mhy had great knowledge, and he was always useful in finding out information. He was quick thinking, and was able to deduce new things. When they had to leave the Path of the Dead it was Lhankor Mhy who knew the right place. But he discovered something which he could not know, and it caused him to stop thinking for a time.
column2: 兰科·米拥有广博的知识，在探寻信息时总能派上用场。他思维敏捷，善于推演新知。当他们不得不离开死者之路时，正是兰科·米知晓正确的去处。但他发现了一件不该知道的事，这件事让他暂时停止了思考。

column1: Flesh Man was slain while in the Underworld. This was not a relief for him, for he kept on the quest anyway, but now he was alone. He was drawn inexorably towards the Halls of the Dead.
column2: 血肉之人在冥界被杀。这对他并非解脱，因为他仍继续着使命，但如今形单影只。他被不可抗拒地拖向死者之厅。

column1: Eurmal was utterly unreliable, for he was as contrary as possible. But when everyone had been lost, he found them and brought them together again. This is why Orlanth spared him for his betrayal. Then he led them to the tracks of Flesh Man, and they went on.
column2: 尤尔马尔完全不可信赖，因为他极尽反复无常。但当所有人都迷失时，他却找到了他们，并将众人重新聚拢。正因为此，奥兰斯才饶恕了他的背叛。之后他带领他们找到了血肉之人的踪迹，他们继续前行。

column1: The gates slammed shut behind them, but the gods could still see, for before them glowed a path of Yelm’s blood. Their journey was not easy, and they were not far past the gates when Canis Chaos attacked them. This was an easy attack to repel, but he would attack again and again during their journey.
column2: 大门在他们身后轰然关闭，但众神仍能看见，因为面前有一条耶尔姆之血铺就的道路在发光。他们的旅程并不轻松，刚过大门不久，混沌犬便袭击了他们。这次攻击很容易击退，但在旅途中他会一再袭击。

column1: After some time they reached Kaldar’s Gate. Eurmal said they must go through it, but the two guardians did not allow this. They were named Kaldar and Sinjota. Orlanth challenged Kaldar to fight and won, while Eurmal seduced Sinjota to divert her while the rest slipped past.
column2: 过了一段时间，他们抵达了卡尔达之门。尤尔马尔说他们必须穿过此门，但两名守卫不允许。他们名叫卡尔达和辛乔塔。奥兰斯挑战卡尔达并获胜，而尤尔马尔引诱辛乔塔以转移她的注意力，其余人趁机溜过。

column1: The companions begin their long descent into the Underworld. Each of them is tested in turn, and each uses a special talent to save the others. Flesh Man is killed, but is not freed from the quest. Eurmal is unreliable and betrays the others, but unites them when all seems lost.
column2: 同伴们开始向冥界深处漫长的下降。他们逐一经受考验，每个人都用一项特殊才能拯救他人。血肉之人被杀，但并未从使命中解脱。尤尔马尔不可信赖并背叛了其他人，但在看似绝境时又将他们团结起来。

column1: At last Orlanth and his companions found the Hall of the Dead. Orlanth heard laughter from it and strode boldly to the porter and spoke.
column2: 最终奥兰斯和他的同伴们找到了亡者大厅。奥兰斯听到从中传来的笑声，便大步走向门卫说道。

column1: Whose hall is this?	这是谁的大厅？
So merry in the darkness?"
column2: 如此欢快于黑暗之中？"

column1: The porter was King Gryphon, who still dragged a shattered wing upon the ground. He said,
column2: 门卫是狮鹫王，他一只破碎的翅膀仍拖在地上。他说：

column1: That is the laughter of Despair, the daily drink here.	那是绝望的笑声，每日在此的饮品。
It would sound joyous to only one being — Yelm's murderer!
column2: 它只会对一个存在显得快乐——耶尔姆的凶手！"

column1: Begone! The Weeping Emperor will not be glad to see you."
column2: “滚开！悲泣皇帝不会乐意见到你。”

column1: But Orlanth was not in a mood to discuss this.
column2: 但奥兰斯没有心情讨论这个。

column1:
Step aside, Gold-Gryphon, or announce my presence.	“让开，金狮鹫，要么通报我的到来。
I've come too far to argue with a servant	我来得太远，没空与一个仆从争辩。
And I must warn you that killing you again	而且我必须警告你，再杀你一次
Will be no trouble for me.
column2: 对我来说轻而易举。”

column1: So Gryphon stepped aside, and Orlanth entered boldly into the hall. The blind Emperor stared with hollow eyes at Orlanth, and did not welcome him. His 294 judges, all rotten corpses, looked up with empty eyes upon the Lightbringers. All of them had worms eating the flesh from their faces and arms, and carrion spiders leapt all about.
column2: 于是狮鹫让开，奥兰斯无畏地走进了大厅。盲眼的皇帝用空洞的眼睛瞪着奥兰斯，没有欢迎他。他的二百九十四位判官——全部是腐烂的尸体——用空虚的眼神望向光明使者。他们脸上和手臂上的血肉都被蛆虫啃食，腐尸蜘蛛四处跳跃。

column1: Orlanth looked about the bleak hall. There sat Ernalda, a sorry and broken slave. Donandar sat with his broken harp. Mahome lay, huddled and cold, ashen. Flamal was there, dried like old leaves. Humakt was there; dull, rusty, and broken. Yinkin was there, murdered and nailed to the wall. And there too were all of the dead Vingkotlings, with raw wounds still bleeding, who had helped him along the way. There were others. There were more. This was the assembly of the gods.
column2: 奥兰斯环顾阴冷的大厅。厄纳尔达坐在那里，是一个凄惨、破碎的奴隶。多南达抱着他破碎的竖琴。马霍梅蜷缩着，冰冷而灰败。弗拉马尔也在那里，干枯如旧叶。胡马特也在那里，暗淡、生锈、破碎。因金也在那里，被谋杀后钉在墙上。还有所有死去的温戈特林人，身上带着仍在流血的伤口，他们曾一路帮助他。还有其他人，更多。这是众神的集会。

column1: Orlanth made his song of Truth. This released those in the hall who would help him, so they came forth and armed him in ragged splendor.
column2: 奥兰斯唱出了他的真理之歌。这解放了大厅中愿意帮助他的人，于是他们走上前来，用破旧却光彩的装备武装了他。

column1: Yelm demanded the Trial by Combat. Orlanth was taken to the Locked Gate, and he fought against all of the Keepers there. These were the monsters which kept the dead imprisoned, and they were the last of the deities to come into the Hall of the Dead. Orlanth came in with them.
column2: 耶尔姆要求决斗审判。奥兰斯被带到紧锁之门，与所有守门者战斗。这些是囚禁死者的怪物，它们是最后进入亡者大厅的神祇。奥兰斯与它们一同进入。

column1: Orlanth made his Promise of the Future. He said that there could be a future, and it would be like the past. Yelm demanded "Which past?" and Orlanth said, "Like all of them." The dead wept bitter dregs at that, for they were there because all things could not exist at once.
column2: 奥兰斯做出了未来之誓。他说可以有一个未来，它会像过去一样。耶尔姆问“哪个过去？”奥兰斯说：“像所有过去一样。”死者们为此流下苦涩的残泪，因为他们之所以在那里，是因为一切事物无法同时存在。

column1: Yelm made his Requirement for Proof. Three searing baths were prepared, and Orlanth submerged in each of them. They were baths of Fire, of Hatred, and of Truth. If he had not been in the Baths of Nelat before he would have died for certain, and been as gone as his brother whose name is not known today. This was when the support of all who loved him was important. And in the land of Life, the thousands of mortals suffering from the chaos of life woke from a nightmare, and prayed to Orlanth that it would not be so. Otherwise, he would have been destroyed. Chalana Arroy could not have prevented it.
column2: 耶尔姆提出了证据要求。准备了三次灼烧的浴池，奥兰斯浸入其中每一个。它们是火焰之浴、仇恨之浴和真理之浴。如果他之前没有经历过尼拉特浴池，他一定会死，并且像他那名字已不为人知的兄弟一样消失。这时，所有爱他之人的支持至关重要。在生者之地，成千上万遭受混沌之苦的凡人从噩梦中醒来，向奥兰斯祈祷，希望事情不要如此。否则，他就会被摧毁。查拉纳·阿罗伊也无法阻止。

column1: When Orlanth emerged alive, even the blind could see that he was changed. Those who had been silent cheered.
column2: 当奥兰斯活着出现时，就连盲者也能看出他改变了。那些一直沉默的人欢呼起来。

column1: Yelm made his Statement of Recognition, and by this agreed that Orlanth and all that he stood for truly deserved a place in the universe, and that Orlanth was High King among the gods, and that all hatred between Emperor and High King would be healed in whatever future might exist.
column2: 耶尔姆发表了承认声明，并由此同意奥兰斯及其所代表的一切真正值得在宇宙中拥有一席之地，奥兰斯是众神中的至高王，皇帝与至高王之间的一切仇恨将在任何可能存在的未来中得到弥合。

column1: Yelm then made his demand for Atonement. Orlanth made obeisance then, and acknowledged the power and majesty of Yelm's being and way of life, as long as it did not interfere with his own. This was satisfactory to the Emperor.
column2: 耶尔姆随后提出了赎罪的要求。奥兰斯于是俯首表示顺从，承认耶尔姆存在与生活方式的力量与威严，只要这一切不干涉他自己的存在。这对皇帝来说是可以接受的。

column1: Then Orlanth made his bid for friendship. Yelm was reluctant to do this, for it was not necessary for the world to work. Finally, after much pleading by Lodril, Dendara, Chalana Arroy, and others, Yelm agreed. After that things went easier, for their friendship was not necessary for the world, but it was better.
column2: 接着奥兰斯作出了友谊的请求。耶尔姆对此犹豫不决，因为这并非世界运转的必要。最终，在洛德里尔、登达拉、查拉纳·阿罗伊等人的多次恳求下，耶尔姆同意了。此后事情变得顺利，因为他们的友谊并非世界所需，却使世界更美好。

column1: Finally Orlanth and his companions reach the Hall of the Dead, where they find the other gods, wretched, withered, and bleeding. Even Ernalda, Orlanth's wife and goddess of the earth, is but a sorry and broken slave. Orlanth reaches an accord with his old enemy, the sun god Yelm, an accord which will make the world work again.
column2: 终于，奥兰斯和他的同伴到达了亡者大厅，在那里他们发现了其他众神，悲惨、枯萎、流血。就连奥兰斯的妻子、大地女神埃尔纳尔达也不过是一个可怜而破碎的奴隶。奥兰斯与他的宿敌太阳神耶尔姆达成了协议，一份能让世界重新运转的协议。
