Even Ernalda, Orlanth’s wife and goddess of the earth, is but a sorry and broken slave. Orlanth reaches an accord with his old enemy, the sun god Yelm, an accord which will make the world work again.
column2: 终于，奥兰斯和他的同伴到达了亡者大厅，在那里他们发现了其他众神，悲惨、枯萎、流血。就连奥兰斯的妻子、大地女神埃尔纳尔达也不过是一个可怜而破碎的奴隶。奥兰斯与他的宿敌太阳神耶尔姆达成了协议，一份能让世界重新运转的协议。

column1: When the gods spoke there were always changes in the world. When the gods spoke together for the first time, cooperatively, a new thing was made. This was the goddess called Arachne Solara. She is unknown before the moment that the gods spoke to each other, but important after that, for she kept them talking.
column2: 众神说话时，世界上总会有变化。当众神第一次合作说话时，一个新的东西被创造出来。那就是名为阿拉克妮·索拉拉的女神。在众神彼此交谈之前，她并不为人所知，但在此之后却很重要，因为她让他们继续交谈。

column1: When Orlanth and Yelm had agreed, Arachne Solara said that all of those present should agree. If they did, she said, they could make the new future which Orlanth had promised. Otherwise, they would be nothing when Wakboth came to them there. Everyone was afraid to see Wakboth, and they all agreed, and swore the oath which Arachne Solara told them to swear.
column2: 当奥兰斯和耶尔姆达成一致时，阿拉克妮·索拉拉说在场的所有人都应该同意。她说，如果他们同意了，就能创造奥兰斯所承诺的新未来。否则，当瓦克博斯来到他们那里时，他们就会化为虚无。每个人都害怕见到瓦克博斯，于是他们都同意了，并发誓遵守阿拉克妮·索拉拉让他们立下的誓言。

column1: This agreement between the gods is called the Cosmic Compromise. All of the deities agreed to share the world with each other, and with all of the experiences which they had already had. No one was allowed to avoid what they did not like, and so all of the gods agreed that they would share their time among both Life and Death. They agreed that they would not actively intervene in each other's realms except in those ways which they had already done. They would not individually or consciously alter the world. They would not even turn their awareness to it, unless called upon to do so.
column2: 这份诸神之间的协议被称为宇宙妥协。所有神祇都同意彼此分享世界，以及他们已经拥有的一切经历。没有人可以逃避他们不喜欢的事物，因此所有神祇都同意在生与死之间分享他们的时间。他们同意不会主动干预彼此领域，除非以他们已经做过的方式。他们不会单独或有意识地改变世界。他们甚至不会将意识转向世界，除非被召唤这样做。

column1: Upon this relationship of promises, Arachne Solara constructed a great magical web which was made from things which did not exist anymore. Then she gave the net to all of the gods to hold between them, to catch and wrap up whatever came among them.
column2: 在这承诺关系之上，阿拉克妮·索拉拉建造了一张巨大的魔法网，它由不再存在的事物制成。然后她将网交给所有神祇，让他们一起持握，用来捕捉并包裹任何来到他们中间的东西。

column1: It was Wakboth the Devil that came. Wakboth came in among the gods when he had killed everything in the middle world. The gods cast the great net upon him, and drew it tight the way hunters do when they capture the mighty cave bear, and held it tight so the Devil was helpless. Then Arachne Solara leapt upon the Devil with vengeance and a strength of desperation and mystical splendor. She wrapped the Chaos god in her legs and her web, and with every orifice she sucked everything out of the Devil and filled herself with it. The empty husk was ground into dust and each god who was present took a tiny piece, to remind them of their oath.
column2: 到来的是恶魔瓦克博斯。当瓦克博斯杀死了中界的一切之后，他来到了众神之中。众神将巨网抛向他，像猎人捕获强大的洞穴熊时那样收紧网，紧紧握住，让恶魔无助。然后阿拉克妮·索拉拉带着复仇、绝望的力量和神秘的荣光扑向恶魔。她用腿和网缠绕住混沌神，用每一个孔窍吸出了恶魔的一切并将其充满自身。空壳被磨成粉末，每位在场的众神都取了一小片，以提醒他们的誓言。

column1: Then the goddess took the net and hung it about her to conceal the birth of her child. Her child is the Pledge of the Gods, and all of existence swore upon it to uphold their agreements. This oath is nothing less than the recreated world, and if any deity denies the oath they threaten the whole world.
column2: 随后女神拿起网挂在自己身上，以隐藏她孩子的诞生。她的孩子是诸神誓言，所有存在都在其上宣誓遵守他们的协议。这个誓言无异于被重新创造的世界，如果任何神祇否认誓言，他们就威胁整个世界。

column2: 奥兰斯和耶尔姆的协议被称为宇宙妥协。它创造了一位新的女神，阿拉克妮·索拉拉，她织了一张网，并向众神展示了如何使用它。用她的网，他们束缚了恶魔，她吸干了恶魔的力量，直到它只剩空壳。

column1: After all of this, Orlanth was surrounded by his family, companions, and followers and accorded a great triumphant procession as they marched out of the underworld to the Eastern Gates. Before them went Yelm and his companions, clearing the way and announcing the good news to all whom they met.
column2: 在这之后，奥兰斯被他的家人、同伴和追随者环绕，并获得了盛大的凯旋队伍，当他们从冥界行进到东门时。在他们前面，耶尔姆和他的同伴开路，并向他们遇到的所有人宣告好消息。

column1: At the Eastern Gates they all assembled once again while Mostal repaired the gates. The great chariot of the sun was prepared, and Yelm was taken aboard.
column2: 在东门，他们再次聚集，同时莫斯塔尔修理着大门。太阳的伟大战车已经备好，耶尔姆被带上了车。

column1: Arachne Solara slipped through a tiny crack and stood upon the edge of creation. Before her the fragmented parts of the world were slowly drifting apart, dissolving into chaos. She then cast her mighty net wide, gripping all the parts of the world together again and pulling them close, like you can do with a string bag. There she revealed her child, Time, and sent it with its 294 servants into the world.
column2: 阿拉克涅·索拉拉穿过一道细小的裂隙，站到了创世的边缘。在她面前，世界的碎片正缓缓漂散，消融于混沌之中。于是她撒开巨网，将所有碎片重新收拢，紧束在一起，如同你可用网兜做到的那样。在那里，她显露出自己的孩子——时间，并令其带着二百九十四名仆从进入世界。

column1: The Gates of Dawn were thrown open. The ghostly gods of Time were already disappearing into the Future. As one, in perfect harmony, the great gods occupied their proper spheres of the world: Yelm ascended into the Sky; Orlanth filled the Air; Ernalda occupied the Earth; Magasta turned the ocean; and Subere revitalized the underworld. When Orlanth and Ernalda again looked upon each other, fresh and full of life again, they embraced as fully as immortals can embrace, and from that moment was born Voria, the Goddess of Spring.
column2: 黎明之门被轰然推开。时间的幽灵诸神已消逝于未来。诸大神完美和谐地各归其位：耶尔姆升入天空；奥兰斯充塞大气；厄娜尔达占据大地；马加斯塔转动海洋；苏贝雷使冥界重焕生机。当奥兰斯与厄娜尔达再次相视，重现生机与活力，他们以不朽者所能拥抱的方式紧紧相拥，从那一刻起，春之女神沃里亚诞生了。

column1: That is how Orlanth and the Lightbringers brought the world, once again, into the sweetness and wonder of Life.
column2: 这便是奥兰斯与光明使者们如何将世界再次带回生命之甘美与奇迹的故事。

column1: The dead gods return to life, and the sun god Yelm reascends to his rightful place in the sky. Amid much celebration, Orlanth and Ernalda are reunited; the Great Darkness is ended. So long as people obey the strictures of the Cosmic Compromise, Chaos will not return.
column2: 亡故的诸神回归生命，太阳神耶尔姆重登他在天空中应得的位置。在无尽的欢庆中，奥兰斯与厄娜尔达重聚；大黑暗就此终结。只要人们遵从宇宙妥协的约束，混沌便不会归来。

column1: This is the journey which Orlanth and his companions took. There were four stages in their journey. The first took them to the edge of the world. The second through the underworld. The third was in the deepest pit of the underworld, in the Palace of the Dead. And the last a return to the eastern horizon and above.
column2: 这便是奥兰斯及其同伴所行的旅程。他们的旅程有四个阶段。第一阶段将他们带至世界边缘。第二阶段穿越冥界。第三阶段在冥界最深处的亡者之殿。最后一段则返回东方地平线之上。

column1: Some fool thane kills one of your pigs with a bad shot. Two clansmen take the deer you killed off the drying rack and split it with their families. A clumsy carl accidentally maims your brother-in-law while raising a new stead. What can you do to these people? You could beat them up, or even kill them, but is that going to bring Justice, or will the clansmen you’ve thrashed hold a grudge? Like Ernalda, who taught Orlanth that violence was not the only option, our Lawspeakers say, “There is always another way.” Certainly Ernalda never advised Orlanth to sue the fools who’d offended him and take their sheep, but this is how the path of Justice often works out within our clans! Take your case to the Lawspeaker. Be prepared to speak your piece and appeal to the law, precedents, and Orlanth’s justice. You may be compensated for the damage you’ve suffered, or maybe you’ll just get the chance to beat up the one who wounded you with Justice on your side of the fight. Or if the problem is with a member of the clan who is beyond the reach of violence, like an angry ghost, law may be the only way to solve the dispute — more than one local haunting has been resolved by a well-spoken case long after the god-talkers have been routed with their clothes on fire! So long as we aren’t slow to swing a sword against our real enemies, Orlanth smiles on a just argument between Air tribesmen.
column2: 某个愚蠢的乡勇射箭失误，杀死了一头你的猪。两个族人从晾架上拿走你猎杀的鹿，与家人分食。一个笨拙的自耕农在搭建新宅时意外致残你的姻亲。你能拿这些人怎么办？你可以揍他们，甚至杀了他们，但这会带来正义吗？还是说被你痛揍的族人会怀恨在心？如同厄娜尔达曾教导奥兰斯暴力并非唯一选择那样，我们的律法师说：“总有另一条路。”诚然，厄娜尔达从未建议奥兰斯去起诉冒犯他的蠢人并夺走他们的羊，但这正是正义之路在我们氏族内通常的运作方式！把你的案子交给律法师。准备好你的说辞，援引法律、先例和奥兰斯的正义。你可能会因受到的损害获得补偿，或者你也许只是有机会在正义站在你这边时揍那个伤害你的人。如果问题出在某个暴力无法触及的族人身上，比如一个愤怒的鬼魂，那么律法或许是解决争端的唯一方法——不止一次，在神言者们衣衫着火被赶跑之后，一个措辞得当的案子便解决了当地的作祟事件！只要我们挥剑砍向真正敌人时不犹豫，奥兰斯便会对风之民之间的公正辩论微笑。

column1: The truth has always been difficult to find. Even the greatest of us can grasp only portions of it. But during the Greater Darkness, just before the Lightbringers Quest, the truth was lost entirely.
column2: 真相向来难以寻觅。即便我们中最伟大者也只能把握其中片段。但在大黑暗时期，就在光明使者追寻前夕，真相完全失落了。

column1: It was Eurmal's fault, as usual. The trickster twisted the truth so that no one could recognize it. Then Issaries, the Talking-Too-Much God, took it and sold it to someone far away. It was up to Lhankor Mhy to get it back.
column2: 和往常一样，这是尤尔马尔的错。这恶作剧者扭曲了真相，以至于无人能识辨。然后，多言之神伊萨里斯将它拿走，卖给了远方的某人。找回真相的任务落到了兰科尔·米身上。

column1: Lhankor Mhy needed help. He thought for a moment about making Eurmal come along to atone for his misdeeds, but he knew that tricksters always betray you when you go on an important quest. He did allow Issaries to come and assist him, for he knew that the Talking-Too-Much God hadn't intended to sell the truth. Lhankor Mhy also sought the aid of Urox, the Storm Bull, knowing that you often stir up unpleasant and dangerous things when the truth is found.
column2: 兰科尔·米需要帮助。他想了一下，是否让尤尔马尔同来以赎其过，但他知道恶作剧者总会在你执行重要追寻时背叛你。他允许伊萨里斯同来协助，因为他知道多言之神并非有意出售真相。兰科尔·米还寻求风暴公牛乌洛克斯的帮助，因为他知道当真相被找到时，往往会搅起不快而危险的东西。

column1: Issaries knew who he'd sold the truth to. Unfortunately, it was someone on the distant continent of Southland, across the ocean. Fortunately, at the time there was a shortcut that took you there quickly, without any need for a boat. (Scholars have tried for many centuries to rediscover the shortcut, and there are many conflicting theories as to where it is.)
column2: 伊萨里斯知道他卖给了谁。不幸的是，那是大洋彼岸遥远南方大陆上的某人。幸运的是，当时有一条捷径可以快速到达那里，无需船只。（学者们已经尝试了许多世纪来重新发现这条捷径，关于其所在之处有许多相互冲突的理论。）

column1: On the way to the shortcut, Urox had to fight many Chaos beasts. He fought broos, gorp, slimekin, ghouls, and krarshtkids. He also rendered another seven types of Chaos creature extinct along the way.
column2: 在前往捷径的路上，乌洛克斯不得不与众多混沌兽战斗。他与布鲁斯、果尔普、泥怪、食尸鬼和克拉什特子嗣交战。沿途他还令另外七种混沌生物灭绝。

column1: Once through the shortcut, Issaries began to cause problems. He lost interest in the all-important quest to find the truth, instead concerning himself with the affairs of a tribe of foreigners, and their troubles with a war between the Mammoths and the Sabretooth Tigers. He did take Lhankor Mhy to see the god to whom he'd sold the truth, though.
column2: 一穿过捷径，伊萨里斯就开始制造麻烦。他对寻找真理这一至关重要的任务失去了兴趣，反而只顾着一群异族部落的事务，以及他们与猛犸和剑齿虎之间的战争纠纷。不过，他确实带兰科·穆去见了那位他出卖真理的神。

column1: That god was called Grandbread. He ate knowledge like it was food. He was trying to untwist the truth so he could pound it into meal, cook it into loaves of bread, and devour it. This way no one else would have it, ever, and he would become more powerful than any other god, because all the truth would be inside of him.
column2: 那位神名叫大面包。他吞噬知识如同进食。他正试图解开扭曲的真理，好将它捣成粉、烤成面包、再吞食掉。这样，就再也没有其他人能拥有真理，而他将变得比任何神都强大，因为所有真理都将藏于他体内。

column1: Lhankor Mhy offered to help Grandbread, untwist the truth, if only he would promise not to eat it. Grandbread refused, so they had to fight. They fought with questions. The first one to fail to answer the other's question would lose the truth forever. They asked and answered questions for a long time, until they both became very hungry. Grandbread grew so famished that he tried to eat the truth as it was, in its sharp and twisted form. The thorns of the distorted truth punctured his stomach, so that his torso opened up and the truth fell back out of him again.
column2: 兰科·穆提出帮助大面包解开真理，只要他承诺不吃掉它。大面包拒绝了，于是他们不得不开战。他们用问题交锋。第一个答不上对方问题的人将永远失去真理。他们一问一答持续了很久，直到双方都饥肠辘辘。大面包饿极了，竟试图直接吃掉仍呈尖锐扭曲形态的真理。扭曲真理的尖刺刺穿了他的胃，他的躯干裂开，真理又从他体内掉了出来。

column1: Lhankor Mhy asked him why he had done this, and he could not answer, for he would not admit that he had been greedy and foolish. So he lost the contest, and with it, all truth, forever. Yet in taking something from Grandbread, Lhankor Mhy gained a fraction of the foreign god's possessiveness. (This is why we Lhankor Mhy initiates must struggle with the temptation to hoard the truth, even today.) Grandbread then became a useless god. Nobody bothered to reawaken him after the Lightbringers Quest brought an end to the Darkness.
column2: 兰科·穆问他为何这么做，他答不上来，因为他不愿承认自己贪婪又愚蠢。于是他输了这场较量，并随之永远失去了所有真理。然而，从大面包那里夺走某样东西的同时，兰科·穆也沾染了一丝这位异族神的占有欲。（这就是为什么直到今天，我们兰科·穆的学徒仍必须与囤积真理的诱惑抗争。）大面包从此沦为一个无用的神。在光明使者追寻终结黑暗之后，也无人费心去唤醒他。

column1: Now Lhankor Mhy had the truth, but it was still twisted. He pushed at it and pulled at it. He sweated and paced and said the words we are not supposed to say in front of children and old women. Whenever he straightened part of it, another part went crooked. Whenever he buffed and polished a portion of its surface, another portion tarnished. He put the leather sheet over his head, which was the way to gain hidden knowledge before the truth was lost. But everytime he looked up from under the sheet, the truth had gotten more tangled, not less.
column2: 现在兰科·穆拥有了真理，但它仍是扭曲的。他推它、拉它。他大汗淋漓、来回踱步，说出了那些不该在孩子和老妇人面前说的话。每当他将一部分捋直，另一部分又变弯。每当他打磨抛光一段表面，另一段又变得晦暗。他把皮草蒙在头上——这是在真理失落之前获取隐秘知识的方法。但每次他从皮草下面抬头看，真理反而缠得更乱，没有变顺。

column1: As Lhankor Mhy was struggling with the truth, Issaries came to him three times. Each time he had stupid questions to ask about his pointless attempt to make peace between the predators and the prey.
column2: 当兰科·穆正与真理苦斗时，伊萨里斯三次来找他。每次他都问些愚蠢的问题，关于他那让捕食者与猎物和解的无谓尝试。

column1: The first time, Lhankor Mhy said, "You are keeping Urox busy, and that is good. But otherwise your silly questions have nothing to do with finding the truth. Without the truth, the Chaos things will win. Go away, and do not trouble me further."
column2: 第一次，兰科·穆说：“你让乌洛克斯忙个不停，这很好。但除此之外，你那些蠢问题与寻找真理毫无关系。没有真理，混沌之物就会获胜。走吧，别再烦我了。”

column1: The second time, Lhankor Mhy said, "Can't you see what I'm trying to do here? The truth is all mixed up! Evil is good, down is up, and Orlanth is a small, red nut! The thing I am saying is that it's turned to lies, all of it. And you come to ask me about a pair of worthless, insignificant animal gods who do not even belong to our clan?"
column2: 第二次，兰科·穆说：“你看不出我正在做什么吗？真理完全乱套了！邪恶成了善良，下变为了上，奥兰斯成了一颗红色小坚果！我说的就是它全部变成了谎言。而你却跑来问我关于两个毫无价值、微不足道的动物神的事，它们甚至不属于我们的氏族？”

column1: The third time, Lhankor Mhy was exhausted. He was so tired that the same empty thought had been running around in his mind for hours. It was an old solution he'd already tried, one that didn't work the first time. But he was at his wit's end, so he just sighed at this latest interruption and said, "You speak of Oriska the Mammoth Goddess and Paratur the Sabretooth God. Remember, Oriska is just a very large cow with fur, big ears, and tusks. Paratur is nothing but an overgrown alynx. Treat them accordingly."
column2: 第三次，兰科·穆已经筋疲力尽。他累得头脑中同一个空洞念头来回打转了好几个钟头。那是他早已试过的旧方法，第一次就不管用。但他已无计可施，只好对着这又一次打断叹了口气，说道：“你说的是猛犸女神奥里斯卡和剑齿虎神帕拉图尔。记住，奥里斯卡不过是一头带毛、长着大耳朵和獠牙的巨型母牛。帕拉图尔只是一只长得过大的山猫。照此对待它们即可。”

column1: Issaries left without a word of thanks, and Lhankor Mhy turned back to look at the truth. It wasn't twisted any more! Lhankor Mhy tried to figure this out. At length, he decided that, in responding quickly to Issaries, without much thought, he had stopped trying to mold the truth into the shape he wanted it to be. He had instead allowed the truth to come to him. Contemplating this thought, and looking at the restored truth, in all its purity, simplicity, and glory, Lhankor Mhy allowed another truth to come to him. And this was the One Great Truth, the one told only at initiation time, to those who dedicate their lives to emulating the Knowing God.
column2: 伊萨里斯不道一声谢就走了，兰科·米转身重新审视真理。它不再扭曲了！兰科·米试图弄清缘由。良久，他断定，自己当时未经深思便匆忙回应伊萨里斯，无意中停止了将真理塑造成心中所想的形状。相反，他让真理自行靠近。沉思着这个念头，望着那恢复原状的真理——纯净、质朴而辉煌——兰科·米让另一条真理也流向他。这便是那唯一大真理，只在入教时刻传授给那些毕生追随全知之神的人。

column2: 伊萨里斯离去，未留下一句感谢，兰科尔·姆伊转身望向真理。它不再扭曲！兰科尔·姆伊试图弄清原委。良久，他意识到，自己匆忙回应伊萨里斯、未及深思时，便不再试图将真理塑造成他想要的形状。他反而让真理自行显现。沉思此念，望着恢复原状的真理——如此纯净、简单而光辉——兰科尔·姆伊容许另一真理向他显现。这便是唯一大真理，只在启蒙时刻，传授给那些献身效仿全知之神的人。

column1: Lhankor Mhy Finds The Truth
column2: 兰科尔·姆伊发现真相

column1: During the Great Darkness, the Truth gets twisted into an unrecognizable shape and then lost. Lhankor Mhy journeys to a distant place to find it. He wins a contest with a forgotten god, and comes to a realization that enables him to untwist the thing he has found, so that it becomes the Truth again.
column2: 在大黑暗时期，真理被扭曲得面目全非，继而丢失。兰科尔·姆伊前往远方寻找它。他在一场竞赛中胜过一位被遗忘之神，并领悟到一种认知，使他能解开所寻之物的扭曲，使之重归为真理。

column1: There came a time when the rich splendor which Ernalda had given to Orlanth began to fade and dwindle. This troubled the god and he sought to learn the cause.
column2: 曾有一时，厄尔纳尔达赐予奥兰斯的丰饶荣光开始消退、缩减。这令神忧心，他试图查明缘由。

column1: Only one person is doing this, said Ernalda, "but I have refrained from telling you, dear husband, because I know that you honor kinship so much. I would never wish to aggravate an already bad situation."
column2: “只有一人所为，”厄尔纳尔达说道，“但我一直未告诉你，亲爱的丈夫，因我知道你如此珍视亲族之情。我绝不愿让本已糟糕的局面雪上加霜。”

column1: The world is poorer for your silence, said Orlanth. "Our own people suffer and go hungry. Tell me, good wife."
column2: “因你的沉默，世界更显贫瘠，”奥兰斯说道。“我们的人民在受苦挨饿。告诉我吧，贤妻。”

column1: At your command, oh husband, I will instigate kinstrife. Your nephew is the cause of our woe. He is drying my yields and starving the world. His name is Daga, the son of Molanni, your niece.
column2: “遵你之命，哦，丈夫，我将挑起亲族争斗。你的外甥是我们苦难的根源。他正使我收成干涸，令世界饥荒。其名达加，莫兰尼之子，你的侄女。”

column1: I have fought with my brothers already, and most of my nephews as well. For you, sweet wife, I will go and speak to him, and then I will threaten him, and then I will curse him, and then I will drive him off or kill him.
column2: “我已与我的兄弟们争斗过，也与其他多数外甥交过手。为了你，娇妻，我将前去与他交谈，然后我会威胁他，再施以诅咒，最后赶走他或杀死他。”

column1: There is more, my love, to know of your foe. His father is your Enemy, the tyrant who would hold all of the world in his hand. Yelm is the father of Daga, born to shameless Molanni.
column2: “还有更多，我的爱，关于你的敌人。他的父亲是你的宿敌，那个妄图掌控整个世界的暴君。耶尔姆是达加之父，由无耻的莫兰尼所生。”

column1: Then my decision is made. I will seek him and kill him, and treat him as they treated Young Varnaval. Then I should find my kinswoman, daughter of my brother, and teach her the lessons of the storm. Thus she will be ruined… and another dishonor heaped upon my family and my name.
column2: “那么我心意已决。我将找到他并杀了他，待他如同他们待年轻的瓦纳瓦尔一般。然后我会找到我的女亲属，我兄弟的女儿，给她上风暴的一课。这样她将被毁……又一份耻辱将加诸我的家族和我的名号。”

column1: We shall eat, said Ernalda. "The people will love you."
column2: “我们将有食物，”厄尔纳尔达说道。“人民会爱戴你。”

column1: And Orlanth went off, and fought against Daga, but he was unable to win. Daga was a specter, a wan and frightening thing without substance to strike or force to scatter. Orlanth thundered and raged at Daga, but nothing he did had any effect. Neither could Daga hurt Orlanth, so soon Daga turned and simply ignored the god.
column2: 奥兰斯出发，与达加交战，却无法取胜。达加是一个幽灵，苍白可怖，没有实体可击，也无力量可驱散。奥兰斯对达加雷霆咆哮，但所做的一切毫无效果。达加也无法伤害奥兰斯，于是达加很快转身，干脆无视了这位神。

column1: The people had seen Orlanth come forth to fight, and they cried out to him, not knowing that he was powerless to overcome their foe. Hearing their cries, Orlanth knew he had to find a way to win. Orlanth sought a long while, testing many weapons and inventing many new attacks, but he was no closer to success when Ernalda came to him again.
column2: 人们看到奥兰斯出来战斗，向他呼喊，不知他无力战胜敌人。听到呼喊声，奥兰斯知道自己必须找到制胜之道。奥兰斯寻找了许久，试了许多武器，发明了许多新招式，但距离成功仍遥不可及，这时厄尔纳尔达再次来到他面前。

column1: Husband, forgive me, for I was wrong when I said that there was only one who has acted against our people. There is another foe, and that other has also turned on its kin.
column2: “丈夫，原谅我，我说只有一个敌人作祟时错了。还有另一个敌人，那一个也反叛了它的亲族。”

column1: Wife, you bring welcome news, because if there is another who has broken ties, and no kin of mine, my strength will not fail. Who aids Daga?
column2: “妻子，你带来佳音，因为若有另一个断绝关系者，且非我亲族，我的力量便不会衰减。谁在协助达加？”

column1: Your old enemy, the Blue Tribe, my lord, have called upon the powers of the deep. Aroka the Blue Dragon has answered the call. Aroka crawled in secret to the stead of Heler, the Lord of Rain, and ravaged Heler's stead until Heler came to defend his home. And although Heler is the Blue Tribe's own, Aroka swallowed him whole, and now the monster hides within its lair, holding the rain that could protect the people from Daga.
column2: “您的旧敌蓝部落，我的主上，召唤了深海的力量。蓝龙阿罗卡响应了召唤。阿罗卡暗中爬往雨神赫勒尔的居所，大肆破坏直到赫勒尔前来守护家园。尽管赫勒尔是蓝部落的神祇，阿罗卡还是将他整个吞下，如今那怪物藏在其巢穴中，扣留着本可保护人民免受达加之害的雨水。”

column1: I have fought with the Blue Tribe already. I have beaten the Blue Tribe's elders and tricked its champions. I have blasted the Blue Tribe's armies and slain its magicians. I will teach this dragon the lessons of the storm.
column2: “我已与蓝部落交过战。我击败了蓝部落的长老，诱骗了它的勇士。我摧毁了蓝部落的军队，杀死了它的法师。我将给这头龙上风暴的一课。”

column1: Aroka had great powers: its eyes could paralyze any intelligent thing, its tongue could choke any physical thing, and its breath could destroy any spirit.
column2: 阿罗卡拥有强大力量：它的目光能麻痹任何有智之物，它的舌头能扼杀任何有形之物，它的吐息能毁灭任何灵体。

column1: Orlanth prepared himself against the monster. He brought a sack with the Four Winds in it, an ancient flint sword called a klanth, a twisted vine which held the Upper Wind, and a leather rope which held the Lower Wind. He spent a year chanting songs of power, and ate of Ernalda's Splendorbread and drank crazy black Widebrew.
column2: 奥兰斯为对抗怪物做好准备。他带来一只装着四方之风的口袋，一把名为克兰特斯的古老燧石剑，一根缠绕着上界之风的扭曲藤蔓，以及一根束缚着下界之风的皮绳。他用了一整年吟唱力量之歌，并食用了埃尔纳尔达的光辉面包，饮用了疯狂的黑色苦艾酒。

column1: Orlanth was delayed on his voyage, first by Krakos, the troll avenger, who was angry because Orlanth broke his father's legs. Orlanth defeated him, and took his Darkwind.
column2: 奥兰斯在旅途中被耽搁了，先是遇到食人魔复仇者克拉科斯，他因奥兰斯打断了他父亲的腿而愤怒。奥兰斯击败了他，并夺取了他的暗风。

column1: Then came Gagarth, the left blowing wind. Orlanth beat him, too. He took the Wind of Above from him.
column2: 接着来了加加斯，那向左吹的风。奥兰斯也击败了他。他从他那里夺走了上界之风。

column1: As he traveled Orlanth reached the Place of Strangers, and there he met the Dark Woman. Their child was born later, and it was called Crushing Noise.
column2: 旅行途中，奥兰斯抵达了异乡之地，在那里他遇到了黑暗女子。他们的孩子后来出生，被命名为粉碎之音。

column1: At last Orlanth found the lair of Aroka, which lay past the Poisonthorn Acre. Orlanth came out of the north to attack. Aroka the dragon refused to rise to confront the approaching god.
column2: 最终，奥兰斯找到了阿罗卡的巢穴，它位于毒刺之地之外。奥兰斯从北方出现发起攻击。巨龙阿罗卡拒绝起身迎战逼近的神明。

column1: Orlanth released the Darkwind first, which bears the howls of lost souls. It filled the creature's lair so it could not bear to be in it, and so it rose to fight.
column2: 奥兰斯首先释放了暗风，其中承载着迷失灵魂的嚎叫。暗风充满了怪物的巢穴，使它无法忍受待在里面，于是它起身战斗。

column1: First Aroka opened its eyes to destroy the mind of Orlanth. The storm god released the Four Winds and they cast their weapons at the eyes of the dragon, blinding it.
column2: 阿罗卡先睁开双眼，企图摧毁奥兰斯的心智。风暴之神释放了四方之风，它们将武器掷向巨龙的眼睛，使其失明。

column1: Aroka lashed out with its tongues. Orlanth released the Upper Wind, and this dried out the snaking enemy.
column2: 阿罗卡用它的舌头猛击。奥兰斯释放了上界之风，这风使那蛇形敌人变得干涸。

column1: Aroka roared out its fatal breath, but Orlanth captured it inside the magical Sack of Winds and threw it away.
column2: 阿罗卡喷出致命的吐息，但奥兰斯将其收入魔法风袋中，并扔了出去。

column1: Then Orlanth strode into its mouth and seized the upper jaw with his hands, and placed his foot against its lower jaw, and with a shout of victory tore the dragon asunder. A great flood of blood, water, and mead swept over the land. Inside was Heler, the rain god, who was Orlanth's friend afterwards.
column2: 接着，奥兰斯大步走进它的嘴里，双手抓住它的上颚，脚抵住它的下颚，随着一声胜利的呐喊，将巨龙撕成两半。巨大的血、水和蜂蜜酒洪流席卷了大地。里面是雨神海勒尔，他从此成了奥兰斯的朋友。

column1: Heler and Orlanth went against Daga, pounding the land and covering it with rain. Orlanth captured Daga and put him in an iron jar. Soon Ernalda was nourishing again, and Drought was banished for as long as Orlanth was chieftain. So long as people are not selfish, and are not foolish enough to let him out by propitiating him, Daga remains safely in the jar.
column2: 海勒尔和奥兰斯一同对抗达加，猛烈冲击大地并降下雨水。奥兰斯俘虏了达加，将他放入一只铁罐中。不久，埃尔纳尔达再次滋养万物，只要奥兰斯担任酋长，干旱就被驱逐。只要人们不自私，也不愚蠢到通过供奉他将他放出，达加就会安然待在罐中。

column1: Drought strikes the land, so Orlanth seeks out Aroka, a dragon summoned by the watery Blue Tribe. Orlanth slays Aroka, releasing the rain god Heler from the dragon's belly. Heler then ends the drought.
column2: 干旱袭击了大地，于是奥兰斯寻找到阿罗卡，一条由水之蓝部落召唤的巨龙。奥兰斯杀死阿罗卡，将雨神海勒尔从龙腹中释放出来。海勒尔随后终结了干旱。

column1: Once, a single Law ruled all of the Old World. But after Orlanth came, the Old World was not big enough to contain a single Law. In those days, no one knew how to settle arguments without fighting. Everyone was fighting, and it was called the War of the Gods. Even kinfolk were fighting, until Orlanth established the Rite of Justice.
column2: 从前，一部单一法则统治着整个旧世界。但奥兰斯到来之后，旧世界便容不下一部单一法则了。那些日子里，无人知晓如何在不诉诸战斗的情况下解决争端。人人都在争斗，这被称为众神之战。甚至连亲族之间也在争斗，直到奥兰斯建立了正义仪式。

column1: Orlanth was called to Arrowmound, that mountain in the Skyreach range.
column2: 奥兰斯被召唤到箭丘，即天界山脉中的那座山。

column1: Jarani Whitetop, the Mountain Glider, occupied Arrowmound. Jarani is the son of Ragorn, the son of Jorganos Archer, the son of King Vingkot Orlanthsson. He claimed the land by right of Possession. He had family and servants, a wall he made around the stead, and a guard with two faces. He kept there the White Sheep of Voriof, and guarded them with the Bow of Jorganos.
column2: 山地滑行者雅拉尼·白头占据了箭丘。雅拉尼是拉戈恩之子，拉戈恩是乔加诺斯射手之子，乔加诺斯射手是文戈特·奥兰斯森王之子。他凭借占有权宣称那片土地。他有家族和仆从，在宅地周围筑墙，还有一名双面守卫。他在那里守护着沃里奥夫的白羊，并用约尔加诺斯之弓保卫它们。

column1: Arrowmound was under siege by Harand Boardick, the son of Harast the Brave and Ornay daughter of King Drorgalar Orlanthsson. Harand was married to Urgkronika, the sow wife. Harand claimed that Arrowmound should be his, by right of Establishment, and had many witnesses ready to support his truth.
column2: 箭丘正遭到哈兰德·博迪克的围攻，他是勇敢的哈拉斯特与国王德罗加拉尔·奥兰斯森之女奥奈的儿子。哈兰德娶了乌尔格克罗尼卡，那位猪妻。哈兰德声称箭丘应归他所有，凭借建立权，并有许多证人准备支持他的真相。

column1: Both claimed the right to the aid of Orlanth, who had established both Possession and Establishment as laws. And both claimed Orlanth's kinship.
column2: 双方都宣称有权得到奥兰斯的援助，因为奥兰斯既确立了占有权也确立了建立权为法令。双方都宣称与奥兰斯有亲缘关系。

column1: Orlanth spent the night in the sky, and plummeted to earth again at dawn. He brought with him the Justice Wand, and the way to use it.
column2: 奥兰斯在天空过了一夜，黎明时再次坠向大地。他带来了正义魔杖，以及使用它的方法。

column1: Orlanth himself was the first Lawspeaker. He pacified and protected the combatants, recited the conditions, and invoked the prayer to call for divine guidance. Lawspeaker explained to everyone the three stages of their commitment, where to stand, and how to put their hands and feet. Lawspeaker suspended the Wand of Justice, and directed each litigant to hold it.
column2: 奥兰斯本人就是第一位律法师。他安抚并保护了参战双方，宣读了条件，并祈祷召唤神谕。律法师向众人解释了承诺的三个阶段、站立的位置以及手脚的放置方式。律法师悬挂起正义之杖，并指导每个诉讼人握住它。

column1: Harand, husband of Urgkronika, was burnt, and could not hold a sword for the time it took his next son to grow to manhood. Orlanth ruled that Justice itself had shown that the claim of Jarani was more correct, and so he was named Lord of the Mountains. Ever since then the Harandings have not been friends with the Vingkotlings.
column2: 乌尔格克罗尼卡的丈夫哈兰德被灼伤，在他下一子成长到成年之前都无法持剑。奥兰斯裁定，正义本身已表明雅拉尼的主张更为正确，因此雅拉尼被册封为群山之王。自那以后，哈兰德氏族与文戈特氏族便不再友好。

column1: Harand then swore to take the land, and prove the natural and ageless Law of Violence. Jarani taunted him as "son of the Brave" and "pig general." Harand got help from the Forces of Darkness. He gave his son to Jogo Zaramzil, who led another army of trolls and men against the fortress of Jarani, Lord of the Mountaintops.
column2: 于是哈兰德发誓要夺取土地，以证明自然且永恒的暴力法则。雅拉尼嘲笑他为“勇敢者之子”和“猪将军”。哈兰德从黑暗势力那里获得了帮助。他将自己的儿子交给了约戈·扎拉姆齐尔，后者率领另一支巨魔与人类军队进攻山顶之王雅拉尼的堡垒。

column1: When Harand and Jogo Zaramzil attacked, many defenders were slain, including the son of Jarani. The two-faced guardian was killed defending the gate. Then Jarani's wife recited the call for help. The Lord of Justice had pledged to uphold the claim, and he had been formally called, so Orlanth helped Jarani in his fight. Together they threw the enemy down from the mountains, and confined them to the valleys for as long as the wind blows. This was called the Battle of Arrowmound.
column2: 当哈兰德与约戈·扎拉姆齐尔发起进攻时，许多守卫者被杀，其中包括雅拉尼的儿子。双面守卫在守卫大门时战死。随后雅拉尼的妻子念诵了求援的呼唤。正义之主曾承诺维护这项主张，且已被正式召唤，因此奥兰斯帮助雅拉尼作战。他们一同将敌人从山上扔下，并将他们囚禁在山谷中，直到永远。这被称为箭丘之战。

column1: Orlanth healed all of the casualties, and they swore to serve forever as the Guardians of Justice.
column2: 奥兰斯治愈了所有伤亡者，他们发誓永远效忠，成为正义的守护者。

column1: Jarani raised a monument to commemorate the event, and to be the place where he would pass on a Wand to whatever Lawspeaker qualified for one, and made sacrifice to Orlanth for this honor. The altar is called the Jarani Stones.
column2: 雅拉尼立起一座纪念碑以纪念此事，并以此地作为他将正义魔杖传给任何有资格获得的律法师之所，并为这份荣耀向奥兰斯献祭。这座祭坛被称为雅拉尼之石。

column1: Our ancestor King Heort was the first man to go to the Jarani Stones. He returned with the Justice Staff, and since then our lawspeakers revere Heort as well.
column2: 我们的祖先赫尔特王是第一个前往雅拉尼之石的人。他带着正义之杖归来，从此我们的律法师也敬奉赫尔特。

column1: Both claimed the right to the aid of Orlanth, who had established both Possession and Establishment as laws. And both claimed Orlanth’s kinship.
column2: 双方都声称有权获得奥兰斯的援助，奥兰斯既确立了占有权，也确立了定居权为律法。双方都自称与奥兰斯有亲缘关系。

column1: Harand then swore to take the land, and prove the natural and ageless Law of Violence. Jarani taunted him as “son of the Brave” and “pig general.” Harand got help from the Forces of Darkness. He gave his son to Jogo Zaramzil, who led another army of trolls and men against the fortress of Jarani, Lord of the Mountaintops.
column2: 哈兰德于是发誓要夺取这片土地，并证明自然且永恒的暴力法则。雅拉尼嘲讽他为“勇者之子”和“猪将军”。哈兰德从黑暗势力那里获得了帮助。他将自己的儿子交给约戈·扎拉姆齐尔，后者率领另一支由巨魔和人类组成的军队，进攻山巅之主雅拉尼的堡垒。

column1: When Harand and Jogo Zaramzil attacked, many defenders were slain, including the son of Jarani. The two-faced guardian was killed defending the gate. Then Jarani’s wife recited the call for help. The Lord of Justice had pledged to uphold the claim, and he had been formally called, so Orlanth helped Jarani in his fight. Together they threw the enemy down from the mountains, and confined them to the valleys for as long as the wind blows. This was called the Battle of Arrowmound.
column2: 当哈兰德和约戈·扎拉姆齐尔进攻时，许多守卫者被杀，包括雅拉尼的儿子。双面守护者也在守卫大门时阵亡。随后，雅拉尼的妻子念诵了求援召唤。正义之主已承诺支持此主张，并且得到了正式召唤，于是奥兰斯帮助雅拉尼作战。他们一同将敌人从山上扔下，并将其囚禁在山谷中，直至风吹不息。这场战斗被称为箭丘之战。

column1: During the War of the Gods, even kinfolk fall to fighting amongst one another. To find a new law, Orlanth ascends into the sky and gains the Justice Wand, which he uses to settle a dispute between his people. The loser of the dispute joins with trolls to attack the winner, and Orlanth fights to defeat him.
column2: 在众神之战期间，连亲族也会彼此争斗。为了寻找新的律法，奥兰斯升入天空，获得了正义魔杖，并用它来平息他子民之间的争端。争端中的失败者与巨魔联手进攻胜利者，奥兰斯则战斗并击败了他。

column1: The Pharaoh
column2: 法老

column1: Dragon Pass is our new home. We did not come here because we wanted to. We came here because we had to.
column2: 龙之隘口是我们的新家园。我们来到这里并非出于自愿，而是迫不得已。

column1: We used to live in the land of Kethaela, to the south of Dragon Pass. Kethaela was a good place. Our part of it was called Heortland, after the legendary King Heort, who battled the darkness and gave us our laws. In Heortland, there was plenty to eat, because there were good pastures for our herds and good land to plant. Sometimes our clans fought one another, but that is the way of things.
column2: 我们曾生活在龙之隘口以南的凯瑟拉之地。凯瑟拉是个好地方。我们那片区域被称为赫特兰，以传说中的赫尔特王命名，他曾与黑暗作战，并为我们制定律法。在赫特兰，食物充裕，因为有良好的牧场放牧，也有肥沃的土地耕种。有时我们的部族之间会争斗，但世事本就如此。

column1: Kethaela used to be ruled by a king called The Only Old One. The Only Old One reigned for almost eight hundred years. When the Empire of Wyrm's Friends came, he pledged loyalty to them, but still ruled justly. The people of Orlanth were happy under the Only Old One.
column2: 凯瑟拉曾由一位名叫唯一古老者的国王统治。唯一古老者统治了近八百年。当龙友帝国到来时，他向帝国宣誓效忠，但仍公正地治理国家。奥兰斯的人民在唯一古老者的统治下幸福生活。

column1: In the last centuries of his reign, Kethaela was isolated. It was impossible to sail the seas, which were closed by a long and mysterious curse. To the east, there were the Storm Mountains. To the north, there was Dragon Pass, which was shunned after the Dragonkill War, in which a million soldiers from all over the continent were eaten up by dragons. But the land had much magic, and it was prosperous.
column2: 在他统治的最后几个世纪，凯瑟拉与世隔绝。海洋被一道漫长而神秘的诅咒封锁，无法航行。东边是风暴山脉。北边是龙之隘口，在屠龙战争后，人们避之不及，那场战争中来自大陆各地的百万士兵被巨龙吞噬。但这片土地魔力充沛，繁荣昌盛。

column1: That isolation ended when a stranger tried to take over the land. His name was Belintar. We knew that he had powerful magic, because he swam ashore from the ocean, which was closed and utterly impassable. Belintar, who did not worship gods anyone knew of, claimed sacral kingship. We protested, supporting the ancient rights of the Only Old One. Not all Orlanthi were so righteous as to speak out against Belintar, and civil war ensued.
column2: 这种隔绝状态终结于一个陌生人试图夺取这片土地之时。他名叫贝林塔。我们知道他拥有强大的魔力，因为他从被封锁且完全无法通行的海洋中游上岸。贝林塔不崇拜任何已知的神祇，却宣称自己拥有神圣王权。我们提出抗议，支持唯一古老者的古老权利。并非所有奥兰斯人都如此正义，敢于公开反对贝林塔，于是内战爆发。

column1: Shamefully, the forces of the newcomer won the fighting. Monsters were slain, mountains were made, and rivers changed course. Then Master Belintar again declared himself to be the sacral king, which he called Pharaoh. He declared Kethaela to be a place called the Holy Country. It was holy, he said, because he ruled it.
column2: 可耻的是，外来者的军队赢得了战斗。怪物被屠，山脉被移，河流改道。然后贝林塔大师再次宣称自己是神圣国王，自称法老。他宣布凯瑟拉为一个叫做圣国的地方。他说，因为它由他统治，所以它神圣。

column1: Those of us who had fought the foreigner were gravely affronted by this declaration. Orlanth was holy. Ernalda was holy. Belintar was not holy.
column2: 我们这些曾经反抗外来者的人对此宣言深感愤慨。奥兰斯是神圣的。埃纳尔达是神圣的。贝林塔并不神圣。

column1: We were beaten but unbowed. We refused to acknowledge him as king, though this made things hard for us in what used to be the best of all lands. When his body wore out, Belintar announced a Tournament of the Masters of Luck and Death, to decide whose body Belintar would take over. We laughed and jeered, calling it a sinister trick. We were attacked, persecuted, robbed. We faced a difficult choice. We could submit to the Pharaoh and remain in Heortland, but as little more than thralls. Or we could strike out for haunted Dragon Pass, risking our lives but retaining our freedom.
column2: 我们被打败了，但并未屈服。我们拒绝承认他是国王，尽管这让我们在这片曾经最好的土地上处境艰难。当贝林塔的身体衰老时，他宣布举办一场幸运与死亡大师锦标赛，以决定他的身体将由谁来接管。我们嘲笑讥讽，称之为邪恶的诡计。我们遭受攻击、迫害、掠夺。我们面临艰难抉择：要么臣服于法老，留在赫特兰，但几乎沦为奴隶；要么冒险闯入闹鬼的龙之隘口，冒着生命危险，但保留自由。

column1: Since I am telling you this in our clan hall in Dragon Pass, you know what choice we made.
column2: 既然我是在龙之隘口的部族大厅里告诉你这些，你就知道我们当初做出了什么选择。

column1: Kethaela used to be ruled by a king called The Only Old One. The Only Old One reigned for almost eight hundred years. When the Empire of Wyrm’s Friends came, he pledged loyalty to them, but still ruled justly. The people of Orlanth were happy under the Only Old One.
column2: 凯瑟拉曾由一位称为唯一古老者的国王统治。唯一古老者统治了近八百年。龙之友帝国来临时，他向帝国宣誓效忠，但依然公正治国。奥兰斯的子民在唯一古老者治下生活幸福。

column1: The Pharaoh may be one of the bad people who disturb the world's order, or he may simply be another dangerous ruler. He recently appeared from nowhere in our old homeland of Kethaela, and stole the throne from its old ruler, the immortal Only Old One. We fled Heortland, our part of Kethaela, and came to Dragon Pass to escape his injustice.
column2: 法老也许是扰乱世界秩序的恶人之一，或者他不过又是一个危险的统治者。他最近凭空出现在我们旧日故土凯瑟拉，从古老的不朽统治者唯一古老者手中窃取了王位。我们逃离了凯瑟拉境内的霍特兰，来到龙之隘口以躲避他的暴政。

column1: The Pharaoh may be one of the bad people who disturb the world’s order, or he may simply be another dangerous ruler. He recently appeared from nowhere in our old homeland of Kethaela, and stole the throne from its old ruler, the immortal Only Old One. We fled Heortland, our part of Kethaela, and came to Dragon Pass to escape his injustice.
column2: 法老也许是扰乱世界秩序的恶人之一，或者他不过又是一个危险的统治者。他最近凭空出现在我们旧日故土凯瑟拉，从古老的不朽统治者唯一古老者手中窃取了王位。我们逃离了凯瑟拉境内的霍特兰，来到龙之隘口以躲避他的暴政。

column1: Runes are the building blocks of Glorantha. They are symbols, archetypes, embodiments, and actual matter or energy of the mundane world. Runes originated with the very creation of Glorantha. Their precise origin is unknown, and believers in particular runes always insist that theirs was first-made.
column2: 符文是格洛兰萨的基石。它们是符号、原型、具现，也是凡俗世界中的实际物质或能量。符文源自格洛兰萨最初的创造。其确切起源无人知晓，而特定符文的信奉者总是坚持自己的符文是最先被造出的。

column1: Each rune has myths associated with it. Some have elaborate cycles woven around their stories. In these stories the runes are sometimes treated as things, or beings, or abstract powers, or even all three.
column2: 每个符文都有与之相关的神话。有些符文的故事构筑了精妙的循环。在这些故事里，符文有时被当作事物、有时被当作存在、有时被当作抽象力量，甚至三者兼具。

column1: Elements
column2: 元素

column1: Glorantha is made of five Elements. Air Darkness Earth Fire Water
column2: 格洛兰萨由五大元素构成。气 暗 土 火 水

column1: Forms
column2: 形态

column1: A god is usually described as being of a particular Power or Element; the Form determines how this force is expressed. Beast Chaos Dragonewt Man Plant Spirit
column2: 神祇通常被描述为具有特定力量或元素属性；形态则决定这股力量如何显现。兽 混沌 龙人 人 植物 灵体

column1: Miscellaneous
column2: 杂项

column1: Communications Law
column2: 通讯 律法

column1: Conditions
column2: 条件

column1: Conditions show what aspect of an Element, Form, or Power a god embodies. Infinity Magic Mastery Moon
column2: 条件揭示神祇所体现的元素、形态或力量的某个方面。无限 魔法 主宰 月

column1: Powers
column2: 力量

column1: Said to symbolize members of the Celestial Court, Power runes are unique in that they’re formed in mutually antagonistic pairs. Opposing gods often have opposing Power runes as part of their identities.
column2: 据说象征天廷成员的力量符文独特之处在于它们成对对立。对立的神祇往往也将对立的力量符文作为自身身份的一部分。

column1: Death Disorder Fate Illusion Motion
column2: 死亡 混沌 命运 幻象 运动

column1: Fertility Harmony Luck Truth Stasis
column2: 丰饶 和谐 幸运 真理 停滞

column1: This is the story of the perfect world. The sacred truth is that this story does not have a beginning or an end. But since I am telling you this story here in the world, instead of in the Sacred Time, let's start with a beginning.
column2: 这是关于完美世界的故事。神圣的真相是：这个故事既无开端亦无终结。但既然我是在凡间、而非神圣时间中给你讲这个故事，那就让我们从一个开端讲起吧。

column1: Back when the Storm was new in Glorantha, Umath ripped a place between the earth and the sky for us, his children. Umath was a mighty warrior, but he was only one big powerful god. Like a warrior who does not know how to be a king, Umath never learned how to bring his children together. Finally Umath took too many wounds from all his battles, and gave leadership of the Storm Band over to his sons.
column2: 当年风暴初临格洛兰萨，尤玛特为他的子嗣——我们——撕裂了天地之间的一处空间。尤玛特是个强大的战士，但他不过是个巨大而有力的大神。就像一个不知如何当国王的武士，尤玛特从未学会如何将他的子嗣凝聚在一起。最终尤玛特在无数战斗中伤痕累累，便将暴风乐队的领导权交给了他的儿子们。

column1: For a time, Umath's sons Kolat, Vadrus, Urox, Humakt and Orlanth contested for leadership, but the outcome was never in question. Umath had led the Storm Band because he was strongest. Orlanth was also the strongest, but he became leader because he understood how all the clans of the Storm could be stronger as a single tribe. Only Orlanth had the power and compassion to hold us together.
column2: 有一段时间，尤玛特的儿子们——科拉特、瓦德鲁斯、尤洛克斯、胡马克特和奥兰斯——为争夺领导权而竞争，但结果毫无悬念。尤玛特曾因最强而领导暴风乐队。奥兰斯也最强，但他成为领袖是因为他明白：风暴的所有部族若能结成单一部落，将更加强大。唯有奥兰斯拥有凝聚我们的力量与慈悲。

column1: For many generations, Orlanth ruled with majesty and justice. For a change, all his kin did their best to live up to his example. Urox helped Uralda fight off the Giggling Ticks and didn't even smash her fences. Vadrus was so busy blowing leftover pieces of Yelm's imperial court off the edge of the world that he usually forgot to come back to Orlanth's hall to cause trouble. When the people required Orlanth or another Lawspeaker to mediate for them, the unjust parties always gave up their claims before undergoing the tests!
column2: 历经许多世代，奥兰斯以威严与公正施行统治。作为改变，他的所有亲族都竭力效仿他的榜样。尤洛克斯帮助尤拉尔达击退了咯咯蜱虫，甚至没有砸坏她的栅栏。瓦德鲁斯忙着将耶尔姆残余的朝庭碎片吹到世界边缘，以至于常常忘了返回奥兰斯之厅惹事生非。当子民需要奥兰斯或其他律法师为他们调停时，不义的一方总是在接受试炼之前就放弃了诉求！

column1: Most all our enemies were too scared of what we could do to them to cause trouble. The Blue Tribe fought us in the War of the Gods, but in the Storm Age, Heler kept the whole world fresh and clean with gentle rain. He made the crops grow strong, so that all people enjoyed Ernalda's bounty instead of having to fight for survival.
column2: 我们的大多数敌人因为太过畏惧我们的力量而不敢惹事。蓝部落在众神之战中与我们为敌，但在风暴时代，赫勒以温和的雨水让整个世界保持清新洁净。他使作物茁壮成长，所有人都享受埃尔纳尔达的恩赐，而不必为生存而战。

column1: The Fire Tribe had snubbed Orlanth till he knocked down Yelm, but in the Storm Age, Mahome the Hearth Fire contentedly worked to cook the finest meals for Orlanth and Ernalda's great table.
column2: 火部落曾怠慢奥兰斯，直到他击倒了耶尔姆；但在风暴时代，炉火女神马霍梅心满意足地为奥兰斯与埃尔纳尔达的盛大宴席烹饪最美味佳肴。

column1: Of course there were some who refused Orlanth's hospitality, enemies who stayed enemies. But even though the Dark Tribe was much stronger with Yelm gone, they could only run and hide when Orlanth came dancing with his lightnings. Other enemies are not even worth mentioning — they fell beneath Barntar's plow and Vinga's spear, or simply turned and ran from Humakt.
column2: 当然，也有拒绝奥兰斯好客的人，那些始终为敌的敌人。但即便黑暗部落在耶尔姆消失后强大得多，当奥兰斯带着闪电起舞时，他们也只能逃窜躲藏。其他敌人甚至不值一提——他们倒在了巴恩塔的犁铧和温加的长矛下，或是干脆转身从胡马克特面前逃跑了。

column1: But there were worse enemies, enemies who started as kin, who brought kinstrife and evil to the perfect world and started the Great Darkness. Their cursed names do not belong here. The sacred truth is that there was no end to the Storm Age. The sacred truth is that the Storm Age exists unchanged in the Godplace. If we are good Orlanthi, we can join Orlanth in the perfect world of the Storm.
column2: 但还有更糟的敌人——那些本是血亲的敌人，他们将族内争斗与邪恶带入完美世界，掀起了大黑暗。他们受诅咒的名字不配在此提及。神圣的真相是：风暴时代永无终结。神圣的真相是：风暴时代在神地中永恒不变。如果我们做优秀的奥兰斯信徒，就能在风暴的完美世界中与奥兰斯同在。

column1: This is the story of the perfect world. The sacred truth is that this story does not have a beginning or an end. But since I am telling you this story here in the world, instead of in the Sacred Time, let’s start with a beginning.

column1: For a time, Umath’s sons Kolat, Vadrus, Urox, Humakt and Orlanth contested for leadership, but the outcome was never in question. Umath had led the Storm Band because he was strongest. Orlanth was also the strongest, but he became leader because he understood how all the clans of the Storm could be stronger as a single tribe. Only Orlanth had the power and compassion to hold us together.
column2: 曾有一段时间，乌玛斯的儿子们——科拉特、瓦德鲁斯、乌洛克斯、胡马克特和奥兰斯——为领导权而争斗，但结果从未有过悬念。乌玛斯曾领导暴风乐队，因为他最强。奥兰斯也是最强的，但他之所以成为领袖，是因为他懂得风暴的所有部族如何能作为一个单一部落变得更强大。唯有奥兰斯拥有将我们凝聚在一起的力量与仁心。

column1: For many generations, Orlanth ruled with majesty and justice. For a change, all his kin did their best to live up to his example. Urox helped Uralda fight off the Giggling Ticks and didn’t even smash her fences. Vadrus was so busy blowing leftover pieces of Yelm’s imperial court off the edge of the world that he usually forgot to come back to Orlanth’s hall to cause trouble. When the people required Orlanth or another Lawspeaker to mediate for them, the unjust parties always gave up their claims before undergoing the tests!
column2: 历经许多世代，奥兰斯以威严与公正统治。作为转变，所有他的亲族都尽力效仿他的榜样。乌洛克斯帮助乌拉尔达击退了“咯咯笑之虱”，甚至没有砸坏她的栅栏。瓦德鲁斯忙于将耶尔姆帝国宫廷的残骸吹到世界边缘，通常都忘记回到奥兰斯的大厅制造麻烦。当人们需要奥兰斯或其他律法师为他们调解时，不义的一方总是在接受考验前就放弃了主张！

column1: Most all our enemies were too scared of what we could do to them to cause trouble. The Blue Tribe fought us in the War of the Gods, but in the Storm Age, Heler kept the whole world fresh and clean with gentle rain. He made the crops grow strong, so that all people enjoyed Ernalda’s bounty instead of having to fight for survival.
column2: 大多数敌人因为太害怕我们对他们能做的事而不敢惹麻烦。蓝部落在众神之战中与我们交战，但在风暴时代，赫勒尔以温和的雨水使整个世界清新洁净。他让庄稼茁壮成长，所有人都享受埃尔纳尔达的丰饶，而不必为生存而战。

column2: 火焰部落曾冷落奥兰斯，直到他击倒了耶尔姆，但在风暴时代，炉火女神马霍梅满足地为奥兰斯和埃尔纳尔达的盛宴大桌烹制最精美的饭菜。

column1: When Orlanth's marriage to Ernalda was new, he spent much time enjoying the sweet secrets of his bride. But at length he grew restless, and began to think again of his enemy the Emperor. Ernalda saw that he was turbulent inside, and said to him, "You will never beat the Emperor by yourself, for when you fight the Emperor you also fight his tribe, the Fire Tribe. If you really want something to rival what the Emperor has, you must make a new thing, like the Fire Tribe, but better."
column2: 当奥兰斯与埃尔纳尔达新婚之际，他花了许多时间品味新娘的甜美秘密。但不久他便躁动不安，开始再次想起他的敌人——那位皇帝。埃尔纳尔达见他内心激荡，便对他说：“你单凭自己是无法打败皇帝的，因为你与皇帝交锋时，也是在和他的部族——火焰部落——战斗。如果你真的想要能与皇帝匹敌之物，就必须创造一样新东西，像火焰部落那样，但要更好。”

column1: Ernalda's words troubled Orlanth, and he walked the world and let them rattle around inside him. The Doubting Wheel rolled towards him, and said that Orlanth should not make a tribe.
column2: 埃尔纳尔达的话困扰着奥兰斯，他在大地上行走，让这些话在心中回响不止。疑虑之轮朝他滚来，说奥兰斯不应创建部落。

column1: Orlanth captured the Doubting Wheel in a great net, and took it home to Ernalda, who cooked it up in a soup. "It is nothing to be afraid of now," she said.
column2: 奥兰斯用一张大网捕获了疑虑之轮，把它带回家交给埃尔纳尔达，她将它煮成了一锅汤。“现在它没什么好怕的了，”她说。

column1: So Orlanth wandered again, until he found his brother Yinkin, who was chief of the Cat Clan. Yinkin said, "My clan is badly pressed by the Plant Tribe, which fights us for our hunting ground." So Orlanth fought Rustling Veins and the Sharp Green, and bested them. He said, "Now you must join my Storm Tribe." Yinkin agreed to make the Cat Clan part of the Storm Tribe, so long as this new tribe had a way of remembering its good laws.
column2: 于是奥兰斯再次流浪，直到找到他的兄弟银金——猫氏族的首领。银金说：“我的氏族正被植物部落逼得走投无路，他们为争夺狩猎场而与我们交战。”于是奥兰斯与簌簌叶脉和锐绿作战，击败了他们。他说：“现在你必须加入我的风暴部落。”银金同意让猫氏族成为风暴部落的一部分，条件是这新部落要有铭记其优良律法的方式。

column1: So Orlanth searched for some good laws, and found the Knowing God, who was head of the Marks On Bark Clan. The Knowing God was trapped inside a great cube. He said that the Stone Tribe had put him in there. Orlanth ruined the cube so that it fell apart. Orlanth gave the Knowing God one of Yinkin's old claws, and said, "Now you must join my Storm Tribe, and help us remember our good laws." The Knowing God agreed to make the Marks On Bark Clan part of the Storm Tribe, so long as this new tribe had fierce warriors.
column2: 于是奥兰斯寻找优良律法，找到了全知之神——树皮印记氏族的首领。全知之神被困在一个巨大的立方体内。他说是石头部落把他关进去的。奥兰斯摧毁了立方体，使其碎裂。奥兰斯给了全知之神一枚银金的旧爪，说：“现在你必须加入我的风暴部落，并帮我们铭记优良律法。”全知之神同意让树皮印记氏族加入风暴部落，条件是这新部落要有勇猛的战士。

column1: Orlanth brought them together into one big moot, and soon everyone was fighting and blaming him. "You said Yinkin would not be here!" Vadrus cried. "If you put yourself above all others, you will be just as bad as the Emperor. You will take freedom from the people, and make unjust decrees. People will expect you to tell them what to do, and in so doing they will steal your own freedom, which is the thing you value most."
column2: 埃尔纳尔达的话困扰着奥兰斯，他在世间游走，任这些话在心中回响。疑虑之轮向他滚来，说奥兰斯不该创建一个部落。“如果你把自己置于所有人之上，你就会和皇帝一样坏。你会剥夺人民的自由，颁布不公正的法令。人们会指望你告诉他们该做什么，而这样一来，他们就会偷走你的自由——那是你最珍视的东西。”

column1: Orlanth captured the Doubting Wheel in a great net, and took it home to Ernalda, who cooked it up in a soup until it was small and silver. "It is nothing to be afraid of now," she said. "Take it and use it to make the tribe I told you about."
column2: 奥兰斯用一张大网捕获了疑虑之轮，带回家交给埃尔纳尔达。她把它煮成汤，直到它变得又小又银白。“现在没什么好怕的了，”她说，“拿着它，用它来打造我告诉你的那个部落。”

column1: So Orlanth wandered again, until he found his brother Yinkin, who was chief of the Cat Clan. Yinkin said, "My clan is badly pressed by the Plant Tribe, which fights us for our hunting ground." So Orlanth fought Rustling Veins and the Sharp Green, and bested them. He gave the small silver thing to Yinkin and said, "Now you must join my Storm Tribe." Yinkin agreed to make the Cat Clan part of the Storm Tribe, so long as this new tribe had a way of remembering its good laws.
column2: 于是奥兰斯再次流浪，直到找到他的兄弟银金——猫氏族的首领。银金说：“我的氏族正被植物部落严重压制，他们为争夺狩猎地而与我们战斗。”于是奥兰斯与簌簌叶脉和锐绿交战，并击败了他们。他把那个银色小物件给了银金，说：“现在你必须加入我的风暴部落。”银金同意让猫氏族成为风暴部落的一部分，只要这个新部落有办法记住它的优良律法。

column1: So Orlanth searched for some good laws, and found the Knowing God, who was head of the Marks On Bark Clan. The Knowing God was trapped inside a great cube. He said that the Stone Tribe had put him in there, because he tried to make new knowledge about them, and the Stone Tribe hated new things. Orlanth ruined the cube by creating a new poem, which confused it so that it fell apart. Orlanth gave the Knowing God one of Yinkin's old claws, and said, "Now you must join my Storm Tribe, and help us remember our good laws." The Knowing God agreed to make the Marks On Bark Clan part of the Storm Tribe, so long as this new tribe had fierce warriors.
column2: 于是奥兰斯去寻找良法，找到了全知之神——树皮印记氏族的首领。全知之神被困在一个巨大的立方体内。他说石头部落把他关在里面，因为他试图创造关于他们的新知识，而石头部落憎恨新生事物。奥兰斯创作了一首新诗，令那立方体陷入混乱、自行瓦解。奥兰斯将银金的一枚旧爪赠予全知之神，说道：“现在你必须加入我的风暴部落，并帮助我们牢记我们的良法。”全知之神同意让树皮印记氏族成为风暴部落的一部分，只要这个新部落拥有勇猛的战士。

column1: So Orlanth looked for fierce warriors, and found his brother Vadrus, who was boss of the Hurt Everything Clan. Vadrus wanted to go off to fight the Blue Tribe, and wouldn't listen to Orlanth's plan. So Orlanth said they should arm-wrestle instead. He defeated Vadrus, and gave Vadrus a lock of the Knowing God's beard, and said "Now you must join my Storm Tribe." Vadrus said that the Hurt Everything Clan would join the Storm Tribe, but not if Yinkin's Cat Clan were part of it. "Yinkin scratched me, and made my essence pour out, and I will not attend a moot if he is there," Vadrus said. Orlanth said nothing about Yinkin and went on his way.
column2: 于是奥兰斯去寻找勇猛的战士，找到了他的兄弟瓦德鲁斯——伤害万物氏族的头领。瓦德鲁斯想去攻打蓝部落，不愿听从奥兰斯的计划。于是奥兰斯提议改为掰手腕。他击败了瓦德鲁斯，将全知之神的一绺胡须交给瓦德鲁斯，说道：“现在你必须加入我的风暴部落。”瓦德鲁斯说伤害万物氏族可以加入风暴部落，但银金的猫氏族不能在其中。“银金抓伤了我，让我的精髓外流，如果他在场，我不会出席集会。”瓦德鲁斯说。奥兰斯对银金的事只字未提，便继续上路了。

column1: Orlanth collected other clans on his journeys. Some of them we remember today. Others later left the tribe, or caused trouble, just like Vadrus' Hurt Everything Clan. And others we have forgotten completely.
column2: 奥兰斯在旅途中收拢了其他氏族。其中一些我们至今记得。另一些后来脱离了部落，或惹出了麻烦，就像瓦德鲁斯的伤害万物氏族那样。而还有一些，我们已经完全遗忘了。

column1: Later, he asked Ernalda how the Night Tribe had known to come to the big moot, but his bountiful wife just smiled, and Orlanth thought about something else, instead.
column2: 后来，他问厄娜尔达夜族是如何得知要来参加那场盛大集会的，但他慷慨的妻子只是微笑，于是奥兰斯转而思索起别的来。

column1: When Orlanth’s marriage to Ernalda was new, he spent much time enjoying the sweet secrets of his bride. But at length he grew restless, and began to think again of his enemy the Emperor, who had shamed him and deprived him of his rightful influence in the world. Ernalda saw that he was turbulent inside, and said to him, “You will never beat the Emperor by yourself, for when you fight the Emperor you also fight his tribe, the Fire Tribe. If you really want something to rival what the Emperor has, you must make a new thing, like the Fire Tribe, but better.”
column2: 当奥兰斯与厄娜尔达新婚之初，他花了许多时间享受新娘的甜蜜秘密。但过了一阵，他变得焦躁不安，又开始想起他的敌人——那位曾经羞辱他、剥夺他在世界上应有影响力的皇帝。厄娜尔达看出他内心动荡，便对他说：“你永远无法独自击败皇帝，因为与皇帝作战就是与他的部落——火焰部落作战。你若真想拥有能与皇帝匹敌的东西，就必须创造一个新事物，像火焰部落那样，但要更好。”

column1: Ernalda’s words troubled Orlanth, and he walked the world and let them rattle around inside him. The Doubting Wheel rolled towards him, and said that Orlanth should not make a tribe. “If you put yourself above all others, you will be just as bad as the Emperor. You will take freedom from the people, and make unjust decrees. People will expect you to tell them what to do, and in so doing they will steal your own freedom, which is the thing you value most.”
column2: 厄娜尔达的话让奥兰斯心烦意乱，他走遍世界，让这些话在心中翻腾。疑虑之轮滚到他面前，说奥兰斯不应建立部落。“你若将自己置于一切之上，就会变得和皇帝一样坏。你会夺走人民的自由，颁布不公的律令。人们会指望你告诉他们该做什么，而这样做就会偷走你自己的自由——那正是你最珍视的东西。”

Yinkin said, “My clan is badly pressed by the Plant Tribe, which fights us for our hunting ground.” So Orlanth fought Rustling Veins and the Sharp Green, and bested them. He gave the small silver thing to Yinkin and said, “Now you must join my Storm Tribe.” Yinkin agreed to make the Cat Clan part of the Storm Tribe, so long as this new tribe had a way of remembering its good laws.

He said that the Stone Tribe had put him in there, because he tried to make new knowledge about them, and the Stone Tribe hated new things. Orlanth ruined the cube by creating a new poem, which confused it so that it fell apart. Orlanth gave the Knowing God one of Yinkin’s old claws, and said, “Now you must join my Storm Tribe, and help us remember our good laws.” The Knowing God agreed to make the Marks On Bark Clan part of the Storm Tribe, so long as this new tribe had fierce warriors.

Vadrus wanted to go off to fight the Blue Tribe, and wouldn’t listen to Orlanth’s plan. So Orlanth said they should arm-wrestle instead. He defeated Vadrus, and gave Vadrus a lock of the Knowing God’s beard, and said “Now you must join my Storm Tribe.” Vadrus said that the Hurt Everything Clan would join the Storm Tribe, but not if Yinkin’s Cat Clan were part of it. “Yinkin scratched me, and made my essence pour out, and I will not attend a moot if he is there,” Vadrus said. Orlanth said nothing about Yinkin and went on his way.
column2: 于是奥兰斯寻找凶猛的战士，找到了他的兄弟瓦德鲁斯，他是伤害万物氏族的首领。瓦德鲁斯想去攻打蓝部落，不愿听奥兰斯的计划。于是奥兰斯说他们应该比腕力。他击败了瓦德鲁斯，给了瓦德鲁斯一绺全知之神的胡须，并说：“现在你必须加入我的风暴部落。”瓦德鲁斯说伤害万物氏族会加入风暴部落，但前提是银金的猫氏族不是其中一部分。“银金抓伤了我，让我的精华流出，如果他在场，我不会参加集会，”瓦德鲁斯说道。奥兰斯对银金只字未提，继续上路。

column1: Orlanth collected other clans on his journeys. Some of them we remember today. Others later left the tribe, or caused trouble, just like Vadrus’ Hurt Everything Clan. And others we have forgotten completely.
column2: 奥兰斯在旅途中收集了其他氏族。其中一些我们今天还记得。其他的后来离开了部落，或惹了麻烦，就像瓦德鲁斯的伤害万物氏族一样。还有一些我们完全忘记了。

column1: Sword Story
column2: 剑的故事

column1: In the old days there was no death or violence. There was simply no need for it. There was more than enough room for everything to grow without limit, and everything did. Voria was born the first time when earth peeped above the ancient sea. When Ernalda was grown there was the Green Age. When she had enough golden grain to hoard then there was the Golden Age.
column2: 古时没有死亡或暴力。根本不需要。有足够多的空间让万物无限生长，而万物确实如此生长。当大地从远古海洋中首次露出时，沃里亚第一次诞生。当厄纳尔达长大时，绿色时代来临。当她拥有足够多的金色谷物可以储藏时，黄金时代来临。

column1: When people had not enough food, they began to quarrel over it. Then the goddess invented gold, and tried to use it to pacify her people. It only gave them more to be greedy for. Greed became so great that even the gods were infected, especially Yelm, who wanted all the gold for himself.
column2: 当人们没有足够的食物时，他们开始为此争吵。然后女神发明了黄金，试图用它来安抚她的人民。但这只让他们更加贪婪。贪婪变得如此之大，以至于连众神都感染了，尤其是耶尔姆，他想把所有黄金都占为己有。

column1: Fighting broke out among the gods, at first for greed but later for revenge, anger, and hatred. This was called the Gods War.
column2: 众神之间爆发了战斗，起初是因贪婪，后来则是为了复仇、愤怒和仇恨。这被称为神战。

column1: There was a god named Eurmal who did not have much going for him. He was less than a stickpicker, because he had no kin, no friends, and no place to live. He had no ring.
column2: 有一个名叫厄尔马的神，他没什么出息。他连个拾柴人都不如，因为他没有亲属，没有朋友，也没有住的地方。他没有长老会席位。

column1: Eurmal always desperately wished to impress his betters. When the Gods War became very violent he was hiding in the dark place, and he saw something which he had not seen before. So he took it.
column2: 厄尔马总是拼命想给他的上司们留下好印象。当神战变得非常激烈时，他躲在黑暗之地，看见了一些他从未见过的东西。于是他把那东西拿走了。

column1: He went to the first person he saw, who was Grandfather Life, the first person. Eurmal asked Grandfather if he wanted to try out this new thing.
column2: 他去找他看到的第一个人，那是生命祖父，第一个人。厄尔马问祖父是否想试试这个新东西。

column1: Grandfather would have refused, but he had previously passed up chances to be Master of Thunder and Lord of Mirror-polishing, and he was sorry he had lost those powers. He agreed to try out Eurmal's new find, and so Grandfather became Grandfather Mortal when he died. He was the first person to ever die, and because of that all of us descendants must die.
column2: 祖父本想拒绝，但他之前错过了成为雷霆之主和磨镜之主的机会，他后悔失去了那些力量。他同意试试厄尔马的新发现，于是祖父在死时成为了凡人祖父。他是第一个死去的人，正因如此，我们所有后代都必须死去。

column1: Eurmal went then to Humakt to show him the Death thing. Humakt was a god, and he did not have any misunderstanding about it. He used it first to sever his ties from his kin, and so he absolved his king for the heinous deeds which he, the God of Death, would do after that. Orlanth was so moved that he has always respected Humakt for his honor and fierce code, and gives him a place on the Ring even though he is a foreigner.
column2: 厄尔马随后去找胡马克特，给他看死亡这东西。胡马克特是一位神，他对它没有任何误解。他首先用它切断了自己与亲属的联系，如此一来，他——死亡之神——此后所做的可憎之事，他的国王便得以免责。奥兰斯深受感动，因此始终尊敬胡马克特的荣誉和严酷准则，并让他在长老会中占有一席之地，尽管他是个外人。

column1: When Orlanth saw the new thing wielded by Humakt, he wanted to use it in one of his contests against the Emperor. He took it to the Weapon Contest. Yelm loosed his far-flying arrows. Then Orlanth wielded Death, in the shape of a sword, and so the Emperor was the first God to die. Howling, the Emperor fled on the trail which Grandfather had taken, and hid in the Underworld.
column2: 当奥兰斯看到胡马克特挥舞的新东西时，他想在对抗皇帝的一场比赛中使用它。他把它带到了武器比赛。耶尔姆射出了他远飞的箭。然后奥兰斯挥舞死亡，以剑的形态，于是皇帝成为第一个死去的众神。皇帝嚎叫着，沿着祖父走过的路逃走，躲进了冥界。

column1: One day Orlanth scolded Eurmal and so Eurmal tricked Orlanth with a copy, and took back the sword, Death. Then Eurmal lost it in a guessing game as part of a wager with Warlord Elf. Elf enchanted it to be an axe, and cut down his dwarf foes.
column2: 一天，奥兰斯责骂厄尔马，于是厄尔马用一个仿制品欺骗了奥兰斯，收回了那把剑，即死亡。然后厄尔马在与军阀精灵的打赌中，在一个猜谜游戏里把它输掉了。精灵将它附魔为一把斧头，砍倒了他的矮人敌人。

column1: For a laugh, Eurmal tripped Warlord Elf and the weapon fell into the hands of Ironman, the dwarf hero. He then cut down the elves. Eurmal offered to make many copies for him, and greedy Ironman agreed. Confused by so many, Ironman did not miss the original Death which Trickster stole.
column2: 为了寻开心，厄尔马绊倒了军阀精灵，武器落入了铁人——矮人英雄——的手中。他接着砍倒了精灵。厄尔马提出要为他做很多仿制品，贪婪的铁人同意了。由于仿制品太多而困惑，铁人没注意到骗子偷走了原始的死亡。

column1: Then many gods got a hold of the weapon, and they were quick to use it. In this way the power of Death was passed among all of the tribes and all of the gods who wished to wield such a thing, and Death was held prisoner without honor.
column2: 然后许多众神都得到了那武器，他们迅速使用它。就这样，死亡的力量在所有部落和所有希望使用这东西的众神之间传递，死亡被囚禁，毫无尊严。

column1: When Orlanth and the Lightbringers reached the edge of the world, they had to enter into the Underworld to continue their travel. At that place, where sky, earth and sea meet, Orlanth gave up his possession and attachment to Death, and he named Humakt to be the honorable wielder of it. In this way Orlanth gained entry into the Land of the Dead, and with that judgment Humakt gained control of Death once again.
column2: 当奥兰斯与光明使者抵达世界边缘时，他们必须进入冥界才能继续旅程。在那天空、大地与海洋交汇之处，奥兰斯放弃了自身对死亡的拥有与执着，并命名胡玛克特为其光荣的执掌者。如此，奥兰斯得以进入死者之地，而凭此裁决，胡玛克特再度掌控了死亡。

column1: Grandfather would have refused, but he had previously passed up chances to be Master of Thunder and Lord of Mirror-polishing, and he was sorry he had lost those powers. He agreed to try out Eurmal’s new find, and so Grandfather became Grandfather Mortal when he died. He was the first person to ever die, and because of that all of us descendants must die.
column2: 凡人祖父本可拒绝，但他此前已错失成为雷霆之主与擦镜之尊的机会，并为失去那些力量而懊悔。他同意试用尤尔马尔的新发现，于是凡人祖父在死去时成为了凡人祖父。他是第一个死去的人，正因如此，我们所有后裔都必须死去。

column1: A pathetic fellow called Eurmal finds a new weapon called Death, and uses it to slay Grandfather Mortal. He shows it to Orlanth's brother, Humakt, who takes it from him. Despite Humakt's attempts to control it, use of the weapon spreads, and soon killing becomes commonplace.
column2: 一个名叫尤尔马尔的可悲家伙发现了一种名为“死亡”的新武器，并用它杀害了凡人祖父。他将此物给奥兰斯的兄弟胡玛克特看，胡玛克特便从他手中夺走。尽管胡玛克特试图控制它，但武器的使用仍在扩散，很快杀戮便变得司空见惯。

column1: A pathetic fellow called Eurmal finds a new weapon called Death, and uses it to slay Grandfather Mortal. He shows it to Orlanth’s brother, Humakt, who takes it from him. Despite Humakt’s attempts to control it, use of the weapon spreads, and soon killing becomes commonplace.
column2: 一个名叫尤尔马尔的可悲家伙发现了一种名为“死亡”的新武器，并用它杀害了凡人祖父。他将此物给奥兰斯的兄弟胡玛克特看，胡玛克特便从他手中夺走。尽管胡玛克特试图控制它，但武器的使用仍在扩散，很快杀戮便变得司空见惯。

column1: A long time ago, before Umath, before Yelm, and long before Orlanth and his brothers, there was the cow mother, Uralda. She lived in good pasture land, and ate well. Her children were fat and happy. Everything was good.
column2: 很久以前，在乌马斯出现之前，在耶尔姆出现之前，早在奥兰斯与他的兄弟之前，有一位母牛女神，名叫乌拉尔达。她生活在丰美的牧场上，吃得好。她的子嗣们肥壮快乐。一切都很美好。

column1: Then the two-legs came. They asked the bulls for help. The two-legs had found this thing called hunger, and wanted the bulls to scare it away. Of course, the bulls just scared the two-legs away. They didn't bother to tell Uralda that the two-legs had come. But Uralda saw the two-legs from a hill, and paid attention to where they went.
column2: 后来两足生物来了。他们向公牛们求助。这些两足生物发现了名为饥饿之物，想让公牛们将它吓跑。当然，公牛们只是把两足生物吓走了。他们懒得告诉乌拉尔达两足生物来过。但乌拉尔达从山丘上看到了两足生物，并留意了他们去了哪里。

column1: Then the biting things came. There were the small biting things who ran circles around Uralda's children. There were the large biting things who jumped out of gullies and from on top of rocks, who knocked down the cows and tore out their throats. And there were all kinds of biting things in between. Uralda did not have the kind of magic that could stop this.
column2: 接着噬咬之物来了。有小的噬咬之物绕着乌拉尔达的子嗣们打转；有大的噬咬之物从沟壑和岩石顶上跃出，撞倒母牛，撕裂它们的喉咙；还有介于两者之间的各种噬咬之物。乌拉尔达没有能阻止这一切的魔法。

column1: So Uralda went on a long journey to the place where the two-legs came from. She was bitten by small things, and by large things, and by things in between.
column2: 于是乌拉尔达踏上了漫长的旅途，前往两足生物来的地方。她被小东西咬，被大东西咬，也被介于两者之间的东西咬。

column1: She went into the two-leg camp. The two-legged bulls tried to stop her and pen her up, but she made her way to the mother of the two-legged herd, whose name was Ernalda.
column2: 她走进了两足生物的营地。那两足的公牛试图阻拦她，把她圈起来，但她还是来到了两足兽群之母面前，她的名字叫厄纳尔达。

column1: Life is almost good, Ernalda said. "The grasses and grains I make for the people are good, but not enough. Thus, my children have found this new thing called hunger, and I do not know what to do."
column2: “生活差不多是好的，”厄纳尔达说，“我为人们创造的草和谷物很好，但不够。因此，我的孩子们发现了这个名为饥饿的新东西，我不知道该怎么办。”

column1: I have a plan, Uralda said.
column2: “我有个计划，”乌拉尔达说。

column1: Uralda went back home, this time with some of Ernalda's two-legged bulls to protect her. She told her bulls to tell the herd to get ready for a journey to the land of the two-legs.
column2: 乌拉尔达这次带着一些厄纳尔达的两足公牛保护她，回到了家乡。她吩咐她的公牛们告诉兽群，准备前往两足生物之地。

column1: They made the journey, and at first the herd was happy. The two-legs made sure they had plenty of grass to eat, and gave them a new thing called shelter when it became too cold to live.
column2: 它们踏上旅程，起初兽群很开心。两足生物确保它们有充足的草吃，并在天气太冷无法生存时给了它们一种叫庇护的新东西。

column1: But then the bulls made a terrible discovery! Some of the cows were disappearing. They saw the two-legs cutting up their bodies, roasting their flesh, and devouring it as a cow would devour grass! "You tricked us," they said to Uralda. "These two-legs are just like the biting things, except now we are trapped!"
column2: 但后来公牛们有了一个可怕的发现！有些牛不见了。它们看到两足生物切分它们的身体，烤它们的肉，像牛吃草一样吞食它们！“你骗了我们，”它们对乌拉尔达说，“这些两足生物跟噬咬之物一样，只不过现在我们被困住了！”

column1: Uralda said, "If the two-legs find in us a way to banish the thing called hunger, our herd will prosper. For every one of us they take, the biting things would have taken two. Trust to your goddess, and go out and be bulls again."
column2: 乌拉尔达说：“如果两足生物从我们身上找到驱逐名为饥饿之物的办法，我们的兽群就会兴旺。他们每带走我们一个，噬咬之物本会带走两个。相信你的女神，出去再次做公牛吧。”

column1: Not long after, the cows made a terrible discovery! "That strange feeling we get every morning — it is the two-legs, stealing the milk meant for our children! These two-legs are worse than the biting things. By taking our milk, they are stealing our next generation!"
column2: 不久之后，母牛们又有了一个可怕的发现！“我们每天早晨得到的奇怪感觉——那是两足生物在偷本该属于我们孩子的奶！这些两足生物比噬咬之物更坏。通过偷我们的奶，他们在偷走我们的下一代！”

column1: Uralda said, "This is why you are the herd, and I am the goddess. Don't you see that if we treat the two-leg children as our own, that there will be many more two-leg children, brought up on our nourishing milk? They will prosper and multiply, and everywhere they go they will take some of our real children. And those children will become mothers and have more children. With our help, the two-legs will cover the world, and wherever they go, there will be cows. Fat and happy cows. Now trust to your goddess, and go out and be cows again."

column1: Uralda, mother of cows, finds that her four-legged people are under attack by biting things, so she convinces them to give themselves over to the protection of Ernalda, earth mother of the two-legged people. The four-legs gain safety, and the two-legs are freed from hunger.
column2: 乌拉尔达，群牛之母，发现她的四足子民正遭受噬咬之物的攻击，于是说服他们将自己托付给埃尔纳尔达——两足子民的大地母亲——的保护。四足者获得了安全，两足者则从饥饿中解脱。

column1: To bless a cow, you have to think like a cow. This is the story the cows told Ernalda a long time ago, and we preserve it and keep it a secret from the bulls, both the four-legged and the two-legged varieties.
column2: 要祝福一头牛，你得像牛一样思考。这是很久以前牛群对埃尔纳尔达讲述的故事，我们将其保存下来，对公牛们——无论是四足的还是两足的种类——都保守秘密。

column1: A long time ago, before Umath, before Yelm, and long before Orlanth and his brothers, there was the cow mother, Uralda. She lived in good pasture land, and ate well. Her children were fat and happy. Her bulls were virile and thought they were in charge. When one bull became weak, another good bull came along and took his place. Everything was good.
column2: 很久以前，在乌玛斯之前，在耶尔姆之前，远在奥兰斯和他的兄弟之前，就有母牛女神乌拉尔达。她住在丰美的牧场上，吃得很好。她的孩子们肥美又快乐。她的公牛们精力旺盛，自以为大权在握。当一头公牛衰弱时，另一头好公牛便会接替他的位置。一切都很好。

column1: Then the two-legs came. They asked the bulls for help. The two-legs had found this thing called hunger, and wanted the bulls to scare it away. Of course, the bulls just scared the two-legs away, because they always took the easiest choice that presented itself at the moment. They didn't bother to tell Uralda that the two-legs had come. But Uralda saw the two-legs from a hill, and paid attention to where they went.

column1: So Uralda went on a long journey to the place where the two-legs came from. She was bitten by small things, and by large things, and by things in between. If she had been thinking only of herself, they would have been strong enough to tear her to pieces. But because she was thinking of her children, they could slow her, but could not stop her, no matter how much of her meat they took.

column2: 但随后公牛们有了一个可怕的发现！一些牛正在消失。它们看到两腿生物切割它们的身体，烘烤它们的肉，像牛啃草一样吞噬！公牛们颤抖着来到乌尔达面前，虚张声势已荡然无存。“你欺骗了我们，”他们对乌尔达说。“这些两腿生物与噬咬之物一般无二，只是如今我们被困住了！”

column1: Uralda said, “Bulls never understand that a little lost blood is nothing, when there is life to be given. If the two-legs find in us a way to banish the thing called hunger, our herd will prosper. For every one of us they take, the biting things would have taken two. Trust to your goddess, and go out and be bulls again.”
column2: 乌尔达说：“公牛永远不会明白，些许失血算不得什么，当生命可以被给予的时候。如果两腿生物在我们身上找到驱逐名为饥饿之物的方法，我们的牛群将繁荣。它们每夺走我们中的一个，噬咬之物本会夺走两个。相信你的女神，出去，再次做公牛吧。”
